*Tardelli Ronan Coelho Stekel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MTEB-PT,一个面向巴西葡萄牙语的原生文本嵌入基准,包含 22 个跨 7 大类别的本土任务,在 93 个模型(73 个开源 + 20 个商业 API)上进行系统评测,并引入了一套包含 Bootstrap 置信区间、配对显著性检验、IRT 区分度分析和 Borda 计数鲁棒性检验的统计学严谨性层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语拥有逾 2 亿母语使用者,但目前缺乏一个综合性的本土嵌入基准。现有评估主要依赖英文基准的机器翻译版本(如 mMARCO-PT),而多语言排行榜(MTEB/MMTEB)中的葡萄牙语任务占比小、覆盖薄。翻译会带来噪声、领域漂移和习语扁平化等系统性伪影,可能掩盖模型在原生文本上的真实差异。因此需要一个原生、非翻译的评测基准,并在评测方法中引入统计严谨性以避免单一分数误导。

Method: 1) 任务构建:从法律、医学、税务、科学、百科、社交媒体等领域的现有巴西葡萄牙语资源中精选 22 个任务(4 分类、1 多标签分类、2 对分类、2 STS、5 聚类、6 检索、2 重排),其中 22 项任务由 17 个语料支撑,4 个语料(ASSIN、Quati、JurisTCU、MedPT)被多协议复用;2) 模型覆盖:评测 93 个模型(23M–27B 参数,涵盖 5 大类:Decoder-LLM 嵌入器 32 个、多语言编码器 12 个、商业 API 20 个、葡萄牙语专用编码器 16 个、Sentence-Transformer 基线 13 个);3) 评估协议:沿用 MTEB 各类别指标(分类用逻辑回归探针,聚类用 V-measure,检索用 nDCG@10,STS 用 Spearman 相关),统一截断 512 token;4) 统计学层:每任务 Bootstrap CI、配对 Bootstrap 显著性、任务级与实例级 IRT 区分度分析、Borda 鲁棒性检验、跨排行榜 Spearman 相关;5) 多样性诊断:对 100 文档/任务的均值嵌入做相关性检验,识别潜在的近重复任务。

Result: 1) 排序能力:93 个模型中 22 任务均分从 0.248 到 0.682(随机基线 0.18),基准可清晰分离 78.7% 的模型对,形成约 12 个可辨层级;2) 前沿收敛:前 6 名(gemini-embedding-001 居首,0.682;Qwen3-Embedding-8B、KaLM-Embedding-Gemma3-12B-2511、voyage-context-4、Octen-Embedding-8B、Qwen3-Embedding-4B)两两均值差仅约 0.005,无一对在 P(A>B)>0.95 下被分辨,共同构成一个未解的前沿层级;3) 开源力量:Apache-2.0 许可的 Qwen3-Embedding-8B(0.670)进入前沿层级,308M 的 embeddinggemma-300m 排名第 13(0.649),距冠军仅 0.033;4) 类别区分度:检索任务区分度 a_t∈[1.49, 2.05] 最高,聚类 a_t∈[0.67, 1.22] 最低,MedPTRetrieval(a_t=2.05)最强,FactckBr(a_t=0.47)最弱;5) 葡萄牙语专用编码器:在检索上落后多语言编码器(0.331 vs 0.517, p=0.003),但控制训练目标后(只比检索调优的 Serafim)差距消失(0.516 vs 0.517, p=0.99),说明差距源于训练目标与领域而非语言;6) 跨排行榜:与 HuggingFace MTEB 多语言榜的 Spearman ρ=0.754(n=55),仅中等程度预测,例如 Llama-Embed-Nemotron-8B 在多语言榜排第 3、在 MTEB-PT 排第 49;7) 性价比前沿:商业 API 中 4 个为 Pareto 最优(voyage-3.5-lite、voyage-4、voyage-context-4、gemini-embedding-001),开源前沿在 300M 处出现拐点,更大模型并未延伸前沿;8) 实例级 IRT:K=50 个最高信息量样本即可恢复完整排名(Kendall τ=0.66–0.90),远优于随机抽样。

Conclusion: MTEB-PT 证明:(a) 葡萄牙语嵌入评测在原生数据上得出与多语言排行榜中度相关但显著不同的结论,多语言榜不能替代本土基准;(b) 顶级质量不依赖商业 API,Apache-2.0 开源模型可达前沿层;(c) 前沿层内模型统计上不可区分,选择应转向成本、许可、延迟、上下文长度等运营维度;(d) 葡萄牙语专用编码器的检索劣势由训练目标而非语言本身导致,改进方向是对多语言/Decoder-LLM 基座进行本土检索数据微调。论文贡献的统计学层(Bootstrap CI、配对显著性、IRT 区分度、Borda 检验)可作为其他语言 MTEB 扩展的可复用模板。所有代码(Apache-2.0)、结果(CC-BY 4.0)与交互式排行榜均已开源发布。

Abstract: Text embeddings for Portuguese have no dedicated benchmark: evaluation rests on translated corpora such as English MS MARCO or on thin multilingual coverage, with native tasks scattered and unconsolidated. We introduce MTEB-PT, a benchmark of 22 native Brazilian-Portuguese tasks across seven categories (classification, multilabel classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, clustering, retrieval, and reranking), admitting only data created or found in Portuguese and excluding translations by construction. We evaluate 93 models spanning 23M to 27B parameters: 73 open-weight and 20 closed commercial APIs. Alongside the leaderboard we report a statistical layer for every headline comparison: per-task bootstrap confidence intervals, paired-bootstrap significance, a task- and instance-level discrimination analysis (how sharply each task separates models) adapted from Item Response Theory, and a cross-leaderboard correlation. Three findings stand out. The benchmark cleanly separates about a dozen tiers of models, though the top six are statistically too close to order. An openly licensed, self-hostable model reaches that leading tier, so strong Portuguese embedding quality does not require a commercial API. And a model's rank on the global multilingual leaderboard predicts its Portuguese rank only moderately (Spearman rho = 0.75 over 55 shared models; one model ranks 3rd there and 49th here), so a native benchmark measures something the multilingual boards do not. We release every task, our code, and a public leaderboard, so practitioners can choose Portuguese embedding models on native evidence.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We introduce PAST-TIDE, our stance detection system addressing both subtasks of the StanceNakba Shared Task at NakbaNLP@LREC-COLING 2026. The main idea is statement tuning. We redefine stance as cloze-style masked language modeling (MLM), letting a verbalizer map label words to stance categories through the pre-trained MLM head rather than appending a randomly initialized classification head. We complement this with prototypical contrastive learning, which uses learnable class prototypes for batch-size independent contrastive training, and topic-conditional layer normalization for cross-topic Arabic stance detection. PAST-TIDE achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.75 for Subtask A and 0.74 for Subtask B on the official leaderboard, indicating that minimal architectural additions to a pre-trained model can remain competitive in low-resource settings.

### [50] [What You See Is What You Get: Observation-Aligned Supervision for Chart-to-Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04726)
*Tianhao Niu,Qingfu Zhu,Wanxiang Che*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"观察对齐监督"（Observation-Aligned Supervision）框架，针对图表到代码生成任务中训练目标包含不可观测的潜在原始数据（如箱线图的原始样本、饼图的原始数值、直方图的原始样本）这一系统性问题，通过将这些潜在变量替换为可从图像直接观察的统计量（箱线统计量、扇形百分比、区间权重）来重写训练目标，实验证明该方法在多个视觉语言模型和基准测试上均提升了数据值恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表到代码生成方法通常采用监督微调，将参考绘图脚本视为完整可观测的目标。然而这一假设往往不成立：渲染后的图表并非生成程序的单射映射。许多不同的程序（尤其是不同的底层数据数组）可以产生相同或视觉上无法区分的图表。例如箱线图仅展示五数概括而非原始样本；饼图仅显示比例而非原始数值的绝对尺度；直方图显示区间级质量而非个体观测值。用这些不可唯一还原的潜在变量作为监督目标，会迫使模型解决一个不适定的逆问题，导致幻觉和过度指定的代码生成。

Method: 方法核心是将训练目标代码重写为与视觉观察对齐的形式 c̄=T(c)，满足两个条件：(1) 重写后渲染图像与原图差异在容差范围内；(2) 重写后代码仅依赖于可观测的图表量。具体针对三种聚合型图表：(1) 箱线图：执行原脚本获取 med、q1、q3、whislo、whishi、fliers 等统计量字典，使用 ax.bxp 替代 ax.boxplot；(2) 直方图：恢复有效区间边界和区间值，将原始样本替换为加权表示传递给 hist API；(3) 饼图：识别传入 pie 的值数组，归一化为百分比形式，保留 autopct 的格式化行为。训练数据来源于 ChartCoder 和 ReChartPrompt-240K，筛选出主绘图 API 为 boxplot、hist 或 pie 的样本，经过图像去重后共 19451 条。评估指标包括 Hist-Value（区间高度匹配）、Box-Value（五数概括匹配）、Pie-F1（扇形百分比匹配），均基于执行后从 Matplotlib 艺术家对象提取的可观察量。

Result: 在多个 VLM（InternVL3-8B/14B、Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B）和两个基准（ChartMimic、ChartX）上的实验表明，观察对齐监督在数据值恢复上一致优于原始代码监督。在 both-executable 评估设置下（排除执行失败干扰），改进尤为显著和稳定。表 1 中：饼图 Pie-F1 如 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 ChartX-both-executable 从 89.5 提升到 95.5；直方图 Hist-Value 在 InternVL3-14B 上从 52.9 提升到 89.0；箱线图在 InternVL3-14B 从 94.3 提升到 98.8。表 2 显示加入其他图表类型后改进仍然存在。分析还表明：(1) 仅用 40% 重写数据即可超越原始数据基线；(2) 改进对区间数量变化鲁棒；(3) 在无百分比标注的饼图上也表现优异。定性地，案例分析显示原始方法倾向于生成伪原始数据列表，而重写方法直接预测可见的统计量、百分比或权重。

Conclusion: 识别了图表到代码生成中系统性的监督缺陷——参考绘图脚本可能包含无法从渲染图像中识别的潜在原始量。通过将箱线图、直方图和饼图的目标重写为观察对齐形式（箱统计量、区间权重、扇形百分比），在多个模型和基准上一致改善了可观察量恢复能力，改进在 both-executable 评估下依然成立。这一发现表明，提升图表到代码模型不仅需要更多数据或更好的学习目标/算法，还需要尊重图像可识别信息的监督目标。未来可扩展至小提琴图、密度图、hist2d、hexbin 等其他包含潜在计算的聚合型绘图 API。

Abstract: Chart-to-code generation is commonly trained with supervised fine-tuning on reference plotting scripts, implicitly treating the gold code as a fully observable target. We argue that this assumption is often invalid: many chart programs contain latent raw variables that cannot be uniquely recovered from the rendered image. For example, a boxplot exposes summary statistics rather than original samples, a pie chart reveals proportions rather than arbitrary raw values, and a histogram shows bin-level mass rather than individual observations. Supervising models to reproduce such non-identifiable quantities encourages hallucination and over-specified code generation. We introduce Observation-Aligned supervision, a rewriting framework that replaces latent raw-data targets with quantities constrained by the visual observation: box statistics for boxplots, wedge percentages for pie charts, and bin weights for histograms. Applying this framework to chart-to-code training data from two sources, we obtain the Observation-Aligned supervision target data. Experiments across multiple VLMs on ChartMimic and ChartX demonstrate consistent improvements in observable value recovery, including under both-executable evaluation. Our results suggest that improving chart-to-code models requires not only more data or advanced learning objectives or algorithms, but also supervision targets that respect what is identifiable from the chart image.

### [51] [LP-SFT: Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Multimodal Entropy Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04733)
*Yueyang Wang,Baolong Bi,Shuo Lu,Jingyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LP-SFT（局部保持监督微调），通过保护预训练模型在非标签候选token间的局部偏好结构，缓解标准SFT中的灾难性遗忘和多样性损失问题。核心发现是预训练模型的下一token分布具有多模态熵结构（entropy peaks出现在ln k处），LP-SFT基于此构建自适应保持集并施加局部归一化KL损失，在多个模型和任务上取得了pass@1与pass@k的最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT使用的交叉熵损失仅优化观测到的标签token，对其余概率质量的重新分配不加约束。这会扭曲预训练阶段学到的丰富局部偏好结构，导致两方面退化：(1) 对微调分布的过度特化引发灾难性遗忘，损害分布外能力；(2) 生成多样性下降，单样本准确率提升以抑制其他合理解为代价。文章还发现预训练模型的下一token分布呈现规则的多模态熵结构（熵峰出现在ln k处，k为整数），表明token位置天然分为不同不确定性区间，亟需一种自适应的保持策略来保护这种异质结构。

Method: LP-SFT包含两个关键设计：(1) **目标token移除（target-token removal）**：从冻结基模型分布中根据有效支撑大小N₁自适应选取top-k_t候选集S_t，移除监督token y_t得到非标签保持集𝒜_t，避免与交叉熵学习冲突；(2) **局部KL归一化（local KL normalization）**：在𝒜_t内对基模型分布和训练模型分布分别重归一化后计算KL散度，仅保持非标签候选间的相对偏好结构而非绝对概率质量。最终损失为L = -ln p_t(y_t) + μ·L_LP_t，μ为保持强度。实现上采用两阶段策略：离线预计算基模型的top-K候选logits并缓存，微调阶段只需标准前向传播，计算开销极低（仅1.07× CE时间，1.10×内存）。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/14B和Llama-3.1-8B三个基座模型、UltraFeedback/Magicoder/NuminaMath三个数据集上的全面实验表明：(1) 混合域微调中Qwen3-14B的Avg.从CE的60.13提升至64.91，与基模型的差距从7.50缩减至2.72；(2) 所有模型×数据集组合中LP-SFT平均得分最高，pass@1与pass@k达到最佳平衡；(3) 消融实验证实目标token移除和局部KL归一化均为关键组件，μ∈[0.1,1.0]范围内性能稳定；(4) 相比ASFT等全词汇表KL方法，LP-SFT计算开销显著更低（ASFT需1.33×时间、1.47×内存）；(5) 对更强基模型（Qwen3）效果尤为显著，较弱基模型（Llama-3.1-8B）在部分数学任务上仍有CE更优的情况。

Conclusion: LP-SFT通过显式保护预训练模型非标签候选间的局部偏好结构，有效缓解了监督微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，同时维持了采样可访问的多样性。提出的多模态熵结构分析（有效支撑比R=N₂/N₁）和plateau-k状态概念为理解预训练分布提供了新视角。该方法在pass@1与pass@k之间取得了最优权衡，验证了局部保持是平衡下游适配与能力保留的有效策略，且计算开销小、超参数鲁棒，具有较强实用价值。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting pretrained language models to downstream domains, yet it often improves target-domain behavior at the cost of degrading pre-existing capabilities. Standard cross-entropy fine-tuning promotes only the observed label token and leaves unconstrained how probability mass is redistributed over other plausible alternatives, potentially distorting the rich local preference structure learned during pretraining. We first analyze next-token predictions using Shannon and Renyi entropies, revealing that pretrained models exhibit a regular multimodal entropy structure. These entropy peaks correspond to varying numbers of plausible alternatives, indicating that the base model intrinsically encodes rich distributional knowledge beyond the single supervised token. Motivated by this observation, we propose LP-SFT, a Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning objective designed to explicitly protect this inherent entropy structure. At each step, LP-SFT constructs an adaptive support of alternative tokens and applies a locally normalized preservation loss to maintain the base model's relative structure among them, while standard cross-entropy independently optimizes the supervised token. Across mixed-domain and single-domain fine-tuning experiments, LP-SFT improves overall performance over vanilla SFT and recent SFT-enhancement baselines, achieving the best balance between pass@1 accuracy and pass@k performance. These results suggest that local preservation helps mitigate capability degradation without collapsing sampling-accessible diversity.

</details>


### [52] [Knowledge Knows, Verbalization Tells: Disentangling Latent Directions for Mathematical Solvability in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05013)
*Nikolaos Xiros,Maria-Eleni Zoumpoulidi,Georgios Paraskevopoulos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究了LLM在数学问题可解性判断中的内部表示机制，将"可解性知识"（模型内部是否识别问题不可解）与"可解性语言化"（模型是否在输出中表达该判断）解耦为隐藏状态中两个不同的线性可解码方向。研究发现：知识与语言化在多个LLM中均可线性解码且方向不同；模型"虚构作答"主要源于语言化与知识的不对齐（特别是语言化方向的偏移）；提示工程主要通过改变语言化来减少虚构；推理模型的思考痕迹与输出痕迹表现出不同的动态；通过门控激活引导可选择性操纵这些方向以提升模型的拒绝作答能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究虽已探查LLM对数学可解性的内部信念，但将"语言化（verbalization）"仅作为行为层面研究，未作为内部表示来分析。这限制了对其机制性理解和操控。本文动机在于：将可解性知识与语言化作为隐藏状态中可分离的表示加以研究，揭示虚构作答（fabrication）的内部机制，并探索通过机制性干预改善模型的拒绝作答（abstention）行为。

Method: 1) 在ReliableMath基准（含313个可解题+1102个不可解题）上对7个LLM（包括LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen3系列、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Gemma4-31B等）进行CoT生成并提取隐藏状态；2) 使用线性探针（logistic regression）训练两个方向的探针——知识探针（K，预测问题真实可解性）和语言化探针（V，预测模型是否在CoT中明确将问题判定为不可解，语言化标签由Llama-3.3-70B作为judge标注，经人评验证Cohen's κ=0.94）；3) 分析两个探针方向的余弦相似度、abstain与fabricate条件下的相关性差异；4) 设计四种提示条件（standard/aware/biased/conditioned）研究对K和V的差异化影响；5) 区分大型推理模型（LRM）的思考痕迹与输出痕迹分析深度动态；6) 在残差流上沿探针方向进行激活引导（activation steering），并引入基于知识探针置信度的二元门控机制以保证特异性。

Result: 1) K和V探针在所有模型上均显著高于随机水平，V-AUC普遍高于K-AUC（V最高0.937，K最高0.872），K与V方向余弦相似度低（0.255-0.647），证实二者是不同且线性可解码的表示；2) 所有模型中abstain时K-V相关性显著高于fabricate时（p<10⁻⁴），且V方向的abstain-fabricate差异大于K方向，表明虚构主要反映语言化偏移；3) 提示工程显著增加不可解题的拒绝率而不大幅牺牲可解题的作答能力，探针翻转分析显示V-only翻转率远高于K-only（统计显著，p<10⁻⁵），表明提示主要改变模型的"表述"而非"理解"；4) 推理模型中K在思考痕迹早期即稳定，V随深度单调上升并在输出痕迹中达峰，K-V差距在输出阶段扩大；5) 无门控引导严重损害特异性（可解题上abstention率达0.6-0.8），而门控联合引导（KVgated）可有效挽救不可解题的拒绝行为（在Qwen3-4B上最优），但Gemma和LLaMA上虽然表示可被移动却对输出无因果效应。

Conclusion: LLM将可解性知识与语言化编码为隐藏状态中两个不同且线性可解码的方向。虚构作答主要源于两者的不对齐，并集中体现在语言化层面的偏移而非知识层面的改变。提示工程主要通过改变语言化起作用；推理模型中思考痕迹保持稳定的知识信号而语言化在输出阶段才最终凝固。通过基于知识探针置信度的门控机制对K和V联合进行激活引导，可机制性提升模型对不可解题的拒绝能力，为理解和缓解LLM的虚构行为提供了表示层面的诊断工具与因果干预手段。

Abstract: Although LLMs have made significant progress in mathematical reasoning, determining whether a mathematical problem is solvable remains a fundamental yet challenging capability. While recent studies have probed internal representations of model solvability beliefs, verbalization has primarily been studied behaviorally rather than as an internal representation, limiting its analysis and manipulation. We address this gap by separately probing representations of solvability knowledge and verbalization, allowing us to disentangle the two within model hidden states. Across multiple LLMs, we show that knowledge and verbalization are encoded as distinct, linearly decodable representations and that fabrication is primarily associated with changes in verbalization rather than the underlying knowledge. Prompting with unsolvability cues reduces fabrication primarily by shifting verbalization, while activation steering demonstrates that these representations can be echanistically manipulated to improve model abstention.

</details>


### [53] [EdgeBench: Unveiling Scaling Laws of Learning from Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05155)
*Deyao Zhu,Xin Zhou,Shengling Qin,Xuekai Zhu,Hangliang Ding,Shu Zhong,Zixin Wen,Zhonglin Xie,Chenhui Gou,Linxuan Ren,Yueyang Wang,Junfeng Zhong,Rui Liu,Tian Gao,Yangguang Lin,Jingyuan Zhang,Maojia Song,Xuan Qi,Jinhong Wu,Chenyang Zhang,Yinzhu Piao,Ziru Niu,Hongbin Lin,Lingxiang Meng,Peng Tang,Chengyao Tang,Shanyu Wu,Huanyu Zheng,Yu Liu,Liya Zhu,He Wang,Ming Ding,Ziyu Wan,Hao Liu,Sibo Wang,Haotian Zhu,Xintian Zhang,Nan Chai,Yipeng Liu,Panhao Lai,Sihang Yuan,Zixin Su,Ge Zhang,Wangchunshu Zhou,Yantao Du,Wenhao Huang,Guang Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EdgeBench 是一个由 134 个真实世界长周期任务（日级，≥12 小时/任务）组成的智能体评测套件，覆盖科学发现、软件工程、组合优化、专业知识工作、形式数学与交互式游戏六大能力族。研究在约 38,000 小时的智能体环境交互数据上，首次发现智能体从环境中学习的总体性能遵循一条**对数 Sigmoid 缩放律** S(t) = S_max/(1+(t_mid/t)^β)，拟合精度达 R²=0.998；且前沿模型的学习速度大约每三个月翻一番。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. **预训练缩放律已成熟，但部署后从真实环境学习的规律尚未可知**：现有基准（MMLU、SWE-bench、Agents' Last Exam 等）任务周期通常仅分钟到几小时，无法揭示学习过程的标度行为。2. **真实部署依赖环境学习**：训练数据无法覆盖私有记录、内部工具或人类迭代推理过程，且知识持续更新，智能体必须能从环境中增量学习。3. **现有基准缺乏"日级"长周期与多层级反馈**，难以让探索、策略修正、经验积累等学习行为涌现。

Method: 1. **EdgeBench 基准构建**：134 个任务（科学/ML 39、系统/SWE 36、组合优化 19、专业知识工作 19、形式数学 13、交互游戏 8），平均人类专家耗时 57.2 小时/任务；采用双容器隔离的工作-评测架构（work image + judge image），通过 SForge 评测框架实现。2. **双反馈环路**：内环为本地可写工作区（快速探索/调试），外环为基于提交的裁判反馈（慢速权威评分），并配有主机端 auto-eval 以无侵入方式记录改进轨迹。3. **三参数对数 Sigmoid 拟合**：S(t)=S_max/(1+(t_mid/t)^β)，S_max 为可及上限、t_mid 为半程时间、β 为学习速率参数。4. **理论建模**：将环境学习建模为隐式任务图上的前沿扩展过程——每个分数单元是图的节点，影响矩阵 K 编码已解锁节点对未解锁节点的促进强度；平均场近似下得到 dx/d(log t) = βx(1-x)；自相似图结构使时间轴取对数刻度。5. **评测对象**：5 个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4、GLM-5.1、DeepSeek-V4-Pro），每任务 3 次独立 12 小时运行；扩展实验延伸至 28 小时（80 任务）和 72 小时（18 任务）。

Result: 1. **对数 Sigmoid 缩放律精确成立**：134 任务平均下 R²≥0.997，跨 6 个能力族、跨 12/28/72 小时窗口均保持 R²≥0.993；用前 6.5 小时拟合可成功外推后 5.5 小时（R²≥0.997，RMSE<1.0），在 log-probit/log-Gompertz/Weibull/log-linear 中拟合误差最低。2. **学习速度约每三个月翻倍**：2025 年 9 月 GPT-5-Codex 至 2026 年 4 月 GPT-5.5，学习速度提升约 8×，前沿模型呈对数线性增长；改进源于每单位交互的有效学习率提升，而非更多提交次数。3. **经验累积超越独立重启**：在相同 12 小时预算下，连续状态保持运行比 6 次独立重启基线高 +6.9 分（43.0 vs 36.1），排除"重复采样"的解释。4. **更长上下文带来稳定增益**：Opus 4.8 的 1M vs 200k 上下文始终领先，差距在 12 小时内维持 +4.4 至 +5.8。5. **排行榜**：Claude Opus 4.8 12 小时综合分 51.3 居首，GPT-5.5 为 48.4，GPT-5.4 39.3，GLM-5.1 37.4，DS-V4-Pro 31.0；Opus 4.8 在多数类别领先但 GPT-5.5 在游戏类接近。6. **引力波案例**：224 次显式提交仅 27 次带来≥0.1pp 提升，最终通过稀疏但结构化的"诊断-编辑-评估"循环从 42.8 提升到 67.0。

Conclusion: 从真实环境学习不仅是若干零散任务结果的总和，更是一个可度量的**缩放对象**——其聚合轨迹在跨域、跨窗口、跨模型条件下均服从统一的 log-sigmoid 律，且前沿模型的学习速度正快速提升。这表明智能体将多样反馈转化为可复用结构的能力是可规模化的；部署后学习值得获得与预训练同等级别的系统性缩放研究投入。EdgeBench 已开源 51 个任务及完整评测框架，为研究智能体经验获取与复用机制提供基础设施。

Abstract: Pretraining scaling laws reveal that model capability improves predictably with data and compute. But learning from real world environments after deployment remains far less understood. Analyzing roughly 38,000 hours of agent interaction with the environment across 134 real world tasks, we find, to the best of our knowledge, the first evidence that overall performance during environment learning follows a log-sigmoid scaling law with remarkably high precision, reaching R^2 = 0.998. Across model generations, we also find that agent learning speed roughly doubles every three months. This discovery stems from EdgeBench, a suite of 134 real world tasks with ultra-long horizons, spanning scientific discovery, software engineering, combinatorial optimization, professional knowledge work, formal mathematics, and interactive games. Each task sustains at least 12 hours of continuous agent operation under rich, multilevel feedback, and is built through substantial expert effort. We publicly release 51 tasks and our full evaluation framework to accelerate the study of how agents learn from real world experience.

</details>

*Lakshani Galwatta,Nisansa de Silva,Sarangi Aththanayake,Adithya Galwatta*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方面级情感分析(ABSA)在英语、中文等高资源语言中已有成熟数据集,但僧伽罗语作为斯里兰卡主要使用的低资源印欧语系语言,缺乏可公开获取的方面级标注数据集。现有僧伽罗语情感分析数据集(如 GeeSanBhava)仅停留在文档级,无法支持细粒度的 ABSA 任务。该研究旨在填补这一空白,为低资源语言 NLP 研究提供基准。

Result: 1. 数据集情感分布存在现实性偏斜:3,150 条正向、762 条负向、58 条中性,中性类显著不足;<br>2. 方面分布呈长尾特征:Overall Satisfaction(27.56%)、Product Quality(16.93%)、Price(8.97%)占主导,前 3 大方面占 53.46%;<br>3. LaBSE 语义相似度:相同方面中位数为 0.83(同情感)/0.80(反情感),不同方面中位数仅 0.44,验证了语义一致性;<br>4. 产品类别分类:FastText 总体准确率 0.64,Macro F1 为 0.50;Electronics 表现最佳(F1=0.77);<br>5. InstructABSA 基线:ATE 的 Macro F1 为 0.72,ALSC 的 Macro F1 为 0.28,表明方面情感分类仍具挑战性。

Conclusion: SalAngaBhava 是首个公开的僧伽罗语方面级情感分析数据集,通过四元组标注方案支持 ATE、OE、ALSC 以及端到端联合任务。数据集结构合理,反映了电商评论的真实分布特征(包括长尾方面分布和类别内情感偏斜),可作为僧伽罗语及其他低资源语言 ABSA 研究的可靠基准。但存在标注覆盖不均(4.28%-100%)和中性类样本极少等局限,数据集已发布在 GitHub 和 HuggingFace 平台以促进可复现研究。

Abstract: Sentiment analysis has been a primary domain under Natural Language Processing (NLP) from its inception as it plays a vital role in both real-world and research applications. In high-resource languages, this has been extended a step further, and instead of predicting sentiment at the sentence level, models have been developed to detect more fine-grained sentiments at aspect level. However, in order to conduct this fine-grained Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA), datasets annotated with aspects and sentiments toward the said aspects is required. Such datasets are lacking for low-resources languages among which, we can count Sinhala, an Indo-Aryan languages used primarily in Sri Lanka. In this work, we introduce, SalAngaBhava, a new Sinhala Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis dataset which contains Sinhala product reviews that are manually labeled with aspect terms and the associated sentiments (positive, negative, neutral). The data was collected from domain-relevant sources such as user-generated reviews and comments, and was annotated following carefully defined guidelines to ensure consistency and quality. The dataset consists of sentences and aspect-sentiment pairs, encompassing a considerable range of aspects from several domains. The analysis confirms that the dataset is well-structured and sufficiently balanced for ABSA research. This dataset can be used as a benchmark and facilitates further studies related to Sinhala natural language processing, and low-resource sentiment analysis tasks.

</details>


### [55] [How Much is Left? LLMs Linearly Encode Their Remaining Output Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05316)
*Mohamed Amine Merzouk,Dmitri Carpov,Mirko Bronzi,Damiano Fornasiere,Adam Oberman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过最小容量线性探针，在三个7-8B开源模型的冻结隐藏状态上训练，发现大语言模型(LLM)在隐藏状态中线性编码了关于"剩余生成令牌数"的内部估计。三项汇聚证据：(1)响应总长度可从提示词末尾隐藏状态单独线性解码；(2)在自然语言数据集上训练的探针方向可广泛迁移至未见过的合成任务，反向迁移失败，这种不对称性本身具有信息量；(3)在模型回退并重启部分解的高损失补全中，探针的逐位置估计在回退时刻向上跳跃。这一现象被解释为LLM维持一个"计划式"的输出长度内部表示（可解码，但未必被因果使用）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在自回归生成时，其响应长度常表现出惊人的一致性（如解题步骤的令牌数可预测）。然而标准自回归计算图中并不存在响应总长度的显式表示。这种一致性究竟是解码过程的统计规律，还是模型内部编码了"剩余工作量"的估计（即"计划"）？弄清此问题对理解模型是否"规划"以及发现不忠实思维链的信号有重要意义。

Method: 方法核心是最小容量线性探针（无激活函数的单层线性层），对冻结LLM的残差流隐藏状态进行探测：(1) Remaining Count Probe（剩余计数探针）：在每个补全位置对剩余令牌数r_t = T-t进行回归；(2) 统计基线：训练集r_t的中位数常数预测；(3) Completion Length Probe（补全长度探针）：仅在提示词末位置训练，预测总长度T，评估时按位置递减倒计时。三种开源7-8B模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Olmo-3-7B、Mistral-7B），七个数据集（含两个合成数据集Count/Countdown和五个自然语言数据集）。评估指标为按令牌加权的MAE。设计关键的跨数据集迁移实验以检验探针是否仅记忆源数据集边际分布。

Result: 核心结果：(1) 补全长度探针在每个(模型,数据集)单元均优于常数中位数基线——Llama在Countdown上提示词末端绝对误差从150.18降至5.27，自然语言集上半至四分之三的相对改善；(2) 每令牌MAE对比显示Remaining Count Probe在大多数单元格超过精确倒计时基线，表明中间补全位置增加了超出提示词末位置的信息；(3) 跨数据集矩阵呈现显著不对称：自然语言训练的探针可迁移到合成任务（含未见过的数据集），但反向迁移失败，作者将这种不对称解释为正则化效应——自然语言训练迫使探针进入更通用的长度追踪方向；(4) 定性观察：在高MAE回退补全中（如"Wait, let me try again"），探针预测从71跳跃至277，方向性向上跳跃为单调的常数中位数和精确倒计时基线在结构上无法重现；(5) 分层扫描显示长度信号主要出现在上层，嵌入层（layer 0）的探针接近基线。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：LLM残差流线性编码了对其自身响应剩余令牌数的内部估计，且这一估计具备三个与"计划式"表示（而非解码的下游统计规律）一致的性质：(i) 在生成首令牌前即可从提示词末隐藏状态单独解码；(ii) 自然语言数据集上恢复的探针方向在不同长度分布间广泛迁移，弱化了"仅记忆边际分布"的解释，而反向迁移不成立；(iii) 在精选回退样例中，估计可方向性更新。论文明确局限：可解码不等于因果使用；动态重估计证据为定性而非聚合结果；未在更大规模或非指令微调模型上验证；研究局限于自然终止的补全。作者指出的下一步工作包括：(1) 通过激活修补研究验证因果使用；(2) 对回退处上跳现象进行系统性、聚合级的分析，与长度匹配的非回退对照组配对。

Abstract: Large language models generate one token at a time, yet their responses show remarkably consistent length structure: step-by-step solutions converge in predictable token counts, retrievals stop after a few sentences, retractions extend responses by measurable amounts. We ask whether the model carries an internal estimate of how much response remains. First, total response length is linearly decodable from the prompt's last hidden state alone, before any output is emitted. Second, probe directions trained on natural-language datasets transfer broadly, including to controlled synthetic completions never seen in training, outperforming a statistical baseline; the converse direction generally fails, and this asymmetry is itself informative. Third, on curated high-loss completions, the probe's per-position estimate shifts upward at the moment the model retracts and restarts a partial solution, a directional behavior no position-only predictor can reproduce (qualitative, not aggregate). We frame this as approximate estimation of remaining generation length, distinct from exact-counting impossibility results for transformers, and interpret it as evidence that LLMs maintain a plan-like internal representation of output length (decodable, not necessarily used causally).

  <summary>Details</summary>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型存在生成器-验证器（G-V）不一致问题：模型生成的响应如果重新进行验证，可能被判为无效。现有方法（如RankAlign）将生成器分数与验证器log-odds直接对齐，但忽略了响应频率的影响——生成器经常给有效字符串赋予低似然，仅仅因为这些字符串先验上不太可能出现。这种朴素的一致性定义可能导致抑制正确响应或产生矛盾的训练信号。需要一种基于原则的频率校正方法来正确处理这种不一致性。

Method: 1. **理论建模**：将LLM建模为理性概率智能体，定义潜在有效性向量v、生成策略π和"错误"策略π'，推导出核心定理：p_V/(1-p_V) = (p_G/p_G') · r(y,x)。2. **频率校正分数**：忽略残差r≈1的假设，定义调整后的生成器分数s_Adj = log p_G - log p_G'，提出两种经验估计器：NegFC（用负面提示获取p_G'）和Unconditional FC（用无条件概率P(y)替代）。3. **训练目标FLORA**：结合成对偏好损失（使用频率校正后的分数作为s(y|x)）、正例的生成器NLL损失和验证器NLL损失，采用半监督设置，仅对同一prompt内、验证器分数差异超过δ的样本对进行训练。

Result: 在三个任务（IFEval指令跟随、HumanEval代码生成、Hyponymy分类知识）和三个模型（Gemma-2-9b-it、Qwen-3.5-9B、Gemma-4-31b-it）上的实验表明：（1）测试时频率校正本身即可提升G-V一致性；（2）FLORA在6个设置中的5个上取得最高ROC_G，比次优方法提升+0.9到+7.3pp；（3）Pearson相关性ρ最高提升+27pp（IFEval的Gemma-2-9b-it上从35.5到62.8，HumanEval上从49.0到76.3）；（4）验证器质量在所有任务上保持或提升，无likelihood displacement现象；（5）消融实验证实移除训练中的频率校正会显著降低性能（HumanEval上ρ下降16.1pp）。

Conclusion: FLORA通过理论驱动的频率校正方法有效改善了LLM的生成器-验证器一致性。该工作首次为G-V关系提供了原则性推导，超越了以往启发式方法。在指令跟随、代码生成和分类知识等多个长文本生成任务上的实验证明了方法的有效性，且不损害验证器能力。局限性包括：理论残差项r≈1的假设难以验证、评估聚焦于固定输出集合而非贪心解码结果、正确性假设为二元。未来工作可探索部分正确性场景及训练时频率校正的更优形式。

Abstract: Large language models are inconsistent: varying prompts or including unrelated information can lead to unexpected changes in model outputs. Our method, \emph{\FCPAname} (\FCPA), is a training objective implementing frequency-corrected G-V consistency for real-world LLMs. Our experimental results show that training with \FCPA{} substantially improves both G-V consistency and generator performance over prior methods, with gains of up to $+27$pp in Pearson correlation on IFEval and HumanEval, while preserving validator quality across all evaluated tasks.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 1）数据构建流程：将SQuAD v1.1英文问题通过TranslateGemma 12B翻译为Luxembourgish，再利用多种TTS引擎（MMS-TTS、Qwen3-TTS含CV/VD模式、OmniVoice含C/VD模式）合成约48k单源或约230k 4TTS混合的语音问题，与文本答案配对；2）模型架构：冻结Whisper-large-v3-turbo编码器（输出经5倍下采样），经可训练线性投影器映射到LLM嵌入空间，连接EuroLLM-9B-Instruct或Apertus-8B-Instruct，配合LoRA（r=α=16）；3）评估设计：在LLAMA-LB-Test（300题，两个真人Luxembourgish说话人条件）上使用语义相似度（SemSim，基于多语言句向量余弦相似度）和LLM Judge Mean（GPT-4o + Gemini-2.5-Flash双评判）作为语义感知指标；4）使用NISQA和DNSMOS对TTS系统进行无参考质量评估。

Result: 1）多源4TTS混合与语音设计（VD）配置显著优于单源TTS配置；EuroLLM-9B（4TTS）在Speaker 1上达到72.6 SemSim / 60.1 LLM Judge Mean，EuroLLM-9B（4TTS-from-ASR）在Speaker 2上达到74.8 SemSim / 61.8 LLM Judge Mean，接近文本基线水平；2）ASR自适应初始化策略可进一步提升性能；3）TTS无参考质量分数（如DNSMOS-OVRL、P.808 MOS）与下游QA性能不呈单调关系——例如Omni-C虽获最高DNSMOS综合分（3.38）但下游QA表现欠佳，表明合成语音应作为任务特定训练数据而非仅作为自然音频来评估；4）通用Luxembourgish音频模型仍较弱（SemSim 38.8–45.7），说明说话人特定合成训练对性能提升至关重要。

Conclusion: 本文将LuxSQA定位为以数据为中心的配方而非纯模型比较，得出三项核心结论：1）TTS增强是低资源SQA的可行策略，可在无大规模人工QA录制条件下构建可用管道；2）合成训练数据的选择比TTS感知质量更重要，应作为任务特定数据生成机制而非单纯语音合成来评估；3）文本与语音之间存在持续差距，即使最佳说话人特定系统的语义相似度较高，LLM Judge Mean仍低于文本基线，表明仍需更广泛的Luxembourgish语音覆盖和自然录制音频评估以提升鲁棒性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Spoken Question Answering (SQA) remains largely focused on high-resource languages and carefully recorded speech, limiting the reach of speech-LLM methods in low-resource settings. This paper investigates whether text-to-speech (TTS) can provide task-specific training data for Luxembourgish SQA without requiring a large human-recorded QA corpus. Starting from existing text-based QA resources, we translate questions into Luxembourgish, synthesize spoken questions with multiple TTS systems, and pair them with textual answers. We train a parameter-efficient SLAM-style architecture that connects a frozen Whisper encoder to frozen multilingual LLM backends through a learned projector and LoRA adapters. We compare MMS-TTS, Qwen3-TTS, and OmniVoice variants, including single-source corpora of about 48k questions and a 4TTS multi-source mix of approximately 230k questions. Evaluation on LLAMA-LB-Test with two real Luxembourgish speaker conditions shows that multi-source and voice-design-based synthetic training configurations yield the strongest SQA performance. The results also show that no-reference TTS quality scores do not monotonically predict downstream QA performance, indicating that synthetic speech must be evaluated as task-specific training data rather than only as natural-sounding audio.

</details>

TL;DR: 提出了一种多模态特征融合框架，用于联合提升印度语言的方言识别（DID）和自动语音识别（ASR）性能，通过融合Bottleneck Encoder（语音模态）和RoBERTa Encoder（文本模态）的特征，并结合门控机制与注意力编码器，在8种印度语言、33种方言上取得了81.63%的DID准确率、4.65%的CER和17.73%的WER，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常单独优化ASR或DID，导致性能权衡问题。具体而言：(1) 之前将方言ID拼接到训练文本前端的做法在方言预测错误时会显著降低ASR性能；(2) DID梯度难以有效回传到ASR模块；(3) 印度语言多为低资源语言且方言差异显著，联合建模研究有限。需要一种不依赖方言ID预拼接、能同时提升两任务的多任务框架。

Method: 方法采用多模态特征融合架构，包括：(1) ASR模块：使用IndicWav2Vec前端+8层Conformer编码器+混合CTC/Attention解码器；(2) DID模块包含Bottleneck Encoder（采用1D卷积替代2D卷积以保留时序信息，从Conformer输出提取方言特征）、RoBERTa Encoder（从CTC嵌入提取上下文特征）、门控机制动态平衡两模态特征、Attention Encoder细化表示；(3) 将DID的注意力嵌入与Conformer输出拼接（detach以防止梯度干扰）以增强ASR特征；(4) 损失函数为CTC损失、注意力损失和交叉熵损失的加权和。

Result: 在RESPIN数据集的8种印度语言（33种方言）上的实验表明：(1) ASR-BN-ROB取得最佳DID准确率81.63%，比基线ASR-DID-ROB（80.74%）提升显著；(2) ASR性能也最优，平均CER 4.65%、WER 17.73%，优于所有对比方法；(3) 在DID预测错误的样本上，提出的方法相比基线相对降低5.52%的CER和5.17%的WER；(4) 混淆矩阵显示方言间准确率标准差平均降低16.08%，泛化性更强；(5) 配对t检验证明DID准确率、CER、WER的差异均具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。

Conclusion: 所提出的多模态融合方法有效缓解了ASR与DID之间的性能权衡问题。通过Bottleneck与RoBERTa双编码器结合门控与注意力机制，显著提升了两任务的性能，尤其改善了方言误判情况下的ASR鲁棒性。未来工作将探索该框架在多语言多方言场景下的可扩展性。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Dialect Identification (DID) are crucial for Indian languages, many of which are low-resource and exhibit significant dialectal differences. Existing methods often optimize ASR or DID individually, resulting in performance trade-offs. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that jointly improves ASR and DID. Our method employs a Bottleneck Encoder to extract dialectal features from Conformer-based speech representations and a RoBERTa encoder to process ASR-generated CTC embeddings. A gating mechanism merges these features, followed by an attention encoder to refine the representations. The learned embeddings are concatenated with Conformer outputs to enhance ASR features. Evaluated on eight Indian languages with thirty-three dialects, our method achieves an average DID accuracy of 81.63% and average CER and WER of 4.65% and 17.73%, respectively. These results highlight the effectiveness of our method for joint ASR-DID modeling.

### [61] [PraMem: Practice-derived Experiential Memory for Long-horizon Behavior Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02881)
*Zhuoqun Li,Boxi Cao,Jiawei Chen,Hanshu Zhou,Ruoxi Xu,Guiping Jiang,Ruotong Pan,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Xiangyu Wu,Hongyu Lin,Yaojie Lu,Xianpei Han,Le Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PraMem，一种无需训练的框架，通过对长历史行为序列进行预先"练习"来构建经验记忆（包含模式经验和偏见警示经验），以解决LLM在长周期行为预测中的潜在行为模式归纳困难和模型固有认知偏差两大核心挑战。该方法在OminiBehavior和MovieLens-1M基准上显著优于现有记忆管理方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期行为预测需要从数千步的长历史序列中归纳用户行为模式并预测下一步动作。基于LLM的自回归方法面临两大核心挑战：(1) 细粒度行为模式分散在长序列中难以归纳；(2) LLM存在固有的认知偏差（如从众倾向、训练偏见、注意力不均衡等）。现有基于上下文压缩的记忆管理方法（如Mem0、MemOS、ProEx）仅将历史序列视为负担进行压缩，无法解决核心问题。本文受辩证哲学启发，主张将长历史序列从"负担"转化为"资源"加以利用。

Method: PraMem框架包含三个迭代阶段：(1) 现有经验试验——从历史序列中采样带标签的练习样本，让LLM在当前经验记忆下进行显式深度思考预测；(2) 反思提案生成——LLM对练习样本、思考过程和预测-标签对比进行反思，生成修改/补充/修剪经验记忆的提案，并经自审查机制过滤；(3) 共识经验调整——每T轮触发一次，仅采纳多个提案共识支持的操作以保证稳定演化。自审查机制包括：基础性审查（扰动历史序列检验提案是否仍成立，剔除不基于实践样本的提案）和泛化性审查（通过改写预测场景构建多选题，剔除过拟合于单一样本的提案）。经验记忆包含两类：模式经验（呈现用户行为模式）和偏见警示经验（警示LLM固有偏差）。

Result: 在OminiBehavior基准的四个场景（视频、直播、广告、电商）上，PraMem在GPT-OSS-120B骨干下整体ACC从73.5提升至84.7，F1从24.7提升至31.6；在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B骨干下也取得显著提升，且经验记忆可跨骨干迁移。在MovieLens-1M的5分类评分预测上，混淆矩阵显示更强的对角线集中度。消融实验验证了深度思考试验、反思提案生成、共识调整、模式经验、偏见警示经验以及自审查机制（基础性和泛化性审查）的有效性。经验记忆随练习轮次增加性能单调提升（10轮时ACC 79.0，80轮时达84.7），且token数先增后稳，避免长度爆炸。代价是离线构建时间较高（55.8分钟/用户 vs ProEx的24.7分钟）。

Conclusion: PraMem通过辩证哲学视角将长历史序列从负担转化为资源，通过迭代练习构建时间和用户专属的经验记忆，有效解决了长周期行为预测中的两大核心挑战（行为模式归纳和认知偏差）。该训练免费框架在多个基准上显著优于现有先进记忆管理方法，且经验记忆具有良好的跨骨干迁移能力，为长周期行为预测的记忆系统设计提供了新方向。主要局限性在于离线构建成本较高。

Abstract: Long-horizon behavior prediction aims to infer a user's next action based on a lengthy historical sequence, playing a crucial role in artificial intelligence field. The rise of large language models (LLMs) offers a promising direction for sequential behavior prediction, yet LLMs struggle with latent behavioral pattern induction and model-intrinsic cognitive biases when tackling long-horizon behavior prediction. Prior memory management methods follow a context-compression paradigm that attempts to address this task by alleviating the historical sequence burden, yet fail to resolve the core challenges. In this paper, we advocate a paradigm shift that reframes the lengthy historical sequence from a burden into a valuable resource to be exploited, and accordingly propose PraMem, which conducts beforehand practice over the lengthy historical sequence to build an experiential memory, thereby serving as the assisted input for accurate long-horizon behavior prediction. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate that PraMem achieves superior performance than prior methods, and more in-depth analyses provide valuable insights into the mechanism and evolution of the experiential memory. Code: this https URL .

Abstract: Cross-lingual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is often deployed in an English-evidence regime, where users query in diverse languages but retrieved passages remain English. In this setting, generation can fail despite strong base models: English evidence induces language drift (English or code-switching outputs) and models use evidence unreliably when producing non-English answers. We attribute these failures to two post-training challenges: (i) errors are prefix-dependent, so fixed-trajectory supervision suffers from prefix mismatch; and (ii) sequence-level (partly discrete / judge-based) rewards yield noisy credit assignment and high-variance updates. We propose TR-RAG, a teacher-regularized RL recipe that couples reward optimization with on-policy distillation on student-visited prefixes. A compact student samples on-policy answers, while a stronger frozen teacher is queried only on those prefixes and provides a prefix-wise student-to-teacher reverse-KL anchor. We further introduce a reward decomposition for English-evidence multilingual generation, combining language consistency, character 3-gram recall, and an LLM-judge score for evidence-grounded correctness. Across three benchmarks -- BioASQ-ENKB5, Hotpot-ENKB5, and naturally multilingual MKQA -- and two backbones, TR-RAG improves the composite of language adherence and evidence-grounded correctness over strong baselines. Crucially, the teacher anchor acts as a safety net: on in-domain languages it prevents the large language-consistency collapses (up to ~27 percentage points) that reward-only RL can suffer by drifting below even the base model, while on distant out-of-distribution languages -- where reward-only RL stalls at the base model's ceiling -- it still improves evidence grounding; and on character 3-gram recall the compact student sometimes surpasses its 70B teacher.

Our approach achieved one of the top Consistency and Contradiction scores for the summarization task and also middle-level results for the other tasks. By testing and developing such mental health-state estimation systems, we contributed to improving mental health support systems. We make our code available this https URL .

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ASR在标准语音上表现优异，但在神经运动障碍（如ALS、帕金森病、中风）导致的构音障碍语音上仍面临巨大挑战。西班牙语方面公开的神经病理语音语料极为稀缺，且已有的GITA和NeuroVoz存在录制条件受控、语种偏倚（智利/卡斯蒂利亚）、覆盖单一（仅PD）等局限，亟需一个多样化、野外场景下的多病种西班牙语基准来推动该方向研究与无障碍辅助技术发展。

Method: 1) 数据构建：从YouTube野外视频中筛选西班牙语构音障碍语音，由3位语言学专业母语者分段并人工转写，标注性别、病种和1-5级可懂度评分，并进行跨标注者一致性检验（加权Cohen κ=0.38）。2) 基线评估：使用四个ASR系统——Whisper-large-v3、Voxtral-Mini、omniASR_CTC_1B_v2（开放权重）和ElevenLabs Scribe v2（商业API），在S-DiverSe、NeuroVoz、TORGO上报告WER。3) 适配实验：对Whisper-large-v3和Voxtral-Mini进行FFT、F-LoRA、EFT、E-LoRA四种微调策略，训练数据组合包括TORGO+NeuroVoz、仅NeuroVoz、以及加入Spanish Common Voice。4) 后处理：基于规则的三步法（去除超长重复字符、词级去重、短语级去重）缓解幻觉。

Result: 基线方面，Scribe v2在S-DiverSe上以20.69% WER领先，omniASR_CTC_1B_v2在开放权重模型中表现最佳（33.56%），Voxtral-Mini在NeuroVoz上最佳（25.15%），Whisper-large-v3在TORGO上最佳。错误模式呈现明显架构差异：自回归模型以插入错误为主（幻觉），CTC模型以替换错误为主。微调始终提升域内性能（TORGO/NeuroVoz），但严重损害域外泛化：Whisper-large-v3经FFT后S-DiverSe WER飙升至125.68%，表现出灾难性遗忘。E-LoRA（仅编码器+连接器）比FFT泛化更好但仍不稳定。相比之下，启发式后处理（PP）在S-DiverSe上一致降低WER且不损伤域内表现，是最鲁棒的适配策略。Voxtral-Mini仅用NeuroVoz训练的E-LoRA+PP在PD子集上超越了仅PP的基线，证明域内病理性训练数据的价值；而加入Common Voice反而降低性能，表明瓶颈在于域差异（干净朗读语音无法弥合野外病理性语音的差距）而非语言不平衡。

Conclusion: S-DiverSe建立了首个西班牙语多病种野外神经病理语音基准，揭示了当前ASR系统在该真实场景下的根本性域差距。核心结论是：对于域外神经病理西班牙语语音，启发式文本后处理比参数微调更具鲁棒性——微调会因灾难性遗忘而无法泛化。干净的朗读语音和受控临床语料无法替代野外病理性数据。该基准明确暴露了现有系统的短板，强调社区需要针对该领域开展更广泛的数据采集工作，特别是增加中风和女性说话者的覆盖，以推动病理性西班牙语语音鲁棒ASR的进步。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has advanced remarkably for standard speech, yet speech affected by neurological conditions remains a challenge. We present S-DiverSe (Spanish Diverse Speech), a corpus of 3.2 hours of in-the-wild Spanish speech from 22 speakers with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and stroke. The dataset contains 444 manually transcribed audio segments with metadata on speaker sex, disease type, and intelligibility. S-DiverSe is designed to support ASR evaluation and development for neurologically affected Spanish speech. We describe the dataset, analyze its composition, and report baseline ASR results alongside initial adaptation experiments. Our findings reveal that heuristic text post-processing is more robust than fine-tuning for out-of-domain neurological Spanish speech. This underscores the need for dedicated in-the-wild Spanish benchmarks.

</details>


### [65] [TACG: Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating for Diffusion Language Model Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03236)
*Chengcheng Wang,Tingzhang Luo,Wenhao Li,Jianyuan Guo,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 TACG（Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating），一种面向扩散语言模型（DLLM）的免训练、门控级解码框架。其核心思想是将"写哪个 token"与"何时提交（commit）该 token"两个决策解耦：token 身份仍由基础后验的 argmax 决定，而提交时机则由轨迹感知信号决定。TACG 由两个互补组件构成——基于 EMA 自参考的 TILG 时序支撑分支，以及要求提案短期持续性的 History Gate（HG），并配合有上限的额外提升预算。在 LLaDA、Dream、LLaDA2-Mini 上的代码与数学基准测试表明，TACG 在通常提升或保持准确率的同时，减少了去噪步数并提高了每次前向的 token 数（TPF）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DLLM 解码器大多基于"快照式"策略，即仅依据当前步的预测分布决定是否提交 token，将"瞬时置信度"等同于"提交就绪度"。这种做法存在两类问题：（1）在上下文尚不完整时，一个短暂出现的 top-1 峰值可能被过早锁定，造成不可逆的错误提交；（2）跨步持续得到支撑的候选反而被延迟，牺牲了解码效率。单纯调整置信度阈值无法同时缓解这两个矛盾：更严格会延迟就绪 token，更宽松则引入不稳定提交。因此，需要一种免训练的、仅利用去噪过程中已有轨迹信号来判断提交就绪度的方法。

Method: TACG 是一种门控级解码框架，锚定 token 身份于基础后验  $\hat{x}_i = \arg\max_v p_t(i,v)$，仅利用轨迹信号决定何时提交。具体包含三个组件：

1. **TILG（Temporal Implicit Logits Guidance）**：维护过去 logits 的指数移动平均 $\bar{z}_{t-1}$ 作为隐式自参考，在自然参数空间（logit 空间）将当前 logits 与参考进行对比，构造辅助读出分布 $q_t(v) \propto p_t(v)^{1+w}/p_t^{\mathrm{ref}}(v)^w$，仅用于评估基础提案的时序支撑 $\sigma_i$（如概率增益 $b_i = [q_t(i,\hat{x}_i) - p_t^{\mathrm{ref}}(i,\hat{x}_i)]_+$）。该读出对 logits 的加法规范具有不变性，且一阶展开可解释为对信念创新 $d_t = z_t - \bar{z}_{t-1}$ 的方向性加权。

2. **History Gate（HG）**：要求 token 提案在连续 $m_{\mathrm{base}}$ 步内保持不变才允许基础提交（已饱和的高置信度位置可通过置信度逃逸 $\tau_{\mathrm{esc}}$ 例外），抑制瞬态承诺。

3. **有上限的额外提升**：在稳定提交集合之外，对通过置信度下界 $\tau_{\mathrm{floor}}$ 与较轻持续性条件 $m_{\mathrm{extra}}$ 的候选，按就绪度分数 $s_i = c_i + \lambda \sigma_i$ 排序，每步至多额外提升 $K_{\mathrm{extra}}$ 个位置，作为显式的加速预算。

整体流程为：基础门（如置信阈值或 KLASS）给出候选 → HG 过滤得到稳定集合 → TILG 支撑排序后从剩余候选中按上限额外提升 → 写入的 token 始终为基础提案。

Result: 在 LLaDA、Dream（8B 量级）及更强的块扩散模型 LLaDA2-Mini 上，于 HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、MATH500 四个基准进行评测：

- **LLaDA + 置信度门**：在四项任务上同时提升准确率并降低步数、增大 TPF，最显著为 HumanEval（37.20% → 42.07%，TPF 6.45 → 7.01）。
- **LLaDA + KLASS**：准确率全面提升，但效率增益因任务而异（KLASS 本身已施加结构稳定性）。
- **Dream**：跨骨干模型表现一致——置信度门下降噪步数减少、TPF 提升；KLASS 下效率改善任务依赖。
- **LLaDA2-Mini**（gen=1024/2048）：在两个生成长度下准确率均一致提升，TPF 基本保持，HumanEval（+1.83）、MATH500（+2.60）提升最大。
- **长生成预算**（gen=512，H200）：HumanEval 准确率从 28.66% 跃升至 38.41%，步数从 103.82 降至 94.15。
- **消融**：TILG 主要驱动效率（更激进的提升），HG 主要保障可靠性（提案持续性），二者结合实现质量-效率最优权衡。
- **超参敏感性**：在较宽的 $\lambda$、$\tau_{\mathrm{floor}}$、HG 窗口、EMA 衰减 $\beta$ 范围内均稳定优于基线。
- 与 d3LLM 相比，TACG 速度稍慢但准确率始终更高，属于"质量优先"的取舍。

Conclusion: TACG 提出了一种将 token 身份与提交时机解耦的 DLLM 解码范式。其 TILG 分支利用 logits 空间的 EMA 自参考，在自然参数坐标中量化基础提案的时序支撑；HG 分支通过提案持续性约束抑制瞬态承诺；有上限的额外提升机制将时序证据作为受控的加速预算使用。该方法无需额外参数、辅助网络或额外前向传播，可即插即用地叠加在置信度门或 KLASS 等基础解码器之上。实证表明，TACG 在多种 DLLM 骨干与任务上一致改善提交时机，在置信度门下同时提升质量与效率，并与分布级稳定性规则互补。局限在于逐位置独立打分以及 EMA 引发的额外张量开销，未来可结合依赖感知调度器、组级提交规则以及融合的 top-K 内核进一步优化。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, exposing a trajectory of predictive distributions rather than a single instantaneous belief. Most existing decoders ignore this trajectory and commit tokens from the current snapshot alone, conflating confidence with commitment readiness: a transient top-1 peak under incomplete context can be locked in, while candidates with consistent cross-step support are delayed. We propose Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating (TACG), a training-free gate-level decoder that anchors token identities to the base posterior and uses trajectory-aware signals only to decide whether the current proposal is ready to commit. TACG combines Temporal Implicit Logits Guidance (TILG), which keeps an exponential moving average of past logits as a self-reference and contrasts the current logits against this reference in natural-parameter space, with a History Gate (HG) that enforces short-term proposal persistence before commitment. Together with a capped extra-promotion budget, these components yield a stability-constrained commit rule without auxiliary networks or extra forward passes. We evaluate TACG on LLaDA, Dream, and LLaDA2-Mini across code (HumanEval, MBPP) and math (GSM8K, MATH500) benchmarks; it typically improves or preserves accuracy while reducing denoising steps and increasing tokens per forward (TPF). The code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [66] [From Gentlemen to Frontiermen: Masculine Formations in English-Language Fiction (1771--1930)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03323)
*Rong Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于 txtLAB Novel450 语料库中的 150 部英美经典小说(1771–1930),通过指代消解构建以男性角色为中心的文本窗口,并拟合以出版年份和作者性别为协变量的结构主题模型(STM),自动识别出六种男性气质形态(贵族骑士、基督教绅士、绅士体面、乡绅、专业-商业、帝国/冒险),并量化了它们在长十九世纪小说中的此消彼长:继承性与神圣权威的形态衰退,工作与冒险(尤其是边疆荒野)形态崛起,且冒险与商业形态在男性作者作品中更显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有男性气质史研究(Tosh、Davidoff、Connell 等)多依赖精读选段,缺乏对长时段小说语料中不同男性气质脚本相对权重变化的可复现性量化测量。本研究旨在填补这一空白:在不预设男性词汇的前提下,以"关于男性角色的叙事段落"为单位,衡量 1771–1930 年英语小说中竞争性男性气质形态的相对地位如何重新分配。

Method: 语料为 Novel450 英语子集 150 部小说;使用 BookNLP 进行角色级指代消解并推断性别;以约 500 词为窗口,仅保留男性提及数超过女性提及数且含至少两个性别化提及的窗口(22,197/35,434);通过数据驱动方式移除专有名词(高频低文档频率词),无需词表;用 stm 包拟合 STM,以出版年份与作者性别为流行度协变量,Spectral 初始化,固定随机种子 42;在 K=2–15 间比较诊断指标,基于可解释性选取 K=12;用 4000 次小说级 bootstrap 量化区间;以剔除 top-5 高负载小说、英国/美国分组作为稳健性检验。

Result: 识别出六种男性气质形态:(1)贵族骑士型(knight, prince, sword, duke),(2)基督教男性(god, sin, soul, prayer, priest),(3)绅士体面型(lady, sir, letter, proposal),(4)乡绅型(squire, horse, parish, stable),(5)专业-商业型(money, dollar, trade, wage, railroad),(6)帝国/冒险型(海上 ship, sea, sailor 与边疆 wolf, jungle, frontier)。历时趋势:绅士体面型从 0.226 降至 0.015(Δ=−0.211,p<0.001),帝国/冒险型从 0.049 升至 0.244(Δ=+0.195,p<0.001,主要由边疆荒野驱动),贵族骑士与乡绅型显著下降,专业-商业型显著上升,基督教男性型下降但不显著。作者性别层面:冒险、商业、贵族骑士形态在男性作者作品中更普遍;绅士体面形态在女性作者作品中更普遍。英美分拆显示绅士衰退与冒险崛起在两国皆显著,商业崛起主要由美国小说驱动。剔除各形态负载最高 5 部小说后,主要趋势方向不变。

Conclusion: 长十九世纪英语小说中的男性权威经历了一次再分配:从继承性等级与神圣权威形态(绅士、骑士、乡绅、教士)转向基于有偿工作与边疆冒险的形态(职员、养家者、边疆人)。研究以无种子词、由指代消解定义对象的 STM 方法,提供了一种可复现的、面向角色而非词汇的远读路径,可独立复现历史学界已确立的男性气质分类并为之提供量化轨迹。局限在于以男性主导段落为分析单位,可能低估在女性主导叙事中呈现的关系性男性气质(父职、求婚、丈夫角色)。

Abstract: Masculinity in nineteenth-century fiction is not a single ideal but a field of competing scripts. Drawing on 150 British and American canonical novels from the txtLAB Novel450 corpus, published between 1771 and 1930, this paper examines the changing relative prominence of competing models of masculine authority. To focus the analysis on masculine characterisation, the study extracts male-character-centred text windows by using coreference resolution to group names, nominal mentions, and pronouns into character-specific reference chains. It then fits an unsupervised structural topic model with publication year and author gender as topic-prevalence covariates. The model identifies six distinct masculine formations: aristocratic-chivalric, Christian manhood, gentlemanly respectability, country squire, professional-commercial, and imperial/adventure. Across the corpus, formations tied to inherited rank and sacred authority decline, while those organised around paid work and adventure rise. The largest increase occurs not in professional-commercial breadwinning but in imperial/adventure masculinity, particularly the frontier-wilderness register. The trajectory points to a reallocation from inherited and sacred status towards achieved, commercial, and expansionary forms of masculine authority. Adventurous and commercial formations are also more prevalent in novels by authors recorded as male. Because these formations emerge without a seeded vocabulary yet align with categories established in independent scholarship, the article offers a reproducible method for measuring the reorganisation of gendered authority across the long nineteenth century.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统情感分析将情感简化为离散类别（如正/负），难以捕捉复杂人类情绪的细微差别和强度。维度化方面级情感分析（DimABSA）通过将情感映射到"效价"（valence，积极性）和"唤醒度"（arousal，强度）的连续二维空间，能够更忠实地反映人类情感的复杂性。该研究旨在解决SemEval-2026 Task 3中细粒度、多语言、多领域的维度化情感分析挑战。

Conclusion: 研究表明，统一的生成式LLM框架在维度化方面情感四元组预测中具有强大能力，能同时捕获文本提取与情感强度的关系，避免多步pipeline的误差传播。俄语赛道的零样本LLM合成描述增强有效帮助编码器理解数值范围差异。论文建议未来工作将纯生成方法扩展至Subtask 1的回归任务，并探索在更多语言和领域中的可扩展性，同时关注超参数选择和提示词设计对性能的关键影响。

Abstract: This paper presents an approach to the SemEval-2026 Task 3: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis. We investigate methods for moving beyond traditional categorical sentiment (e.g., positive or negative) to predict fine-grained, real-valued scores for sentiment "valence" (positivity) and "arousal" (intensity). We participate in two subtasks: predicting these scores for given aspects (Subtask 1) and extracting full sets of sentiment details, including aspects, categories, and opinions alongside their scores (Subtask 3). Our approach for the regression task involves a weighted ensemble of transformer-based encoder models. For the Russian language, we further enhance the input by using a large language model (LLM) to generate synthetic sentiment descriptions. For the extraction task, we fine-tune a decoder LLM to perform structured prediction, allowing the system to identify sentiment elements and estimate their numerical scores simultaneously.

</details>


### [68] [Learning from Lost Provenance: Multiple Instance Learning for Cancer Registry Tumor Group Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03481)
*Leonard Ruocco,Jonathan Simkin,Lovedeep Gondora,Gregory Arbour,Raymond Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于注意力多示例学习（ABMIL）的框架，利用加拿大BC省癌症登记处（BCCR）日常运营中产生的患者级别肿瘤组标签，通过注意力机制恢复标签与具体病理报告之间的"丢失溯源"链接，将大规模噪声标注语料库蒸馏为高质量的逐报告训练数据集，最终在12类肿瘤组分类任务上达到macro F1=0.83，优于标签传播和文本拼接基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癌症登记处（PBCR）每年需处理大量病理报告并由肿瘤数据专员（ODS）手动分配肿瘤组分类，耗费巨大人力。深度学习虽可自动化此过程，但核心瓶颈在于缺乏报告级别的人工标注数据。登记处虽在日常运营中产生大量专家分配的标签，但这些标签属于患者/肿瘤级别，并未记录与具体病理报告的溯源链接，无法直接用于监督训练。现有方案（过滤单报告病例、标签传播至所有报告、拼接所有报告）均存在数据浪费、标签噪声或计算开销过大的问题。

Method: 提出两阶段ABMIL管道：(1) **ABMIL-WS（弱监督分类）**：将每个患者健康号（PHN）视为一个"包"，其关联的多份病理报告视为"实例"，使用BCCRTron（基于GatorTron-base在110万份病理报告上继续预训练得到的临床语言模型）提取报告的[CLS]嵌入（d=1024），冻结编码器，仅训练门控注意力池化层（隐藏维度512）和12类softmax分类头，以PHN级别肿瘤组标签作为监督信号，注意力权重即为每份报告的相关性分数。(2) **ABMIL-DISTIL（数据蒸馏+微调）**：利用训练好的注意力权重按百分位阈值（0%–99%扫描）过滤语料库，保留高注意力报告，将肿瘤组标签传播至这些报告，构建干净的逐报告数据集，再用BCCRTron作为编码器进行端到端微调（部分解冻，24层中放开6层）。在75%阈值处达到最优权衡。基线包括标签传播（0%阈值）和文本拼接（BCCRTron-2k，2048 token上下文）。

Result: 数据集包含2020–2023年82,855名PHN的359,714份病理报告，覆盖12个肿瘤组。在2,057份ODS标注的独立测试集上：(1) ABMIL-DISTIL（75%阈值）macro F1=0.83，表现最优；(2) 标签传播基线macro F1=0.68；(3) 文本拼接基线macro F1=0.79；(4) ABMIL-WS作为独立分类器macro F1=0.72，略优于标签传播基线。ABMIL-DISTIL在大多数肿瘤组上均优于基线，Skin、Genitourinary、Melanoma提升最显著。例外是Sarcoma组因50余种亚型重叠且训练数据有限，成为"兜底类"（precision=0.25, recall=0.89）。阈值扫描显示macro F1在75%处达峰，低于该值因标签噪声过大，高于该值因训练数据不足。

Conclusion: 本研究首次将ABMIL应用于基于运营级PHN级别监督的病理报告肿瘤组分类，证明了注意力机制既是分类工具也是数据筛选机制——通过百分位阈值过滤可将大型噪声语料库蒸馏为紧凑高质量的训练集，无需额外人工标注。ABMIL-WS仅需冻结嵌入和轻量注意力头（可在CPU上运行），为资源有限的登记处提供了自动化入口。该框架具有任务无关性，原则上可推广至任何以患者级别标签监督、关联病理报告语料的登记处编码任务（如组织学分型、原发部位、偏侧性等）。局限性包括：仅在单一登记处验证、排除多原发肿瘤患者、假设每个包中至少有一份报告与标签相关。

Abstract: Modernizing cancer registries with deep learning is opening new opportunities to automate labor-intensive tasks such as the coding of pathology reports. However, progress is constrained by the scarcity of report-level human-annotated training data. Cancer registries generate substantial volumes of expert-assigned labels as a routine product of their operations, but these exist at the patient level and are not linked to the individual pathology reports that informed them, limiting their direct use for training models. We develop an efficient framework for training deep learning classifiers by leveraging these operationally-generated labels without requiring per-report human annotation, demonstrated for tumor group classification at the BC Cancer Registry. We use Attention-Based Multiple Instance Learning (ABMIL) to recover the lost link between patient-level labels and the reports that informed them, leveraging the attention the model places on each report to distil a large, noisily-labeled corpus into a compact, high-quality per-report training dataset. A classifier fine-tuned on a distilled dataset achieved a macro F1 of 0.83, outperforming established baselines across most tumor groups. By turning routine operational labels into high-quality training data without additional annotation or large-scale computing infrastructure, ABMIL offers a practical and accessible route to automating cancer registry workflows.

</details>


### [69] [Lacuna Inc. at SemEval-2026 Task 4: Structurally Gated State-Space Models for Disentangling Narrative Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03482)
*Aleksey Kudelya,Rafif Alshawi,Alexander Shirnin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对 SemEval-2026 Task 4 叙事相似度任务,提出了 IVD-SSM 模型(Invariant-Variant Disentangled State-Space Model)。该模型以 Jamba-1.5-Mini 混合 Mamba-Transformer 为骨干(4-bit 量化 + QLoRA 微调),核心创新为结构门控对齐头(SGA):Macro-path 通过大步长(k=4)下采样捕捉粗粒度的不变情节骨架,经 Sigmoid 激活生成"结构门",通过逐元素乘法过滤 Micro-path 中的表层词汇干扰,实现不变情节结构与可变语义细节的显式解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 叙事相似度评估要求模型超越具体人名、场景、物体等表层词汇,聚焦因果链与情节进展等抽象模式。现有方法存在两大瓶颈:(1) 标准 Transformer 由于自注意力的 O(N²) 计算复杂度难以处理长篇叙事,且基于稀疏注意力的扩展会割裂长程因果依赖;(2) 标准模型(尤其是词袋/通用句子嵌入)易受"伪相关"欺骗——共享主题词汇(如"zombie""spaceship")但因果链截然不同的"硬负例"会误导模型,因此需要显式解耦结构性不变量(情节骨架)与词汇变体(表层细节)。

Method: IVD-SSM 由两部分组成:(1) 编码器:Jamba-1.5-Mini 骨干网络以 NF4 量化加载,仅对 embed_tokens、x_proj、in_proj、out_proj 注入 QLoRA(秩 16,α=32)适配器,其余参数冻结,利用 Mamba 的 O(N) 线性复杂度捕捉长程因果链;(2) 结构门控对齐头(SGA):将锚点/候选故事经两层 GELU MLP 投影至 256 维,Macro-path 以步长 k=4 下采样并计算余弦对齐矩阵 M_macro(粗粒度结构),Micro-path 计算全分辨率 M_micro(细粒度实体匹配);通过双线性插值将 M_macro 还原至全分辨率,经温度系数 τ=0.1 的 Sigmoid 激活生成"软门控掩码"G,以 M_filtered = M_micro ⊙ G 实现结构过滤,最终经行方向最大池化与均值池化得到标量相似度分数。训练采用 AdamW(余弦退火学习率 5e-4→1e-4)+梯度检查点,在 1900 条合成三元组上对 SGA 头与 QLoRA 进行 4 轮对比学习(Track A 交叉熵损失);Track B 复用训练后的投影层对单条叙事做均值池化与 L2 归一化生成嵌入。

Result: 在 SemEval-2026 Task 4 官方测试集上,Track A 配对分类准确率 57.25%(优于随机基线 50% 与 Jaccard 词项基线 56.25%,但低于零样本 GPT-4o-mini 67%),Track B 嵌入相似度准确率 54.5%(优于随机基线,劣于 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 的 58.5%)。消融实验显示 Macro-path 单独使用 57.00%(提供主要信号),Micro-path 单独使用 55.75%(弱于 Jaccard 基线,验证了细粒度匹配易受词汇干扰),门控机制在 Macro 基础上额外带来 +0.25% 提升。Track B 表现欠佳归因于:SGA 头训练目标为配对比较,均值池化压缩单故事嵌入时丢失了结构门控信号,且对比训练从未接触独立嵌入目标。

Conclusion: 研究验证了"叙事相似度不能仅靠词袋或通用句子嵌入度量,而需要显式建模顺序行动链"的假说,以及"结构不变量的显式解耦是必要的"——Macro-path 结构性骨架承载了模型大部分预测能力。门控机制虽增量有限,但以极低计算成本针对性地抑制了硬负例的语义噪声,定性分析中成功识别出"含'zombie'词汇但因果链不同的诱饵案例"。性能仍大幅落后于大规模零样本 LLM(GPT-4o-mini 领先约 10 个百分点),未来工作方向包括:(1) 动态门控阈值;(2) 更丰富的训练数据;(3) 将解耦 SSM 思路扩展到完整小说/剧本等更长叙事。局限:软 Sigmoid 门控在大量命名实体重叠时存在信号"泄露"问题;SGA 头重新引入 O(L_a × L_c) 二次瓶颈,限制了对长篇文档的扩展性;合成数据训练可能导致模型对 LLM 生成风格产生过拟合,对先锋派/非线性人类叙事的泛化能力尚待验证。

Abstract: In this paper, we present the Invariant-Variant Disentangled State-Space Model (IVD-SSM), our submission to SemEval-2026 Task 4 on Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning. Evaluating narrative similarity is a profound computational challenge that requires models to look past concrete, superficial elements such as specific names, actors, objects, or settings to isolate and compare abstract patterns of causality and plot progression. To model these extended causal chains without the quadratic bottlenecks of standard Transformers, we leverage a hybrid State-Space Model (Jamba-1.5-Mini). Building upon this backbone, we introduce the Structurally Gated Alignment (SGA) head, a novel, differentiable algorithmic architecture. The SGA head operates on two scales: a heavily strided Macro-path maps the coarse structural skeleton of a story, which then acts as a gating mechanism to filter a full-resolution Micro-path, actively suppressing semantic noise and superficial keyword overlaps. Evaluated on both pairwise comparative judgments (Track A) and dense representation learning (Track B), our approach demonstrates that explicitly disentangling structural invariants from lexical variants provides a robust, principled framework for deep narrative understanding.

</details>


### [70] [Mental Health Disorder Detection Beyond Social Media: A Systematic Review of Available Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03540)
*Sadiya Sayara Chowdhury Puspo,Ana-Maria Bucur,Stevie Chancellor,Özlem Uzuner,Marcos Zampieri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇系统性综述论文，首次全面回顾了用于心理健康研究的非社交媒体自由文本数据集，揭示了当前资源以英语和抑郁症检测为主，并提出了开发更多样化、可靠且具有临床相关性资源的机会。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于心理健康检测的NLP和机器学习方法主要依赖社交媒体数据，但这类数据集存在采样偏差以及伦理和隐私问题。为克服这些局限，作者旨在系统性地梳理非社交媒体自由文本数据集，以促进更可靠、更具临床价值的研究资源建设。

Method: 采用PRISMA方法进行系统性综述调查，涵盖多种语言的非社交媒体自由文本数据集，并对这些数据集在人口统计、平台、数据类型、标注技术和方法学方面的特征进行回顾与比较分析。

Result: 研究发现非社交媒体自由文本数据集主要集中于英语语种和抑郁症检测任务；数据集在人口统计、平台、数据类型、标注技术和方法学方面存在显著差异；同时识别出该领域的关键空白。

Conclusion: 该综述揭示了现有非社交媒体心理健康数据集的关键缺口，强调未来需要开发更多样化、更可靠且更具临床相关性的数据资源。

Abstract: Detecting mental health disorders in a timely manner is an important societal challenge. NLP and machine learning (ML) methods used to assist with detection rely on data collected primarily from social media. However, such datasets often have sampling biases and inherent ethical and privacy issues. One avenue to overcome these limitations is non-social media data. We present the first comprehensive review of non-social media, free-text datasets for mental health research. We use the PRISMA methodology to conduct our survey and we review datasets available in multiple languages. We find that non-social media free-text based datasets are predominantly focused on English and on detecting depression. These datasets also vary in demographics, platforms, data types, annotation techniques, and methodologies. This systematic review also reveals key gaps and highlights opportunities to develop more diverse, reliable and clinically-relevant resources.

</details>


### [71] [Annotating Korean adnominal ending constructions in corpus data: Beyond relative-clause identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03681)
*Jungyeul Park,Chulwoo Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对韩语冠词形词尾ETM，提出基于语料库的体裁分类体系，区分其多种名词修饰构式（关系从句类、形容词性、系词性、黏着名词、词汇化等），并将其实现为KLUE依存树库的构式敏感标注层，论证仅凭冠词形词尾形态无法识别韩语关系从句式修饰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语冠词形词尾ETM既出现在关系从句类结构中，也出现在形容词、系词、黏着名词及词汇化表达等多种名词修饰构式中；现有研究常默认ETM即标记关系从句结构，造成修饰小句分析中的混淆。本文旨在澄清ETM的形态学地位，建立可操作的构式分类。

Method: 1) 基于语料库考察ETM出现的构式多样性；2) 提出五维分类特征：谓词类型、辅助结构、论元结构兼容性、中心名词限制、词汇化模式；3) 将分类操作化为KLUE依存树库的构式敏感标注层，采用有序的基于规则的处理流程；4) 通过人工验证评估标注质量。

Result: 分析样本中，仅39.4%为能产的关系从句类用法，其余主要包括形容词性、系词性、黏着名词、情态、时间及搭配性构式。结果表明，韩语的关系从句式修饰无法仅通过冠词形词尾形态加以识别。

Conclusion: ETM并非关系从句结构的直接标记，而是多种名词修饰构式共享的形态实现。该构式敏感标注方案及基于语料库的体裁分类为韩语依存句法分析及关系从句研究提供了更精细的语言学基础。

Abstract: The Korean adnominal ending \texttt{ETM} occurs in diverse noun-modifying constructions, including relative-clause-like modifiers, adjectival and copular forms, bound-noun constructions, and lexicalized expressions. This paper argues that \texttt{ETM} is not a direct marker of relative-clause structure, but a morphological exponent shared by several adnominal constructions. We propose a corpus-based typology that distinguishes these constructions using predicate type, auxiliary structure, argument-structural compatibility, head-noun restriction, and lexicalized patterns. We operationalize the typology as a construction-sensitive annotation layer for the KLUE dependency treebank, implemented through an ordered rule-based procedure and evaluated by manual validation. Productive relative-clause-like uses account for 39.4\% of the analyzed instances; the remainder consists mainly of adjectival, copular, bound-nominal, modal, temporal, and collocational constructions. The findings show that Korean relative-clause-like modification cannot be identified from adnominal morphology alone.

</details>


### [72] [Optimizing Large Language Models for Causality Assessment in Pharmacovigilance: Developing a Performance Metric as Objective for Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03704)
*Nicole Sonne Heckmann,Arnault-Quentin Vermillet,Søren Norlin Mølgaard,Manuela Del Castillo Suero,Lars Melskens,Gerard Ompad,Maurizio Sessa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对LLM在药物警戒因果关系评估中推理时超参数优化未被研究的问题，开发了GP兼容的复合优化目标（EWACS最优），通过贝叶斯优化对温度参数进行案例特异性调优，使GPT-5.2在Naranjo算法的因果分类一致性上从45.0%提升至72.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着FAERS中个体病例安全报告（ICSR）数量激增，自动化因果评估需求迫切。虽然LLM在此任务上展现出潜力，但其性能仍欠佳，且推理时超参数（如温度）的优化在既往研究中尚未被系统研究。

Method: 1. 数据来源：723例FAERS病例，由专家进行Naranjo因果关系评估；2. 模型：OpenAI GPT-5.2，采用思维链（CoT）提示；3. 指标体系：开发四种GP兼容的复合指标（WCS、IWAS、EWACS、CWCS），结合概率改善（PoI）采集函数；4. 优化方法：在温度区间[0,2]上采用高斯过程（GP）代理模型进行贝叶斯优化；5. 评估：在Naranjo算法问题5（因果分类）和问题10上进行一致性分析。

Result: 基线（T=0）下GPT-5.2优于既往生物医学LLM，问题5一致性74.1%、问题10一致性65.4%；信息熵分析显示二者为仅有的信息优化目标；温度对群体水平无系统性影响（β=0.002, p=0.959）；EWACS引导的贝叶斯优化将因果分类一致性从45.0%提升至72.0%（+27 pp），其中"Doubtful"病例获益最大（+42.9 pp）。

Conclusion: EWACS被确定为最优GP兼容指标；不存在普适的温度最优值，表明LLM性能主要由ICSR内容驱动；但案例特异性的温度选择可带来有意义的改善，支持在LLM辅助药物警戒中进行温度优化。

Abstract: Background: Growing individual case safety report (ICSR) volumes have intensified demand for scalable automated causality assessment. Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, yet performance on clinically demanding tasks remains suboptimal and inference-time hyperparameter optimization has not been investigated. Objective: To develop a Gaussian Process (GP)-compatible optimization objective and investigate whether temperature optimization improves LLM-expert agreement on Naranjo causality assessment of FAERS ICSRs. Methods: Expert causality assessments were performed on 723 stratified FAERS cases. OpenAI's GPT-5.2 was evaluated using chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Four composite metrics were developed: Weighted Cosine Similarity (WCS), Information-Weighted Agreement Score (IWAS), Entropy-Weighted Agreement and Cosine Similarity Score (EWACS), and Consensus-Weighted Cosine Similarity (CWCS) and Bayesian optimization using a GP surrogate with Probability of Improvement (PoI) acquisition was applied across temperature [0, 2]. Results: GPT-5.2 outperformed prior biomedical LLMs at baseline (T = 0), achieving 74.1% agreement on question 5 and 65.4% on question 10 of Naranjo algorithm. Entropy analysis identified these as the sole informative optimization targets. Temperature showed no systematic population-level effect (\b{eta} = 0.002, p = 0.959). EWACS-guided Bayesian optimization improved causality classification agreement from 45.0% to 72.0% (+27 pp), with the largest gain in Doubtful cases (+42.9 pp). Conclusion: EWACS was identified as the optimal GP-compatible metric. The absence of a universal temperature optimum indicates LLM performance is driven primarily by ICSR content, yet case-specific temperature selection produced meaningful improvements, supporting temperature optimization for LLM-assisted pharmacovigilance.

</details>


### [73] [GRASP: Graph-Reasoning Aided Survey Planning for High-Fidelity Related Work Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03709)
*Haoming Li,Jessica Ouyang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GRASP（Graph-Reasoning Aided Survey Planning）是一个用于自动生成学术论文"相关工作"章节（Related Work Section, RWS）的框架，通过结合大语言模型（LLM）的规划能力与图算法，提出双层图结构（思维图 Graph of Thoughts 与论证-反论证规划网络 ACPN），并采用基于斯坦纳树（Steiner Tree）的拓扑剪枝策略，聚焦论文间的核心关系，从而生成在话语角色、引用意图和引文分组上高度贴近人类撰写目标的高保真相关工作章节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着科学出版物数量呈指数级增长，研究者撰写文献综述所需的时间和认知负担急剧加重。现有LLM在单文档摘要上表现优异，但在多文档关联摘要（尤其是RWS生成）方面存在显著不足：难以在上下文限制下保持对多篇论文的整体视角，无法准确捕捉论文之间"借鉴、挑战或提供替代视角"等复杂关系。此外，传统评估指标（如ROUGE、BERTScore）与科学文本的人工判断相关性较差，传统引文网络方法则受稀疏性和冷启动问题制约，且既有的规划引导综述生成方法未显式建模论文间关系。因此亟需一种能够显式捕捉并利用论文间关系、结构化生成高质量RWS的框架。

Method: GRASP框架由三个核心模块组成：（1）**思维图层（Graph of Thoughts, GoT）**：首先通过LLM将引用文献按主题聚类划分，对每篇论文采用思维链（Chain-of-Thought）提示提取关键观点作为顺序节点，再通过语义相似度评估将不同论文的相似节点合并为"共识节点"（consensus node），构建有向无环图；随后将剪枝问题建模为**斯坦纳树问题**——以共识节点和中介中心性排名前20%的顺序节点作为终端节点，使用2-近似算法求解，从而保留跨论文的语义主干。（2）**论证-反论证规划网络层（ACPN）**：在论文层面提取核心主张（claim），结合GoT节点信息，对论文两两关系进行分类（support/contrast/neutral），形成有向关系图，显式建模高层论证关系。（3）**RWS Writer模块**：将两层图序列化为JSON节点链接格式注入LLM提示，采用"全面草稿→语义压缩→最终合并"三阶段生成策略，并在后处理中标准化引文格式、修正幻觉作者信息。基础模型采用GPT-4o-mini。

Result: 在OARelatedWork数据集的1,350篇论文子集上的实验结果表明：（1）**传统文本生成指标**：剪枝后的GRASP在ROUGE-1/2/L、BERTScore、BLEU、METEOR上全面超越所有基线（包括SRW、L&O、Direct生成和No-graph基线），如ROUGE-1 F1达0.771，BERTScore F1达0.832。（2）**话语角色分布**：GRASP生成的句子类型分布最接近目标，而基线L&O过度生成引言/过渡和反思类句子，No-graph基线则退化为单篇论文摘要列表。（3）**引文重要性**：GRASP在Dominant类引文F1达0.922，准确识别应被详细讨论的核心文献。（4）**引文意图**：在Differences、Extends、Similarities等关系密集型意图上表现优异，Future Work类F1达1.000。（5）**引文共现**：边缘连接Jaccard相似度0.847、肯德尔τ为0.886，显著优于基线，反映出优秀的分组保真度和排序一致性。（6）**消融实验**：验证了GoT与ACPN互补不可缺，剪枝步骤对去除外围节点、降低冗余至关重要；Writer的三阶段策略在简洁性与完整性之间取得平衡。整体而言，GRASP生成的相关工作章节在结构和引文分布上与人类撰写的目标高度吻合。

Conclusion: GRASP提出了一种结构感知的自动化相关工作生成框架，通过双层图（GoT捕捉主题聚类与细节内容，ACPN建模高层论证关系）结合斯坦纳树拓扑剪枝，在保持简洁性的同时显式聚焦论文间核心关系。论文还提出了一套基于引文分析的评估体系（涵盖话语角色、引文重要性、引文意图、引文共现分组与排序），比传统文本生成指标更能反映科学文本质量。实验证明GRASP在各项指标上显著优于现有图基线（SRW、L&O）与强LLM基线（GPT-5-mini直接生成），生成的RWS在结构和引文分布上与人类目标高度一致。然而该框架仍存在局限：假设引用论文全文可用、计算成本较高（但每样本仅约2.5美分和1.5分钟）、主题划分互斥假设可能损失跨主题引文信息、且不替代人类写作（仍存在事实错误和抄袭风险），定位为辅助工具。

Abstract: Writing a literature review requires a deep understanding of the relationships among cited papers: how they build on, challenge, or offer alternative perspectives to one another. We present Graph-Reasoning Aided Survey Planning (GRASP), a framework combining LLM planning for related work generation with graph algorithms to extract key relationships among cited papers. Our two-layer graph structure consists of a Graph of Thoughts and an Argument-Counterargument Planning Network, representing the cited papers at different levels of granularity, and we apply topology-aware pruning via a Steiner tree to identify the core inter-paper relationships captured in our graph. Our citation analysis-based evaluation shows that GRASP generates related work sections (RWS) that closely match human-written targets in terms of the discourse roles, intents, and grouping of citations.

</details>


### [74] [SelfMem: Self-Optimizing Memory for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03726)
*Shu Yang,Junchao Wu,Derek F. Wong,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SelfMem提出了一种面向AI Agent的自优化记忆框架，将记忆管理从固定管线转变为由Agent自主决策的优化过程，通过暴露记忆工具与反馈信号让Agent自行探索、评估并优化记忆策略，在BEAM基准上以更低成本取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agent记忆方法（如RAG、MemGPT、MemoryBank、A-Mem、Mem0等）依赖人工预设的存储、检索和更新机制，难以适应不同任务需求，且需大量手动调优。长程任务中相关信息稀疏、分散并混杂过时内容，固定策略无法满足多样化的记忆需求。

Method: SelfMem将原始对话记录作为不可变的真实来源（以SQLite表存储），通过SQL查询等只读工具供Agent检视；同时提供模型管理的记忆工作区及四类动作空间（读取、写入、审查、自测），并以工具与环境反馈（如响应性能、token数、成本、缓存命中率）作为优化信号。Agent通过"检视-写入-审查-修订"循环自主决定存储内容、压缩与更新策略，并可通过迭代策略优化（仅基于训练集聚合反馈）进一步改进记忆行为。

Result: 在BEAM基准的100K、500K、1M token规模上，SelfMem在Score和Pass@0.5上均达到最优，分别以0.504/0.487/0.454的Score超越最强基线48.7%、40.8%、41.9%，且成本远低于MemGPT、Mem0、A-Mem等重型框架；在10类问题中的9/8/7类取得最佳成绩。策略优化实验中，默认策略的0.472提升至最终0.497，搜索中发现的最优策略达0.510。

Conclusion: 提供Agent可探索、可优化的记忆环境（含工具与反馈信号），比直接规定固定记忆模式更有效——SelfMem在长程记忆中实现了更优的质量-成本权衡，并暴露了可通过语言反馈迭代改进记忆行为的优化空间。

Abstract: While current AI agents support increasingly long context windows, tool use, and skill execution for long-horizon tasks, they still require memory systems to effectively leverage historical experience. Existing memory frameworks typically rely on fixed storage, retrieval, and summarization mechanisms, which can be rigid across different tasks and often require manual tuning. To address this limitation, we propose SelfMem, a self-optimizing memory framework. Inspired by prior work on self-improving AI, we follow the principle of "teaching an agent to fish rather than giving it a fish." Instead of forcing the model to follow a predefined memory strategy or format, SelfMem provides an environment with memory tools and feedback signals that allow the agent to explore, evaluate, and refine its own memory strategy. Our results show that SelfMem consistently outperforms retrieval, compression, and agent-memory baselines on BEAM across conversation scales from 100K to 1M tokens. Compared with the strongest baseline, SelfMem improves the official score by 48.7%, 40.8%, and 41.9% at 100K, 500K, and 1M, respectively. Further question-type analysis shows broad robustness across diverse memory demands, and our optimization study shows that model-guided strategy refinement further improves performance.

</details>


### [75] [ProACT: Towards Breakdown-Aware Proactive Agent in Multi-User Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03730)
*Shu Yang,Difei Xu,Jiaxin Pei,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ProACT 是一个面向多用户协作的"故障感知"主动代理框架，使 LLM 代理能够从被动响应转变为主动参与者，在多人对话中检测协作故障（如冲突、目标漂移、讨论循环、遗忘约束等）并决定何时发言、如何通过针对性协作技能进行简洁干预；同时构建了首个多用户协作主动代理评估基准（3,244 个轮次级样本），在五个 LLM 主干上均显著优于直接对话基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理本质上是被动且反应式的，仅响应用户的显式请求。然而在多用户协作场景中，分歧、模糊目标、遗忘约束、未明确计划、讨论循环和参与度失衡等协调故障会逐渐侵蚀团队进度。现有主动代理工作（如 Lu et al. 2025）主要关注单用户场景下的意图预测，无法解决"在具有不同、不确定或冲突意图的群体交互中何时应干预"这一社会规范性问题。论文借鉴共同基础、协作规划和协调工作理论，将代理从被动助手转变为主动参与者。

Method: ProACT 框架包含三阶段决策流水线：（1）**故障感知诊断**——观察说话者归属的对话历史 $H_t$，诊断当前轮次是否包含需要干预的协作故障（覆盖 8 类故障：冲突、不确定性、计划不明确、遗忘约束、目标漂移、讨论循环、参与失衡、风险承诺）；（2）**静默决策**——若无需干预则输出 Silence；（3）**技能路由干预**——若需干预则路由到对应的协作技能（共 9 个动作空间，包括澄清、计划补全、冲突调解、约束提醒、目标重聚焦、循环打破、参与平衡、风险检查）。每个技能定义为轻量级操作程序，包含触发条件、诊断线索、社会约束和输出契约。结构化接口将内部技能选择与可见群组面向响应分离，确保最终输出仅为简洁的群组消息。此外，论文构建了首个多用户协作主动代理基准（3,244 个样本：2,444 来自 GitHub issues 和 QMSum 的真实样本 + 800 个基于 BEAM 注入故障的合成样本，平衡为 1,622 干预与 1,622 静默案例），并使用 GPT-5.4-Nano 作为外部评判 LLM，从恰当性、非中断性、简洁性和质量（1–5 分）四个维度评估。

Result: 在五个 LLM 主干（GPT-5.4、Kimi K2.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、GPT-OSS-120B）上，ProACT 在所有指标上均一致优于 Direct Chat 基线。以 Kimi K2.5 为例：恰当性从 0.222 提升至 0.870，非中断性从 0.323 提升至 0.942，简洁性从 0.129 提升至 0.964，干预质量从 1.789 提升至 3.450。GPT-5.4 的参与时机分析显示：在静默标注样本上，ProACT 仅在 39.3% 的轮次发言（Direct Chat 为 100%），将恰当性从 65.2% 提升至 89.6%；在干预标注样本上，干预质量从 3.486 提升至 3.988，不恰当静默率仅 4.7%。质量增益在社会规划任务（委员会治理 +1.333、学术协作 +1.236、产品设计 +1.115）和对话后期（第 200–500 轮 +1.009、第 500 轮后 +1.400）最为显著。83.5% 的"漏报干预"被评判为可接受的克制性静默，反映群体正在自我修复。

Conclusion: ProACT 框架通过故障感知诊断和技能路由，使 LLM 代理能够在多用户协作中做出更好的参与时机决策和干预质量。论文贡献包括：（1）首个将代理从被动响应转向主动协作的"故障感知"框架；（2）首个多用户协作主动代理基准；（3）在五个 LLM 主干上验证一致改进。局限性包括：评估为离线轮次级设置，未能捕捉实时协作动态（如信任形成、用户适应）；使用外部 LLM 评判需补充人类研究；论文明确警示了主动代理在群体决策中可能被滥用以选择性呈现证据、不对称框架选项、压制异议或诱导合作等风险，建议未来工作应包括受控人类实验、部署审计以及透明度、日志、可争议性和角色权限约束。

Abstract: Conversational agents are increasingly embedded in human collaborative work, yet they remain fundamentally passive and reactive: they respond to explicit user requests rather than proactively recognizing moments when a team would benefit from timely intervention as human collaborators often do. This reactive design substantially limits the use of agents as active participants in multi-user collaboration, where disagreements, ambiguous goals, forgotten constraints, underspecified plans, discussion loops, and imbalanced participation can gradually undermine group progress. To move agents from passive assistants toward active participants in multi-user collaboration, we introduce ProACT, a breakdown-aware agent framework grounded in theories of common ground, collaborative planning, and coordination work. ProACT observes the speaker-attributed conversation history, determines whether the current turn contains a collaboration breakdown requiring intervention, decides whether the agent should stay silent or speak, and, when speaking is needed, routes the case to a targeted collaboration skill. We further introduce the first multi-user collaboration benchmark for evaluating proactive agents across project planning, product design, research collaboration, logistics, education, and resource-constrained decision making. Across 3,244 turn-level examples and five LLM backbones, ProACT consistently improves collaborative appropriateness, non-interruptiveness, conciseness, and judged intervention quality over direct chat.

</details>


### [76] [Rethinking Scientific Discovery in an Agentic Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03863)
*Yining Zheng,Yuxin Wang,Jiahao Lu,Shicheng Fang,Weiyi Wang,Yongzhuo Yang,Bowen Li,Haochen Ma,Chen Hu,Bowen Chen,Yang Wang,Huanhui Chen,Yitong Chen,Jiajun Chen,Zhiyuan Li,Yanlin Li,Zhuo Yang,Qifeng Wu,Jiaying He,Zhijie Jinluo,Xiaohu Xu,Yi Feng,Juncheng Qian,Yizhou Chen,Yang Cheng,Tong Zhu,Tianlei Ying,Hongyu Yu,Hongjun Xiang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SCION 是一个面向科学研究的智能体操作系统（agentic scientific operating system），通过 Science Agent 作为 Meta-Harness，将科学任务、工具、代理、工件与记忆串联起来，把科研过程转化为可执行、可审计、可复用的操作流程，并在材料分析、分子设计、蛋白质/抗体筛选等任务中优于现有自主研究代理基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 AI4Science 系统大多是碎片化工具，仍需人类研究者手动协调问题建模、文献检索、模型调用、仿真、验证与知识复用等环节。这种"以人为中心"的协调模式难以支撑长周期、跨工具的科学发现，也阻碍了科研成果的可追溯性与可复用性。论文旨在填补这一缺口，将 AI 从孤立的工具集合提升为可协调、可治理的科研操作层。

Method: SCION 的核心方法包括：(1) Research Execution Plan (REP)：将高层科学意图编译为分阶段目标、依赖关系、验证检查点、工具需求、预期工件与回退条件；(2) 分层多智能体执行（hierarchical multi-agent execution）结合基于画像的专家化（profile-driven specialization）；(3) 选择性上下文构建（selective context construction）与受治理的委派机制（governed delegation）；(4) 分层认知记忆（layered epistemic memory），支持长周期科学工作的记忆复用；(5) 在理论层面，将科学发现建模为 Target-conditioned Inverse Search，并进一步扩展到隐藏目标场景，在有限实验预算下采用批处理主动搜索（batch active search）。

Result: 在材料分析、分子设计、蛋白质与抗体筛选等应用场景中，SCION 在任务分解、验证、迭代优化与记忆复用等关键能力上优于现有自主研究代理基线。在科学阅读、创意生成、分子生成与抗体筛选等实验任务上同样表现突出，验证了 REP 与分层多代理架构在跨领域科研任务中的有效性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: SCION 将 AI 从孤立工具转变为面向科研的协调操作层，使科学发现过程具备可追溯、可审计、可复用的特性。论文提出了一个统一的系统与理论框架（REP + Target-conditioned Inverse Search），为长周期、跨工具的自主科学创新提供了新范式，推动 AI4Science 从"工具组合"走向"组织化协同"。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced scientific discovery, but most AI4Science systems remain fragmented tools that rely on humans to coordinate problem formulation, literature grounding, model use, simulation, validation, and knowledge reuse. This paper presents \textbf{SCION (Scientific Collaborative Innovation with Agentic Organizational Nexus)}, an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an \textbf{organizational nexus}. Through a Science Agent serving as a \textbf{Meta-Harness}, SCION connects scientific tasks, tools, agents, artifacts, and memory, transforming research into an executable, auditable, and reusable operational process. At its core is the \textbf{Research Execution Plan (REP)}, which compiles high-level scientific intent into staged objectives, dependencies, verification checkpoints, tool requirements, expected artifacts, and fallback conditions. SCION further integrates hierarchical multi-agent execution, profile-driven specialization, selective context construction, governed delegation, and layered epistemic memory to support long-horizon scientific work. We formulate discovery under SCION as \textbf{Target-conditioned Inverse Search} and extend it to hidden-target settings through batch active search under finite experimental budgets. Applications in materials analysis, molecule design, and protein or antibody screening, together with experiments on scientific reading, idea generation, molecule generation, and antibody screening, show that SCION outperforms existing autonomous research-agent baselines, especially in decomposition, verification, refinement, and memory reuse. Overall, SCION shifts AI from isolated tools toward a coordinated operational layer for traceable and reusable scientific innovation.

</details>


### [77] [Can Dialects Be Steered Like Languages? Sparse Neurons and Distributed Directions in Arabic LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03936)
*Kareem Elozeiri,Mervat Abassy,Omar Kallas,Fahim Dalvi,Preslav Nakov,Kentaro Inui,Nadir Durrani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究阿拉伯语LLM中方言特征的编码机制，提出两种推理时干预方法（稀疏神经元操控和分布式激活向量操控）来控制方言生成，无需微调即可引导模型生成目标方言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯方言数据稀缺导致LLM倾向于生成现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA），无法准确生成方言内容。从可解释性角度出发，探索方言特征在模型内部的编码方式，并利用这些表征实现推理时的方言控制。

Method: 两种互补的推理时方法：(1) 基于LAPE框架识别方言相关MLP神经元，通过缩放激活值进行神经元操控；(2) 从对比方言-MSA对的响应端隐藏状态中提取平均差值向量，通过前向hook注入残差流。同时结合LLM-as-a-judge、人工评估和AL-QASIDA（ADI2指标）三种评估方式。

Result: 方言信息呈"稀疏+分布式"混合编码：方言神经元集中在模型后层（ALLaM第29-31层占69.5%，Fanar第37-41层占50.6%），MSA与口语方言的Jaccard重叠仅0.09-0.14，方言间重叠0.40-0.55。向量操控在单方言和MSA提示下均显著优于神经元操控，能从MSA提示覆盖生成方言；神经元操控仅能强化已有方言倾向，但LAPE选出的神经元仅解释了约7-20%的残差方言方向。在ALLaM-7B和Fanar-1-9B两个阿拉伯语专用模型、埃及/摩洛哥/海湾/黎凡特方言上得到验证。

Conclusion: 阿拉伯方言特征既不是完全局部化于神经元，也不是完全弥散分布，而是呈结构化的因果可操控维度。神经元操控提供局部可解释性但效果有限，分布式向量操控提供更可靠的方言控制。这是首次证明阿拉伯方言可通过稀疏神经元和分布式激活空间方向在LLM中进行因果操控。

Abstract: A key challenge in Arabic NLP is the scarcity of dialectal data relative to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), causing LLMs to overproduce MSA and struggle with dialectally accurate generation. From an interpretability perspective, this raises a fundamental question: where and how are dialectal features encoded within model internals, and can these representations be leveraged to improve dialect generation without fine-tuning? This study investigates two complementary inference-time approaches that serve simultaneously as interpretability probes and control mechanisms. First, we conduct a neuron-level analysis, identifying sparse neuron populations that encode dialect-specific features and showing that amplifying or suppressing these neurons can steer model outputs toward target dialects. Second, motivated by the entanglement of dialectal features at the single-neuron level, we apply a vector-steering approach that extracts dialect-specific activation directions and injects them during inference. Together, these methods illuminate the geometry of dialectal knowledge in Arabic LLMs and offer a principled, interpretability-grounded framework for dialect control without requiring dialect-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [78] [TRACER: Early Failure Detection for Task-Oriented Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03974)
*Erfan Nourbakhsh,Rocky Slavin,Ke Yang,Anthony Rios*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACER，一种面向任务型对话（TOD）的早期失败检测方法。该方法将失败预测建模为"部分对话预测"问题，通过双流架构融合对话信念状态的轨迹动态特征（振荡分数、覆盖率、冲突计数、填充速度、领域切换）与序列化信念状态文本表示，从对话前缀预测整个对话是否最终失败，并基于阈值触发恢复干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务型对话系统的评估范式主要衡量最终结果（任务是否成功），但对话失败往往是渐进式出现的（槽位不稳定、矛盾、约束缺失、领域漂移），等到结果出来时已经为时过晚，缺乏从部分对话上下文预测即将失败并触发恢复决策的原则性框架。相关工作如PARADISE、对话中断检测（breakdown detection）、TD-EVAL侧重事后分析或单轮质量评估，而开放域的derailment forecasting依赖社交信号而非信念状态演化，均不能直接适用于TOD的轨迹级失败预警。

Method: （1）将任务型对话失败预测形式化为部分对话预测问题：从每个对话的每个可见前缀构造监督样本，共享对话级最终成败标签。（2）双流编码器架构——轨迹流：提取5维轨迹特征向量（OscScore振荡分数、CoverageRate覆盖率、ConflictCount冲突计数、FillVelocity填充速度、DomainShifts领域切换数），通过3层Transformer（d=64，4头）编码并掩码均值池化得到h_A；信念文本流：将累积信念状态序列化为文本，用RoBERTa编码[CLS]表示并投影为h_B（256维）；融合层拼接[ h_A; h_B ]∈R^320，经MLP和sigmoid输出失败概率。（3）训练目标：BCE损失加上早期预测奖励项，对早期正确触发的失败预测按剩余对话比例加权（λ=0.3）。（4）触发策略：在开发集上以FPR≤0.15为约束选择阈值τ=0.7788，冻结后用于测试时干预决策。（5）恢复模块：比较基于模板的方法（按特征模式路由到不同澄清/确认模板）与微调T5生成器。

Result: 在MultiWOZ上的主要结果：TRACER（oracle）AUC-ROC=0.741，F1=0.463；TRACER（generated）AUC-ROC=0.617，F1=0.370，均显著优于启发式（feature-threshold ensemble AUC=0.535）、经典逻辑回归（AUC=0.600）以及Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B的零样本/思维链/少样本提示基线（最佳AUC=0.531）。消融实验显示双流融合优于单流（特征流AUC=0.623，文本流AUC=0.692）。固定上下文分析表明，仅25%对话可见时AUC已达0.666，75%时升至0.811，接近全上下文水平。跨域零样本迁移：ABCD上AUC=0.771效果较好，SGD上AUC=0.494效果差。恢复实验中模板方法在groundedness（0.669 vs 0.374）、问题针对性（0.376 vs 0.011）上显著优于T5生成器。启发式基线虽EDS较高但FPR也极高（如τ=0.1时FPR=1.0），凸显阈值权衡的必要性。

Conclusion: TRACER证明了从部分对话上下文预测任务型对话失败的可行性，通过结合轨迹动态与信念状态文本的双流架构，在仅观察到25%对话时即产生有意义的失败预警信号，在多个指标上优于启发式、经典和LLM提示基线，可作为任务型对话系统的实用预警控制层，补充传统事后评估方法。局限性包括恢复分析为离线评估不能证明对真实用户有效、失败分类法非黄金标准监督、跨域迁移不一致（ABCD成功、SGD失败）、部分轨迹特征较粗糙、EDS单独不足以评估需结合FPR权衡。未来工作将进行交互式在线验证、改进跨数据集迁移、加强人类标注的失败类别验证。

Abstract: Task-oriented dialogue systems often fail before the final breakdown is obvious, but most evaluation only measures failure after the conversation has already gone wrong. We present TRACER, a method for early failure detection in task-oriented dialogue. TRACER predicts from a partial dialogue whether the full conversation will eventually fail by combining simple trajectory signals from belief-state changes with text representations of the evolving dialogue state. We evaluate the method in both oracle and generated belief-state settings, and test how well it works when only 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of the dialogue is visible. Across these settings, TRACER detects useful failure signals well before the end of the conversation and outperforms heuristic, classical, and single-stream baselines. These results suggest that early failure detection can provide a practical warning signal for dialogue systems before the interaction fully breaks down.

</details>


### [79] [Candidate-Constrained Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LongEval-RAG: System Design and Empirical Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04008)
*Yingdong Yang,Haijian Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向LongEval-RAG任务的候选集约束型检索增强生成（RAG）系统，系统评估了10种流水线变体，发现结合基于规则的文本切分、查询扩展、伪相关反馈（PRF）、倒数排名融合（RRF）、重排序以及MiniLM句子级神经选择的"rule-minilm"变体在BERTScore、检索精度、nugget覆盖率和平均评分上表现最佳。研究表明，稳定的基于规则的证据单元与句子级神经选择的组合比复杂的语义切分更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LongEval-RAG任务要求所有检索证据和最终引用必须严格限制在组织方预先提供的候选文档集内，这与开放域RAG（如基于Wikipedia检索）有本质区别。作者旨在设计一个满足候选集约束的系统，并通过系统性的流水线变体实验，探究在受限检索环境下提升RAG性能的关键因素，同时验证多指标评估的必要性。

Method: 系统核心方法包括：(1) 确定性来源追踪（deterministic provenance tracking）与基于段落的检索；(2) 确定性查询扩展；(3) 伪相关反馈（PRF）；(4) 倒数排名融合（RRF）；(5) 轻量级证据重排序；(6) 引用感知的证据聚合；(7) 可选的MiniLM句子重排序。实验共设计了10种流水线变体，使用组织方的主评估和作者自建的LLM-judge辅助诊断协议进行评估，评估指标包括BERTScore、检索精度、nugget覆盖率和平均评分。

Result: 主评估结果显示，"rule-minilm"变体（基于规则的切分流水线，融合查询扩展、PRF、RRF、重排序、引用先验及后期MiniLM句子选择）在BERTScore、检索精度、nugget覆盖率和平均评分上均取得最高分。然而，辅助LLM-judge评估则强调了不同的系统，与基于黄金答案和nugget的主评估结果存在差异，凸显了多指标RAG评估的必要性。

Conclusion: 主要性能增益并非来自更复杂的语义切分或主题转移切分策略，而是源于将稳定的基于规则证据单元与生成前的句子级神经选择相结合。LLM-judge评估虽对早期诊断和补充分析有价值，但与黄金答案和nugget基评估的侧重点不同，证实单一评估指标不足以全面衡量RAG系统性能，多指标协同评估是必要的。

Abstract: We present a candidate-constrained retrieval-augmented generation system for LongEval-RAG, where each query is associated with an organizer-provided candidate set and all retrieved evidence and final citations must remain within that set. The system combines deterministic provenance tracking with passage-based retrieval, deterministic query expansion, pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), lightweight evidence reranking, citation-aware evidence aggregation, and optional MiniLM sentence reranking. We evaluate ten pipeline variants using a primary organizer evaluation and a supplementary self-generated diagnostic protocol. The primary evaluation shows that the strongest balanced variant is rule-minilm: a rule-based chunking pipeline with query expansion, PRF, RRF, reranking, citation prior, and late MiniLM sentence selection. This variant obtains the highest BERTScore, retrieval precision, nugget coverage, and average grade among our submissions. The result suggests that the main gain does not come from more complex semantic or topic-shift chunking, but from pairing stable rule-based evidence units with sentence-level neural selection before generation. The supplementary LLM-judge evaluation remains useful for early diagnosis and additional analysis, but it emphasizes different systems than the primary gold-answer and nugget-based evaluation, highlighting the need for multi-metric RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [80] [CrossHallu: Do Hallucination Signals Generalize Across Languages and Domains in Large Language Model's Internals?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04029)
*Aisha Alansari,Malak Alkhorasani,Hamzah Luqman*

Main category: cs.CL
