Prior work has attempted to tackle this problem via inference scaling, using large language models to generate many BRTs and patches, then using execution feedback to select and improve them. Unfortunately, this is expensive and the feedback is unreliable. This paper explores evolutionary programming for BRT generation to sharpen the feedback, while enhancing evolutionary programming to keep costs in check. Our new approach, EvoOtter, controls test execution costs via successive halving. Furthermore, it controls LLM costs via batched crossover for an entire generation in a single LLM call, as well as via rule-based code mutations, with a new fitness score tailored for BRTs. As a result, EvoOtter generates state-of-the-art quality BRTs at the fraction of the cost of prior inference-scaling approaches to this problem. More broadly, this paper points at how to efficiently and effectively combine evolutionary programming with large language models for software engineering.

</details>


### [159] [Diagnosis-Driven Automatic Repair for Agentic Workflow via Symbolic Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02882)
*Xuyan Ma,Yawen Wang,Junjie Wang,Xiaofei Xie,Boyu Wu,Mingyang Li,Dandan Wang,Qing Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowFixer，一个面向平台编排的智能体工作流（Agentic Workflow）的诊断驱动自动修复框架。该框架通过将执行轨迹转化为统一符号表示并进行符号推理，推导出节点级行为规约（包含存在性、时序性、因果性三类约束），进而实现精确的故障归因与根因分析，并生成有针对性的修复补丁。在Dify、Coze、n8n三大平台的实际工作流失败案例上，FlowFixer修复成功率达71.3%，较SOTA基线提升11.9%~27.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平台编排的智能体工作流（如Dify、Coze、n8n）因LLM输出的概率性、节点间复杂依赖与异构工具交互而面临严重的可靠性挑战。现有工作流优化与智能体增强方法主要依赖轨迹级反馈进行探索式优化，缺乏对失败根因的显式建模，导致修复方案粒度粗、靶向性差。因此需要一种诊断驱动的修复范式：通过精确的故障归因与根因分析，为修复提供明确指导。核心挑战有二：①工作流失败在执行轨迹中仅部分可观测，错误沿依赖传播导致上下游症状交织；②节点与提示、变量、模型配置及下游行为深度耦合，局部修改可能引入副作用。

Method: FlowFixer采用"诊断↔修复"闭环架构，包含两大核心阶段：\n\n1. **符号建模与推理（Symbolic Modeling & Inference）**：将异构平台的执行轨迹归一化为统一符号表示；通过LLM驱动的规约生成器为每个节点推断三类行为规约——存在性约束（必要字段/输入/输出）、时序约束（节点执行顺序语义）、因果约束（变量一致性、接口兼容性、任务语义依赖），并以轻量级断言DSL表达。\n\n2. **故障诊断（Stage 1）**：\n   - **故障归因**：结合断言违反率与节点结构位置（上游传播影响力）计算可疑度分数，定位故障责任节点；\n   - **根因分析**：基于预定义根因分类法（16类，涵盖节点能力、节点编排、节点执行）映射失败症状到根因类型。\n\n3. **工作流修复（Stage 2）**：\n   - **补丁生成**：基于根因-策略映射知识，通过5种原子编辑操作（Insert/Remove/Replace/Append/Swap）生成修复补丁；\n   - **多维预执行评估**：从结构正确性、语义正确性、行为一致性、偏移合理性四个维度过滤不可行候选，减少动态验证开销；\n   - **动态验证与迭代循环**：通过实际执行验证补丁，失败则反馈至诊断阶段迭代重试。\n\n4. **经验池（Experience Pool）**：维护在线修复反馈（短期记忆）与累积修复经验（长期知识），支撑跨案例的持续改进。

Result: 在AgentFail数据集（307个Dify/Coze案例）与自收集的136个n8n案例上的实验结果表明：\n\n- **修复效果（RQ1）**：FlowFixer修复成功率达71.3%，超越SWE-agent（43.7%）、RepairAgent（51.2%）、ReCreat（59.4%）、GEPA（58.8%）、Scope（52.9%）、SelfHeal（55.4%），绝对提升11.9%~27.6%。\n- **诊断效果（RQ2）**：故障归因准确率84.4%（FAMAS: 51.3%，DOVER: 79.6%，AgentFixer: 66.8%），根因分析准确率87.9%（AgentFixer: 62.1%），分别提升4.8%~33.1%与15.3%~38.8%。\n- **消融实验（RQ3）**：符号化、经验池贡献最大（移除后RSR下降24.3%和29.6%）；根因分类法主要提升RCA（+33.5%），修复知识主要提升RSR（+11.1%）。\n- **预执行评估有效性**：精度99.7%，召回率84.6%，显著减少不必要的动态执行开销。\n- **成本分析**：平均17K tokens/次修复，优于SWE-agent（38K），归因于预执行评估对低质量候选的早期过滤。

Conclusion: FlowFixer通过将符号建模与符号推理引入智能体工作流的故障诊断与修复流程，实现了从"轨迹级粗粒度优化"到"诊断驱动靶向修复"的范式转变。其核心贡献在于：①提出基于行为规约验证的故障诊断机制，将节点正确性、时序依赖与因果关系形式化为可执行断言；②构建根因-策略映射知识引导的补丁生成与多维预执行评估体系，有效降低验证成本；③通过经验池实现跨案例的持续学习。实验证明该方法在真实跨平台工作流失败上显著优于现有程序修复与智能体增强基线，为智能体工作流的可靠性与可维护性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Platform-orchestrated agentic workflows have become a popular paradigm for developing LLM-based applications. However, their reliability remains a major challenge due to the uncertainty of LLM outputs, complex inter-node dependencies, and heterogeneous tool interactions. Existing agentic workflow optimization and agent enhancement methods primarily rely on trajectory-level feedback. Without explicitly identifying the underlying failure root causes, their resulting repair plans are often insufficiently targeted. We propose FlowFixer, a diagnosis-driven automated repair framework for agentic workflows. FlowFixer first transforms workflow executions into unified symbolic traces and performs symbolic inference to derive executable behavioral specifications that capture node correctness, temporal dependencies, and causal relationships. Based on specification verification, it conducts failure attribution and root cause analysis, and then generates targeted repair patches. To reduce verification costs, FlowFixer further employs a multi-dimensional pre-execution assessment to filter infeasible repairs before dynamic verification. We evaluate FlowFixer on workflow failures collected from three popular development platforms: Dify, Coze and n8n. Results show that FlowFixer achieves a repair success rate of 71.3%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by 11.9% to 27.6%. It also improves failure attribution accuracy by 4.8% to 33.1% and root cause analysis accuracy by 15.3% to 38.8%. This work offers a new perspective on reliable diagnosis and repair of agentic workflows through symbolic modeling and inference.

</details>


### [160] [BeSpec: Behavior-Level Specification Alignment for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02949)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Boxi Yu,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: BeSpec 提出了一种基于行为模型的规范对齐方法，用于 LLM 代码生成。它从意图中预测可检查的行为属性（如输出格式、可行性条件、语义规则），与候选程序的观测行为对比，通过"预测-观测"差距精确定位规范歧义并迭代修复规范。在三个 LLM 和四个基准（含无污染的 LiveCodeBench）上，BeSpec 在 Pass@1 和 APR 两项指标上均优于九个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代码生成方法主要采用"生成-然后-修复"范式，即在执行反馈上修补代码，但假定模型对意图（intent）的理解已经正确。然而，编程任务描述常存在歧义或欠规范问题（specification mismatch），导致模型可能正确实现了错误的意图——这是当前代码生成的核心瓶颈。现有规范对齐方法（如 Specine、SpecFix）依赖测试级证据，但测试需要完整预言（oracle），其生成难度不亚于解题本身，且失败信号过于粗糙，无法定位规范中具体哪个部分存在歧义。

Method: BeSpec 采用行为级（而非测试级）规范对齐，包含两大并行流水线：① **预测行为流水线**：从意图抽取结构化规范（输入/输出格式、约束、正确性规则、边界用例、解释字段），并预测四种预期行为——金标准行为（来自样例）、输出行为（格式/不变量）、输入行为（适用条件）、语义行为（规则推论），每个行为实现为 check(input, output) 函数；② **观测行为流水线**：生成探测输入场景与候选程序池，在共享探测场景上执行候选程序得到观测行为。**失配识别**：构建候选×行为比较矩阵，若所有候选在某行为上一致则认为对齐；若存在分歧则标记该行为失配。**规范修复**：针对失配行为，通过 LLM 修订结构化规范中的相关字段（规则、解释、边界用例），重新生成候选并迭代检查，最多 N 次。**行为驱动选择**：排除不满足公开样例的候选，优先选择满足更多预测行为、崩溃/缺失更少的程序。

Result: 在三个 LLM（qwen3-coder-30b、glm-4.7-flash、gpt-5-mini）和六个评估设置（CodeContests 含 Raw/扩展、xCodeEval、APPS 含 APPS-Eval、LiveCodeBench）上，BeSpec 在 Pass@1 和 APR 上均达到最优。平均 Pass@1 相对最强基线提升 8.1%–25.3%，APR 提升 8.7%–28.7%；在无污染的 LiveCodeBench 上 Pass@1 提升 15.8%–17.7%，证明改进非来自记忆。效率方面，每问题消耗 60.3k–122.1k tokens、364–1132 秒，远低于 SpecFix。在 qwen3-coder-30b 上的消融实验表明：移除行为模型使 Pass@1/APR 在所有基准上大幅下降（如 CodeContests 上 Pass@1 降低 55.2%），候选池大小与迭代次数存在权衡（池大则迭代少）。失败分析显示，1175 个剩余失败中仅 52 个归因于"规范薄弱"，绝大多数为算法/逻辑、运行时崩溃或超时——证明对齐后规范已不再是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: BeSpec 将规范对齐从粗粒度的测试级证据推进到细粒度的行为级推理，通过显式行为模型、预测-观测对比和针对性规范修复，有效解决了意图歧义问题。该方法在跨 LLM、跨基准的全面评估中一致优于九个基线，且失败分析表明规范误解已不是剩余错误的主要来源。消融验证了行为模型各组件的关键贡献。未来工作将扩展到结合测试与执行轨迹等多源证据进行联合推理。

Abstract: LLMs have made substantial progress on automated code generation from natural-language descriptions of desired behavior (intent). Most existing methods improve generated programs through execution-guided code refinement: they generate a candidate solution, execute it, and patch the implementation using feedback, while leaving the underlying specification unchanged. This workflow implicitly assumes that the LLM's understanding of the intent is already correct and complete. In practice, however, intents are often ambiguous or underspecified. As a result, even a capable model may produce a correct implementation of the wrong intent, making specification mismatch a central bottleneck. This paper presents BeSpec, a behavioral model-based approach to specification alignment. BeSpec treats the task description as partial evidence about the intended behavior of the correct program. It first builds an explicit behavioral model, which are checkable properties that valid outputs must satisfy. BeSpec then generates candidate programs, executes them on probe inputs, and compares their observed behavior with the predicted behaviors. When observed behavior does not match the predicted behaviors, BeSpec either refines the specification or rejects the candidate program. We evaluate BeSpec with three LLMs on four benchmarks: CodeContests, xCodeEval, APPS, and the contamination-free LiveCodeBench. Against nine baselines, BeSpec achieves the highest Pass@1 and average pass rate across all settings, improving average Pass@1 over the strongest baseline by 8.1%--25.3% relative across the three LLMs. A failure analysis shows that after alignment, most remaining errors stem from algorithmic difficulty rather than misunderstood specifications, while ablation studies confirm that each major component of BeSpec contributes positively.

</details>


### [161] [CAFÉ, an automated feedback tool to approach Formal Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03001)
*Géraldine Brieven,Ayman Labrahimi Kasdaoui,Benoit Donnet*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CAFÉ是一个面向计算机科学学生的在线学习平台，通过"图形化循环不变式编程"（GLIBP）方法教授形式化方法（FM）。学生通过填写空白GLI（图形化循环不变式）并推导对应代码来培养结构化思维，平台提供关于GLI设计及其与代码一致性的个性化自动反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化方法（FM）在工业界日益重要，但教授和学习FM仍具挑战。现有研究指出，编写正确程序是初学者面临的主要困难，而循环的正确构建尤为关键。然而，现有的基于不变式的编程教学工具不支持图形化循环不变式，也缺乏自动反馈功能。因此，作者开发了CAFÉ平台，旨在通过GLI这种非形式化的可视化表示方法，让CS1阶段的学生尽早接触结构化思维，为后续形式化方法的学习奠定基础。

Method: CAFÉ基于GLIBP（图形化循环不变式编程）方法，该方法以Hoare逻辑和Dijkstra编程方法论为基础。GLI用非形式化的图表表示循环不变式，包含迭代对象、变量及其属性、变量间关系。学生在填空式GLI中填写"自由框"（表达式）和"约束框"（预定义符号）。平台通过形式化语义进行自动检查：自由框映射到域或与其他框的依赖关系，约束框映射到符号ID。教师可通过配置文件定义新题目和对应的元模型及检查规则。求解过程分为五个步骤：完成GLI、确定初始状态、确定最终状态、给出循环变体函数、编写代码。系统对每个部分提供个性化自动反馈，并已在Dafny中开发了将GLI和C代码自动翻译进行形式化验证的原型。

Result: CAFÉ已在作者的CS1课程中部署多年，2025-2026学年包含三道编程挑战（涉及范围乘积、数组压缩、属性筛选等）。学生有2天窗口期可提交最多3次，每次都获得自动反馈，最终提交决定分数，每题占总成绩2%。研究结果显示，CS2课程中，学生绘制GLI的能力与编写形式化循环不变式（FLI）的能力存在统计学上的显著正相关，表明GLI训练有效促进了学生识别属性和描述区域的能力。平台已测试将GLI和C代码翻译为Dafny进行验证，覆盖10个代表性CS1问题。Dafny翻译通过提取三个核心组件（迭代对象、区域分隔符、区域文本描述）映射为谓词。

Conclusion: CAFÉ通过结合结构化可视化循环不变式表示与个性化自动反馈，帮助学生在教育早期培养结构化思维技能，为形式化方法奠定基础。该平台已成功在CS1课程中应用，目前正开发将GLI和C实现自动翻译为Dafny的原型，以实现形式化验证和更丰富的反馈。作者认为这是弥合非形式化图表推理与严格形式化方法之间差距的有力一步，并欢迎其他机构合作采用或扩展CAFÉ用于FM教学。

Abstract: We present CAFÉ, a learning platform designed to introduce computer science students to Formal Methods (FM). CAFÉ aims to scaffold students' structural thinking (in contrast with operational thinking) by promoting the practice of Graphical Loop Invariant Based Programming (GLIBP). In the GLIBP approach, students solve loop-based problems by first constructing a Graphical Loop Invariant (GLI) before deriving the corresponding code. The GLI is an informal diagrammatic representation of the loop invariant. It illustrates the variables involved in the loop, their properties, and the relationships between them. To enable automated feedback, students complete a blank GLI, a box-based version of the GLI. Beyond evaluating the code students submit, CAFÉ provides personalized feedback on students' GLI and its alignment with the code. In this demo, we walk through CAFE from both a student's and a teacher's perspective. We show how the tool supports GLI design and provides feedback. We then present how a teacher can encode programming challenges together with a corresponding blank GLI.

</details>


### [162] [Detection of LLM-assisted Code Plagiarism Using k-gram Software Birthmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03014)
*Nikolay Fedorov,Akito Monden,Hiroki Inayoshi,Haruaki Tamada,Masateru Tsunoda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究使用基于 Java 字节码操作码的 k-gram 软件出生标记（software birthmarks）来检测由大语言模型（LLM）通过代码释义（code paraphrasing）生成的抄袭代码。通过实验三个 LLM（ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Claude-Haiku-4.5）和五种相似度度量方法，发现 k-gram 出生标记在检测 LLM 辅助抄袭方面仍然有效，其中 2-gram 表现最佳，Dice 指数是最有效的相似度度量，ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini 生成的抄袭代码最难检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的快速发展显著降低了软件抄袭的技术门槛。攻击者可以通过 LLM 对源代码进行释义（paraphrasing），在保留功能的前提下大幅修改语法、结构和格式，从而逃避传统基于源代码相似度的抄袭检测。这种威胁对于开源软件生态尤其严重，因为攻击者可以在不直接复制代码的情况下重现功能，规避 copyleft 许可证（如 GPL）的要求。现有抄袭检测技术多依赖源代码相似度比较，但在实际场景中，被分发的往往是可执行文件而非源代码。因此，需要研究能够从可执行文件（即编译后的字节码）中提取特征的软件出生标记技术在面对 LLM 辅助抄袭时是否仍然有效。

Method: 1. **出生标记提取**：采用 Myles 和 Collberg 提出的 k-gram 出生标记方法，将 Java 源文件用 javac 编译后用 javap 提取字节码指令，再转换为 ASM 框架定义的 opcode 数字序列，通过滑动窗口（k=1 到 6）生成唯一的 k-gram 集合作为出生标记。\n2. **LLM 代码释义**：使用三个 LLM（ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Claude-Haiku-4.5）对原始源代码进行释义，要求修改语法、格式和结构同时保留功能，并保持可编译。\n3. **数据集**：从 GitHub 上筛选 BSD-2-Clause 许可证、超过 100 星且 2025 年 6 月 14 日后有更新的活跃 Java 项目，要求源文件可独立编译，逻辑代码行数（LLC）在 30 到 1000 之间，最终保留 352 个源文件。\n4. **相似度度量**：评估五种方法——余弦相似度（count 和 TF-IDF 两种向量化）、Dice 指数、Jaccard 系数、Simpson 指数和基于 Levenshtein 距离的编辑距离相似度。\n5. **评估指标**：使用韧性（resilience rate）和可信度（credibility rate）的调和平均（Hmean）作为评价指标，通过阈值（0.5≤ε<1）进行分类决策，报告最佳 Hmean 值。

Result: 1. **k 值的影响（RQ1）**：1-gram 表现最差，因仅捕获单个 opcode，结构信息不足；2-gram 表现最佳（平均 Hmean=0.830），3-gram 紧随其后（0.822）；k 越大，检测性能逐渐下降。结论：k=2 和 k=3 在韧性和可信度之间提供了最佳平衡。\n2. **相似度函数的影响（RQ2）**：Dice 指数表现最佳（平均 Hmean=0.946），Simpson 指数次之（0.9351），Jaccard 和 count 余弦相似度也表现良好，TF-IDF 余弦相似度稍逊；编辑距离相似度表现极差（平均 Hmean=0.276），因代码释义常改变指令顺序，使序列比对方法失效。结论：基于集合的相似度度量对释义攻击更具鲁棒性。\n3. **LLM 选择的影响（RQ3）**：Claude-Haiku-4.5 的抄袭代码最易检测（平均 Hmean=0.9322），DeepSeek-V4-Flash 次之（0.9258），ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini 生成的抄袭代码最难检测（0.8603）。同时 ChatGPT 产生的编译错误最少（10 个），说明该模型在不牺牲可编译性的前提下进行了更有效的代码转换。结论：编码专用模型（Codex-Mini）在执行释义任务时表现更优。

Conclusion: 本文得出三个核心结论：（1）k-gram 软件出生标记在检测 LLM 辅助代码抄袭方面仍然有效，特别是当 k 值较小（k=2 或 k=3）时；（2）基于集合的相似度度量（尤其是 Dice 指数）比序列敏感的编辑距离度量更适合此任务；（3）不同 LLM 生成的抄袭代码可检测性存在显著差异，面向编码的 LLM（如 Codex-Mini）生成的抄袭更具挑战性。总体而言，k-gram 出生标记凭借其简单性和可扩展性，为 LLM 时代的可执行文件级抄袭检测提供了有效基础。未来工作将扩展到更多类型的出生标记和更高级的抄袭策略，并研究结论是否适用于其他开源许可证下的软件。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly lowered the technical barrier to software plagiarism. By transforming existing source code while preserving its functionality, modern LLMs can generate semantically identical program that may evade traditional plagiarism detection techniques. Among such attacks, code paraphrasing modifies the syntax and structure of a program while preserving its behavior. This paper investigates whether software birthmarks can detect such LLM-assisted plagiarism. As a starting point, we employ k-gram software birthmarks based on unique k-grams of Java opcodes, with k ranging from 1 to 6. We employ three contemporary LLMs: ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and Claude-Haiku-4.5. The dataset consists of individually compilable source files extracted from actively maintained BSD-2-Clause licensed Java projects. We further compare five similarity measures for birthmark matching: cosine similarity, Dice index, Jaccard coefficient, Simpson index, and edit-distance-based similarity. The results demonstrate that k-gram software birthmarks remain effective for detecting LLM-assisted plagiarism. Among the evaluated models, ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini generated the most difficult-to-detect clones. Furthermore, the findings confirm the higher performance of coding-oriented models for plagiarism task.

</details>


### [163] [Compression, structure, and executor capability: a controlled real-cost decomposition of language-model agent skill optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03048)
*Xiaonan Xu,Wenjing Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过一项受控分解实验（1,200 次 rollout，覆盖 10 个条件、40 个任务）对智能体技能（agent skill）的常见优化策略进行系统性验证。结果表明：确定性缩短、结构化渲染、作用域加载与更强模型编译均未能超越原始技能；唯一具有鲁棒性效应的是执行模型（executor）能力层级，其将通过率提升 27 个百分点，但代价是约 5 倍的真实成本。没有任何优化表示策略能在真实价格下实现实际收支平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能优化普遍基于一个未被充分验证的假设——更短或更优结构的技能可以在保持任务成功率的同时降低成本。然而，现有研究往往（1）将长度、结构、编译模型与作用域加载等多个变量混杂进行端到端比较，无法归因；（2）以 token 数量而非真实货币成本作为度量，导致使用更强模型时 token 视角下的"节省"与真实账单相悖。该研究将技能表示视为受控的软件质量测量问题，旨在同时以质量和真实成本进行评估并分离各贡献因子。

Method: 采用 10 个技能交付条件、40 个软件工程任务（跨 8 个类别，含可执行验证器）、每格 3 次重复（共 1,200 次 rollout）的因子分解设计。两个模型层级：紧凑型（gpt-5.4-mini）与强型（gpt-5.5）。条件包括无技能基线、原始技能基线、确定性提取式缩短、共享语义账本的线性和结构化渲染、作用域加载，以及编译器与执行器层级交叉。关键控制：共享账本保证线性与结构化渲染的内容等价（载荷相等性检查）；哨兵审计验证无技能隔离；预固定决策边界（−5 个百分点的非劣效边界、10% 成本等价边界）和 8 个对比族（Holm 校正）。质量指标为验证器通过率；成本指标为按标准公开定价的真实 solve 阶段成本，并提供 token 体积累一化视图作为稳健性检查，编译成本单独摊销。统计方法：任务为推断单位，任务聚类自助法（10,000 次）构建 95% 区间，任务内符号翻转置换检验构建 p 值。

Result: 1,200 次 rollout 中含 500 次成功、647 次求解失败、53 次超时。原始技能将紧凑型执行器的通过率从 26.7% 提升至 42.5%，强型执行器达 64.2%（最高）。主要对比结果：确定性缩短（S2E-M vs S1-M）：+1.7 pp（95% CI [−7.5, +9.2]，Holm p=1.000），未建立非劣效，成本等价；结构化渲染（S3-55-M vs S1-M）：−13.3 pp（CI [−22.5, −4.2]，p=0.080），成本反而高 $0.0013；作用域加载：−8.3 pp（CI [−17.5, 0.0]）；在内容匹配下结构化与线性渲染不可区分（−8.3 pp，p=0.591）。编译器层级无鲁棒效应；执行器层级是唯一在校正后仍显著的因素：在同一结构化渲染下从紧凑型提升至强型执行器，通过率提升 +26.7 pp（CI [14.2, 39.2]，Holm p=0.003），但真实成本增加约 $0.027，约为 5 倍。技能注入足迹的减少（4,550 → 2,080 token）并未转化为 solve 阶段节省。真实价格下任何优化条件在条件均值上均无有限收支平衡点；强编译条件下中位有限重用次数约为 150–290 次，紧凑编译下约 12 次。真实价格视图与 token 归一化视图在跨层级时严重背离（强型执行器归一化下看似便宜但实际贵约 7 倍）。

Conclusion: 在真实价格下，将执行器能力视为决定性杠杆，而非对技能表示形式进行投资。没有任何表示策略在两个执行器层级上超越原始技能；常见优化（缩短、结构化、作用域、编译）要么未提升质量，要么甚至降低质量，且无一能降低真实 solve 阶段成本以实现摊销。该研究支持一种实践准则：在将任何智能体技能优化视为"节省"之前，应以执行器层级的真实货币价格对其进行定价。需扩大任务集与模型家族以检验该结论的外部有效性。

Abstract: Agent skills, reusable instruction artefacts supplied to a tool-using language model, are increasingly optimised by shortening, structural rewriting, stronger-model compilation, and scoped loading, on the assumption that a smaller or better-organised skill lowers cost while preserving success. That assumption is rarely tested with quality and real monetary cost measured on the same runs and the contributing factors separated. This study reports a controlled decomposition over ten skill-delivery conditions, 40 software-engineering tasks, and three repetitions per cell (1,200 rollouts), separating no-skill execution, raw skills, deterministic shortening, linear and structured rendering from a shared semantic ledger, scoped loading, and the compiler and executor model tiers. Quality is the verifier pass rate at task level; cost is solve-stage token cost at standard provider prices, with a token-volume-normalised view for robustness and compilation cost amortised separately. The task is the unit of inference, intervals are task-clustered, and the contrast family is multiplicity-controlled. Deterministic shortening is close to the raw baseline but does not establish non-inferiority within the preset margin. Structured rendering and scoped loading lower pass rate on the compact executor without lowering cost, and structured rendering is indistinguishable from linear text at matched content. The only contrast surviving correction is executor capability, which raises pass rate by 27 percentage points at roughly five times the real cost, with compiler tier showing no robust effect. Under real prices no optimised representation reaches a practical break-even. The evidence indicates that executor capability is the dominant lever and that no representation strategy improves over the raw skill on either executor tier.

</details>


### [164] [A Measurement Study on the Adoption of Pledges and Unveils in the OpenBSD Operating System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03056)
*Jukka Ruohonen,Krzysztof Sierszecki,Abhishek Tiwari*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对 OpenBSD 操作系统中 pledge 和 unveil 系统调用的采用情况进行了纵向测量研究，覆盖 19 个发行版（5.9 至 7.7，约 2016-2025 年）。研究发现这两个系统调用已被广泛且持续地采用，程序和库的大小与采用率相关性很弱，整体采用模式呈"全面普及"而非偏向大型或小型程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明系统调用最小化与沙箱技术的采用普遍存在困难（如 seccomp 在 Linux 上被认为"过于强大"且维护成本高）。本文旨在通过纵向案例研究，考察 OpenBSD 自主设计的、更简单的 pledge 和 unveil 系统调用在实际使用中是否被广泛采用，从而检验"沙箱技术难以采纳"这一论点。

Method: 对 OpenBSD 5.9 至 7.7 共 19 个发行版的源代码树（src.tar.gz）进行解析，排除 distrib、gnu、regress、sys 根目录；按行扫描 .c 文件，统计 pledge 和 unveil 字符串后接左括号的调用次数及其参数；按子目录聚合作为程序/库单位；以 .c 文件数作为软件规模代理变量；使用描述性统计和相关系数回答四个研究问题。

Result: 1）采用率持续增长，线性趋势可作为粗略启发式；7.7 版本中 pledge 调用超过 700 次、unveil 接近 300 次。2）软件规模与采用率相关性弱：unveil 相关系数仅 0.052，pledge 为 0.332（规模与采用几乎无关）。3）最常使用的承诺是 stdio（标准 I/O），其次为 rpath、wpath、cpath；unveil 中超过 40% 使用 r（可读）权限。4）pledge 和 unveil 的使用模式在各版本间保持稳定，仅 stdio 和 r 略有增长。采用主要分布在 /usr/bin 和 /usr/sbin 下的程序（如 OpenSSL、smtpd、su、passwd、dhcpleased、ldapd 等）。

Conclusion: pledge 和 unveil 在 OpenBSD 核心用户态中实现了"全面普及"式采用，既适用于大型程序也适用于小型程序，否定了此前"pledge 仅适用于简单程序"和"大型程序更受益"两种相互矛盾的论断。整体结果反驳了文献中关于系统调用最小化和沙箱技术难以采纳的观点，提示其简单性可能降低了采用门槛；作者建议未来研究应关注维护成本、POSIX 标准化可能性以及采用率与漏洞/利用数量下降之间是否相关。

Abstract: The paper presents a longitudinal measurement study on the adoption of the pledge and unveil system calls in OpenBSD. These system calls are used to sandbox programs and libraries. Given a dataset covering 19 releases, many programs and libraries were modified to use the system calls already before their introductions in official releases. The adoption rates have also steadily grown; a linear trend provides a coarse but sensible heuristic. Although particularly programs residing in /usr/bin and /usr/sbin have been modified to use the system calls, the sizes of programs and libraries do not correlate well with the amounts of pledge and unveil system calls invoked. Regarding the pledges made, standard input and output operations have frequently been requested, although the full fine-grained arsenal offered by pledge has generally been utilized in OpenBSD. The same observation is seen in that particularly read operations to given paths have frequently been unveiled. All in all, the measurement results indicate that the adoption of system call minimization and sandboxing techniques is not necessarily as troublesome as has often been discussed in the literature.

</details>


### [165] [A Model-Based Framework for Developing DTs in Industry 4.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03080)
*Lina Bilal,Benoit Combemale,Jean-Marc Jézéquel,Quentin Perez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种工具支持的自动化框架，用于从物理孪生(PT)的现有工程模型自动推导数字孪生(DT)，通过配置通用框架和少量额外开发，即可生成与运营目的对齐的数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着工业4.0和赛博物理系统(CPS)、物联网(IoT)的融合，数字孪生(DT)应用激增，但缺乏标准化方法以及构建DT所需的时间和资源仍是重要挑战。现有工程模型往往可用但未被充分利用，因此需要一种自动化、低成本的方法来推导DT。

Method: 提出一个工具支持的框架，利用物理孪生(PT)现有的结构和行为模型，通过以下方式自动化推导DT：(1) 从PT模型自动派生DT；(2) 对通用框架进行配置；(3) 进行最小的ad hoc额外开发以连接DT与PT。在四个不同的用例上验证了该方法的可行性和适用性。

Result: 实验证明，该框架能够在满足假设和要求的上下文中构建数字孪生，仅通过配置框架即可生成与运营目的对齐的DT，验证了方法的可行性和广泛适用性。

Conclusion: 该框架为解决DT构建中的标准化缺失和资源消耗问题提供了有效方案，通过重用现有PT模型并结合最小化额外开发，降低了构建DT的门槛，推动了DT在工业4.0场景中的更广泛应用。

Abstract: With the rise of Industry 4.0 driven by the integration of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) and the Internet of Things (IoT), the use of Digital Twins (DTs) has significantly increased over the past decade, as they provide detailed insights and support well-informed decision-making. However, the lack of standardized methodologies, in addition to the time and resources involved for building them remains an important challenge. Building on the idea that engineering models of the physical twin (PT) are often available, we propose a tool-supported framework that automates the derivation of DTs by leveraging existing structural and behavioral models of the PT and extending them with additional models to build a comprehensive DT. To demonstrate the feasibility of our approach, we applied it to four different use cases, in which we automatically derived DT instances from (1) models of their PT, (2) configuration of our generic framework and (3) minimal ad hoc additional development for connecting the DT to the PT. These experiments illustrate the applicability of our framework for building DTs in contexts that satisfy our assumptions and requirements. By simply configuring the framework, we are able to derive a DT aligned with its operational purpose.

</details>


### [166] [Towards Automatically Inferring Constraints to Identify Implicit Assumptions in Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03114)
*Florian Sihler,Lars Pfrenger,Oliver Gerstl,Matthias Tichy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一视角，将数据分析脚本（如R/Python）中的可复现性问题归结为"隐式假设"（implicit assumptions），并倡导使用静态分析技术自动推断这些假设，以代码约束的形式使其显式化，从而支持脚本的可执行性、运行时校验及文档化。作者基于flowR框架实现了概念验证，并针对包版本推断、脚本间依赖、数据形状期望三类典型假设展开了讨论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据科学脚本与notebook普遍存在可复现性问题：研究表明65-77%的分析产物因缺失依赖、执行顺序错误、糟糕编码习惯等原因无法执行；70-80%的代码片段是其他片段的克隆，50%不含任何独有代码。现有的工具（如renv、groundhog、nbconvert等）分散且缺乏统一的视角来处理这些挑战。作者借鉴软件工程中"隐式假设"的概念，将这些可复现性问题统一框架化。

Method: 核心方法为基于flowR静态分析框架的约束推断（Constraint Inference），区分两种场景：（1）preemptive analysis（原始执行环境中）；（2）retroactive analysis（部分信息缺失时，复现/复制/复用）。具体技术包括：(i) 数据流图（dataflow graph）识别库加载模式及API使用；(ii) 三步法重构计算环境（识别依赖→推断版本→分析系统/解释器约束）；(iii) 程序依赖图构建脚本间隐式依赖关系（已对8,160个Zenodo/Harvard Dataverse等R项目评估，发现约14.6%存在隐式互依赖）；(iv) 通过抽象解释（abstract interpretation）新增数据框形状抽象域（追踪列名、行列数），半自动插入guard检查数据形状约束（如t检验前提）。所有假设用一个8行R脚本示例（ggplot2/dplyr/t-test）展示，包含10条具体隐式假设（A1-A10）。

Result: 在flowR框架上完成了概念验证实现：(1) 能有效推断R脚本请求的库；(2) 对8,160个真实R项目（共33,336个文件）的评估显示14.6%的项目存在隐式脚本间互依赖；(3) 数据框形状推断的抽象解释初步评估结果良好，可追踪列名、列数与行数。但承认这些类别并非穷举，且受Rice定理限制，隐式假设的推断本质上是不完备的，需要启发式与人工介入（human-in-the-loop）。

Conclusion: 作者提出"隐式假设"作为理解数据分析脚本可复现性挑战的统一新视角，并展示了通过静态分析推断约束以文档化与运行时校验这些假设的可行性。未来计划：完成flowR上完整实现；通过DSL与stopifnot式检查允许用户补充约束；通过三项评估验证——(a) 修复已知的不可执行artifact，(b) 对数据集进行fuzzing测试，(c) 针对R用户的可用性用户研究。最后强调即使无法自动解析所有假设，仅检测出隐式假设本身也具有重要价值。

Abstract: High-level languages such as R or Python are used frequently to analyze and visualize data in the form of scripts or notebooks. However, these artifacts suffer from reproducibility issues due to what we frame as implicit assumptions made by the authors. Such assumptions range from package versions and shapes of involved data tables, to manual and often undocumented setup steps. Within this work, we provide a unified, example-driven perspective on implicit assumptions in data analysis backed by an explorative proof-of-concept implementation. With this perspective, we propose the use of static analysis techniques to identify such assumptions and to make them explicit in the form of code constraints, focusing on the inclusion of data-analysis-specific issues. Such constraints can then be used to automatically transform these scripts into executable and reproducible artifacts, to check these assumptions at runtime, and to serve as documentation to support code reuse and comprehension.

</details>


### [167] [Copper: Unifying Correctness and Performance Specification in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03130)
*André Lizardo,Raul Barbosa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Copper 框架,通过将形式化验证(Dafny 作为中间语言)与性能感知规范相结合,使 LLM 生成的代码在功能正确性和算法复杂度两方面同时获得形式化保证,并通过迭代修复循环显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 代码生成研究存在两大盲点:一是对正确性的验证多依赖单元测试,缺乏绝对保证;二是性能优化被严重忽视,且现有基准(HumanEval、SWE-bench)易被数据污染或刷榜。功能正确性与运行效率通常被孤立处理,缺乏一种统一规范同时约束两者的机制。论文旨在弥合"可信赖性"与"高性能"之间的鸿沟,推动 LLM 从生成可运行代码向生成可证明正确且高效代码的方向演进。

Method: 1) **五阶段流水线**:PromptBuilder(构造提示)→ ModelRequester(调用 LLM 并解析 Dafny 代码块)→ CorrectnessVerifier(运行 dafny verify 与 dafny build)→ PerformanceAnalyzer(估算时间复杂度)→ SanityChecker(运行 Python 并验证输出)。2) **三种提示策略**:Short(简短自然语言)、Detailed(详细需求与边界条件)、Formal(预定义 Dafny 契约,含 requires/ensures)。3) **复杂度形式化规约**:利用 Dafny 的 ghost 变量机制引入零运行时开销的"步数计数器",通过 loop invariant 将其与循环索引绑定,使时间复杂度可被 SMT 求解器归纳证明(如 `ensures steps == Log2(n) + 1`)。4) **反馈修复循环**:将各阶段失败信息(错误日志、生成的代码)回注到下一轮 prompt,迭代至通过或达到上限。5) **评估设置**:在二分搜索任务上对比 gemini-3-flash-preview、gemma4:31b、llama3:8b 三个模型,使用 pass@k 和 repair@k 指标,辅以卡方检验统计显著性分析。

Result: 1) **模型规模决定成败**:8B 的 Llama3 在所有设置下均完全失败(pass/repair 全为 0);gemini-3-flash-preview 表现最优,gemma4:31b 次之。2) **pass@1 几乎为零**:独立运行下,几乎所有模型-提示组合的单次成功率均为 0,必须依赖修复循环。3) **Short 提示反常胜出**:统计检验显示 Prompt 因素对 pass@10 影响极显著(χ²=48.2, p≈3.47×10⁻¹¹),短提示优于详细提示和形式提示,gemini+short 与 gemma4+short 是 pass@10 最优对。4) **修复循环显著提升**:repair@10 统计上优于 pass@10,gemini+short、gemini+detailed、gemma4+formal 三组合成功率 10/10(p=0.0138)。5) **正确性与性能的难度差异**:模型在生成满足时间复杂度的代码上比生成功能正确代码相对容易(formal prompt 下 gemma4 仅性能 repair@1 达 0.7,而正确性仅 0.3)。

Conclusion: Copper 证明将形式化验证与迭代反馈生成相结合是生成可信赖高性能代码的可行路径。关键结论:① 单次提示不足以获得形式化验证解,pass@1≈0 凸显引导式迭代的必要性;② 模型规模是决定性因素,≤8B 参数模型完全失败;Dafny 训练语料稀缺是主要瓶颈,需通过专项数据集与微加以改进;③ 修复模式跨模型跨提示稳健提升成功率,验证错误反馈机制有效;④ 短提示意外表现最佳,推测 LLM 在响应前已对提示进行大量内部处理,过度详细反而干扰生成。该工作为规格驱动的代码生成提供了实用框架,未来方向在于扩充 Dafny 高质量训练数据与模型微调。

Abstract: Generative AI has made remarkable progress in producing functionally correct code, yet ensuring both correctness and performance remains an open challenge. We present Copper, a framework that combines formal verification with performance-aware specification to generate code that is provably correct and efficiently executable. Our approach integrates AI-driven code synthesis with formal verification tools, and automated performance profiling loops. Evaluated on a diverse set of algorithmic and real-world programming tasks, Copper produces solutions that satisfy strict correctness guarantees while delivering significant improvements in runtime and memory efficiency compared to baseline AI-generated code. This work demonstrates that it is feasible to bridge the gap between trustworthiness and performance in AI-assisted programming, offering a practical pathway toward reliable, high-performance code generation.

</details>


### [168] [TATG: Tracking-Aware Testing Objective for LLM-based Test Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03194)
*Guancheng Wang,Qinghua Xu,Lionel C. Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出TATG，一种基于LLM的单元测试生成框架，通过引入统一的"目标表示"(objective representation)对静态分析与动态反馈产生的测试需求进行细粒度跟踪，并采用结构覆盖与变异强化两阶段工作流，在141个复杂Java方法上显著优于现有SOTA方法KTester和PANTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的单元测试生成方法（如KTester、PANTA、MUTGEN）虽然结合了项目上下文、静态分析、覆盖反馈或变异指导，但未对每个分支级测试需求进行显式表示与跨迭代跟踪，导致生成过程重复针对已满足的需求而忽略未解决的分支与薄弱断言；此外，覆盖导向与变异导向反馈通常被独立优化，缺乏统一协调机制。

Method: 核心抽象为"目标状态"(objective state)，每个目标以元组⟨id, src, cat, E, S, A, Q, α, status, key⟩表示，包含证据、所需前置状态、目标动作、断言形状、验收谓词、状态与去重键。静态分析生成结构目标（StateSetup、DispatchArm、ExceptionPath、Construction、BoundaryInput、EntryRoute），执行期间生成反馈目标（ValidationRepair、OracleStrengthening、MutationReachability、MutationAssertion）。采用两阶段工作流：(1)结构阶段利用编译/执行诊断与覆盖反馈提升可达性与覆盖率；(2)硬化阶段利用变异反馈强化断言并杀死存活变异体。预算按活跃目标数量动态分配，每阶段5次迭代共10轮。

Result: 在141个复杂Java方法（含KTester基准110个+额外31个多模块项目方法）上，使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash-284B两个开源LLM进行评估。TATG相比最强基线PANTA平均提升行覆盖22.15个百分点、分支覆盖20.14个百分点、变异得分37.66个百分点。在50个方法子集上与基于GLM-5.2-753B的工业级专有工具对比，TATG取得相当的分支覆盖同时在行覆盖（75.01% vs 68.23%）与变异得分（53.72% vs 46.14%）上更优，并额外成功生成了6个工业工具失败的方法的有效测试。消融实验表明移除结构阶段后性能大幅下降（行覆盖降至26.90%，变异得分降至23.45%），验证了两阶段设计的必要性。统计检验（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，α=0.05）显示相对KTester与PANTA在三项指标上均有统计显著提升。

Conclusion: TATG通过统一的目标表示将静态分析与多种动态反馈信号纳入同一跟踪机制，使LLM在迭代过程中聚焦于未解决的测试目标，从而在结构覆盖与故障检测能力上同时取得显著提升。该框架验证了显式目标跟踪对于LLM测试生成的重要价值，且目标表示本身与语言无关，便于迁移到其他生态系统。

Abstract: Complex Java methods remain challenging for automated unit test generation because achieving high coverage and fault detection often requires satisfying branch-specific testing requirements that are not directly visible from a focal method. Recent LLM-based approaches, such as KTester, PANTA, and MUTGEN, leverage project context, static analysis, coverage feedback, or mutation guidance. However, they do not explicitly represent and track individual testing requirements across iterations. As a result, generation may repeatedly target satisfied requirements while overlooking unresolved branches and weak assertions. Existing approaches also optimize structural coverage and mutation effectiveness separately. We present TATG, a tracking-aware LLM-based unit test generation approach. TATG introduces a unified objective representation that captures testing requirements derived from static analysis and dynamic feedback. The representation enables fine-grained tracking of satisfied and unresolved requirements throughout generation. TATG further employs a two-stage workflow: structural rounds improve coverage, followed by mutation-guided hardening rounds that strengthen assertions and improve fault detection. We evaluate TATG on 141 complex Java methods, including the 110 KTester subjects and 31 additional challenging methods. Compared with KTester and PANTA, TATG improves line coverage, branch coverage, and mutation score by 22.15, 20.14, and 37.66 percentage points on average. On a selected subset of focal methods, TATG also achieves performance comparable to a proprietary industrial test generation tool while achieving higher line coverage and mutation score.

</details>


### [169] [Round-Trip Mutation Testing: Translating Code to Natural Language Intent and back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03223)
*Asma Hamidi,Cedric Richter,Ahmed Khanfir,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"往返突变测试"（Round-Trip Mutation Testing, RTM）的新方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）在程序代码与自然语言意图之间的双向翻译能力来生成突变体，以模拟开发人员因需求误解而产生的细微语义错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于模式的突变测试（pattern-based mutation）生成的突变体在语法多样性上有限，可能无法暴露因规范/需求误解而产生的真实故障。作者希望借助LLM的代码-自然语言双向翻译能力，生成语义上更细微、更贴近真实开发者错误的突变体，从而提升突变测试发现实际漏洞的能力和效率。

Method: 给定一段原始程序代码，RTM首先利用LLM预测其意图（intent，即自然语言描述的功能说明），然后基于该意图再次生成程序代码。若重新生成的代码与原始代码不同，则构成一个突变体。此外，RTM还通过在生成最终代码之前对意图进行人工扰动（mutating the intent），主动制造"错误翻译"，以产生更多类型的突变体。这种"代码→意图→代码"的往返过程可传播意图层面的微小变化到代码层面，从而生成具有细微语义差异的突变体。

Result: 在40个真实有缺陷的方法上进行评估，结果表明：(1) RTM能够生成语法上更加多样化的突变体，可能暴露传统突变算子难以发现的故障；(2) 在引导测试以检测缺陷方面，RTM优于传统的基于模式的突变测试——当分别仅选择4个和30个测试用例时，RTM平均能检测出超过4倍和1.7倍的真实故障。

Conclusion: 往返突变测试是一种有潜力的方法，能够生成更逼真、更多样化的突变体来模拟真实开发者错误，并在更小的测试套件下实现更强的故障检测能力，为LLM驱动的软件测试开辟了新方向。

Abstract: This paper presents Round-Trip Mutation Testing (RTM), a novel approach that generates mutants from LLM mistranslations between a program code and its intent. Leveraging the generative capability of LLMs from and to programming and natural language, and given an input program, our approach predicts its intent, that is used to generate programs, which when different from the original one, constitute the output mutants. The approach produces additionally mutants, stemming from artificially provoked mistranslations, by mutating the intent prior to the final programs (mutants) generation. Originating from the propagation of small changes in the intent to the code, our intuition is that these programs would present subtle semantic differences from the original one, simulating likely-to-occur faults that could result from specification misunderstandings, and enabling mutation testing. To evaluate RTM, we run it on 40 real buggy methods and evaluate its effectiveness and cost-efficiency in guiding testing towards detecting the bugs. Our results demonstrate the potential of round-trip mutation testing to produce syntactically more diverse mutants, potentially exposing faults that traditional mutation operators fail to reveal. More interestingly, RTM outperforms traditional pattern-based mutation in producing smaller and stronger test-suites, detecting on average over 4 and 1.7 times more faults when selecting only 4 and 30 tests respectively.

</details>


### [170] [An Empirical Study of Downstream Adaptation for Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03238)
*Xinjian Wu,Jingzhi Gong,Gunel Jahangirova,Zhenpeng Chen,Jie M. Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对LLM智能体技能的"下游适配"进行了首次系统性实证研究。通过分析六个广泛采用的技能仓库中的1,126个技能适配实例,构建了一个包含46种适配模式、归为13个家族的分类法。研究发现技能复用存在"复用悖论"——开发者投入大量精力改写技能功能、修复可发现性、翻译工具和语言,且适配高度相互依赖,近五分之一(18.6%)的适配在指令文本中注入了安全敏感内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体技能(skills)成为现代软件系统中的新型软件复用单元,公共技能市场已托管超过42,000个技能。然而,现有研究主要将技能视为由原作者设计维护的可复用制品,完全忽视了技能被下游开发者分叉(fork)后如何被修改以适应当地上下文。这一空白使得研究者无法理解技能在真实演化中遇到的障碍,也无法指导技能设计、演化和编排的改进。

Method: 1. 语料库构建:从六个高度分叉且广泛采用的技能仓库中,基于GitHub公共分叉历史,筛选出1,126个技能适配实例(定义为下游分支中开发者对上游技能包引入独特适配的快照)。2. 分类法开发:通过系统化标注流程,开发并验证了一个包含46种适配模式、归为13个家族的分类法。3. 研究问题驱动分析:围绕五个研究问题展开——适配模式与流行度(RQ1)、跨组件分布(RQ2)、家族共现(RQ3)、安全敏感添加(RQ4)、提交信息覆盖度(RQ5)。4. 工具开发:发布RADAR——一个轻量级、面向影响的技能适配审查清单。5. 审计与开源:发布标注语料库、分类法定义、标注工作流、审计记录和分析脚本。

Result: 1. 适配模式与流行度(RQ1):识别出46种模式归为13个家族,揭示"复用悖论"——开发者大量精力用于改写技能功能、修复可发现性、翻译工具和语言。2. 组件分布(RQ2):适配分布在SKILL.md的元数据(YAML front matter)、指令正文(Markdown body)以及捆绑资源(scripts/templates/references)等不同组件中。3. 家族共现(RQ3):适配高度相互依赖,流程、决策和策略的修改紧密耦合,一处改动常需协同更新。4. 安全敏感添加(RQ4):18.6%的分叉主动注入了安全敏感模式(如提示词注入、恶意指令等),由于这些风险嵌入在自然语言指令中而非代码,完全绕过了传统以代码为中心的安全审查流水线。5. 提交信息覆盖(RQ5):提交信息通常描述功能结果而非底层定制需求,直接检查修改本身至关重要。6. 资源发布:公开了标注语料库、分类法、RADAR审查清单等。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了智能体技能的"自治意图设计与演化现实"之间的根本性不匹配:技能虽为复用而生,下游工程师却必须手动大幅重构才能落地。为解决该问题,论文提出对多方利益相关者的启示:技能开发者应提供更清晰的扩展点、模块化抽象、显式依赖结构和标准化适配机制(工具、语言、约束、发现元数据);工具构建者应开发变更影响分析、一致性检查和适配感知diff技术,以检测耦合修改并暴露自然语言指令中的安全敏感变化;研究者应探索面向演化中技能生态系统的表征、测试和安全性分析方法,其中行为逻辑分布在提示、策略、元数据和工具规范之间。

Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents become integral to modern software systems, ``skills'' have emerged as a novel unit of software reuse, enabling developers to package workflows, decision procedures, and prompt-based policies. While skills are intended for reuse, downstream developers frequently modify published skills to fit local contexts, yet little is known about the nature of such adaptations. This paper presents the first empirical study of downstream skill adaptation in public forks, to understand how published skills are adapted, and to provide implications for researchers and engineers on improving skill design, evolution, and orchestration. Specifically, we analyze 1,126 skill-adaptation instances from six widely adopted skill repositories and develop a taxonomy comprising 46 adaptation patterns organized into 13 families. Our key findings reveal a reuse paradox: although skills are intended to be easily imported and reused, developers spend a lot of effort rewriting what the skills do, fixing skill discoverability, and translating them for different tools and languages, indicating a need for better abstractions, standardized interfaces, and automated support for skill adaptation. Furthermore, adaptations are highly interdependent, with changes in one component often requiring coordinated updates elsewhere, motivating automated support for detecting inconsistent modifications. We also find that nearly one-fifth of adaptations introduce security-sensitive content within the same instruction text that governs behavior.

</details>


### [171] [Socio-Technical Anti-Patterns in Building ML-Enabled Software: Insights from Leaders on the Forefront](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03270)
*Alina Mailach,Norbert Siegmund*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文针对机器学习(ML)系统难以投入生产的问题，通过对MLOps社区73个视频(共66小时)的定性分析，识别出17种社会技术反模式(anti-patterns)，并将其根因归结为组织与管理层面的三大问题：组织孤岛、组织内沟通缺失以及领导力真空。研究为从业者提供了具体的诊断清单与改进建议，并验证和扩展了既有研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管ML系统在商业上取得巨大成功，但大量公司与从业者在将ML模型投入生产时面临重重困难。既有研究多聚焦于纯技术层面（如测试、流水线、MLOps自动化），对围绕团队和组织的"社会技术"挑战关注不足。Gail Murphy在ASE'20上也指出，软件工程研究并未真正解决软件工程问题。轶事证据（博客、推特、播客）反复表明：失败的项目往往根源于管理、组织与社会因素，而非单纯的技术缺失。因此，有必要进行系统性研究，挖掘一线从业者（尤其是领导者视角）的经验与见解。

Method: 采用反思性主题分析(Reflexive Thematic Analysis, RTA)，一种源自心理学、在人机交互领域日益普及的纯定性研究方法。数据源为MLOps.community在YouTube上发布的210个视频中的73个（涵盖Meetups与Coffee Sessions，时长合计66小时，约对应1200页自动转录文本）。受访者主要来自北美(50%)和欧洲(39.2%)，覆盖各种规模公司，角色以管理层(31.3%)与领导者(27.6%)为主。研究分两个阶段：(1)归纳阶段——以"team"为关键词初步筛选37个视频，通过Braun & Clarke六步流程（熟悉数据、编码、初步主题生成、迭代优化、命名定义、撰写）开展分析；(2)演绎与精炼阶段——基于已形成的主题/代码回溯至剩余128个视频，再筛选38个相关视频进行主题丰富与精炼。最终提炼出7个上下文/开发活动中的17种反模式及其成因(C1-C16)与建议(R1-R15)。

Result: 研究发现17种反模式集中在三大组织层面：(1)**组织孤岛**——包括"模型到生产集成"(AP1长发布周期、AP2团队间张力、AP3数据科学家被阻塞)和"数据生产者到消费者集成"(AP4数据请求困难、AP5技术与团队紧耦合、AP6部分数据可用性)；(2)**组织内沟通**——包括"冗余开发"(AP7特征不可发现/不可访问/不可复用、AP8冗余ML基础设施、AP9影子IT)和"管理层vs数据科学"(AP10数据科学家角色挣扎与倦怠、AP11管理层与数据科学间的张力)；(3)**领导力真空**——包括"无头鸡式招聘"(AP12员工技能不足、AP13数据科学家无合适产品)、"简历驱动开发"(AP14工具与模型与团队/产品目标不匹配)和"炒作驱动产品创建"(AP15困在PoC、AP16"一切皆可受益于ML"的认知、AP17因数据或人才缺失导致产品不可行)。每种反模式配有具体成因（如文化与工具冲突C1、缺失工程能力C2、缺乏数据科学流程C6、角色与头衔模糊C8、管理层缺乏ML知识C14等）及对应建议（如模型注册表与特征库R1、跨职能团队重组R2、强流程R9、用例筛选流程R13等）。与Nahar等人、Kim等人、Arpteg等人、Granlund等人及Amershi等人的既有研究对比表明，多数反模式得到跨研究印证，证实了发现的普适性。同时，作者从领导者视角补充了关于缺乏决策流程(C12)与产品管理缺位(C14-C16)等新洞见。

Conclusion: ML系统投产困难的根因往往不在技术层面，而在组织与管理层面（呼应Conway's Law）。该研究在方法论上展示了如何利用从业者社区作为定性数据源，弥补结构化访谈在样本招募上的局限。提出的17种反模式、16类成因和15条建议，为管理者和组织领导者提供了诊断与改进ML项目社会技术问题的可操作清单。未来研究方向包括：探究这些反模式是否为ML系统特有，还是更一般的软件工程社会技术挑战；以及为实验驱动的ML模型构建过程定制敏捷框架等。总体而言，研究呼吁学术界对ML使能软件的开发流程、指南和组织结构给予更多关注。

Abstract: Although machine learning (ML)-enabled software systems seem to be a success story considering their rise in economic power, there are consistent reports from companies and practitioners struggling to bring ML models into production. Many papers have focused on specific, and purely technical aspects, such as testing and pipelines, but only few on socio-technical aspects. Driven by numerous anecdotes and reports from practitioners, our goal is to collect and analyze socio-technical challenges of productionizing ML models centered around and within teams. To this end, we conducted the largest qualitative empirical study in this area, involving the manual analysis of 66 hours of talks that have been recorded by the MLOps community. By analyzing talks from practitioners for practitioners of a community with over 11,000 members in their Slack workspace, we found 17 anti-patterns, often rooted in organizational or management problems. We further list recommendations to overcome these problems, ranging from technical solutions over guidelines to organizational restructuring. Finally, we contextu-alize our findings with previous research, confirming existing results, validating our own, and highlighting new insights.

</details>


### [172] [Regulatory compliance-readiness in the AI Supply Chain: examining datasets in Hugging Face](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03310)
*Georgia M. Kapitsaki*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: A very large number of datasets are made available via Hugging Face (HF). These datasets are used to train a vast number of AI models, also available via HF. There are regulatory issues that might arise in the AI supply chain when those datasets do not follow, for instance, data privacy practices, or do not disclose their data sources, cleaning and preparation processes. In this preliminary work, regulatory compliance-readiness is examined as a quality attribute in the framework of HF datasets, with a main focus on data privacy (e.g. GDPR, CCPA). Towards this direction, an analysis on regulatory compliance (e.g. with privacy laws) of the dataset using the dataset card and the dataset structure overview as starting points has been performed. We collected 11,682 HF datasets that have a dataset card, are not gated and have at least 500 downloads and analyzed the datasets using automated techniques and manual analysis on a sample of the dataset. The results show that a very small number of datasets are explicit on the datasets creation processes and mention data sources, while some make mentions to Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or other sensitive data in their data schemas. These results show the need for more detailed examinations of regulatory compliance in AI datasets and models, and research on tools that provide guidance to practitioners and automate the compliance process.

### [173] [AtomicCommitBench: Can Coding Agents Reconstruct Commit Histories from Squashed Patches?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03332)
*Zhihao Lin,Mingyi Zhou,Li Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AtomicCommitBench 提出"回溯式提交历史重构"任务：给定一个已完成但被 squash 的补丁，让编码智能体将 hunk 重新分组成可回放的、有原子性的提交序列。基准包含 10 个 Python 项目共 800 个真实连续提交片段，用 PPAR（回放有效性）、ARI（分组质量）和 TCR（测试失败隔离率）三个互补指标评估。结果表明：所有非随机方法回放几乎饱和（PPAR≥0.988），但分组质量差异巨大（ARI 0.03–0.46）；合成混合比真实 squash 补丁容易得多；GPT-5.4 和 GLM-5 显著优于 MiniMax 和 Kimi；DACE 证据主要帮助弱模型克服"同文件堆叠"和"支持 hunk 漂移"两类错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前编码智能体通常以一个 squash 后的合并补丁交付会话结果，丢失了原本用于 code review、选择性 revert、历史检索和 bug 定位的提交结构。已有研究（如 SWE-bench）只评估最终代码正确性，不衡量组织良好的提交历史这一独立可测的产出质量。先前的 commit untangling 工作多依赖合成合成物，且未要求回放有效性与序列生成。因此需要：(1) 一个独立衡量提交历史组织的形式化任务；(2) 一个基于真实开发会话的基准；(3) 能在历史非唯一的前提下给出可比信号的指标体系。

Method: （1）任务形式化：Hunk-to-Commit 分区+回放有效性要求。将 squash 后的 diff 解析为 hunk，预测其分组 π=(C₁,…,Cₘ) 并要求各前缀能无冲突应用以重现最终状态。（2）数据集：从 10 个成熟 Python 项目（pytest, pydantic, requests, httpx, black, rich, fastapi, flask, click, typer）收集 800 个连续提交片段（Easy/Medium/Hard 三档：320/320/160），每个片段 squash 后保留原 commit 作为参考标签。同作者、48 小时窗口，过滤 merge/bot/二进制。智能体只见 diff 和 base snapshot，不可见 git 历史。（3）评估指标：PPAR（前缀可应用率）、ARI（相对于参考分区的调整兰德指数）、TCR（在修改测试的可评分子集上按预测 commit 反向回放引发的失败集中度）。（4）六个诊断基线（NoSplit/Random/FileSplit/HunkSplit/DepSplit/Untangle）以及 DACE 外部证据（依赖分析器+hunk profiler）。评估 4 个模型-智能体设置：GPT-5.4+Codex CLI、GLM-5/Kimi/MiniMax-M2.5+Claude Code CLI。

Result: RQ1：自然回溯重构显著难于简单替代——所有非随机方法 PPAR ≥ 0.988，但 ARI 在 0.03–0.46 范围跨度大；FileSplit 是最强简单启发（ARI=0.340）；匹配 commit 数的合成混合比真实 squash 补丁容易 +0.333 ARI（p<10⁻⁴⁹, Cliff's δ=0.430）。RQ2：GPT-5.4 达 ARI=0.459、GLM-5 达 0.425、均超过 FileSplit；MiniMax 0.306、Kimi 0.288 接近文件本地启发；TCR 在 151 个可评分片段上排序一致；难度越高，强弱模型差距越大；替换参考、bootstrapping 与配对符号秩检验均保持相同分带；严格输出校验亦稳定。RQ3：典型错误为"同文件堆叠"与"支持 hunk 漂移"；DACE 让 MiniMax +0.075（p<10⁻⁸）、Kimi +0.049（p<10⁻⁶），而对 GPT-5.4 与 GLM-5 无统计显著影响，呈现针对性增益。

Conclusion: 提交历史组织是独立于最终代码正确性的可测产物属性。AtomicCommitBench 通过"回放有效性（PPAR）+参考分组质量（ARI）+测试隔离（TCR）"三轴互补度量建立了可比较的回溯重构评估框架：自然会话 squash 显著难于合成；当前强弱模型形成稳定两个分带；DACE 类结构化证据对 locality-overfitted 模型收益最大。意义在于：(1) 提醒评测同时关注智能体留下的"历史"而非仅"代码"；(2) 支持工具应暴露依赖边、hunk 角色等结构化线索，将最终分组决策留给智能体；(3) 该"可验证结构门 + 参考相对分 + 行为探针"的评估模式可推广到其他无唯一答案的智能体编码产物。

Abstract: Coding agents often finish a session by returning one squashed patch that mixes feature implementation, bug fixes, refactorings, tests, and configuration edits. While the final code may be correct, collapsing unrelated edits into one patch removes the history structure needed for review, selective revert, and later maintenance. We study retrospective commit-history reconstruction: given a completed squashed change, an agent groups its hunks into commits and materializes a replayable commit sequence. We formalize the task as hunk-to-commit partitioning with a replay requirement and build AtomicCommitBench, containing 800 real consecutive-commit episodes from 10 Python projects. Because multiple decompositions may be reasonable, we evaluate outputs using complementary metrics: PPAR for replay validity, ARI for reference-based grouping quality, and TCR for failure containment on scoreable modified-test episodes. Natural retrospective reconstruction proves substantially harder than replay checking or synthetic tangling. Although nearly all non-random methods achieve replay validity (PPAR >= 0.988), grouping quality ranges from 0.03 to 0.46 ARI. Matched synthetic composites are much easier than real same-author squashed diffs (+0.333 ARI). In our evaluation, the GPT-5.4 setup driven by Codex CLI (0.46 ARI) and the GLM-5 setup driven by Claude Code (0.43 ARI) outperform MiniMax (0.31) and Kimi (0.29). Qualitative analysis identifies same-file lumping and support-hunk drift as recurring failure modes. Dependency-Aware Commit Evidence (DACE) improves the lower-scoring setups by 0.05 to 0.08 ARI, indicating that dependency cues and hunk-role information help agents avoid locality-driven grouping errors. AtomicCommitBench enables evaluation of the commit histories produced by coding agents alongside the final code.

</details>


### [174] [Anchored Self-Play for Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03523)
*Caroline Choi,Zeyneb Kaya,Shirley Wu,Tengyu Ma,Tatsunori Hashimoto,Ludwig Schmidt*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Anchored Self-Play (ASP)方法，通过引入参考集嵌入相似度奖励和参考bug混合训练，解决生成器-修复器自博弈中分布漂移问题，在跨bug来源修复任务上显著优于标准自博弈方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码修复训练数据稀缺，而单元测试只能验证功能正确性而无法保证bug的真实性。标准生成器-修复器自博弈方法会逐渐偏向困难但不真实的bug，导致在人类编写的bug上性能退化。需要一种能扩展监督信号同时保持bug分布现实性的方法。

Method: 1) 提出BugSourceBench基准：基于BigCodeBench构建，包含人类编写、人类编辑LM、Qwen-7B和gpt-oss-20b四种bug来源，固定任务仅改变bug实现；2) 生成器-修复器自博弈：单一模型通过GRPO交替生成bug和修复bug，生成器奖励基于难度带[0.25, 0.75]的修复率；3) Anchored Self-Play (ASP)：通过(a)嵌入相似度奖励——计算生成bug与参考集编辑的k-NN余弦相似度作为辅助奖励，以及(b)参考bug混合——以概率pmix将参考bug混入修复器训练，来锚定自博弈到目标bug分布。

Result: ASP在BugSourceBench所有bug来源上均取得最佳修复率：相对标准自博弈平均修复率提升24%（+7.0个百分点绝对值），LM生成bug上提升100%（+11pp），人类来源bug上提升7.1%（+3.4pp）；Qwen-7B bug上提升145%（+12.6pp），gpt-oss-20b bug上提升69%（+8.7pp）。仅需50个参考样本即可见效，参考池组成可控地引导自博弈偏向不同bug模式。

Conclusion: 仅靠单元测试的自博弈会因缺乏现实性信号而发生分布漂移。ASP通过轻量级的嵌入相似度锚定机制有效缓解该问题，证明显式的现实性信号对扩展代码修复监督至关重要。未来可探索学习型bug风格评判器、偏好奖励或更丰富的锚定信号。

Abstract: Code repair is an important capability for language models (LMs): given a buggy program and unit tests, an LM must produce a fixed program that passes the tests. Because code repair data is limited, we aim to scale supervision by using an LM to generate bug--fix tasks. We propose __generator--fixer self-play__, in which a single model is trained with reinforcement learning to generate bugs and fix them. As the fixer improves, the generator adapts to produce more difficult bugs, yielding an automatic curriculum. To test whether this curriculum generalizes, we introduce BugSourceBench, a repair benchmark spanning realistic bug sources: bugs in human-written code, LM-generated code, and human-edited LM-generated code. On BugSourceBench, we find that self-play drifts toward difficult but unrealistic bugs, improving on synthetic bugs but degrading on human-authored ones. We propose Anchored Self-Play (ASP), which anchors self-play with a small reference set by adding a code-embedding similarity reward for generation and mixing reference bugs into fixer training. Across bug sources, ASP achieves the best fix rates, improving average fix rate over standard self-play by $+24\%$ relative / $+7.0$ pp absolute, with gains on bugs from both LMs and humans.

</details>


### [175] [GameEngineBench: Evaluating Coding Agents on Real C++ Runtime Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03525)
*Brian La,Sejoon Chang,Ben Kim,Junyoung Bae,Aamish Ahmad Beg,Sei Chang,Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: GameEngineBench 是一个用于评估编码代理在 Unreal Engine 5 项目中进行 C++ 编程能力的基准测试，包含来自 9 个真实游戏仓库的 110 个任务，涵盖游戏机制、多人行为、AI 编排、动画、UI、网络集成等。最强模型配置 pass@1 仅 55.5%，31 个任务无任何配置能解决，揭示了前沿编码代理在实时交互式 C++ 系统集成方面的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码代理基准（如 SWE-bench、HumanEval、Terminal-Bench）主要评估通用软件工程或孤立函数合成，无法直接衡量生成的 C++ 代码能否正确集成到运行中的游戏引擎中。游戏引擎具有实时模拟、网络通信、对象生命周期、子系统架构等复杂行为，编译通过的正确补丁仍可能因权威性错误、状态同步失败或生命周期处理不当而无法正确运行。因此需要一个在可执行游戏引擎环境中评估 C++ 编码代理的基准。

Method: （1）从 9 个开源 Unreal Engine 5 项目中构建 110 个任务，每个任务提供可构建的起始状态、可编辑的 C++ 文件列表和公共行为规范；（2）测试套件在求解阶段被隐藏，求解完成后注入并通过 Unreal Play-in-Editor 自动化框架在 listen-server 模式下执行；（3）采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式评估行为正确性而非参考答案相似度，并支持跨家族判断以缓解自评偏差；（4）通过任务校准流程（测试验证 + LLM 审核 + 任务修订）确保任务质量；（5）评估 12 种模型配置，以 pass@1 为主要指标。

Result: （1）最强配置 claude-fable-5（max 推理）达到 55.5% pass@1，GPT-5.5（xhigh）29.1%，claude-opus-4-8（max）23.6%，Gemini 3.1 Pro 18.2%；（2）GPT-5.5 推理努力从 medium 到 high 到 xhigh 使 pass@1 从 9.1% 提升至 19.1% 再到 29.1%；（3）79 个任务至少被一个配置解决，31 个任务无任何配置能解决，且无任务被所有配置解决；（4）失败模式集中在权威性错误、状态同步错误、对象生命周期 bug、初始化错误和系统集成不完整等运行时问题，而非语法或编译错误；（5）存档/持久化任务未解决比例最高；（6）模型能力呈互补结构而非严格嵌套。

Conclusion: GameEngineBench 证明前沿编码代理在将 C++ 代码集成到现有游戏引擎运行时系统方面仍有显著困难，失败源于结构化的运行时和集成问题。基准填补了现有软件工程评估在引擎集成原生 C++ 编程方面的空白，揭示了游戏引擎基准作为现有评估补充的价值。未来工作应扩展跨系统协调任务和音频、性能、编辑器工具等代表性不足的领域，并通过标准化执行封装和改进测试覆盖来增强评估可靠性。

Abstract: Game engines provide real-time simulation, rendering, physics, interaction, networking, and asset pipelines, making them valuable not only for games but also for 3D applications in healthcare, robotics, architecture, manufacturing, and related domains. Because game development is where these systems are most mature and publicly available, it offers a practical testbed for evaluating coding agents that must modify C++ code within stateful, interactive, real-time systems. We present GameEngineBench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on scoped C++ implementation tasks inside Unreal Engine 5 projects, built from nine real-world game repositories. The evaluation set consists of 110 tasks spanning gameplay mechanics, multiplayer behavior, AI and world orchestration, animation and movement, UI and session code, loading behavior, online-service integration, persistence, data serialization, XR behavior, and rendering-oriented plugins. These tasks require models to make native C++ changes that compile and satisfy behavioral tests within executable Unreal Engine projects. Across twelve evaluated configurations, the strongest model reaches 55.5\% pass@1, while 31 tasks remain unsolved by every configuration. Our results demonstrate that frontier coding agents continue to struggle with deeply integrated C++ development for real-time interactive software, highlighting game-engine benchmarks as a valuable complement to existing software engineering evaluations.

</details>


### [176] [LogSemFuse: Semantic Evidence Fusion for Explainable Log Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03599)
*Hassan Jabri,Zeyang Ma,Zhijie Wang,Tse-Hsun Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LogSemFuse是一个即插即用的语义增强框架，通过融合骨干检测器、本地事件模式、LLM语义推理和聚类衍生可执行规则四类证据，提升日志异常检测的准确性和可解释性。在HDFS、BGL、Liberty三个数据集上对DeepLog、LogAnomaly、LogBERT、NeuralLog四个骨干模型均有效，且仅带来较小的推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于模型的日志异常检测器虽性能良好，但仅输出分数或标签，缺乏解释"为什么"的语义证据，使运维人员难以区分紧急故障与良性偏差，也无法追溯可疑会话到具体操作行为。LLM虽能提供丰富语义，但作为独立检测器或重复生成自由格式解释成本高且难以复用。如何在不替换现有检测器的前提下，以低成本提供语义证据并增强可解释性，是核心问题。

Method: LogSemFuse采用三阶段语义证据构建与四信号融合：(1) 训练时构建本地事件模式库Kngram（从训练会话中挖掘判别性的unigram/bigram/trigram，通过lift和支持度筛选）；(2) 用TF-IDF+HDBSCAN对异常训练会话聚类，用LLM为每个聚类生成可执行规则库Krule（含contains_ngram、ordered_subset、min_count、absent_within四类原语）；(3) 推理时由LLM对每个新会话做语义推理（产出is_high_risk、confidence、expected、observed四要素），并通过会话ID缓存复用。最后将骨干信号sb、本地模式信号sn、规则信号sr、LLM推理信号sℓ通过OR/AND/vote-k策略融合，融合策略及阈值在验证集上选择。同时输出匹配的pattern、触发的rule、LLM理由作为解释证据。

Result: 在3个数据集×4个骨干模型=12种组合中，LogSemFuse使所有非完美基线的F1分数均提升（最高+0.55，LogBERT on Liberty从0.44到0.99），完美基线得以保持；共恢复98.8%（2056/2081）的骨干假阴性。推理开销小且稳定（HDFS增加5.63-5.81秒，BGL增加3.93-4.07秒，Liberty增加2.36-2.41秒）。LLM成本通过知识库复用摊销（每次会话约624 token，聚类约2500-4000 token）。用户研究（N=14）显示，LogSemFuse解释在五维Likert量表（逻辑一致性、技术合理性、标签对齐、清晰度、整体质量）上均显著优于直接使用GPT-4o-mini生成的解释（p<0.001），整体质量4.13 vs 3.06。消融实验表明本地事件模式贡献最大（尤其对LogBERT），规则库次之，LLM语义推理在困难配置下提供针对性增益。在30%/50%/70%训练数据比例下均保持稳定有效。

Conclusion: LogSemFuse证明了将语义解释转化为可复用证据的可行性：通过融合骨干检测、本地模式、LLM语义推理和聚类衍生规则，能在保持原有检测流水线的同时提升检测效果与可解释性，且仅带来适度稳定的推理开销。该框架为现有日志异常检测器的语义增强提供了一条实用路径，避免了让LLM充当唯一检测机制的高成本问题。

Abstract: Log anomaly detection is critical for reliability monitoring and failure diagnosis in modern software systems. Existing model-based detectors provide useful anomaly signals, but they can still miss anomalous sessions and typically expose only scores or labels rather than the operational semantics behind a decision. This lack of semantic evidence limits their ability to explain why a session is anomalous, even when the final anomaly label is correct. The gap matters in practice because operators need to distinguish urgent failures from benign deviations and trace suspicious sessions back to concrete operational behavior. LLMs can recover richer log semantics, but using them as standalone detectors or repeatedly generating free-form explanations can be costly and difficult to reuse. We present LogSemFuse, an evidence-guided plug-in framework that enhances existing backbone detectors without replacing their original pipelines. LogSemFuse combines backbone predictions with reusable semantic evidence from local event patterns, LLM-based semantic reasoning, and cluster-derived executable rules to produce both anomaly decisions and evidence-based explanations. The resulting output reports the final label together with the semantic evidence that supports it, such as fired local patterns, triggered rules, and LLM rationale. We evaluate LogSemFuse on HDFS, BGL, and Liberty using DeepLog, LogAnomaly, LogBERT, and NeuralLog as backbones. LogSemFuse improves every non-perfect baseline, preserves the already perfect case, recovers 98.8% of backbone false negatives, and produces explanations preferred over direct LLM explanations in a human study. These gains require only modest and stable inference-time overhead, showing that semantic augmentation can improve detection effectiveness and interpretability without imposing large runtime costs.

</details>


### [177] [Fault Detection and Explainable Classification in Automotive HIL Validation via Denoising Autoencoders and In-Context Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03734)
*Mohammad Abboush,Hamza Ouarrad,Andreas Rausch*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于汽车硬件在环(HIL)实时验证中故障检测与可解释分类的两阶段框架：第一阶段使用仅基于健康信号训练的去噪自编码器(DAE)通过重构误差检测异常；第二阶段将异常窗口编码为相对于时间对齐健康参考的紧凑文本统计证据，由冻结的大语言模型在零样本或少样本提示下进行分类，并输出预测类别、排序备选、置信度、故障位置及简短解释。在两种动力系统(汽油机和电动汽车)和三种驾驶工况上评估了8个开源LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汽车软件系统验证产生大量多变量测试记录，目前仍依赖人工审查和基于规则的评估，效率低下且难以检测预定义规则之外的故障。现有监督式机器/深度学习方法需要大量标注数据、泛化性差且缺乏可解释性；LLM在汽车实时HIL验证中的泛化能力及提示策略对性能的影响尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) DAE故障检测——仅用健康信号训练，加入高斯噪声学习去噪表示，通过重构误差阈值检测异常，无需故障标签；(2) LLM故障分类——将异常窗口转换为相对健康参考的紧凑统计证据(sig, z, md, mad, maxd, zero, sat, level)，区分直接根信号证据与传播效应证据，使用冻结的开源LLM(Gemma 2 9B、Llama 3.1 8B、Mistral 7B、Qwen2.5 7B、Phi-3.5 Mini、Qwen2.5 14B、Phi-4 14B、Mistral Small 24B、Gemma 3 27B、Qwen2.5 32B、DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B、Llama 3.1 70B AWQ INT4等)在零样本和少样本提示下进行分类，输出受约束的JSON结构化结果。采用时间泄露控制协议(15-25s为少样本区、25-30s为隔离区、30-45s为测试区)。

Result: 检测性能：DAE在汽油机和EV上平均F1=0.97，平均平均误差<0.03；跨三种驾驶工况平均F1=0.98。分类性能：零样本提示不足(最佳F1=0.519)；少样本提示在稳定工况下达到完美判别，Gemma 2 9B(90亿参数)在EV上F1=0.970，超过所有零样本中大型模型；Mistral Small 24B在城市和高速工况均表现鲁棒，被选为主管线模型；混淆矩阵显示主要错误来自汽油机中相关执行器/动力总成故障的混淆；模型解释有效区分了直接根信号证据与传播证据。计算开销：Mistral Small 24B推理时间4.94s/窗口，在准确率与效率间取得最佳平衡。

Conclusion: 该框架成功将无标签检测与基于提示的分类解耦，通过区分直接与传播证据的表示促进根因推理，提供了可解释、证据链可追溯的诊断报告，无需任务特定微调。关键发现是提示策略(而非参数量)是分类质量的主导因素。主要局限：仅在HIL仿真数据上验证、仅覆盖10个单故障类别、零样本性能较低、城市工况下校准误差较高、3-7秒推理时间更适合离线部署。未来工作将扩展到真实道路数据、并发与交互故障、改进瞬态工况校准，并探索LoRA、检索增强提示、模型蒸馏与量化。

Abstract: Validating automotive software systems produces large multivariate test recordings that are still examined through effort-intensive manual review and rule-based evaluation, which detects faults beyond predefined rules poorly. Machine and deep learning have advanced fault diagnosis, yet most supervised models require large labelled datasets, generalise poorly to unseen conditions, and offer little insight into their decisions. We propose a generalisable and explainable two-phase framework for fault detection and classification during real-time validation. A denoising autoencoder trained only on healthy signals first flags abnormal behaviour through reconstruction-error analysis, removing the need for fault labels. Each abnormal window is then encoded as compact textual statistical evidence relative to a time-aligned healthy reference and classified by a frozen large language model under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, returning the predicted class, ranked alternatives, a confidence value, the fault location, and a short evidence-based explanation. Eight open-source models are evaluated across two powertrains and three driving regimes. The detector attains average F1-scores of 0.97 across powertrains and 0.98 across regimes, with average mean error below 0.03. Zero-shot prompting proves insufficient (best 0.519 F1-score), whereas few-shot prompting reaches perfect discrimination under stable regimes, showing that prompting strategy, rather than parameter count, governs classification quality: a nine-billion-parameter model surpasses every zero-shot medium and large model. Mistral Small 24B is adopted as the main pipeline model for its balance of accuracy, class-balanced reliability, calibration, and inference cost, giving engineers interpretable diagnostic reports and more efficient validation.

</details>


### [178] [Graph-Aware Fuzzing for Graph Database Management Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03741)
*Yu Li,Qiang Hu,Yao Zhang,Junjie Wang,Hao Liu,Rui Wang,Yongqiang Lyu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 GRAF，一种用于图数据库管理系统（GDBMS）查询引擎的黑盒模糊测试框架。该框架通过 LLM 生成 Cypher 查询骨架、级联依赖解析实例化，以及基于执行状态反馈（执行时间、结果大小、系统状态）的图特定变异策略，在 Neo4j、Memgraph、RedisGraph、NebulaGraph、FalkorDB、KuzuDB 六个目标上相比最强基线提升行覆盖率 31.6%–41.1%，发现 34 个未知漏洞（32 个已确认，23 个已分配 CVE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GDBMS 测试方法主要依赖差分测试与蜕变测试，其结果一致性预言机要求查询跨引擎或跨变换可比较，导致单引擎运行时故障（崩溃、内存错误）未被充分探索。开发专用 GDBMS 模糊器面临两大挑战：（1）在复杂图约束下生成有效且结构多样的查询——通用字节变异常破坏 Cypher 语法盲目结构变异违反图模式，前端解析器拒绝执行，使查询无法到达后端优化与执行逻辑；（2）引导探索以捕获拓扑依赖的执行行为——传统代码覆盖率仅跟踪控制流，无法反映枢纽节点、稠密子图、环依赖、遍历深度等拓扑敏感的数据流效应，小的参数变化（如遍历上界）即可引发执行时间指数级爆炸。

Method: GRAF 采用分离查询骨架与数据绑定的设计，包含两大核心组件：（1）图上下文感知查询生成——利用 LLM（Gemini-3.1-pro，一次性合成约 $10 成本）生成 5,000 个参数化 Cypher 骨架（强制标准化标识符、占位符一致性与作用域注释），经四步过滤（占位符校验、ANTLR 语法分析、作用域分析、去重）形成骨架池；通过级联依赖解析将骨架绑定到图上下文 C=(M,G,V)（模式元数据、全局拓扑、类型特定值），按拓扑→属性与值→全局参数三阶段实例化，保证语义有效。（2）执行状态引导查询变异——定义五个图特定变异算子（拓扑变异、深度与体量变异、谓词变异、子句插入、值变异），由反馈向量 F=<t,|R|,s>（执行时间、结果大小、系统状态）动态调度：空结果查询偏向谓词放松与拓扑调整；超时查询的子代抑制深度/体量扩张；异常终止查询标记后局部变异定位根因。整个测试循环纯黑盒运行，输入选择不使用源码覆盖率。

Result: 在六款主流 GDBMS（Neo4j 5.26.27、Memgraph 3.7.1、FalkorDB 4.16.1、KuzuDB 0.11.3、NebulaGraph 3.8.0、RedisGraph 2.12.10）上 12 小时评估：GRAF 覆盖行数 Memgraph 45.8K、FalkorDB 25.9K、Neo4j 89.3K、KuzuDB 126.9K、NebulaGraph 46.0K、RedisGraph 27.1K，相对最强基线提升 31.6%–41.1%；有效查询率 61.8%–76.7%，高于 BUZZBEE 与 AFL++，低于 Dinkel 的保守模板；12 小时内触发 25 个唯一漏洞（基线合计仅 6 个），总计发现 34 个未知漏洞，分布涵盖模式匹配、投影、路径扩展、聚合、属性访问、事务管理等核心组件，其中 32 个经开发者确认、23 个已分配 CVE，主要漏洞类型为 OOM（11 个）和段错误（11 个）。消融实验显示骨架实例器缺失使有效查询率下降 85%、覆盖率下降 81%–86%，执行监控缺失使慢/超时查询数量翻倍（3,755→7,680），各组件均不可缺。

Conclusion: GRAF 验证了将抽象查询结构与运行时图数据解耦（LLM 骨架 + 级联依赖解析）、并以外部执行状态反馈替代传统代码覆盖率来驱动变异，可有效测试复杂数据库引擎的后端执行逻辑。该工作弥补了 GDBMS 专用模糊器的研究空白，未来将把上下文引导技术扩展至其他专用数据库范式，以发现语义逻辑缺陷。

Abstract: Graph Database Management Systems (GDBMSs) are essential infrastructure for managing interconnected data. Existing GDBMS testing methods primarily rely on differential and metamorphic testing. The result consistency oracles of these methods constrain inputs to queries that are comparable across engines or transformations, leaving single engine runtime failures, such as crashes and memory errors, insufficiently explored. Developing dedicated fuzzers for GDBMSs faces two key challenges: (1) generating valid and structurally diverse queries under complex graph constraints, and (2) guiding exploration to capture topology dependent execution behavior. To address these challenges, we propose GRAF, a black box fuzzing framework for GDBMS query engines. First, GRAF introduces graph context aware query generation based on cascading dependency resolution. It instantiates parameterized Cypher skeletons generated by a Large Language Model (LLM) by jointly resolving labels, relationship types, properties, values, and variable scopes against the active graph state. This process produces structurally diverse queries while eliminating syntactic and semantic violations. Second, GRAF applies five graph specific mutation operators guided by execution state feedback, including execution time, result size, and system status. This feedback steers exploration away from unproductive queries and expensive traversals, while prioritizing local mutations around abnormal executions. We evaluated GRAF against three existing approaches on six widely used GDBMSs. GRAF consistently improves line coverage by 31.6% to 41.1% over the strongest baseline on each target. In 12 hour fuzzing, it triggered 25 unique bugs, compared to six from all baselines combined. Overall, GRAF discovered 34 previously unknown bugs, with 32 confirmed by developers and 23 assigned CVEs.

</details>


### [179] [EvoEye: Self-Evolving Runtime Monitoring for Autonomous Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03755)
*Mingfei Cheng,Lionel Briand,Xiaofei Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: EvoEye是首个面向自动驾驶系统（ADS）的自演化运行时监控框架，由FusionMonitor（跨模块时序融合的碰撞风险预测器）和BlindSpotEvolver（基于监控反馈与密度感知变异的信息化场景采集器）组成，通过"监控→反馈→采集→更新"的闭环迭代提升碰撞检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ADS运行时监控存在两类局限：基于规则的安全指标（如TTC、RSS）仅覆盖人工指定的冲突模式，无法刻画跨模块复杂交互导致的失效；基于学习的监控器依赖固定初始训练数据，对训练集未覆盖的运行时行为存在显著盲区。因此需要一种能够主动采集信息、执行场景并迭代自我更新的监控框架。

Method: EvoEye包含两大组件：(1) FusionMonitor采用分层特征融合架构——模块专属编码器（Shared MLP+AttnPool用于感知/预测，MLP用于规划/控制）将异构运行时信号编码为统一帧特征，再通过时序聚合MLP融合最近L帧上下文，最终由全连接分类器经sigmoid输出未来H秒内的碰撞风险分数，以BCE损失训练；(2) BlindSpotEvolver形成自演化闭环——Monitor-Oriented Feedback以当前监控器在场景上的平均预测误差作为反馈信号，Density-Aware Mutation根据邻域内反馈的均值与标准差计算"区域开发潜力q_δ(x)=μ_δ+σ_δ"，以概率p_δ(x)在邻域内局部变异或全局采样，从而平衡局部利用与全局探索，每N_round次迭代后重新训练监控器并刷新反馈。

Result: 在Baidu Apollo与CARLA平台的高速切入（S1）和无保护交叉口（S2）两类NHTSA预碰撞场景上的评估显示：FusionMonitor在FPR=0.05时帧级Recall较最强基线提升最多37.8个百分点，CPU推理延迟仅2.49ms，S1中位预警提前4.2秒、S2提前2.8秒；BlindSpotEvolver在相同6小时仿真预算下，在EvoEye*初始漏检的Hard Set上F1较Uniform采样和AVFuzzer最多提升13.2点；消融实验验证了时序上下文（L=5）、跨模块输入、监控反馈与密度感知机制的各自贡献，且仅对低容量监控器（AEM）施加演化几乎无效，证明自演化需以具备表达力的监控器为前提。

Conclusion: EvoEye通过将具备跨模块时序建模能力的FusionMonitor与基于监控盲区引导的BlindSpotEvolver相结合，在工业级Baidu Apollo全栈ADS上验证了其在碰撞风险预测中的有效性与实用性，证明了自演化运行时监控的可行性；同时揭示了有效自演化既需要信息化的场景采集策略，也需要具备足够学习容量的基础监控器。

Abstract: Runtime monitoring is essential for detecting impending hazards in autonomous driving systems (ADSs). However, existing ADS runtime monitors have fixed detection capabilities: rule-based monitors cover only manually specified hazards, while learning-based monitors depend heavily on their initial training data and may retain substantial prediction errors. We therefore propose EvoEye, which identifies the current monitor's errors, generates informative executions accordingly, and updates the monitor through self-evolution. To enable effective self-evolution, EvoEye combines a capable runtime monitor with targeted scenario acquisition. FusionMonitor learns cross-module temporal interactions for collision prediction, while BlindSpotEvolver converts current prediction errors into search guidance and uses density-aware mutation to acquire informative executions for subsequent monitor updates. We evaluate EvoEye on Baidu Apollo with CARLA in representative highway and urban scenarios. FusionMonitor improves frame-level Recall by up to 37.8 percentage points at a false positive rate of 0.05, with 2.49 ms latency and 2.8-4.2 seconds of median warning time. Under the same budget, BlindSpotEvolver outperforms uniform and violation-oriented sampling by up to 13.2 F1 points on previously missed unsafe contexts.

</details>


### [180] [Semantic-aware and Self-improving Program Reduction via Agentic Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03766)
*Xintong Zhou,Hongxu Xu,Chunhao Liao,Puzhuo Liu,Yongqiang Tian,Chengnian Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 PROJ，一种基于智能体大语言模型（LLM）的程序归约框架，将程序归约重构为自主推理任务。该方法通过两个协作组件——执行语义感知归约的"归约智能体"和提取可复用策略的"反思智能体"——克服了现有归约器缺乏语义理解和无法自我进化的局限。在 C、Rust、JavaScript 三种语言的 90 个基准测试中，PROJ 始终产生比现有最优归约器更小的归约结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序归约（将触发 bug 的程序最小化）是调试语言处理器（编译器、解释器）的关键任务。现有归约技术存在两大根本局限：（1）缺乏语义感知——无论是语言无关的归约器（如 Perses、Vulcan）还是语言特定的归约器（如 C-Reduce），都依赖预定义的、语法驱动的转换规则，无法根据程序的具体语义进行推理，错失了许多归约机会；（2）缺乏自我进化能力——规则集在设计时就固定了，无法从历史归约经验中学习，新增策略需要专家手动设计实现。作者希望借助智能体 LLM 的推理能力，让归约器既能进行语义感知的、针对具体程序的归约，又能从经验中不断积累可复用的策略。

Method: PROJ 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 归约智能体（Reducer Agent）：在 ReAct 循环中工作，采用两级循环结构（外层 I_max=3 次迭代，每轮开启新的 LLM 会话；内层 A_max=60/50/40 次尝试），在每次提议前必须以自然语言阐述"理由"（rationale），然后通过工具接口（propose_candidate）提交候选程序，由执行环境（Harness）调用属性检查器验证。支持默认模式（直接缩减）和探索模式（可临时增大程序以解锁进一步归约机会，配有探索预算 N=5）。(2) 反思智能体（Reflector Agent）：离线工作，检查成功的归约记录，通过泛化（Generalize）、查找相似策略（FindSimilar）、补丁（Patch）将具体的成功归约操作提炼为可复用的策略（match + rewrite 对），并通过验证管道（包含至少两个测试，其中至少一个来自其他程序）确保通用性，最终以可执行 pass 的形式提交到"学习到的归约器"（Learned Reducer）中。整体工作流为：先用语言无关归约器（如 Perses）粗归约 → 学习到的归约器应用积累的策略 → 归约智能体进行语义感知精细归约 → 反思智能体离线提炼新策略。

Result: 在 90 个跨 C、Rust、JavaScript 三种语言的基准测试中：有效性方面，PROJ 在每种语言上都产生最小的归约结果，平均在 C、Rust、JavaScript 上分别比最佳基线小 39.0%、36.0%、38.9%；在 C 程序上，PROJ 是首个超越长期事实标准 C-Reduce 的归约器。效率方面，PROJ 是除 Perses 外最快的，运行时间比 Vulcan、LPR、C-Reduce 分别减少 77.2%、42.6%、57.7%。在泛化性方面，在 RQ1 过程中，学习到的归约器分别积累了 58（C）、25（Rust）、12（JS）个策略，在 C 和 JS 上贡献了 46% 和 52% 的归约量；在 30 个未见过的 C 程序上，单独使用冻结的学习到的归约器就能达到 159 tokens，超越 Vulcan（192）和 LPR（160），接近 C-Reduce（140）。消融实验验证了：（a）两级循环结构均必要；（b）默认模式贡献 80%+ 归约量，探索模式贡献 14-20% 但有不可替代价值；（c）方法对不同 LLM 后端（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Mimo-V2.5、MiniMax-M3）均稳健；（d）专用执行环境的贡献远大于通用 SWE 智能体（mini-SWE-agent、Aider）。成本方面，PROJ 每次约 0.055 美元（归约 0.035 + 反思 0.020），高于 LPR 的 0.014 美元，但学习到的归约器积累后可降低后续 33% 的 API 调用和 26% 的成本。

Conclusion: 该论文提出了"智能体程序归约"这一新范式，将程序归约从基于固定转换规则的过程转变为语义感知的探索性推理过程。PROJ 框架通过归约智能体实现针对具体程序的语义感知归约，通过反思智能体实现从经验中自动积累可复用策略的自我进化能力。实验证明该方法在有效性、效率和泛化性上均显著优于现有方法，是首个在 C 程序上超越 C-Reduce 的归约器。学习到的归约器能自动从经验中提炼出与多年手工工程化工具相媲美的归约知识，且仍有持续增长空间。论文的主要局限是"策略爆炸"风险——随使用时间增长，策略池可能积累大量低产策略，需要未来的策略治理机制。

Abstract: Reducing bug-triggering programs to their minimal essential form is a fundamental task in debugging language processors such as compilers and interpreters. Existing reduction techniques are limited by their reliance on predefined, syntax-driven transformations that lack semantic understanding of the target program, and by their inability to learn from past reduction experiences. We present a new approach that recasts program reduction as an autonomous reasoning task powered by agentic Large Language Models (LLMs). Instead of applying fixed transformation rules, our method enables an LLM to analyze program semantics, formulate reduction hypotheses, and iteratively refine its approach based on execution outcomes. Successful reduction experiences are further distilled into reusable strategies, allowing the system to continuously improve over time. We realize this approach in PROJ, a framework built around two collaborative components: a reducer agent that performs semantic-aware, case-specific program reduction, and a reflector agent that extracts and accumulates transferable reduction knowledge. Extensive experiments on 90 benchmarks spanning three programming languages show that PROJ consistently produces smaller reduced programs than all existing state-of-the-art reducers while maintaining high efficiency.

</details>


### [181] [LogNLQ: Natural-Language Log Querying with Parser-Induced and Semantically Grounded Schemas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03884)
*Juepeng Wang,Jinyang Liu,Zhuangbin Chen,Zibin Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出LogNLQ框架，将自然语言日志查询重新定义为在解析器归纳和语义基础模式上的可执行SQL生成。该方法通过日志解析将原始日志转化为模板分区的关系表，并对模板与参数列进行双粒度语义标注。配套发布了LogNLQ-Bench基准（4个真实数据集上8,895个查询）。实验表明LogNLQ在所有基线上均大幅领先，尤其在分析复杂的场景查询中优势显著（检索F1基本查询>0.89，场景查询>0.54）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件系统日志量巨大（每日百万至十亿行），工程师需依赖平台特定查询语言（LogQL、KQL等）进行故障诊断与异常分析，使用门槛高。自然语言查询（NLQ）是弥合意图-接口差距的可行方向，但现有三类方法均存在根本缺陷：(1) 文本式日志QA（LogQA、LogSay）仅在单行粒度上操作，无法执行计数、分组等语料级分析；(2) 日志DSL生成（LogQLLM）因原始日志无稳定模式，模型常产生幻觉字段；(3) 面向日志的Text-to-SQL（DIN-SQL）依赖预定义人工模式，与原始日志的半结构化特性不兼容。共同根源在于：原始日志缺乏可执行模式，现有方法未先建立这一前置条件，导致查询无法精确执行。

Method: LogNLQ采用离线-在线两阶段架构：（1）**离线模式归纳阶段**——基于LILAC的缓存树流式解析机制，将原始日志分解为事件模板与动态参数序列，按模板分区构建列式关系存储（Parquet）；为每个参数列计算轻量统计画像（基数、值域、Top-K高频值）。（2）**双粒度语义基础阶段**——利用LLM为模板生成自然语言摘要（事件级），为参数列赋予规范语义名称（如"Source IP"）及描述（参数级）；维护全局参数词汇表 𝒢，通过向量检索保证跨模板同义参数命名一致性；最终将物理结构与语义信息封装为"模式文档" 𝒟ₖ，使用doubao-embedding编码并以FAISS索引。（3）**在线查询执行阶段**——用户查询经embedding后通过FAISS近邻检索Top-K相关模式文档，构造受约束Prompt调用LLM生成限定于检索上下文的SQL（单表或UNION跨表），最终由DuckDB执行。配套构建了LogNLQ-Bench基准，覆盖OpenSSH/HDFS/Spark/BGL四个数据集，包含基础查询与场景查询（Alert、Triage、Mitigation、RCA、Audit、Report六类），检索与聚合两种任务，采用执行验证的F1与RO-Match指标。

Result: **有效性（RQ1）**：LogNLQ在所有数据集与查询类型上一致领先。在基础检索上F1>0.89，最强基线仅约0.20；在场景检索上F1>0.54，基线普遍<0.25。聚合任务（RO-Match）优势更显著，场景聚合下基线近乎归零。错误分析揭示基线四大失败模式：过度宽泛的内容匹配、字段/标签幻觉、错误的聚合解析，以及LogNLQ自身的检索遗漏问题。**效率（RQ2）**：LogNLQ存储开销仅为原始日志的33%–62%，而Elasticsearch与Loki分别为108%–133%；离线构建吞吐量在模板收敛后稳定在数十万行/分钟级，单机可在30–40分钟内完成最大数据集（11M–16M行）处理；每模板约7次LLM API调用，调用次数与日志量无关；在线延迟主要来自LLM推理（>90%，约5.7–7.7秒），模式检索（119–201ms）与SQL执行（7–48ms）均可忽略。**消融与敏感性（RQ3）**：消融实验揭示三级层次依赖——移除解析式结构化时聚合RO-Match骤降至0.032（绝对前置条件）；移除全部语义基础时F1下降0.312、RO-Match下降0.243；仅移除参数级基础造成针对性退化（聚合受影响更大）。Top-K=5在四个数据集上均达最优。四个LLM骨干（doubao-seed-2.0-pro、deepseek-v3.2、GLM4.7、doubao-seed-1.6）均显著优于基线，差距在场景查询上放大，证明结构是主导使能因素。

Conclusion: LogNLQ通过将日志解析重新定位为面向执行的模式归纳机制，配合双粒度语义基础、模式检索与受约束SQL生成，弥合了原始日志无模式与自然语言查询之间的根本鸿沟。LogNLQ-Bench（8,895查询、4数据集、执行验证）为该方向提供了首个严格基准。实验证明：解析式结构化是语料级可执行分析的必要前提，语义基础进一步带来实质性增益；该框架模型无关、性能稳健。未来工作将拓展至跨系统多模态可观测性分析（日志、追踪、指标融合）及多跳异构事件源诊断场景。

Abstract: Logs are essential for system monitoring and failure diagnoses in modern software systems, yet querying them through natural language remains an open challenge. Existing approaches either treat logs as plain text, generate queries for schema-light backends, or assume predefined relational schemas, but none addresses a fundamental obstacle: raw logs carry no executable schema over which structured queries can be defined and run. To address these limitations, we present LogNLQ, a framework that formulates natural-language log querying as executable SQL generation over parser-induced and semantically grounded schemas. LogNLQ parses raw logs into template-partitioned relational tables, then applies dual-granularity semantic grounding to annotate both templates and parameter columns with interpretable names and descriptions. At query time, relevant schema candidates are retrieved via semantic search, and a large language model (LLM) generates executable SQL constrained to the retrieved context. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce LogNLQ-Bench, an execution-verified benchmark of 8,895 queries over four real-world log datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that LogNLQ consistently outperforms all representative baselines by wide margins, with especially pronounced gains on analytically complex scenario queries.

</details>


### [182] [Inferring the Shape of Data Frames in R Programs using Abstract Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03889)
*Oliver Gerstl,Florian Sihler,Matthias Tichy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对R语言数据框(data frame)的静态形状分析技术，通过抽象解释跟踪确保存在的列名、潜在列名及潜在行列数，能在78个真实R脚本上保持经验性健全性，并在33,314个脚本的大规模数据集上推断出大量具体形状约束，还成功识别出40个存在潜在无效数据框访问的脚本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: R作为数据科学的主流语言，其核心数据结构data frame在程序执行中缺乏静态形状保证，使得研究人员难以在程序特定点推理其行列结构。这一缺陷导致数据访问错误难以在编译期发现，亟需一种静态分析方法来推断data frame的形状。

Method: 基于抽象解释框架，设计了一个约简乘积域(reduced product domain)，分别跟踪：(1)确保存在的列名集合、(2)潜在列名集合、(3)潜在列数与行数。并为最常用的data frame操作（如mutate、filter、subset等）定义了相应的抽象语义。

Result: 在78个可执行真实R脚本上验证了正确性与准确性，经验证明分析具有健全性（从不低估形状）；在33,314个真实R脚本的大规模评估中，42.1%的操作可推断出具体形状约束、0.9%可推断出精确形状；当提供所有读取的数据集时，这一比例分别提升至58.7%和4.2%。最终识别出40个存在潜在无效data frame访问的真实脚本。

Conclusion: 该静态分析技术能够有效推断R程序中data frame的形状，展示了在数据科学研究中支持研究人员使用data frame的显著潜力，为自动化错误检测提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Data frames are a fundamental data structure in many data analysis tasks and are widely used in programming languages like R. Due to their omnipresence in data analysis, there are many functions that operate on their shape and content, for example, to clean and transform study data. However, languages like R do not offer static guarantees on data frames making it difficult to reason about their shape at a specific point in the program. In this paper, we present a novel static analysis to infer the shape of data frames in R programs using abstract interpretation by tracking the ensured and potential column names, as well as the potential number of columns and rows. For this, we use a reduced product domain and define abstract semantics for the most commonly used data frame operations, such as mutating, filtering, and subsetting. We evaluate the correctness and accuracy of our analysis on a selection of 78 executable real-world R scripts achieving empirical evidence for soundness by never under-approximating the data frame shape. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability of our analysis to infer the shape of data frames on a large dataset of 33,314 real-world R scripts by inferring concrete shape constraints for 42.1 % and exact shapes for 0.9 % of the data frame operations, improving to 58.7 % and 4.2 % if all datasets read in these scripts are available to our analysis. Using the inferred data frame shapes, we identified 40 real-world R scripts containing potential invalid data frame accesses. This shows the potential of our analysis to significantly support researchers in using data frames in data analysis.

</details>


### [183] [Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03963)
*Yanjie Zhao,Hongjie Chen,Li Lu,Zhou Yang,Xiao Cheng,Haoyu Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LeanGuard是一个神经-符号混合框架，通过将LLM定位为"语义过滤器"（仅对AST候选事实进行增删，不裁决安全性），将"安全义务的履行"交由Lean 4定理证明器内核完成，并由一个证据感知裁决器融合两方判断，从而在五个CWE类别上全面提升漏洞检测的F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的漏洞检测存在核心可靠性问题——模型倾向于在证据不充分时，用流畅的"理由"过早地解除安全义务（premature discharge）。即使使用更强的模型和智能体（如Codex、Claude Code配合全仓库访问），它们仍系统性偏向于将代码判定为安全，从而遗漏真实缺陷，特别是在依赖时序的生命周期类漏洞（CWE-415/416）上。论文将失败根因归结为"解读代码"与"解除义务"由同一组件承担，论证应进行职责分离。

Method: 六阶段流水线：(1) 基于tree-sitter的AST候选事实抽取并打上γ∈{High,Low}语法置信度；(2) LLM作为受限的语义过滤器，仅在固定JSON模式下对候选列表做add/remove编辑并输出verdict；(3) 混合事实调和（Source-Backed与ForceKeep规则防止幻觉擦除关键事实）后做领域特定的自动配对，构建claim ⟨o,P_o⟩；(4) 将claim编译为Lean 4验证脚本，由内核判定proved/unproved/error；(5) 在V_Lean与V_LLM冲突时触发一次神经-符号精炼；(6) 证据感知裁决器综合V_Lean、质量等级Q_Lean、Q_LLM与|O|，通过非对称裁决矩阵输出最终标签。统一验证模型M=⟨E,P,O⟩在五种CWE（CWE-476/120/125/416/415）上实例化。

Result: 在5个CWE类×3个后端（纯LLM DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Codex Agent、Claude Code Agent）共15个设置中，LeanGuard在所有15项上F1均高于最强基线，绝对增益最高+0.20（CWE-415+Claude Code F1从0.34→0.54）。在CWE-415上召回率近乎翻倍（0.21→0.41）。三重复运行子集（3类×3后端=9组）的配对t检验中，6/9达到p<0.05，符号检验p≈0.002；F1标准差<0.04，稳定性与基线相当甚至更优。消融显示：直接让LLM写Lean的成功率最低（CWE-120/Claude Code仅29%通过），证明确定性翻译器不可缺；AST抽取阶段主要贡献于精度提升（抑制"全部标红"），自动配对主要贡献于召回。代价方面，纯LLM后端37–104秒/样本、token<1M；Codex/Claude Code需130–276秒/样本与数千万token。

Conclusion: 论文将"过早解除安全义务"确立为LLM漏洞检测的核心失效机制，并提出将"提议事实"与"解除义务"严格分离的设计原则。LeanGuard以可机检的Lean 4证据和保守解读弥补了LLM在跨调用、时序推理上的结构性短板，在五个代表性CWE上证明该职责分离具有可推广的可行性。其局限在于按CWE类手工规格的依赖与不进行全程序推理，作者明确将其定位为可行性验证原型而非可部署工具，未来工作指向自动路由与共享抽取层。

Abstract: Ask a large language model (LLM) whether a pointer dereference is safe, and it can often produce a plausible justification for ``yes''. The difficulty is that a fluent justification is not a proof. This gap is precisely where automated vulnerability detection lives: deciding, for a given operation in source code, whether a memory safety defect such as a null dereference, use-after-free, or double free can actually occur. We trace the unreliability of LLM-based vulnerability detection to a mechanism, the premature discharge of safety obligations, and argue that the remedy is not better prompting but a separation of roles: the component that interprets the code must not also be the one that decides a safety obligation is met. In this paper, we present LeanGuard, a neuro-symbolic framework that assigns each act to the side equipped for it. On the neural side, an LLM serves strictly as a semantic filter over candidate facts extracted from the abstract syntax tree (AST): it prunes spurious facts and keeps the real ones, but never discharges an obligation or decides the verdict on its own. On the symbolic side, the surviving facts are compiled into a verification model in Lean 4 (a formal proof assistant whose kernel accepts a conclusion only when it is formally proved), where every dangerous operation must be matched by a guard that provably covers it in scope; absent such a guard, the obligation stays open rather than being argued away. Because a function rarely arrives with full context, this symbolic model is necessarily partial: an unproved obligation is not yet a defect. An evidence-aware adjudicator therefore weighs the symbolic and neural verdicts by the quality of each. We instantiate the framework on five CWE classes to ask how far this division of labor can be pushed.

</details>


### [184] ["AI Slop is DDoSing Open Source": Understanding the Impact of AI-Generated Contributions on Open Source Sustainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04003)
*Sadia Afroz,Courtney Miller,Tyler Menezes,Edward Gilmour,Anita Sarma,Zixuan Feng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI-DDoS"概念,指出生成式AI工具产生的大量看似合理但低质量的贡献正在淹没开源软件(OSS)社区的审核能力,构成一种类似DDoS的拒绝服务效应。研究通过混合方法验证了这一现象,并提出了11项缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具大幅降低了生成代码的成本,但增加了评估代码的成本。这种不对称性在开源社区中导致大量低质量AI生成贡献,严重消耗维护者有限的审核资源。虽然已有大量实践者描述这种现象,但缺乏对其普遍性和表现的实证理解,也不知道这是暂时性问题还是需要重新设计工作流的结构性转变。

Method: 采用基于现象的混合方法研究(PBR):(1)阶段一对Reddit、OSS导师邮件列表和博客三种灰色文献进行三角验证的主题分析,识别6个主题并推导假设;(2)阶段二使用贝叶斯结构时间序列(BSTS)因果影响分析,在294个广泛使用的仓库中测试假设,数据集包含超过200万PR和问题;(3)通过对11名OSS维护者进行半结构化访谈识别11项缓解策略,并通过对229名OSS实践者进行调查验证这些策略的接受度。理论框架采用组织韧性理论(ORT)。

Result: 6个主题涵盖:流量洪泛、质量崩溃、临时贡献者、激励结构、维护者福祉和防御性收缩。BSTS分析显示2025年PR量增加6.80%,合并率下降1.06%,其中一次性贡献者PR合并率相对反事实下降18.18%(效应最强)。识别出11项缓解策略,分为保护性(preservative)、适应性(adaptive)和变革性(transformative)三类;调查发现社区倾向于低努力的防御策略(保护性策略认同度最高达73%),而变革性策略(涉及身份验证等)认同度较低。研究将AI-DDoS定性为不仅贡献量问题,更是一个可持续性陷阱:社区默认采用低成本防御策略保护短期审核能力,但使开放性难以持续。

Conclusion: AI-DDoS是一种新兴的全生态系统结构性危机,引发"刚性陷阱"风险——保护性策略虽能短期保护审核能力,却窄化了支撑OSS长期发展的贡献通道。研究呼吁借鉴传统DDoS缓解思路,采用上游缓解、轻量级参与证明、跨项目信任信号和参与质量评估工具等策略,将AI-DDoS压力转化为共享的可持续性基础设施。未来研究需探索既能让真正新人轻松跨越、又能抵御AI规避的验证机制。

Abstract: Open source software (OSS) communities are facing increasing pressure from Generative AI (GenAI) tools. We call it AI-DDoS: a denial-of-service effect in which plausible but low-quality AI-generated contributions overwhelm OSS community capacity.
