Existing approaches apply RL exclusively to text steps, relegating image generation to supervised surrogates, preventing policy gradients from propagating through the full interleaved trajectory across heterogeneous modalities. This leaves the potential of RL for UMMs largely untapped. In the paper, we introduce \textbf{BRAID} (\textbf{B}ridging inte\textbf{R}le\textbf{A}ved mult\textbf{I}-modal reasoning as a unified \textbf{D}ecision process), a simple framework that casts multi-turn text-image-text reasoning as a unified Markov decision process (MDP), enabling joint optimization of textual and visual generation via a single, principled RL objective. BRAID computes a shared trajectory-level advantage and propagates it coherently into both text tokens and image denoising paths, each optimized through its modality-native policy gradient mechanism. To further address long-horizon credit assignment, BRAID employs a vision-language model (VLM) judge that scores each intermediate image on its reasoning utility, supplying dense turn-level feedback to sharpen learning at critical visual branches. Experiments on spatial reasoning and visual perception benchmarks show that BRAID consistently outperforms various baselines, confirming that a unified MDP formulation with vision-thinking guidance is essential for effective multi-modal reasoning.

</details>


### [601] [Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03787)
*Aureka AI OpenDDE project*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OpenDDE是首个Apache-2.0许可的全原子生物分子基础模型，在共折叠（co-folding）任务上达到与IsoDDE相当的精度，并显著优于现有开源模型（AlphaFold3、Chai-1、Boltz-1、OpenFold3、Protenix-v1、ESMFold2），特别是在抗体-抗原界面预测方面。其核心创新包括原子级潜在结构推理（structural token reasoning）、形状互补性损失、以及将结构预测与从头设计统一在条件扩散框架中，并系统验证了数据/模型/推理多维度的缩放规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子相互作用建模是生物学与药物发现的核心瓶颈。尽管AlphaFold2/3和IsoDDE等闭源/受限模型取得了突破，但其封闭性阻碍了可重复性与社区驱动的迭代。同时，共折叠精度的边际改进正在放缓，需要厘清当前架构、数据与推理流程是否已接近实际瓶颈，以及未来缩放方向应从何而来。OpenDDE旨在提供一个完全开源、可复现的基础模型与平台，以解决上述可及性与扩展性问题。

Method: 1) **架构**：基于Pairformer主干（48层，hidden dim=384，655M参数），将残基token扩展为结构token（主链、侧链、碱基、配体/原子），通过Structural Refiner进行细粒度关系推理，再以扩散Transformer（24层）生成全原子坐标。2) **结构推理**：在坐标生成前通过配对条件注意力与三角对更新在结构token图上进行潜在推理（(S^r,Z^r)→(S^s,Z^s)→X）。3) **Lock-and-Key损失**：引入形状互补性目标（surface normal、gap、clash），结合局部坐标系监督与侧链扭转角χ损失。4) **统一预测-设计框架**：通过已知/目标原子掩码将结构预测与从头设计统一为条件扩散问题。5) **训练**：五阶段课程学习（精度→广度→精度），数据截止2021-09避免泄漏，使用50×8 A100约6周加上8×8 H100一周，总计约414K GPU小时。6) **缩放分析**：沿训练token数与训练成本两轴对比AlphaFold3、Protenix v1/v2、SeedFold、ESMFold2，并验证推理时多采样扩展。7) **并行计算**：集成NVIDIA Fold-CP进行上下文并行以处理大规模复合物。

Result: 1) **抗体-抗原共折叠**：在PXMeter-AB（51.0%）、FoldBench-AB（70.0%）和2026ARK-AB（66.4%，新建164个低同源复合物基准）上均取得最高DockQ成功率，显著优于ESMFold2与Protenix-v1；Oracle选择下分别达65.9%/81.9%/80.1%。2) **FoldBench综合表现**：蛋白单体LDDT 0.890、蛋白-蛋白DockQ 0.769、抗原-抗体0.700、蛋白-RNA 0.735、RNA单体0.660、蛋白-配体0.601，均达到或接近最强基线。3) **缩放规律**：性能随训练token数与有效计算平滑提升，呈次线性趋势，OpenDDE位于高尺度-高性能端，差距指向IsoDDE。4) **测试时缩放**：FoldBench-AB上排序成功率从~62%提升至~73%，高DockQ率从~28%提升至~34%；Oracle成功率从~66%提升至>90%，表明存在显著的排序校准空间。5) **案例研究**：8Z8V（ALB8 VHH-HSA）、8ZP2（NET转运体纳米抗体，cryo-EM膜蛋白）、8JYR（HER2 Fab）均准确恢复结合几何。

Conclusion: OpenDDE证明开源共折叠模型可以与闭源前沿系统竞争，并通过开放权重、代码与基准推动可复现的生物分子智能研究。其以折叠为中心的架构为药物发现引擎提供了共享的结构推理层，可自然扩展至从头设计、亲和力估计等下游任务。验证的缩放规律（数据/模型/推理）表明生物分子建模正进入类似大语言模型的缩放时代。下一步将与NVIDIA Fold-CP团队合作实现十亿参数级训练（B300 GPU），并拓展至更大复合物、配体对接与构象集合建模。当前版本明确不针对配体虚拟筛选/亲和力排序进行优化，且作为可扩展引擎的折叠核心仍需社区驱动迭代。

Abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine. Rather than treating structure prediction as an isolated endpoint, OpenDDE is designed as a shared structural reasoning layer for modeling sequence-structure-function relationships across biomolecular complexes, enabling complex structure prediction today while providing a foundation for de novo design, affinity estimation, structure-conditioned optimization, and more. OpenDDE integrates advances in all-atom architecture, atomic latent reasoning, inference optimization, and large-scale data processing to achieve IsoDDE-level co-folding accuracy within a reproducible and openly accessible framework. We also identify two scaling-law directions for co-folding models, revealing practical routes for continued improvement through data, model, inference, and training scaling. By releasing training code, inference pipelines, checkpoints, and benchmarks, OpenDDE aims to democratize access to frontier biomolecular intelligence, accelerate global collaboration, and lay an open foundation for next-generation drug discovery systems that can move from predicting molecular structures toward designing, scoring, and optimizing therapeutic candidates for human health.

</details>


### [602] [Evaluating LLM Uncertainty in Long-Form Generation Using Deterministic Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03870)
*Ido Amit,Ido Galil,Ran El-Yaniv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SALT（Single-answer Atomic Long-form Target）基准，一个具有确定性长文本真值的程序生成任务套件，用于在零噪声条件下评估大语言模型（LLM）在长文本生成中的细粒度不确定性。基于对50多个LLM的大规模实证研究，论文揭示了：（1）原子级置信度排序在细粒度分辨率下失效；（2）推理机制（CoT/推理模型）在提升准确率的同时系统性地损害置信度排序；（3）长文本正确性具有路径依赖性，全局前缀正确性主导未来错误传播，而答案长度仅产生有界退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM生成长文本输出（如代码库、多步推理），传统对整篇生成的不确定性评估方法已不足以满足风险敏感应用（如医疗AI）的要求。现有的长文本不确定性评估方法存在两个关键缺陷：（1）依赖LLM评判器或蕴含模型进行原子事实分解，引入标签噪声；（2）评估粒度过粗，无法定位局部错误。此外，标签噪声会以与置信度评分相关的偏差方式系统性地扭曲AUROC排序。因此，亟需一个具有确定性真值、支持细粒度评估的长文本生成基准。

Method: 方法论核心包含三部分：(1) SALT基准构建——六个程序生成任务（矩阵乘法、Kronecker积、DNA翻译、Multi-Needle词语收集、一阶逻辑、代码执行），每个任务具有唯一的确定性长文本真值，支持原子级（atomic-unit）和行级（line-unit）两种评估粒度，总计54,797个评估单元；(2) 置信度函数评估——比较基于logit的函数（困惑度、平均概率、最大概率、logprobs Sum等）和语言化方法（P(True)、Verbalized 2S），采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验确定统计显著性；(3) 受控干预实验——通过修改前缀原子（修正/破坏）并控制目标位置，采用配对差值三次B样条回归（OLS/GLM），分离全局前缀正确性与局部（最后10个原子）正确性对后续正确性的因果效应。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 置信度排序存在高分辨率失败模式：Macro-AUROC在原子级（0.45-0.7）显著差于行级（p=7.5×10⁻⁹），但校准（ECE）在粒度间相对稳定；(2) 推理权衡：推理机制使精确率提升78.2%、ECE降低60.8%，但AUROC下降23.3%——中介分析表明ECE改善完全由精确率中介（p<0.001），推理本身无独立的校准效应（p=0.567）；(3) 前缀正确性主导未来错误：全局前缀正确性的独立效应约为局部（最后10原子）的2倍，破坏的损害是修正收益的2-6倍；(4) 答案长度效应有界：95%的渐近下降在66.6个原子处完成，长度效应独立于正确性且饱和较早；(5) 不同置信度函数各有所长——Perplexity/Entropy主导校准，Logprobs Sum主导排序，logit方法显著优于语言化方法（p<0.05）。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：当前的扩展范式和推理机制正在使能力与可靠性脱钩。对风险关键应用而言，仅有高准确率是不够的，如果伴随脆弱的置信度估计。SALT为未来研究提供了必要的基础：（1）程序化设计支持可扩展干预，可用于训练细粒度置信度分类器；（2）密集反馈机制天然适合RL后训练以缓解推理-排序权衡；（3）需要专门为高分辨率原子单元设计的置信度函数。论文强调，未来模型扩展智能的同时，必须同步扩展对其自身局限性的认知能力。

Abstract: As LLMs generate increasingly long outputs, effective uncertainty estimation must identify errors at fine-grained levels rather than discard entire responses. While such methods exist, evaluating uncertainty at any resolution (token to an entire generation) is challenging and highly sensitive to label imperfections, making zero-noise benchmarks essential; yet, long-form generation benchmarks tend to rely on fallible labels rather than deterministic ground truth. We introduce Single-answer Atomic Long-form Target (SALT), a benchmark of six procedurally generated tasks with single deterministic long textual ground truths, enabling unit-level evaluation of correctness, calibration, and ranking without external judges. Equipped with SALT, our analysis of 50+ LLMs reveals key insights: We identify which confidence functions dominate each uncertainty aspect and show that confidence ranking largely breaks at atomic resolution, even when clearer separability emerges at coarser line-level units. SALT further enables controlled atom-level interventions throughout generation, revealing two separable drivers of future errors: propagation from corrupted prefixes, dominated by global context correctness, and bounded degradation from increasing answer-context length. Finally, we demonstrate that reasoning, via Chain-of-Thought prompting or internalized through training, introduces a trade-off, improving accuracy while degrading confidence ranking. These findings directly impact risk-critical applications requiring reliable error identification and mitigation.

</details>


### [603] [Harness-Aware Self-Evolving: Co-Evolving Model Weights, Harness, and Task Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03935)
*Haochen Luo,Yi Huang,Sichun Luo,Fengyuan Liu,Lei Li,Zefa Hu,Junlan Feng,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HASE（Harness-Aware Self-Evolving），一个智能体强化学习框架，使单一模型能在同一多轮动作空间中同时生成任务解决方案与编辑选定的harness组件。该框架区分两类harness：指导型组件（提示、记忆、检索等）可自由优化，评估型组件（验证器、评分器）则需在真实世界评估器发现代理分数与预言分数发散时才进行修复。实验表明，仅用Qwen3-8B单模型，HASE在文本分类任务上匹配GPT-OSS-120B+Claude Code基线，在Alpha因子挖掘上超越该基线，并在圆填充算法发现中修复不完美的评估器后达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自演化框架通常假设harness（决定模型如何观察、行动和评分的prompt、记忆、检索、工具接口、评估器等中介组件）是固定的，但这种假设存在两大局限：(1) 人写的评估器可能不完整或与环境错位，导致模型通过漏洞获取奖励而非真正解决问题；(2) 即使评估器正确，指导型harness可能提供较差的搜索先验。因此需要让模型与harness协同演化。

Method: HASE将解生成与harness编辑统一在同一多轮动作空间中，包含以下核心设计：
1. **两类harness分离**：指导型组件（prompts、记忆格式、检索脚本）可自由优化；评估型组件需在局部评估器与真实评估器发散时通过oracle-gated机制修复。
2. **统一动作空间**：模型可在ls/cat/grep/replace/overwrite等沙盒工具和提交解决方案之间选择。
3. **阶段级GRPO训练循环**：每阶段包含多轮GRPO epoch，rollout中的harness编辑仅影响该轨迹；持续harness仅在阶段边界审查后更新。
4. **奖励设计**：harness操作本身无奖励；指导编辑采用PoC（proof-of-concept）机制——只有当编辑后的harness在同轨迹中产生更高任务分数时才被纳入候选池；评估编辑仅在代理-预言分数发散且新修复解决不匹配时获奖励。
5. **不匹配集M**：当代理分数与预言分数不一致时将该解加入M作为新测试用例，引导迭代式评估器修复。

Result: 在四个任务上的实验结果：
1. **文本分类（Symptom2Disease）**：HASE Qwen3-8B达到86.98%±0.38%，匹配Meta-Harness的GPT-OSS-120B基线（86.8%），远超零样本（63.2%）和五样本（59.4%）。
2. **Alpha因子挖掘（CSI300，10天）**：HASE Qwen3-8B在RankIC=0.0302、AER=14.35%、IR=1.70上全面超越GPT-OSS-120B（AER=7.89%、IR=0.80）。
3. **圆填充**：从缺失边界和重叠检查的不完整评估器出发，经两次发散驱动的修复（先添加约束，再收紧容差至10^-12），最终达到2.635983分，与AlphaEvolve SOTA持平。
4. **Heilbronn三角**：在脆弱评估器下，权重冻结基线仅达0.021880，而协同演化在Phase 8达到0.036082，验证了参数协同演化的必要性。所有Alpha因子均通过未来信息泄露检测和4个LLM法官120/120一致CLEAN审计。

Conclusion: HASE是首个将模型权重、harness和任务解在同一统一智能体过程中协同演化的框架。通过将harness编辑纳入智能体动作空间但区分指导型与评估型组件的治理规则，HASE让单个Qwen3-8B模型能在文本分类上匹配、需要更少上下文的更大模型+外部harness提议者，在金融Alpha挖掘上超越GPT-OSS-120B基线，并能在不完美评估器下通过发散检测机制迭代修复评估器并达到几何算法发现的SOTA。局限在于：当前实验并非穷尽的扩展研究，harness编辑采用保守的白名单策略，可能拒绝有用的修改；未来可扩展可编辑表面、增加更强测试并使用更丰富的不匹配集。

Abstract: Self-evolving frameworks usually optimize task solutions while treating the surrounding harness as fixed. We introduce Harness-Aware Self-Evolving (HASE), an agentic reinforcement-learning framework in which a single model can generate task solutions or edit selected harness components in a multi-turn action space. HASE enables a single Qwen3-8B model to match the text-classification performance of a GPT-OSS-120B model that uses Claude Code as the harness proposer. In alpha factor mining, HASE outperforms the reported GPT-OSS-120B baseline. HASE also repairs imperfect evaluation components and converges to state-of-the-art performance in circle-packing algorithm discovery. These results show that HASE improves the harness and the solution through one unified agentic process.

</details>


### [604] [Online Linear Programming for Multi-Objective Routing in LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03948)
*Zixi Chen,Yinyu Ye,Zijie Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于在线线性规划（Online LP）的多目标优化框架，用于大语言模型（LLM）服务中的请求路由决策。该方法将路由问题建模为具有时序耦合批大小和KV-cache约束的在线LP，通过对偶分解获得影子价格，并采用投标价格控制（bid-price control）策略与热启动投影梯度更新实现毫秒级决策。实验证明该方法在Vidur模拟器中显著优于轮询、最短队列、随机和Power-of-2等启发式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务存在多种相互冲突的服务等级目标（SLO），如首token时间（TTFT）、端到端延迟（EEL）、吞吐量和尾延迟等，不同应用场景对这些指标的优先级要求不同。现有的路由启发式策略（如贪心负载均衡、随机路由）未与显式的优化目标绑定，无法灵活控制延迟-吞吐量权衡，每次部署都需重新调参。因此亟需一个通用的多目标控制框架，通过调整目标权重即可灵活适配不同业务需求。

Method: 1. **在线LP建模**：将LLM路由问题建模为带时序耦合约束（批大小B与KV-cache容量M）的在线线性规划，决策变量x_{j,g,τ}表示将请求j分配到设备g在周期τ开始解码。
2. **多目标奖励设计**：将吞吐、EEL、TTFT、QPS、尾EEL、尾TTFT分解为可加的逐请求奖励，尾延迟通过指示函数（是否满足阈值t'）转化为即时奖励，避免了聚合统计指标难以在线优化的问题。
3. **投标价格控制**：利用LP对偶得到影子价格p_i，量化批大小和KV-cache的机会成本；接受请求当且仅当其奖励r_{j,g,k}超过a⊤p的隐含资源成本Δ_j(g)>0。
4. **热启动投影梯度下降**：采用样本均值近似（SAA）学习价格向量，通过K步小批量投影次梯度迭代以O(KGH)复杂度在线更新对偶变量，每周期约1-2ms。
5. **非平稳适应**：通过滑动窗口监测到达率，丢弃过时历史样本以应对负载突变。

Result: 在Vidur模拟器（4×A100）上对真实数据集（lmsys-chat-1m）和合成数据进行测试：
- **带噪声解码长度预测（±20%）下相对轮询的改进**：平均EEL降低45.75%，P95 EEL降低42.49%，P99 EEL降低25.85%，SLO违规降低11.10%，吞吐量提升0.90%，显著优于LOR（0.67%/4.01%/6.19%）和Power-of-2（1.30%/3.84%/6.06%）。
- **目标权重可控**：调整权重可系统性地在平均延迟与尾延迟间移动帕累托前沿；增大ζ_2直接提高TTFT满足率。
- **鲁棒性**：在到达率从λ=0.4突变为λ=0.6的非平稳场景下仍保持44.81%/45.69%/31.15%的改进；解码长度预测误差20%以内性能稳定。
- **效率**：每周期路由计算约1-2ms，远低于A100上单次decode迭代的10-30ms。

Conclusion: 本文将运筹学中的在线资源分配和对偶投标价格控制方法引入LLM服务系统，提供了首个明确建模时序耦合容量约束的多目标路由优化框架。其核心价值在于：(1) 影子价格可诊断瓶颈资源（批大小vs KV-cache）；(2) 目标权重提供透明可解释的SLO权衡控制；(3) 优化方法在解码长度长且多变、多SLO冲突、系统接近满载时收益最大。局限性在于仅基于模拟验证，未来需在真实生产系统（如vLLM）中实现，并扩展到公平性、优先级分层和异构GPU集群等场景。

Abstract: We study the online routing problem in large language model serving, where requests arrive sequentially and must be dispatched to parallel decode workers under tight batch-size and KV-cache constraints. Unlike widely used routing heuristics that are not tied to explicit service-level objectives (SLOs) and offer limited control over latency-throughput trade-offs, we introduce a multi-objective optimization framework that formulates routing as an online linear programming with interpretable decision rewards. We apply an efficient bid-price control policy based on the online linear programming that admits requests when their SLO-weighted benefit exceeds their shadow prices. To meet millisecond decision requirements, we develop a warm-started, projected first-order updates that track the evolving dual shadow prices online with predictable runtime. We integrate our router into the Vidur simulator and demonstrate substantial improvements over standard baselines across multiple SLO regimes, including end-to-end latency, time-to-first-token, throughput, and tail performance. A big picture from our result: a science-based approach outperforms others based on heuristics.

</details>


### [605] [Explainable AI for Screening Abuse-Related Trauma in Bangladeshi Children: A Training-Free Multimodal Framework Evaluated on Noise-Aware Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04010)
*Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli,Fahima Haque Talukder Jely*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ShishuRaksha AI——一个针对孟加拉国儿童虐待相关心理创伤早期筛查的多模态决策支持框架，融合 SDQ/CPSS 问卷、孟加拉语叙事文本、HTP 绘画特征和面部情感四个通道，采用训练自由（training-free）、临床加权的跨模态注意力融合机制，并通过扰动式加性归因生成孟加拉语/英语双语可解释报告，对接孟加拉国法定儿童保护机构（OCC、DSS、NMHH）。由于伦理上无法收集受虐儿童临床数据，作者构建了含四层噪声的合成基准（500 例），在 5 折分层交叉验证下融合模型 AUC 达 0.874，显著优于 SDQ 单一基线（0.756）。本文定位为可行性研究，明确披露合成数据、文本特征循环性、无独立测试集及城乡子群体差距等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉国心理健康专业人员极度匮乏（每 10 万人仅 1.17 名，全国仅 6 名儿童精神科医生），且缺乏孟加拉语、文化适配的儿童虐待创伤筛查工具。现有量表需训练有素的管理者人工实施，无法自动化分诊。本文旨在设计一个可审计、低资源、可解释的儿童保护筛查辅助框架，帮助学校辅导员、NGO 工作者等非专业人员识别需转介的高风险儿童。鉴于在概念验证阶段无法伦理地收集受虐儿童真实数据，作者采用合成数据驱动的方法先行验证设计可行性。

Method: 1. **四模态输入与临床权重**：问卷（SDQ+CPSS，权重 0.40）、孟加拉语叙事文本（BanglaBERT 编码，权重 0.25）、HTP 绘画（EfficientNet-B0+20 个二元标记，权重 0.20）、面部情感（权重 0.15）。2. **训练自由注意力融合**：各模态经种子化随机投影至共享 128 维空间，跨模态缩放点积注意力+残差+tanh，拼接为 512 维融合向量，所有参数均可由代码复现或临床指定。3. **风险分层与覆盖规则**：LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL 四级，对接 OCC（热线 16767）、DSS（1098）等法定转介路径；任一单模态分数 >0.85 即强制升级至 HIGH。4. **可解释性**：基于扰动的临床加权加性归因（SHAP 思路），瀑布图展示各模态贡献。5. **合成基准生成**：固定种子 42，按 SDQ/CPSS 分布、HTP 文献先验、孟加拉语模板生成；引入 ±15% 测量误差、10% 报告者误分类、20% 绘画检测错误、15%/10% 叙事翻转、8% 标签噪声四层噪声。6. **评估**：用梯度提升树和随机森林作为融合引擎的树集成代理，采用 5 折分层交叉验证，1,000 次自助法置信区间。

Result: 融合模型 AUC = 0.874 [0.834–0.908]，显著高于 SDQ 单一基线（0.756）、文本单独（0.768）、绘画单独（0.774）；消融显示去除文本通道损失最大（−0.099），但作者指出文本通道存在特征-标签循环性故该下降部分为人为产物；权重敏感性分析显示 AUC 在 0.865–0.875 之间，临床权重主要贡献于可审计性而非判别力。运营点上 MODERATE 阈值灵敏度 0.707/特异度 0.878，HIGH 阈值 0.603/0.930，CRITICAL 阈值 0.457/0.956。子群体分析显示城乡 AUC 差距达 0.122（城市 0.780 vs 农村 0.902），区间重叠提示差距尚未确立但方向值得关注。校准方面 ECE=0.074 整体可接受，但高风险箱预测值系统性高估实际患病率，需重新校准后方可作概率解读。

Conclusion: 本文将 ShishuRaksha AI 明确定位为设计与可行性论证，而非经过验证的筛查工具。其核心贡献在于"脚手架"层面——可审计的训练自由融合、双语可解释报告、对接孟加拉国法定儿童保护机构的转介路径——而非具体性能数字。合成数据上的结果仅是设计合理性的初步证据，能否迁移至真实儿童群体仍是悬而未决的关键问题。后续工作需在严格的伦理审查下开展前瞻性验证，与儿童保护 NGO 及临床研究者合作，并在数据收集前优先解决同意/伦理程序问题。作者认为"先收集数据后讨论伦理"是导致领域出现不当系统的根本原因，坚持正确的优先顺序。

Abstract: Bangladesh has an estimated 1.17 mental-health professionals per 100,000 population and only six child psychiatrists nationwide. No Bengali-language, culturally adapted tool exists for early screening of abuse-related psychological trauma in children. We present ShishuRaksha AI, a decision-support (not diagnostic) framework that fuses four screening modalities: validated questionnaires (SDQ, CPSS), Bengali narrative text, House-Tree-Person (HTP) drawing features, and facial affect. The fusion is training-free and clinically weighted, uses cross-modal attention, and includes a single-modality override rule. Every risk score is explained through clinically weighted, perturbation-based additive attribution and rendered as a bilingual (Bangla/English) report with referral routing to national child-protection services (OCC, DSS, NMHH) under the Children Act 2013. No clinical dataset of abused children can be collected ethically at this stage, so we introduce a noise-aware synthetic benchmark (500 cases, 116 positive [23.2%], four deliberate noise layers, literature-grounded HTP priors) and evaluate tree-ensemble surrogates of the fusion design (facial channel excluded) under 5-fold stratified cross-validation. The fused model reaches an AUC of 0.874 [0.834-0.908], against 0.756 [0.705-0.803] for an SDQ-only baseline, with ablation, operating-point, subgroup, and calibration analyses. We state all limitations openly, including synthetic-only data, no held-out set, text-feature circularity, and an urban-rural subgroup gap. This work is a feasibility study and a design contribution toward ethically deployable child-protection screening in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [606] [What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04049)
*Claudio Novelli,Luciano Floridi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文论证生成式AI会通过侵蚀学术判断力形成与学术信任建立的核心实践而损害研究本身。作者反对将研究简化为"产出"的做法，呼吁将研究重新理解为一种"生活实践"，强调默会知识、个人承诺、学术社会化与深度阅读这四种不可自动化的研究源泉与保障，并提出"第二学术"（second scholarship）概念来描述对学术技艺的批判性重新占有。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型等生成式AI被广泛引入研究流程，研究者越来越多地将探究的核心任务（如构思、写作、综合）委托给AI系统。论文的动机在于揭示这一趋势背后的隐忧：即使AI生成的成果在表面上"更好"，研究者作为学术主体的成长与判断力的形成却可能被掏空。论文质疑当前盛行的"人类在环"（human-in-the-loop）方案是否足以维护研究的智识养成功能，呼吁重新审视研究作为"生活实践"的本体论意义。

Method: 本文采用哲学—规范性论证（normative-philosophical argument）的方法。核心策略包括：1) 区分研究的"最终产出"与"构成性实践"（constitutive practices），指出AI能模拟前者但无法替代后者；2) 通过"展示—反例"（showcase and counterexample）结构，论证表面改进与研究者真实发展之间可能脱节；3) 提出"第二学术"（second scholarship）作为替代性概念框架，强调对学术技艺的批判性重新占有；4) 从四个维度（默会知识、个人承诺、社会化、深度阅读）系统论证研究实践的不可自动化性。本文不含实证数据或实验，属于概念性、批判性论文。

Result: 论文的"结果"是一组规范性论断与一个概念框架：1) 仅保留人类作为提示者或质检者不足以保护研究的智识养成功能；2) 研究应被重新理解为"生活实践"，判断力通过摩擦与学术共同体参与逐渐形成；3) 提出四项不可自动化的研究保障：默会知识（tacit knowledge）、个人承诺（personal commitment）、社会化（socialisation）、深度阅读（deep reading）；4) 引入"第二学术"概念，主张研究者在亲历生成式AI的局限后，应批判性地重新占有学术技艺；5) 明确划定"不可也不应被委托"（cannot and should not be delegated）的研究核心，将其作为学术共同体应守护与负责的领域。

Conclusion: 论文结论是：生成式AI对研究的最大威胁不在于产出质量的下降，而在于研究者因放弃核心探究实践而丧失判断力养成与学术品格的发展空间。维护研究作为智识养成场域，需要的不是在AI流程末端增设人类环节，而是从根本上重新承诺于研究的生活实践——那些经由困难、共同体参与与深度阅读而形成的学术判断。"第二学术"是对这一承诺的命名：它要求学术共同体识别、珍视并对那些"不可委托之物"负责。论文以此作为对"留给我们的东西"（what is left for us）的回应。

Abstract: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed and academic trust is built. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the final outputs of research, which is what AI so effectively simulate. Accordingly, when researchers delegate central tasks of inquiry to systems like Large Language Models, they may stop enacting these practices and, with them, lose access to the formation they provide. An individual research output generated by AI may even appear improved but the researcher behind it fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans in the loop as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through frictions, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. This practice enacts what we call second scholarship, by which we understand the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what generative AI can and cannot do. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.

</details>


### [607] [PLACEMEM: Toward a Compute-Aware Memory Plane for Lifelong Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04089)
*Sukanta Ganguly*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PLACEMEM 提出"记忆胶囊"(versioned capsules) 作为终身智能体中语义记忆与运行时记忆（KV cache、prefix cache）之间的统一中间层，通过控制平面将检索、重用决策与级联失效整合为可修正感知的单一标识，并基于 vLLM 实现可执行原型，在保持 ~60% TTFT 降低的同时将校正后陈旧命中从 17 降至 0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前终身智能体系统存在两层割裂：智能体记忆层（如 Generative Agents、MemGPT）只关注检索语义内容，将运行时复用视为黑盒；推理服务层（如 vLLM）只优化 KV 管理与调度，不感知语义新鲜度。这导致两个可避免的失败：(1) 存在可重用状态时仍重复昂贵的 prefill；(2) 事实被纠正后仍静默复用陈旧运行时工件。论文认为记忆-推理边界正成为下一代智能体系统的一阶瓶颈。

Method: 核心抽象是"记忆胶囊"——版本化对象，统一封装 tenant 标识、文本、时间戳、有效期、摘要、来源、实体、依赖与可重用运行时工件（embeddings、KV segments、layer-frontier checkpoints）的单一身份。架构包含：胶囊目录、依赖图、调度器、放置 sidecar 与失效引擎。对每个请求通过效用函数 U(c,t,r)=w₁·P_reuse + w₂·C_saved + w₃·V_sem − w₄·R_stale − w₅·B_remote − w₆·L_target 联合权衡语义相关性、重用收益、新鲜度风险与传输开销。修正事件通过依赖边级联失效衍生摘要、索引与 KV 工件。原型基于 vLLM 实现，包含持久胶囊状态、并发安全失效、OpenAI 兼容路由 sidecar、类型化元数据契约与基准测试 harness。

Result: 在 48 轮 pilot 评测中：prompt-only 基线 TTFT 18.25 ms；runtime-only 复用降至 6.72 ms（-63.2%）但产生 17 次校正后陈旧命中；完整 PLACEMEM TTFT 7.17 ms（-60.7%）且陈旧命中为 0，失效开销仅 1.09 ms。在真实 vLLM 后端（LFM2.5-230M）9 轮校正后查询 × 3 工作负载 = 27 轮测试中：无失效条件下校正后准确率为 0（选到陈旧胶囊），完整 PLACEMEM 恢复至 1.00 准确率，TTFT 20.54 ms vs 文本摘要基线 36.08 ms（节省 75%）；340 轮批量部署吞吐验证 22.42 ms 全栈可用。

Conclusion: PLACEMEM 通过版本化胶囊设计闭合了语义记忆与运行时复用之间的鸿沟，证明修正感知控制平面可在不增加延迟成本的前提下消除陈旧重用。论文明确区分了当前控制平面可执行能力（文本与 KV 感知路由）与前瞻议程（layer-frontier 回放、多节点异构放置评估），定位为系统立场（systems position）而非完整回放引擎，为后续研究者提供验证 KV 回放收益、多节点放置与大规模修正感知失效的直接接口。

Abstract: Lifelong agents need more than larger context windows and better retrieval. They need memories that can persist, evolve, and be corrected without forcing the serving stack to recompute the same history on every turn or silently reuse stale runtime state. We present PLACEMEM as a systems position on lifelong-agent memory, instantiated by an executable control-plane prototype. The central claim is that agent memory should be represented as versioned capsules that unify semantics, provenance, validity, and reusable runtime state under one correction-aware identity. In the current prototype, capsules drive prompt-level text retrieval, KV-aware routing, and cascading invalidation over live streamed backends; prospective layer-frontier replay is intentionally framed as a deeper integration agenda rather than a claimed engine feature. We describe a vLLM-first prototype with persistent capsule state, concurrency-safe invalidation, an OpenAI-compatible routing sidecar, a typed metadata contract, and a benchmark harness that measures live first-token latency, reuse, and post-correction behavior. The result is both an executable artifact that demonstrates correction-aware control-plane behavior today and a concrete roadmap for replay-aware serving integration in future lifelong-agent systems.

</details>


### [608] [Forethought: Verifiable Reasoning from Neurosymbolic Primitive Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04096)
*Vishvesh Bhat,Jay Vaghasiya,Emmanuel Anaya Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Forethought 是一个神经符号推理系统，将推理表示为可通过嵌入式 DSL 组合的可验证原语库组成的显式程序，而非依赖测试时扩展的随机思维链。它在五个工具调用基准上比基础模型准确率提升约 30%，且后训练成本比专用推理模型低约三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流的推理增强方法（如 DeepSeek-R1）依赖测试时扩展，通过强化学习训练模型生成长链思维，但存在三个核心缺陷：(1) 推理能力纠缠于特定模型权重中，无法跨模型迁移；(2) 推理过程是随机的、不可逐步验证的；(3) 推理时计算成本高昂。对于需要部署到生产环境尤其是监管领域的智能体，准确率已不再是唯一指标，还必须兼顾效率、成本和可审计性。

Method: Forethought 架构包含三大核心组件：(1) **推理原语库**：每个原语实现窄域推理操作，分为确定性符号原语（如类型检查、约束传播）和基于微调小语言模型（SLM）的神经原语，每个原语附带形式化的输出契约（类型、值、语义约束）。(2) **Python 嵌入式 DSL**：提供 Sequence、Parallel、Conditional、Iterate、Fallback 等类型化组合算子，支持静态类型检查、成本延迟预估、正确性推理和 AST 优化。(3) **执行引擎**：解释程序、调度原语、强制执行契约、生成结构化执行轨迹，并支持并行化、缓存、批处理等优化。具体实例化为工具调用执行内核，包含五个可组合子过程：Decompose、Init-Scratchpad、Get-Order、Check-Prerequisites、Match-Functions-and-Parameters。设计时验证工作流是核心：通过 300 个手工推导的样本迭代精炼 DSL，在部署前完成静态分析、契约审查、边缘案例分析和受控执行。所有 SLM 原语基于 Gemma 12B 微调，共 16,502 个训练样本。

Result: 在 Tau2（航空/零售/电信）、BFCL v3/v4 多轮、LiveMCPBench 五个基准上：NRE 持续提升基础模型准确率（弱模型相对提升 30–60%，如 Haiku 4.5 在 Tau2 Telecom 从 53.5 提升至 98.0）；在所有基准上优于 vanilla prompting、RLM 和 GEPA 基线；小模型配合 NRE 可匹配甚至超越前沿大模型的 vanilla prompting。在控制基模型的对比中，DeepSeek-V3（非推理）+ NRE 在 Tau2 平均 83.5、BFCL v4 达 70.5，显著超越 DeepSeek-R1（推理模型）的 33.2 和 57.0；后训练成本对比为 ~$500 vs >$500K（约三个数量级差距）。人类评审修正后，BFCL v4 分数进一步提升 10–20 分，揭示标准评分流程存在系统性地惩罚功能正确输出的偏差。原语级精确匹配准确率达 92.5%。

Conclusion: Forethought 证明了神经符号程序是测试时扩展的有力替代方案：可验证性驱动准确率（在部署前即可发现并修正错误）、数据与计算高效（16K 样本 vs 800K）、模型无关（同一程序可在不同基础模型上执行）、完全可审计（每步带契约校验的执行轨迹）。未来工作包括 DSL 程序的自动合成、扩展原语库以"减薄"推理层，以及将神经符号分解推广至工具调用之外的更广泛推理领域。论文核心论点是：结构化验证带来的增益是架构性的，无论基础模型如何进步都会持续存在；而基于随机搜索的扩展存在结构性的计算低效、不可靠纠错和模型特异性限制。

Abstract: Current agentic workflows usually involve decomposing user requests into sequences of tool calls with correctly resolved parameters, the results of which are processed through reasoning traces in the language model's context window. The prevailing route to improve such reasoning is test-time scaling, which trains models to search over long chains of thought; but the resulting capability is entangled in model weights, is not verifiable step-by-step, and is costly at inference. We present Forethought, a neurosymbolic reasoning system that instead treats reasoning as an explicit, verifiable program, that builds from a library of symbolic and neural primitives which are composed through a domain-specific language. The result are reasoning programs, which are concrete representations of the model's work, and as such can be inspected and modified before deployment. Instantiated as a tool-calling execution kernel and evaluated across five benchmarks, Forethought improves base-model accuracy by about 30% relative and outperforms vanilla prompting, reinforcement learning scaffolds, and prompt-evolution methods, enabling small models to match or exceed frontier models capabilities. In a direct comparison, a non-reasoning model augmented with Forethought competes with a dedicated reasoning model while requiring roughly three orders of magnitude less post-training investment, and remains model-agnostic and auditable.

</details>


### [609] [Language models guide symbolic equation discovery by controlling search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04156)
*Zikai Xie,Wenmei Li,Man Luo,Jun Jiang,Linjiang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-PySR框架，将语言模型定位为符号回归的"搜索控制器"（负责指定变量、算子、变换与搜索深度），而非方程作者或候选筛选者；实验证明该分工在准确率、复杂度、稳定性与成本上取得最佳平衡，并在电池循环寿命预测任务中发现简洁的分段线性关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学方程发现需要兼顾领域先验与严格的数值验证。现有方法面临两难：符号回归虽具数值基础但搜索空间组合爆炸；多数语言模型系统则让模型直接提出或筛选公式，缺乏数值层面的硬约束。作者由此提出质疑——是否应采用一种不同的"劳动分工"来融合二者优势。

Method: 对比三种语言模型角色设定：(1)方程作者（直接生成公式）、(2)候选筛选者（在候选集中做选择）、(3)搜索控制器（LLM-PySR）。在控制器模式下，LLM负责指定变量、算子、变换与搜索深度等高层假设空间结构；符号回归引擎负责枚举与拟合表达式；确定性指标（非概率判断）负责保留决策。以此区分"假设探索"与"方程存亡决定权"。

Result: 在74个AI-Feynman方程及7个复杂公式复原任务上，搜索控制器角色在准确率、表达复杂度、数值稳定性与计算成本四维度上均展现出最优的综合平衡，显著优于端到端语言模型基线与纯数值基线。在独立电池数据集上，LLM-PySR成功识别出早期电压曲线位移与循环寿命之间的紧凑分段线性关系，体现方法对真实科学场景的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 语言模型在科学方程发现中的恰当定位应是塑造假设探索空间，而非裁决哪些方程存活；将数值验证的最终决定权交还给确定性度量，可有效结合语言模型的语义先验与符号回归的数值严谨性。

Abstract: Scientific equation discovery must combine broad domain priors with strict numerical testing. Symbolic regression supplies numerical grounding but faces a combinatorial search space, whereas many language-model systems ask the model to propose or select formulas directly. We test a different division of labour. We compare role specifications in which the language model acts as equation author, candidate decider or search controller, alongside end-to-end language-model and purely numerical baselines. In the controller setting we propose here, implemented as LLM-PySR, language models specify variables, operators, transformations and search depth; symbolic regression enumerates and fits expressions; and deterministic metrics govern retention. Across 74 AI-Feynman equations and seven complex formula-recovery tasks, search control achieved the strongest observed balance of accuracy, complexity, stability and cost. On an independent battery dataset, LLM-PySR identified a compact piecewise-linear relation between early voltage-curve displacement and cycle life. The results suggest that language models should shape hypothesis exploration rather than decide which equations survive.

</details>


### [610] [A Clustering-Based Framework for Identifying Suspicious Trading Patterns in Capital Market](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04184)
*Asif Zaman,Romona Magdalene Sarkar,Sabiha Khair Ohi,Iftekharul Mobin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于K-Means++聚类的无监督市场操纵检测框架（SMMD），通过对达卡证券交易所（DSE）约100万笔交易数据进行聚类分析，识别出2.02%的可疑交易，并将其细分为六类欺诈模式（spoofing占51.1%、pump and dump占0.10%、insider trading占0.55%、fake breakout占1.43%、rug pull、unclassified占46.83%），最终轮廓系数（Silhouette Score）为0.561。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统监管方法和有监督机器学习依赖标注数据和预定义模式，难以识别金融市场中复杂的欺诈活动。孟加拉国达卡证券交易所（DSE）长期面临内幕交易和操纵问题，投资者信任受损。因此需要一种轻量级、无监督的聚类欺诈检测框架，能够自适应地从不断演变的市场数据中识别可疑交易行为。

Method: 1. 数据预处理：合并2010-2024年数据，排除2010-2011年，删除缺失值，保留约101.9万条记录。
2. 特征工程：基于30天滚动窗口构建9个技术指标，包括价格变化百分比ΔP%、日内振幅R、30天滚动波动率σ₃₀、成交量/交易笔数/换手率脉冲比Sᵥ/Sₜ/Sₜᵤᵣₙ、VWAP、均价Pₐᵥ𝓰。
3. 特征标准化：使用StandardScaler进行z-score标准化。
4. 聚类建模：采用K-Means++算法，通过Elbow法确定k=5；并与DBSCAN、OPTICS、层次聚类对比。
5. 异常检测：计算每点到聚类中心的欧氏距离，选取第95百分位作为结构异常阈值，并结合95百分位的脉冲指标和|ΔP%|>10%的行为阈值进行混合过滤。
6. 风险评分与分类：基于异常频率与严重度（权重α）的可疑分数将股票分为5个风险等级（Critical/High/Medium/Low/Minimal），并通过启发式规则将可疑交易分类为六种欺诈类型（pump & dump、spoofing、rug pull、insider trading、fake breakout、unclassified）。

Result: 框架在DSE数据上标记了2.02%的交易为可疑；在六类欺诈分类中，spoofing占51.10%，pump and dump占0.10%，insider trading占0.55%，fake breakout占1.43%，rug pull占比未明确，unclassified占46.83%。轮廓系数达到0.561（内部对比实验中报告0.965，需注意文中存在数值不一致）。K-Means在准确率（0.987）、轮廓系数和可扩展性上优于DBSCAN、OPTICS和层次聚类。模型在印度NSE数据上的轮廓系数为0.292，验证了跨市场适用性。可疑度最高的股票包括UNILEVERCL（44.1%）、SQURPHARMA（22.1%）、ACI（19.3%）等。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了无监督聚类结合行为启发式规则在缺乏标注数据的资本市场中检测操纵行为的可行性。局限性包括：缺乏真实标签（ground truth）验证、启发式阈值难以适应高动态市场、60/40权重分配依赖经验、46.83%交易被归为unclassified表明分类粒度仍需提升。未来方向包括引入DBSCAN/HDBSCAN等更先进的密度聚类方法、引入实时流处理、以及将异常收益分类进一步细化。该框架在DSE和NSE两个不同市场均表现良好，具有向全球市场监管与分析师推广的潜力。

Abstract: Market manipulation is the dubious practice of manipulating stock prices in order to make a quick profit, which truly degrades confidence on trading platforms. We implemented an unsupervised fraud-detection toolkit that begins with K-Means++ clustering to address this issue. A dataset of roughly one million financial transactions from 2012 to 2024 is used. In order to identify fraudulent trades and categorize them using market practice heuristic thresholds, the study suggests a clustering-based pipeline. The method highlights 2.02% of trades as suspicious where 51.10% clearly indicate spoofing, 0.10% indicate pump and dump, 0.55% indicate insider trading, 1.43% indicate a fake breakout, and 46.83% are unclassified. Despite the lack of ground truth, the model's performance is confirmed by a Silhouette Score of 0.561.

</details>


### [611] [Agentic IoT: Architectures, Applications, and Challenges Toward the Internet of Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04219)
*Rümeysa Hilal Sevinç,Bahaeddin Türkoğlu,İbrahim Kök*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并系统定义"Agentic IoT"（智能体化物联网）这一新兴范式，将其定位为融合自主AI智能体感知、推理、规划、学习与行动能力与信息物理系统的下一代认知物联网，并通过三参考架构、文献综述与挑战分析，搭建从传统物联网/AIoT走向"智能体互联网"（Internet of Agents）的研究基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIoT系统普遍依赖针对特定任务的预训练模型进行感知推理，在系统层面缺乏实时推理、自适应规划、自主协调、工具使用、持续学习和上下文决策等能力，难以应对异构、动态、实时和不确定性场景，亟需一种新的范式将IoT从以数据为中心的感知推理基础设施转变为跨设备/边缘-雾-云的分布式认知智能体生态系统。

Method: 采用系统性综述与概念框架相结合的方法：(1) 通过范式演变分析刻画从传统IoT到AIoT再到Agentic IoT的演进路径，并构建三维度对比表（决策机制、自主性等级、推理、规划、工具使用、记忆、学习、适应性、多智能体协调等）；(2) 提出三层参考架构（设备/物理层、边缘/雾层、云/智能层）加跨层智能体智能平面，包含统一智能体认知循环（感知-推理-规划-行动-学习）、短/长期记忆与RAG、工具集成、MCP/A2A等智能体通信协议与IoT协议桥接机制，以及设备-边缘-云混合部署策略；(3) 对现有IoT、Internet of Agents与Agentic IoT研究按基础设施、安全与信任、网络、智慧城市与灾害、工业与农业等五大领域进行系统分类与对比分析；(4) 从互操作性、信任与治理、资源感知智能、实时推理、记忆管理、多智能体协调、可解释性等七个维度梳理挑战，并提出面向物联网的基础智能体、边缘原生系统、世界模型与神经-符号物理锚定、智能体化数字孪生、自演化系统、智能体XAI与溯源、能耗均衡可持续设计以及标准化基准与仿真测试平台等八大未来方向。

Result: (1) 给出Agentic IoT的形式化定义，明确其与IoT、AIoT、Agentic AI及Internet of Agents的边界与关系；(2) 通过对比表清晰展示Agentic IoT在决策机制、自主性、推理、规划、工具使用、记忆、学习、适应性、多智能体协调、自然语言交互和行为模型等方面相对IoT与AIoT的本质差异；(3) 系统梳理并归纳了涵盖IoT智能体基础设施、安全信任、网络管理、智慧城市与灾害响应、工业与农业等多领域的代表性研究，呈现从符号/规则/本体驱动向LLM驱动推理与智能体协议演进的研究轨迹；(4) 通过表II对17种适用于IoT的小型/边缘语言模型（含DeepSeek-R1、Falcon-E、Gemma、Phi、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2等）的参数规模、架构、部署方式、工具支持与量化方案进行横向比较；(5) 识别出互操作性与协议碎片化、信任/安全/治理、资源感知智能、实时推理与边缘约束、记忆管理与终身学习、多智能体协调、可解释性等七大核心挑战。

Conclusion: Agentic IoT作为Internet of Agents愿景在物联网领域的应用导向延伸，可将IoT从被动传感与推理基础设施转变为运行于设备/边缘-雾-云连续体的分布式认知智能体生态系统；所提出的三层架构与跨层智能体智能平面为该领域提供了统一的参考设计，所识别的七大挑战与八大未来研究方向（包括面向IoT的基础智能体、边缘原生系统、世界模型与物理锚定、智能体数字孪生、自演化系统、能耗均衡设计与标准化基准）构成了Agentic IoT走向成熟与实际部署的研究路线图，并有望成为Internet of Agents愿景触及物理世界的现实路径。

Abstract: The integration of AI into Internet of Things (AIoT) systems has gradually transformed them from passive data collection infrastructures into intelligent systems capable of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, classification, forecasting, and optimization. However, most existing solutions still rely on task-specific models that infer from sensor data; thus, system-wide capabilities such as real-time reasoning, adaptive planning, autonomous coordination, learning, tool use, and contextual decision-making remain limited. This paper examines Agentic IoT as a next-generation cognitive IoT paradigm that integrates the perception, reasoning, planning, learning, and action capabilities of autonomous AI agents with cyber-physical systems. Agentic IoT aims to transform IoT from data-centric sensing and inference infrastructures into distributed cognitive agent ecosystems operating across the device/edge-fog-cloud continuum. The paper first grounds this transition as a paradigm shift and positions Agentic IoT in relation to AIoT, edge intelligence, multi-agent systems, and the Internet of Agents. It then systematically reviews current studies, presents a holistic architectural framework, discusses domain-specific application potential, and identifies key technical, operational, and research challenges together with future research directions.

</details>


### [612] [Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04222)
*Amit LeVi,Elad David,Max Fomin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MAG（Mining via Activation Geometry），一种无监督框架，通过将固定的自然语言指令 Q 拼接到输入 p 前后，比较模型残差流读出的激活差 m(Q∥p)−m(p) 来提取"模型相对"的推理特征。定义了 8 种 MAG 算子，并在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it、Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct 上验证：MAG 特征可读、能近似为单一激活方向、通过激活引导可翻转模型的二元判断、上下文相关概念方向与单概念方向几何可分。进一步将 MAG 几何用于候选训练集选择——最佳三元组合在 19 次有效洗牌上达到 94.7% Top-1 和 100% Top-2 准确率，显著优于原始激活的质心余弦相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法多依赖人工标注的概念样本，可能带有标注者偏见；且模型自省（introspection）相关工作主要考察模型能否报告其内部状态，缺少一种外部、无需标注、可在评测时诱导推理特征并提取、复用与组合的方法。同时，提示注入分类器探针训练中"选哪个数据集加入训练池"缺乏有效的几何预测信号。

Method: 1) 对每个输入 p 拼上固定自然语言指令 Q（如"它能出现在沙漠里吗？"或"该提示是否为恶意？"），在残差流最后一层最后一个 token 位置读取激活 A(x)=m(x)，用差值 Δ^Q(p)=m(Q∥p)−m(p) 捕获 Q 诱导的推理特征。2) 定义 8 个算子：Direct、Prefixed、Answered、QuestionDelta、InputDelta、Interaction、Verdict、FewShot，对比各算子的均值差异方向 u_Q 和 v_Q。3) 用模型自身 yes/no 偏好构造自标签 y^M（而非数据集标签）作为对比集 P⁺/P⁻。4) 通过归一化重建误差 ε_Q 衡量线性可近似性，并在最后一层注入方向做行为引导（标定强度 α(τ)）。5) 在 18 个提示注入数据集上评估候选训练集转移：用每种算子×8 种相似度/距离度量构成预测器，按百分位秩聚合，用 Top-k 准确率衡量。

Result: 可读性：MAG 在 9 个 (概念, 模型) 单元中均优于原始激活，沙漠/海洋 LOO ROC 提升 6–10 点，5 个单元 ≥0.97；MAG 分类器在模型与数据集标签不一致时 69.3%–73.7% 跟随模型判断。线性：最后一层注入单方向优于逐层注入，每个 (模型, 前缀) 单元 ε∈[0.59,0.97]。引导：匹配 yes/no 探针下，类均方向可在 12 个中性对象上翻转 11–12 个 "no→yes"；提示注入方向不能翻转中性对象。组合性：Llama 上 Bob 与 desert 方向几乎正交（cos=−0.04），均能在留出对象上分类。训练集选择：原始质心余弦基本无信号（ρ∈[0.01,0.05]）；最佳三元 {Y₃+cos_ben, Y₅+cos_ben, Y₈+cos_mal} 在 19 次有效洗牌中 94.7% Top-1、100% Top-2；质心稳定性 K≥64 时 Top-3 仍 100%。

Conclusion: MAG 提供了一种无需人工标注、无需微调、无需拟合聚合权重的激活级审计原语，能定义、提取、读出、引导和组合模型相对的推理特征；其几何信息可有效预测候选训练集对下游任务的转移收益，显著优于原始激活相似度方法。作者指出 MAG 具有双重用途：既可支持防御性审计，也可能被用于探测/削弱安全表征，应被视为模型攻击面的一部分。局限：仅使用一种下游分类器；最强三元仅在 19 次洗牌上评估且选择-评估同分布；匹配格式引导无法可靠控制开放式生成；提示注入前缀线性度低且不能翻转中性样本；y^M 是模型相对判断而非真值。

Abstract: Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations by prepending the same natural-language instruction $Q$ to every input $p$, where $Q$ defines the reasoning feature of interest, such as ``Can this object be found in the desert?'' or ``Is this prompt malicious?'' We measure how the instruction changes the model's internal representation using $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout point. We explore eight different MAGs. The extracted reasoning features predict the models' own world understanding and judgment, can be approximated into a single activation direction, we found that some features are more linearly represented and some less, this linear representation, which is vector steering, can change the LLMs' decisions through activation steering by injecting reasoning features. Finally, we use the same method to select the best training datasets for prompt-injection classifier probes: while similarity between ordinary activations is almost unrelated to downstream performance, RFD-based similarity achieves $94.7\%$ Top-1 and $100\%$ Top-2 accuracy.

</details>


### [613] [Biological Motifs for Agentic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04240)
*Bogdan Banu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将基因调控网络（GRN）的控制拓扑映射到智能体软件架构的有类型接口对应框架，利用应用范畴论（多项式函子与连线图）将五个生物控制基序（前馈环、适应性免疫、线粒体信号、内共生、形态发生素扩散）转化为可组合的软件设计模式。核心贡献包括：(1)智能体操作范畴（Agentic Operad）的有类型语法及其在CFFL拓扑下的误差抑制界；(2)基于认知拓扑推导的四个多智能体缩放预测定理；(3)从结构到发育的六层进展框架。配套实现包含1,813个测试和116个示例，并通过与Kim等人实证基准的定性一致检验获得支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的智能体架构在可靠性、安全性和状态管理方面面临严峻挑战，包括幻觉级联、无限循环和提示注入攻击等问题。这些故障模式与生物体所面临的分布式信息处理约束存在结构相似性。基因调控网络（GRN）经过亿万年进化形成的网络基序（如前馈环、免疫系统）已发展出处理噪声、安全和状态管理的成熟拓扑方案。作者主张可在有类型接口和协调结构层面（而非字面机制）建立GRN与智能体软件系统之间的精确对应，从而将成熟的生物启发设计模式引入智能体工程领域。

Method: 方法论建立在应用范畴论（Applied Category Theory）之上，以多项式函子（Polynomial Functors, **Poly**）作为有类型接口的统一语言，连线图（Wiring Diagrams）作为组合语言。具体步骤包括：(1)建立基因对象与智能体能力对象在 Coalg(**Poly**) 中的子集对应（命题1）；(2)定义智能体操作范畴 WAgent 包含三种组合运算（平行⊗、串行∘、迹Tr）；(3)将Lens光学扩展为Prism（条件路由）和Traversal（批处理）；(4)构建代谢煤代数（Metabolic Coalgebra）以纳入资源约束；(5)定义Provenance函子与Trust-Gated Lens实现结构化信任；(6)以Kripke认知逻辑从连线图观测结构派生认知算子（K_i、E_G、C_G、D_G）；(7)证明四个预测定理（误差放大、序列惩罚、并行加速、工具密度缩放）；(8)建立从结构到发育的六层进展模型。

Result: 主要结果：(1)定理2（误差抑制）证明CFFL拓扑在独立失效下将失败概率从 p 降至 pq，相关失效ρ=0时退化至p²，定理明确量化了生成器-验证器相关性对安全增益的侵蚀效应；(2)定理1（代谢边界）证明在无再生、单调递减资源条件下，执行长度受初始预算除以最小消耗率所界定，确保终止性可判定；(3)定理3（内容级信任伪造抗性）证明当Provenance由入口通道元数据而非内容计算时，内容编辑无法提升信任级别；(4)定理4-7构成认知拓扑预测框架：误差放大界 A_⊗ ≤ n 和 A_∘ ≤ n(1-d)；序列协调惩罚公式；并行加速公式 S ≈ m；工具密度缩放 O(tn) vs O(t)；(5)实现包含1,813测试和116示例，在合成评测中验证了级联chaperone（56.2% vs 5.5%严格模式）、错误上下文修复（99.6% vs 68.0%盲重试）、免疫检测（敏感性100%，假阳性0.4%）等模式的有效性；(6)与Kim等人180种智能体配置下的实证结果定性一致（如A_e比值3.9、PlanCraft序列任务退化-39.1%至-70.1%、Finance-Agent并行加速+80.8%）。

Conclusion: 本文建立了GRN与智能体软件架构之间在有类型接口层面的精确而非字面等价的对应关系，将生物控制基序转化为可组合的软件设计模式。范畴论框架使模式能够精确分析：多项式函子提供统一的接口语言，操作范畴提供组合语法，连线图强制类型安全防止运行时错误，代谢煤代数形式化资源约束保证终止性，认知拓扑从结构派生知识属性。作者明确指出该对应是接口层面的，不主张GRN与智能体系统在机制上等价。四定理的定性预测与已发表多智能体基准一致，但作者强调需以结构而非优化的方式解读这些对应。论文包含一个六层进展框架（结构→记忆→适应→认知→发育→集成），并以工程实现与合成评测证明该框架的可行性，但作者也明确边界条件：生物抽象在代码结构层面泛化，但在优化算法层面不泛化；保证分层级；证书提高可靠性但不加速；委派需新信号源。

Abstract: The transition of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive generators to autonomous agents has introduced significant challenges in reliability, security, and state management. Current agentic architectures are often constructed ad-hoc, prone to hallucination cascades, infinite loops, and prompt injection attacks. This paper argues that many of these failure modes can be analyzed using control motifs long studied in systems biology, provided the comparison is made at the level of typed interfaces and coordination structure rather than literal biological mechanism. We develop a typed interface correspondence between Gene Regulatory Networks and agentic software systems using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams. Five biological motifs are mapped to composable software design patterns: Coherent Feed-Forward Loops for noise suppression, Adaptive Immunity for layered security, Mitochondrial Signaling for resource governance, Endosymbiosis for neuro-symbolic integration, and Morphogen Diffusion for spatially varying coordination. An epistemic topology layer derives Kripke-style knowledge operators from the wiring diagram's observation structure and proves four predictive theorems for multi-agent scaling. The core contributions are: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed syntax for agent composition with provable error suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology with four theorems (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, and tool density scaling) whose qualitative predictions are consistent with published multi-agent benchmarks; and (3) a six-layer progression from structure through development, grounded in autonomous learning frameworks and convergence proxies from the empirical literature. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples illustrates practical feasibility.

</details>


### [614] [Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04242)
*Mingxuan Fan,Peiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ProGPO（Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization），一种无需学习critic的步级强化学习方法，用于长程智能体任务。该方法将精确前缀一致的组内动作比较与基于回滚状态电位的转移信用（transition credit）相结合，通过语义扩展和跨历史深度的逆方差融合来稳定状态电位估计，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上优于现有步级组RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 步级组强化学习在长程智能体任务中面临信用分配难题：按当前观察分组可扩大覆盖范围，但可能比较不同历史下的动作，导致有偏优势估计；强制历史一致性虽公平但易产生单例组和低对比组，使许多步骤失去同伴比较信号。在训练轨迹中，ALFWorld 44.5%和WebShop 33.7%的步骤在转换信用计算前没有同伴比较优势信号。

Method: ProGPO采用双轨设计：(1) 精确前缀一致的步级组相对优势（层次加权聚合多深度有效前缀组）；(2) 基于回滚统计的非参数状态电位V̂(s)，通过逆方差权重w_k = n_k/(σ_k² + ε_var)对多深度估计进行可靠性感知融合，并在小组大小低于阈值m时使用策略隐藏状态的最近邻语义扩展。状态转移信用A^trans_t = V̂^mr(s_{t+1}) − V̂^mr(s_t)补充同伴比较信号，最终优势A^ProGPO = A^hier + λ_tr·η_t·A^trans，使用裁剪替代目标优化。

Result: 在ALFWorld上，ProGPO将Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的整体成功率从HGPO的87.8%提升至90.1%，并在Pick/Clean/Cool/Look/Heat诊断任务上领先；在WebShop上将成功率从GiGPO的67.6%提升至71.5%。Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct的ALFWorld实验（步155）显示ProGPO达到94.5%验证成功率（GiGPO 93.0%，HGPO 89.1%）。消融实验表明语义扩展与可靠性融合组合将训练成功率从87.5%提升至96.9%。

Conclusion: ProGPO在不训练参数化价值网络或奖励模型的前提下，通过回滚派生的状态电位和转移信用缓解了上下文一致步级组RL的信用稀疏问题。精确前缀比较保证动作比较公平性，语义扩展与逆方差多分辨率融合使状态电位估计更稳定。方法在ALFWorld和WebShop上展示了相对于匹配基线的稳定改进，且计算开销相当。

Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective paradigm for improving large language model agents on long-horizon interactive tasks. To obtain finer-grained policy updates than trajectory-level optimization, recent work has moved toward step-level group-based RL, where intermediate steps are grouped and compared within a rollout batch. However, step-level advantage estimation is sensitive to how groups are formed: grouping by broad state keys improves coverage but may compare actions taken under different histories, while enforcing historical consistency yields fairer comparisons at the cost of fragmented groups and missing peer-comparison signal. In this paper, we propose ProGPO (Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization), a learned-critic-free method for context-consistent step-level learning. ProGPO keeps exact-prefix action comparison, and complements sparse peer comparisons with transition credit derived from rollout-based state potentials. To estimate these potentials reliably, ProGPO combines semantic expansion with inverse-variance fusion across history depths. We evaluate ProGPO on two challenging agentic tasks, ALFWorld and WebShop, with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Results show that ProGPO improves over matched agentic RL baselines under comparable computational overhead, and additional Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct experiments further test the scalability of the proposed method.

</details>


### [615] [Shortcut Learning in Legal Judgment Prediction: Empirical Evidence from the UK Employment Tribunal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04261)
*Joe Watson,Joana Ribeiro de Faria,Marcus Tomalin,Måns Magnusson,Huiyuan Xie,Hao Tian Yeung,Felix Steffek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现：法律判决预测模型在事后判决文本上取得的高分，部分可能来自结果泄露与捷径学习；但通过识别并遮蔽泄露特征后，模型性能几乎不降，说明LJP仍有价值，但必须进行严格的数据泄露审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LJP常依赖判决书等事后司法材料，这些文本可能已包含暗示最终裁判结果的叙述线索，导致模型学习到语言捷径，而非真正根据案件事实进行前瞻性预测。论文旨在实证检验这种捷径学习是否存在、影响多大，以及是否可通过审计和遮蔽缓解。

Method: 研究以英国就业法庭（UKET）33,158条个体诉求为语料，进行诉求级结果预测。输入包括诉求文本与由LLM抽取的案件摘要；模型覆盖可解释的TF-IDF分类器到黑箱LLM。作者通过人工判断对测试数据按泄露程度分层，并识别疑似泄露特征；进一步训练仅使用泄露特征的模型，同时在遮蔽泄露特征后重新训练模型，以比较性能变化。

Result: 实验显示，整体预测指标看似较强，但当文本中嵌入更多结果揭示性线索时，模型性能显著提高。仅用约4%的泄露特征训练的模型也能取得较高性能，甚至超过人类专家，说明泄露特征具有很强解释力。不过，在遮蔽这些泄露特征后重新训练，Macro-F1仅出现很小下降，表明模型并非完全依赖泄露，仍能从非泄露文本中抽取有效信号。

Conclusion: 该研究认为，基于事后司法文本的法律判决预测（LJP）容易受到“结果泄露”和捷径学习影响，表面上的高性能可能并不等同于真实预测能力。但这一问题并不否定LJP研究本身；只要将事后判决文本视为可能受污染的数据，并进行主动审计、遮蔽泄露特征，模型仍能保留有用的预测信号。

Abstract: Current Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) is constrained by its reliance on post-hoc judicial materials, increasing the likelihood that models perform retrospective classification rather than true forecasting. This paper empirically investigates shortcut learning in this context by studying claim-level outcome prediction in UK Employment Tribunal (UKET) decisions. Using a corpus of 33,158 individual claims, we predict outcomes from claim texts and LLM-extracted case summaries, evaluating models ranging from interpretable TF-IDF-based classifiers to black-box LLMs. While headline predictive performance figures appear strong, we demonstrate that such performance in LJP systems trained on post-hoc judicial text can be driven by the retrospective nature of the source material. Stratifying the test data by human judgments of leakage reveals that performance increases where outcome-revealing cues are embedded in the narrative. Moreover, a model trained on just the 4% of features identified as leakage achieves high performance, outperforming human experts. These findings substantiate concerns that LJP performance may be exaggerated by linguistic artefacts. Yet this vulnerability is not fatal to the research agenda. Instead, post-hoc judgments might be treated as potentially contaminated texts, requiring active auditing. Retraining models after masking leakage features results in only a negligible reduction in Macro-F1. Hence, while models will opportunistically exploit shortcuts when available, they remain capable of extracting useful predictive signals when these artefacts are removed.

</details>


### [616] [Agentic SABRE: An Uncertainty-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Ransomware Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04292)
*Henry Kabuye,Biju Issac,Jeyamohan Neera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agentic SABRE提出了一种不确定性感知、神经-符号融合的多Agent勒索软件检测框架，通过语义Agent与行为Agent的分数融合，结合蒙特卡洛Dropout认知不确定性估计与可解释的双阈值分诊策略（τ, κ），实现AUTO-CONTAIN/ESCALATE/ALLOW的自主防御决策，在RDset上达到完美判别（AUC=1.0），同时在行为信号弱的场景下保持校准不确定性并减少误升级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 勒索软件在概念漂移、规避和行为多态性下持续进化，静态签名和单一分类器难以泛化。现有机器学习检测器存在三个核心缺陷：(1) 缺乏不确定性量化，无法判断何时应自主防御或升级人工；(2) 是独立处理数据增强、语义建模、不确定性、多Agent架构等子问题，缺乏统一框架；(3) 缺乏将预测不确定性绑定到自主决策中的操作机制，导致错误冒进（灾难性误报）或过度保守（分析师负担过重）。SABRE旨在以认知不确定性作为操作控制信号而非诊断辅助，填补这一差距。

Method: 框架包含五阶段流程：(1) 混合特征提取—从PE元数据生成384维语义嵌入，同时从I/O遥测提取16维滑动窗口行为特征；(2) 特征级SMOTE增强；(3) 训练两个独立的1D-CNN Agent，均采用Monte Carlo Dropout（每个样本T=30次随机前向传播）产生预测均值与认知不确定性σ；(4) 分数级CTGAN增强后，由MLP决策Agent融合为统一风险p̂；(5) 分诊策略采用最大不确定性聚合σ_max = max(σ_sem, σ_beh)作为安全保守信号，在二维(p̂, σ_max)空间中以可解释的轴对齐阈值对(τ, κ)与(τ_high, κ_low)划分为三区域—高风险低不确定性→AUTO-CONTAIN；中等风险或高不确定性→ESCALATE；其余→ALLOW；并集成梯度显著性、置换重要性与反事实分析等事后可解释性机制，符号线索采用ATT&CK启发的API类别标志、熵阈值信号与文件系统访问启发式规则作为神经-符号混合推理组件。

Result: 在RDset（语义饱和区）上实现完美判别AUC=1.0000（语义Agent），Triage分诊后精度0.99999；在RanSMAP（行为高不确定性区）行为Agent精度0.9872但AUC=0.6030，反映类先验偏差；分数融合将RanSMAP AUC提升至0.5397（移除CTGAN降至0.5142），移除不确定性使假阴性从43,656激增至58,441；在相等召回率下实现最高4.9%的误升级率相对降低；四种划分下AUROC分别为随机分层0.961、硬件留出0.939、时间留出0.960、家族留出0.707（家族留出显示泛化差距，但不确定性信号正确将陌生家族样本路由至ESCALATE）；反事实分析显示100%标签翻转成功率，平均‖Δz‖₂=3.27，证明语义与行为反事实方向近似正交，形成超加性对抗成本C²_fus ≳ C²_sem + C²_beh；对抗行为规避（慢加密、内存掩蔽）在α=1.0时检测率从0.879降至0.817和0.847，但升级率自适应上升（0.088→0.102），不确定性信号正确识别被扰动样本；GPU实测全流水线延迟约3.7ms（≈270样本/秒），行为CNN仅含8,385参数（32.8 KB），适合端点部署。

Conclusion: Agentic SABRE不仅是一个更高精度的检测器，更是一个不确定性感知、可解释推理与自适应分诊三者结合的代理式网络防御系统。语义与行为特征空间存在显著的不对称分布（语义Wasserstein距离远大于行为），框架通过双阈值分诊策略将不确定性从描述性诊断提升为操作性控制信号，在高置信区间自主防御、在模糊条件下升级人工，建立了自动化与人类监督之间的灵活计算契约；模块化设计允许策略级更新与Agent独立重训，为动态勒索软件威胁下的持续架构演进提供了基础，但当前工作受限于融合层的条件独立性假设、Monte Carlo Dropout在非平稳分布下可能低估不确定性、轴对齐阈值的边界脆弱性、以及缺乏2021年后现代勒索软件家族的覆盖评估等。

Abstract: Ransomware has evolved into a complex, adaptive, and fast-moving adversary category in which static signatures and monolithic classifiers fail to generalise under concept drift, evasion, and behavioural polymorphism. In this paper, we present Agentic SABRE (Semantic-Behavioural Arbitration for Ransomware Evaluation), an uncertainty-aware, neuro-symbolic, multi-agent framework for adaptive ransomware detection. SABRE fuses semantic, representation-based evidence with behavioural, time-window forensic telemetry and employs Monte Carlo Dropout inference to quantify epistemic uncertainty for each agent. We introduce a decision-layer orchestrator that performs risk- and uncertainty-aware triage using two interpretable thresholds: a risk score and an uncertainty budget. High-confidence, high-risk samples are automatically contained, while uncertain or borderline cases are escalated to human analysts, establishing a flexible computational contract between autonomous response and analyst oversight. To support auditability and trust, SABRE integrates post-hoc explainability mechanisms, including gradient saliency, permutation importance, and counterfactual analysis, enabling both local and global interpretation of agent decisions. Extensive evaluation on RDset and RanSMAP demonstrates that Agentic SABRE preserves perfect discrimination on saturated semantic datasets, with AUC equal to 1.0, while improving robustness under weak behavioural signals. It achieves up to a 4.9 percent relative reduction in false escalations at equal recall while maintaining calibrated predictive uncertainty. Counterfactual analysis further shows that semantic and behavioural decisions can be reversed with bounded perturbation cost, indicating stable and interpretable decision boundaries.

</details>


### [617] [HAS-Bench: Evaluating LLM-Based Human-Agent Systems under Configurable Human Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04329)
*Yaozu Wu,Wei-Chieh Huang,Jizhou Guo,Dongyuan Li,Renhe Jiang,Henry Peng Zou,Chunyu Miao,Shanghao Li,Weizhi Zhang,WeiWei Ye,Yankai Chen,Meng Zhang,Xue Liu,Philip S.Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HAS-Framework（基于图的框架）将人类和LLM智能体视为同等参与者，并构建HAS-Bench基准，用于在可配置人类参与下评估人-智能体系统在任务结果和协作过程行为上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估多将人类视为被动任务提供者，忽视了人类作为主动协作者的角色。需要系统性地建模和评估人-智能体协作中人类参与的时机、方式和角色对系统性能的影响。

Method: 1. HAS-Framework：基于图的框架，将人类和LLM智能体建模为一类参与者（first-class participants），显式定义其角色、权限、通信路径和行动权限。2. HAS-Bench基准：在六个领域中，通过可配置的人类参与（包括agency levels、交互渠道和persona policies）评估人-智能体系统。3. 评估指标涵盖任务结果与过程级协作行为，包括clarification quality、feedback utilization、control calibration、safety、initiative和interaction cost。

Result: 跨六个领域的实验表明，人类参与可显著提升任务完成率和失败恢复能力，但收益取决于人类输入的介入时机、方式以及参与者的身份/角色。

Conclusion: 人类参与对人-智能体系统性能有重要影响，但并非简单正相关；需要通过HAS-Framework和HAS-Bench等工具系统性地设计、配置和评估人类协作模式，以实现最佳的人机协作效果。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate in settings where humans are active collaborators rather than passive task providers. We introduce HAS-Framework, a graph-based framework that represents humans and LLM-powered agents as first-class participants with explicit roles, permissions, communication paths, and action authority. Building on this framework, HAS-Bench evaluates Human-Agent Systems under configurable human participation across agency levels, interaction channels, and persona policies. The benchmark measures both task outcomes and process-level collaboration behavior, including clarification quality, feedback utilization, control calibration, safety, initiative, and interaction cost. Experiments across six domains show that human participation can substantially improve task completion and failure recovery, but the gains depend on when, how, and by whom human input is exercised.

</details>


### [618] [Do GUI Agents Believe Their Eyes? Diagnosing State-Belief Reliance on Pixels versus Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04334)
*Guijia Zhang,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"视觉状态依赖"(visual state reliance)概念及核心指标"感知-融合差距"(Perception-Fusion Gap, pfg),通过310个真实网页/移动/桌面探针上的配对单通道干预,诊断多模态GUI代理的状态信念究竟来源于像素、结构还是先验。研究发现:文本状态信念在像素感知正确时仍会服从冲突的序列化结构(所有5个模型pfg均为正),而非文本身份(如图标)则基本保持像素绑定;白盒嵌入消融表明文本冲突由被复制的单个结构值因果驱动;该错误会传播到真实动作,导致AndroidWorld与MiniWoB++中任务失败;坐标动作的专用GUI代理对此免疫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI代理基准评估任务完成率、元素定位或攻击抵抗力,但无法回答一个根本问题:代理关于界面当前状态的信念是否真的来自像素,而不是直接从DOM/可访问性树复制的字符串。当结构与渲染不一致(结构过时、渲染滞后、本地化差异)时,基于结构而非像素的信念会在真实部署中无声地失败。论文动机在于将"信念来源"从"感知能力"中分离出来,提供可测量的诊断。

Method: 1)形式化:将状态信念建模为ŷ=g(P,S),引入视觉状态依赖概念;2)基准构建:从Multimodal-Mind2Web、RICO+CLAY、ScreenSpot-Pro构建310个真实探针,所有冲突由确定性规则编辑或天然存在,采用二元强制选择评分,无LLM评判员,双标注员审核(κ=0.83);3)配对干预:每次仅修改一个通道(像素、结构、两者皆无),共8种条件;4)指标:pfg = 在像素感知正确的子集中融合后转向结构答案的比例,辅以pfr/sfr/vor/ppd等;5)实验:5个模型(Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B、gpt-5.4、gpt-4o、gpt-5.4-nano)、3个GUI专家(UGround、Aguvis、OS-Atlas);6)白盒因果消融:将冲突值token的输入嵌入置零并重新解码;7)反事实族:对结构正确但像素模糊的探针验证评分非伪;8)行动级评估:在AndroidWorld与MiniWoB++中执行真实点击;9)无训练一致性门:对候选元素裁剪区域二次核查像素与文本是否一致。

Result: 1)文本冲突下pfg对所有5个模型均为正(Qwen-7B 0.30、Intern-8B 0.75、gpt-5.4 0.51、gpt-4o 0.69、gpt-5.4-nano 0.57),尽管Acc_img维持在0.86–0.93;2)非文本移动控件身份保持像素绑定(pfr 0.80–0.98),仅最小模型nano崩塌到结构;3)白盒消融:删去冲突值token使63%文本冲突信念翻转回像素,随机消融仅3%;4)真实行动失败:AndroidWorld中点击错误率达91–98%,MiniWoB++中95–100%,36个审计探针中25个到达错误页面,奖励由+0.85降至-0.58至-0.85;5)坐标动作专家(UGround、Aguvis)结构跟随仅0.02–0.07,OS-Atlas(索引动作)高达0.96–0.97;6)同一模型切换动作格式即可重现结构跟随(坐标0.11、元素id 0.64、索引0.90、文本标签0.98);7)无训练门减少24–44点行动错误,陈旧节点跟随降至0.07以下;8)人类基线sfr仅0.03(模型0.30–0.79),验证问题清晰。

Conclusion: 视觉状态依赖作为一个可测量的诊断,揭示了多模态GUI代理的一个普遍失败模式:即便像素感知近乎完美,文本状态信念仍会被冲突的序列化结构所劫持,且该错误会沿行动级联导致真实任务失败。该效应在三个供应商五个模型上一致出现,由单一被复制的结构值在白盒上因果驱动。结构跟随与像素跟随的权衡取决于动作输出通道——坐标动作免疫但对结构-only威胁无防御;索引动作易于劫持。无训练一致性门可大幅缓解但仍非完备防御。结论强调未来GUI代理不仅应跟踪其预测的状态,还应跟踪支持该状态的观察通道来源。

Abstract: Multimodal GUI agents read an interface through two redundant channels: the rendered pixels of a screenshot and a serialized structure such as a DOM or accessibility tree. Before acting, an agent forms a belief about the current interface state, but existing benchmarks score task success, element grounding, or attack resistance and do not ask whether that belief is drawn from the pixels. We formalize visual state reliance, the attribution of a state belief to pixels, structure, or priors, and measure it with paired single-channel interventions over 310 real web, mobile, and desktop probes. Every probe is scored by deterministic forced choice, with no model-generated item and no model judge. Our central metric is the Perception-Fusion Gap, the fraction of probes a model perceives correctly yet resolves toward structure under conflict. Across five models from three vendors, textual state beliefs defer to structure while image-only accuracy stays near ceiling, and Perception-Fusion Gap is positive for every model; non-text identity, by contrast, stays largely pixel-bound. The substitution is specific to the serialized-text and indexed-action channel, and coordinate-action agents are largely immune. For textual conflicts, a white-box ablation traces the effect to a single copied structural value, and in two live environments the conflict drives wrong actions and real task failure. Visual state reliance therefore gives a measurable diagnostic of whether agent state beliefs are visually grounded, and the errors it exposes propagate to actions.

</details>


### [619] [Server-side Anti-cheat in FPS games for Aimbot detection using Deep learning and Machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04336)
*Siddhesh A. Dhinge,Shubham G. Sukum,Harsh S. Ranjane,Ruturajsingh R. Rajput,Jyoti H. Jadhav*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"YAACS"的服务端FPS游戏自瞄外挂检测系统，基于Stacked LSTM与Dense层构建时间序列分类器，在CS:GO游戏中以88.6%的准确率和仅0.97%的误报率（比决策树基线的2.68%低2.76倍）有效识别自瞄外挂玩家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着FPS游戏（如CS:GO、Valorant）日益流行，自瞄、透视等外挂行为破坏了游戏的公平性。现有客户端反作弊易被绕过，而服务器端反作弊面临如何在高准确率与低误报率之间取得平衡的挑战——误封正常玩家会带来严重的负面体验，因此误报率是反作弊系统最关键的指标。

Method: 系统架构包含解析器、深度学习模型和中间连接工具（ICU）。使用Python-demoparser从128 tick的demo文件中提取29个特征，分为alpha（输入模型的时序特征，如瞄准速度、ΔYaw/ΔPitch、距离、是否开火等）和beta（用于报告的元数据）。构建6种不同时间窗口的数据集（Tick Delta Negative/Positive及Max Fight Size变化），训练9种LSTM变体（Single/Stacked/Stacked+Dense，各3种单元数：32/64/128），并以决策树作为基线对比。训练20个epoch，使用GPU加速。

Result: 最佳配置为Stacked LSTM + Dense层（Model 1）配合Dataset 1（窗口=128 ticks），达到88.6%准确率、95.8%精确率、0.97%误报率。决策树基线虽准确率更高（96.2%）、召回率更高（92.6%），但误报率为2.68%。实验发现：时间窗口越大，误报率越低（呈单调关系）；LSTM单元数从32增至128提升微乎其微（仅0.1%）；当窗口缩小至1 tick时所有LSTM模型完全崩溃（退化为多数类预测），证明时序上下文是分类的决定性信号。

Conclusion: 研究证明基于深度学习的序列模型在FPS自瞄检测中显著优于传统单次分类方法，时序上下文是降低误报率的关键因素。尽管决策树召回率更高，但其高误报率不适合反作弊生产环境。未来工作可探索Transformer等注意力机制模型，或采用两阶段集成策略（先用决策树高召回率筛选可疑玩家，再用LSTM低误报率过滤），以兼顾检测率与误报率。

Abstract: Modern video games are becoming more complex day by day. Most of these modern games are multiplayer first-person shooter (FPS) games. The rising popularity of FPS games emphasizes the need to combat cheating for fair and enjoyable gaming. As the number of players using cheating techniques like aimbots, wallhacks, and speed hacks is also increasing, we need a way to detect players who are using cheating tools to gain an unfair advantage over regular players. In this system, we focus exclusively on detecting aimbot cheats. Players who use aimbot cheats generally do not prioritize other aspects of the game. To distinguish between regular and cheating players, we identify specific features encompassing time-series data such as aim velocity, number of shots, distance to target, and more, along with behavioral data such as utility usage, player movement, and other gameplay patterns. Utilizing these features, we construct a server-side aimbot detection classifier named 'YAACS'. YAACS comprises a parser, a deep learning model, and intermediary connection utilities designed for integration with the game server. The proposed system achieves a classification accuracy of 88.6% with a false positive rate of 0.97% using a Stacked LSTM with Dense layers trained on sequences of 128 ticks (Tick Delta Negative=56, Tick Delta Positive=24), outperforming the Decision Tree baseline which achieves a higher accuracy of 96.2% but at a false positive rate of 2.68%, 2.76x worse than the best LSTM configuration. These results demonstrate that incorporating temporal context through sequence modelling is critical for minimising false accusations in FPS cheat detection.

</details>


### [620] [Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04371)
*Akhiad Bercovich,Talor Abramovich,Daniel Afrimi,Shay Aharon,Nir Ailon,Vladimir Anisimov,Omer Ullman Argov,Maor Ashkenazi,Tomer Asida,Nave Assaf,Tomer Bar Natan,Alexander Bukharin,Grzegorz Chlebus,Marcin Chochowski,Eric Chung,Mohammad Dabbah,Carlo del Mundo,Ewa Dobrowolska,Ido Galil,Yaniv Galron,Amnon Geifman,Yonatan Geifman,Izik Golan,Alex Gronskiy,Tomasz Grzegorzek,Netanel Haber,Lior Kadoch,Grzegorz Karch,Tomer Keren,Abhinav Khattar,Amir Klein,Tugrul Konuk,Roi Koren,Daniel Korzekwa,Shaun Kotek,Konstantinos Krommydas,Itay Levy,Ofri Masad,Yoav Miron,Pavlo Molchanov,Shahar Mor,Zach Moshe,Saurav Muralidharan,Najeeb Nabwani,Besmira Nushi,Mostofa Patwary,Omri Puny,Johannes Rausch,Tomer Ronen,Sepehr Sameni,Itamar Schen,Elad Segal,Daniel Serebrenik,Ido Shahaf,Soumye Singhal,Daniil Sorokin,Sharath Turuvekere Sreenivas,Marta Stepniewska-Dziubinska,Ali Taghibakhshi,Nima Tajbakhsh,Oren Tropp,Dor Tzur,Anna Warno,Yi-Fu Wu,Michal Zawalski,Jiaqi Zeng,Yian Zhang,Ran Zilberstein,Amit Zuker,Ran El-Yaniv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B，一种针对混合 MoE 架构（Transformer + Mamba + MoE）的大型语言模型部署优化压缩方法。通过迭代 Puzzle NAS 框架联合剪枝 MoE 专家中间通道、top-k 与 Mamba SSM 状态，并结合知识蒸馏、强化学习、量化与多令牌预测，在将总参数量从 120.7B 压缩至 75.3B（活跃参数从 12.8B 降至 9.3B）的同时，在 8×B200 节点上实现约 2× 服务端吞吐提升，并在单卡 H100 上将 1M 上下文并发从 1 提升至 8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿大模型参数与架构复杂度持续增长，带来推理成本、显存占用、延迟与部署灵活性的多重挑战。混合 MoE 架构的瓶颈具有场景依赖性：长输入请求受计算限制，长输出请求受 IO 限制，超长上下文请求受 KV cache 与 Mamba state 显存限制。不同部署场景需要不同的优化策略，亟需一种兼顾异构架构、硬件感知且能保留能力的通用压缩方法。

Method: 两阶段流水线：1）结构压缩——提出 Iterative Puzzle，将 Puzzle NAS（Bercovich et al., 2025）扩展为多轮迭代，每轮在当前子模型上重新打分并求解混合整数规划（MIP），交替进行 MoE 中间通道异构剪枝、top-k 异构削减（teacher k=22 降至 4–18）和 Mamba SSM 状态（128→96）剪枝，每轮后用短 KD 恢复；三阶段分别将 MoE 权重降至 75%、60% 和 top-k 预算 50%；2）能力恢复——在 32K 短上下文与 128K/512K 长上下文上对教师 logits 做大规模 KD（最高 100B tokens），随后针对软件工程任务做 RL（SWE 1/SWE 2），并对多个学习率 run 做权重平均。部署侧使用面向 Blackwell 的 NVFP4 与 Hopper 的 FP8 量化，并继承 Super 的共享头 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）并通过继续训练缓解 teacher-forcing 与自回归推测解码之间的分布失配，平均接受长度提升 25%–30%。

Result: 在 8×B200 NVFP4 单步解码下，Puzzle-75B-A9B 在 50K/2K 与 8K/64K 两个交互式场景、UT ≥ 100/125/150 tok/s 三个工作点均取得 1.6×–2.14× 服务端吞吐提升；在单卡 H100 上 1M-token 并发请求数从 1 提升至 8，聚合 decode 吞吐约 4×；准确率平均仅比 Super 低约 1 个百分点（MMLU-Pro 82.2 vs 83.5，AIME25 89.9 vs 89.9，RULER-1M 93.2 vs 93.8，Arena-Hard-V2 69.0 vs 72.6 等），NVFP4 与 BF16 精度差距很小；MTP 最佳 draft length=3 时吞吐达 4.63× Super，相对请求完成率 4.91×；消融显示三阶段 Iterative Puzzle 比单步 Puzzle 在平均分上提升 +0.57；解耦 prefill 剪枝变体（FastPuzzleV1/V2）可在保 79.9 公共均分下提升 50K/1K prefill 吞吐 5–7%。

Conclusion: 证明大型混合 MoE 模型（Transformer + Mamba + MoE）可经由迭代、硬件感知的结构压缩，在大幅削减总参数与活跃参数的同时保持强下游能力并显著提升部署效率；Iterative Puzzle 在多轮重新打分与恢复下优于单次 NAS 求解；NVFP4/FP8 量化与共享头 MTP 的组合进一步放大了吞吐收益。未来工作将探索更激进的压缩比率、更多 RL 环境以及逐层异构 SSM 通道剪枝。

Abstract: We present Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B, a compressed variant of Nemotron-3-Super optimized for interactive deployment. We designed the model to maximize server throughput under high user throughput constraints. In interactive serving workloads on a single 8xB200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B achieves approximately 2x higher server throughput than Nemotron-3-Super at matched user throughput constraints. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model increases 1M-token concurrency from 1 request to 8 requests. Puzzle-75B-A9B is constructed using a multi-stage pipeline that combines the Iterative Puzzle compression framework with knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, quantization, and a Multi-Token Prediction head. The compression process jointly optimizes heterogeneous MoE pruning, active parameter budget, and Mamba pruning to improve inference efficiency while preserving model quality. We evaluate Puzzle-75B-A9B on a broad suite of reasoning, coding, multilingual, long-context, and agentic benchmarks. Despite substantial compression, the model retains strong downstream accuracy relative to the parent model across a wide range of tasks. These results demonstrate that large hybrid MoE models can be substantially optimized for deployment efficiency while maintaining strong downstream capability.

</details>


### [621] [Decentralized Aggregation of LLM Predictions via Wagering Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04389)
*Yuhong Luo,David M. Pennock,Xintong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WALLA（Advantage-Aligned Wagering Mechanisms for LLM Aggregation），一种用于去中心化聚合多个LLM预测的博弈论机制。每个LLM报告预测和赌注，机制通过leave-one-out基准计算净支付，使最佳响应赌注与模型预期得分优势成正比，从而同时实现预测的占优策略激励兼容、优势-赌注对齐和与预测解耦的赌注优化学习。实验在QA和预测基准上表明，WALLA在预测性能上匹配集中式聚合方法，同时实现去中心化学习、优势对齐的聚合权重、不确定性感知和激励兼容的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多LLM预测聚合场景中，集中式方法可访问模型隐藏表示来学习聚合权重，但去中心化部署时模型的私有信号不可用。现有去中心化方法使用固定权重或基于置信度/困惑度的启发式权重，这些权重在模型校准不准时不可靠，且可被策略性地夸大以获取更大影响力或奖励。因此需要设计去中心化机制，使聚合权重与模型对聚合预测的预期贡献对齐，并能抵抗策略性报告。

Method: 核心方法是在传统加权分数投注机制（WSWM）的净支付函数中引入leave-one-out基准，引入二次正则化项c₃wᵢ²。理论证明：(1) 真实预测是任意信念结构下的占优策略（DSIC），不受对手策略影响；(2) 最佳响应赌注w*ᵢ=(Aᵢ/2c₃)⁺与模型预期得分优势Aᵢ成正比；(3) 赌注优化与预测解耦，可独立学习。提出两种变体：WALLA I（加权分数基准，满足normality但有套利）和WALLA II（加权预测基准，满足no-arbitrage但违反normality），最坏情况赤字有界。学习阶段，每个LLM冻结基础模型，仅训练一个两层MLP投注网络，从最后一层隐藏状态映射到非负赌注，最小化净支付的负值，通过hindsight最优赌注作为目标进行回归。

Result: 在四种LLM（Gemma2-9B、Llama3.1-8B、Llama3-Aloe-8B、BioMistral-7B）和五个数据集（PubMedQA、MedMCQA、MMLU、ARC-Challenge、BayesX合成预测数据集）上的实验表明，WALLA在预测性能（AUC、ACC、KLD）上与集中式基线（StackedGen、RouteLLM）相当，同时是唯一同时实现加权聚合、不确定性感知、完全去中心化学习和激励兼容保证的方法。三种场景（同类模型私有上下文、异类模型无上下文、异类模型私有上下文）下，WALLA赌注与实现得分优势呈正相关（Pearson相关性证实）。校准后性能进一步提升，证实机制激励参与者校准预测。WALLA在M∈{4,8,12}模型规模下保持鲁棒，而学习无关方法（UniformAvg等）随规模增大性能下降。

Conclusion: WALLA是首个同时实现优势加权聚合、不确定性感知、完全去中心化学习和激励兼容保证的LLM预测聚合机制。理论上解决了WSWM的两个局限：依赖不变信念假设和产生二元边界赌注。实验上达到与集中式基线匹配的预测性能。未来工作方向包括探索上下文学习能力用于专有LLM的赌注估计，以及将机制扩展到多步推理等更复杂协作场景。

Abstract: It is increasingly common to aggregate predictions from multiple LLMs, each with domain expertise or access to private tools and data, to improve collective prediction performance. In decentralized settings, aggregation weights need to be determined without access to models' private information and should remain robust to strategic reporting. We propose a family of advantage-aligned wagering mechanisms for LLM aggregation (WALLA), in which each model reports a prediction and a learned wager, and predictions are aggregated using wagers as weights. WALLA introduces a leave-one-out baseline into the net payout function, yielding three desirable properties: (1) dominant-strategy incentive compatibility of prediction under arbitrary belief structure, (2) advantage--wager alignment, where the optimal wager is proportional to the model's expected score advantage, and (3) prediction-agnostic wager optimization, enabling decentralized learning of wager policies without requiring optimal predictions. We further instantiate two mechanism variants that trade off normality and no-arbitrage while maintaining a bounded worst-case deficit for the mechanism. Experiments on question-answering and forecasting benchmarks across heterogeneous models and private-information settings show that WALLA matches centralized aggregation methods in predictive performance, while simultaneously achieving decentralized learning, advantage-aligned aggregation weights, uncertainty awareness, and incentive-compatible prediction.

</details>


### [622] [MechMath Agent Team: LLM Driven Agents for Mathematical Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04394)
*Yichuan Cao,Ruichen Qiu,Junqi Liu,Jiaqi Wang,Dakai Guo,Ruyong Feng,Lihong Zhi,Xiao-Shan Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 MechMath Agent Team (MMAT)，一种基于大语言模型的多智能体数学研究系统。该系统采用三段式 Harness 架构（控制平面、执行平面、增强平面），集成了知识库管理器（KB-Manager）、自然语言证明器（NL-Prover）和基于 Lean 4 的形式语言证明器（FL-Prover），在两个月内部署中解决了数论、代数复杂性理论、微分代数、算子代数和不等式等多个领域的 11 个开放问题，其中 9 篇论文已上传 arXiv。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学研究具有非线性推导路径、严格的逻辑要求和漫长的探索周期等特征，对现有推理系统构成严峻挑战。传统的线性多智能体流水线因工作流僵化和错误传播问题，难以胜任数学研究任务。需要一种能够协调严谨逻辑控制与开放式研究灵活性、贯穿完整数学研究周期的新型智能体架构。

Method: MMAT 采用三段式 Harness 架构将系统职责解耦：(1) 控制平面：基于 DAG 的全局执行图与局部任务账本，由集中式 Orchestrator 驱动动态调度与错误恢复；(2) 执行平面：通过隔离工作区（沙盒目录）和基于文件交接（避免对话历史膨胀）实现物理和信息边界的解耦；(3) 增强平面：通过人机协同推理（提供交互断点与可读进度笔记）和分层持续记忆（提炼负面约束作为行为边界）突破自主模型的认知瓶颈。在此基础上实例化三个专业智能体：KB-Manager 管理面向对象的卡片式记忆图（含 Source、Concept、Analysis、Lean、PartialProof、Obstruction 六类卡片），NL-Prover 包含 12 个子智能体（Sketcher、Generator、Verifier、Explorer、CE-Hunter 等），FL-Prover 利用 Lean 4 编译器进行确定性验证。三者通过 Inform、Formalize、Feedback、Archive 四个原语形成闭环协作。

Result: 在两个月的实际部署中，MMAT 解决了 11 个数学开放问题并提交了 9 篇 arXiv 论文，包括：(1) Katz 关于广义 Airy 算子等价性的问题；(2) Plaisted 提出的稀疏多项式整除测试复杂性挑战（证明在有限域上 coNP-难）；(3) Davenport 等提出的输出敏感 GCD 计算复杂性挑战（证明有限域上 NP-难）；(4) Roche 关于稀疏多项式乘法拟线性时间的问题；(5) Erdős–Rényi 猜想的多变量推广；(6) Vasc 循环不等式 n=9 的正实数情形（验证全部 40320 个锥体）。系统还自动审计了 Giorgi 等人(2020)的概率分析，发现引理 4.7(ii)的逻辑缺陷，并通过 N=10²⁰ 规模的反例予以证伪，进而在 Lean 4 中形式化验证了重建证明。

Conclusion: MMAT 验证了结构化多智能体协作结合形式化验证与人机协同推理能够有效加速数学发现。该系统不仅能完成单个问题的完整自然语言到形式化证明流水线、审计现有证明的逻辑缺陷、整合人类反馈，还能从一个成功问题出发，引导对整个数学领域（如稀疏多项式计算）的系统性探索，体现了其作为贯穿数学研究全周期的"副驾驶"的潜力。这种将确定性状态管理与形式化验证工具链与 LLM 认知灵活性相结合的设计，为 AI 辅助数学研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: AI reasoning has become a central focus in contemporary artificial intelligence, largely driven by the success of large language models. However, mathematical research, which is characterized by non-linear derivation paths, rigorous logical requirements, and protracted exploration cycles, poses severe challenges for existing reasoning systems. To overcome these limitations, we present the MechMath Agent Team (MMAT), which is a large language model driven agent designed to serve as a co-pilot throughout the full cycle of mathematical research. We design a tripartite Harness Architecture that decouples system responsibilities into Control, Execution, and Augmentation planes, thereby reconciling rigorous logical control with the agility demanded by open-ended research. Building upon this framework, we instantiate three specialized agents: a Knowledge Base Manager, a Natural Language Prover, and a Formal Language Prover, all operating in a closed loop to produce formally certified mathematical proofs. We evaluate MMAT on open problems in Number Theory, Algebraic Complexity Theory, Differential Algebra, Operator Algebra, and Inequalities. Across a two-month deployment, 11 problems have been solved, demonstrating its capacity to act as a co-pilot throughout the entire research cycle. The contributions are threefold: a general decoupled Harness Architecture for multi-agent mathematical reasoning, its concrete instantiation in the MMAT system, and empirical validation on a diverse suite of open problems.

</details>


### [623] [LLM-as-a-Tutor: Policy-Aware Prompt Adaptation for Non-Verifiable RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04412)
*Yujin Kim,Namgyu Ho,Sangmin Hwang,Joonkee Kim,Yongjin Yang,Sangmin Bae,Seungone Kim,Jaehun Jung,Se-Young Yun,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-as-a-Tutor 框架，将 LLM 从评判者扩展为导师角色，通过检测非挑战性提示并附加原子约束来动态调整训练提示难度，从而在不可验证指令跟随任务中实现自校准的强化学习信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于 LLM 评判的强化学习中，现有方法虽然会针对策略动态调整评分标准（rubrics），但训练提示本身仍来自固定语料库且保持静态。这种静态提示策略与不断演化的策略能力之间存在关键错配：当提示无法在多次 rollout 中引发质量差异时，评判者无法恢复具有区分度的奖励信号，导致训练效率下降。

Method: 提出 LLM-as-a-Tutor 框架，让单一 LLM 同时承担两种角色：(1) 审查者（examiner）—— 通过成对比较策略 rollout 检测非挑战性提示；(2) 生成器（generator）—— 向这些提示附加原子约束（atomic constraints）。该"仅追加"设计能够随策略能力单调提升提示难度，无需依赖外部难度调度计划，从而产生自校准的训练信号。

Result: 在三个复杂的指令跟随基准测试上，该方法持续优于：(1) 策略无关的基线方法；(2) 此前通过调整评分标准或重写提示来适应策略的策略自适应方法。

Conclusion: 研究表明提示自适应（prompt adaptation）是不可验证 RL 中策略感知性（policy-awareness）的一个重要但被忽视的维度，与评分标准自适应相结合可显著提升训练效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for non-verifiable instruction following increasingly relies on LLM judges with prompt-specific rubrics as reward signals. While recent methods adapt these rubrics to the evolving policy during training, the training prompts themselves remain static, drawn from fixed corpora. This static approach often results in a critical misalignment between prompt difficulty and policy capability, leaving the judge unable to recover a discriminative reward signal when prompts fail to elicit quality variance among rollouts. To address this misalignment, we introduce LLM-as-a-Tutor, a framework that extends the LLM's role from judge to tutor: a single model serves as an examiner that pairwise-compares policy rollouts to detect non-challenging prompts, and as a generator that appends atomic constraints to them. This append-only design monotonically raises difficulty in step with the policy's capability, producing a self-calibrating training signal without external difficulty schedules. On three complex instruction-following benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms both policy-unaware baselines and prior policy-adaptive methods that adapt rubrics or rewrite prompts, suggesting prompt adaptation as a missing axis of policy-awareness in non-verifiable RL.

</details>


### [624] [Agent Step Value: State-Transition Measurement with State-Grounded LLM Evaluators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04419)
*Andrew Zhang,Chengzhan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent Step Value (ASV) 框架，通过状态接地（state-grounded）的 LLM 评估器对智能体每一步状态转移产生的候选答案分布变化进行测量，从而定位轨迹中真正改变评估器信念的关键动作，而非仅依赖最终答案或轨迹级分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估方法通常将多步轨迹压缩为最终答案、成功标志或轨迹级分数，掩盖了关键诊断问题：哪个动作使状态朝有用方向改变？作者希望提供一种 transition-level（转移级别）的诊断工具，以定位建设性或破坏性的信念转折点。

Method: 1) 形式化问题：将轨迹表示为有序转移序列 (x_{i-1}, a_i, x_i)，定义固定候选集 C；2) 状态评分协议：包含两阶段——先由评估器生成标签无关（label-free）的精简理由缓冲区 r_x，禁止物理选项标签、金标等泄漏；再追加物理标签映射，调用单 token 的 log-probability 评分；3) 步骤指标：报告无金标诊断（熵变化 ΔH、贝叶斯惊讶度 S_i、JS 枢轴分数 J_i）以及离线金标验证指标（金标边际增益 G_margin、金标对数似然增益 G_logp）；4) 候选集设计：每题含 3 个具体答案 + 1 个"以上皆非"候选，支持标签置换审计 A_channel。

Result: 在 100 道开放域问答任务（1,100 步、2,200 状态，使用 PubMed 实时检索和 DeepSeek 评估器）的固定布局理性条件下协议下：平均金标边际增益为 -2.335（轨迹自助法 95% CI [-3.395, -1.272]），熵变化为 0.000，平均贝叶斯惊讶度为 2.693（最大 15.194）。所有步熵变化均为零，但贝叶斯惊讶度揭示大量近 one-hot 信念翻转；移除底分步或金标泄漏轨迹后结论稳健。分步类型分析显示 extract、audit、validate-plan、retrieve 步骤平均最负，post-audit 与 finalize 步骤略正。

Conclusion: ASV 成功将智能体评估重构为状态转移测量，在近 one-hot 评估器机制下展示出熵指标失效而贝叶斯惊讶度与金标边际增益可定位建设性/破坏性枢轴；负均值反映特定被测协议下的状态，而非对智能体的整体定性；作者发布独立 ASV Eval 工具包支持重实现与新评估，但警告评估器固有偏差与候选构建对结果的潜在扭曲风险。

Abstract: Most agent evaluations collapse a multi-step trace into a final answer, a success flag, or a trajectory-level score. These aggregates obscure the diagnostic question developers need most: which action changed the state in a useful direction? We introduce Agent Step Value (ASV), a state-transition measurement framework that scores each observed action by the change it induces in a state-grounded evaluator's distribution over fixed candidate outcomes. ASV renders redacted before/after state projections, uses a stateless LLM evaluator to assign candidate log scores, and reports both gold-free belief diagnostics and offline oracle validation metrics. A label-free rationale pass separates evaluator deliberation from one-token option scoring, preserving candidate likelihoods while exposing leakage and floor-score events. On 100 reviewed open-QA evidence-seeking tasks with live PubMed retrieval, a partially live DeepSeek actor, and DeepSeek log-probability scoring, ASV evaluates 1,100 steps and 2,200 states. Under the fixed-layout rationale-conditioned protocol, mean gold-margin gain is -2.335 (trajectory-bootstrap 95\% CI [-3.395, -1.272]), entropy movement is 0.000, and mean Bayesian surprise is 2.693. ASV therefore localizes constructive and destructive belief pivots that final-answer scores and entropy-only step metrics miss. We release the standalone ASV Eval toolkit.

</details>


### [625] [ResearchStudio-Idea: An Evidence-Grounded Research-Ideation Skill Suite from ML Conference Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04439)
*Qihao Zhao,Yangyu Huang,Yalun Dai,Lingao Xiao,Jianjun Gao,Xin Zhang,Wenshan Wu,Scarlett Li,Yang He,Yan Lu,Yap Kim Hui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ResearchStudio-Idea 是一个面向机器学习研究"第一英里"（前期构思）的可复用技能套件，基于对 1,947 篇 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 2021–2025 论文（含 Oral、高引、拒稿）的实证挖掘，归纳出 15 个可操作的"构思模式"（ideation patterns），并以 IdeaSpark 这一端到端技能将文献检索、瓶颈诊断、模式引导生成、碰撞检测与审计整合为可审计的研究提案生成流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 科研构思系统存在缺失层：如何在"成果数据"与"想法生成"之间建立可操作的桥梁。研究者面临如何将检索到的文献证据转化为可识别的瓶颈、如何从既有策略空间中选择可辩护的策略组合、以及如何在投入实验前进行可审计的新颖性审查的难题。现有系统多停留在端到端工作流自动化、候选空间搜索或基于接受/拒稿信号的偏好学习，未将"会议成果"中的策略算子与失败信号同时打包为可推理时加载的技能资产。

Method: 方法包含四个阶段：(1) 对每篇论文进行两阶段"创新签名"提取——12 个结构化字段经由 Sonnet 4.6 抽取后，4 个策略字段再被改写为领域无关的命令式表达；(2) 用 OpenAI text-embedding-3-large 嵌入 1,891 篇论文后通过 UMAP+HDBSCAN 发现 31 个细粒度"子模式"聚类；(3) 由 Opus 4.7 归纳为 15 个高层"构思模式"（含定义、操作签名、适用条件），并对每张卡补充成功条件、失败模式、审稿人期望、认知壁垒与示例；(4) 实施独立的多标签模式分配（k=2 为众数），构建 IdeaSpark 两层技能架构：运行时层包含阶段提示、检索钩子与确定性验证器，证据层包含 15 张模式卡与子模式卡。运行时流程为 Phase 0 文献检索→Phase 1 瓶颈识别（方法谱系树）→Phase 2 模式引导生成（分模式选择与候选生成两步）→Phase 3 质量审视（四项检查+双层裁决）→Phase 4 扩展、可实施性审计与渲染，全程由确定性验证器（杀手机开关完整性、扩展完整性、子模式引用一致性）守护。

Result: 实证发现：(1) 15 个模式构成紧致而非琐碎的空间，902 篇 HDBSCAN 未聚类论文在多标签分析下完全被覆盖；(2) 拒稿论文重聚类后 13 个簇全部映射回 15 模式词汇，无离群策略类，拒稿价值在于对比式失败证据；(3) 多模式组合是常态，k=2 为众数，33.6% 论文执行 ≥3 个模式；(4) 接受偏置 Δ_OR 仅 ±2.9pp 较窄，但程序委员会与社区偏好的 Δ_OH 维度可达 ±13pp，二者近正交；(5) "刻画极限再超越"模式是跨领域最强接受信号。在 100 个 ICLR 2026 Oral 种子、3 轮盲测自动化评判下，IdeaSpark 以 3.87/4 的质量分数与 88/100 的胜率显著优于无技能基线（Opus-4.8 裸 2.56、GPT-5.5 裸 1.00）与通用技能基线（Opus-self-gen 2.57），新颖性（L3 主流）与"新颖-空洞"失败模式（GPT-5.5 高新颖但质量 1.00）形成对照；其在 21 个一级研究领域均居质量首位。

Conclusion: 会议成果中蕴含可重复使用的策略算子，被拒稿与被接收论文共享这些算子，其成功与失败条件可被打包为检索、生成与审查的实用技能；ResearchStudio-Idea 的 IdeaSpark 在自动化评判下证明可显著提升构思质量并保持竞争性新颖性，但声明严格限定在构思阶段，验证仍需人类审稿、实施结果与跨会议外部效度检验；该工作的核心贡献在于把"数据到技能"的非参数化模式卡与生成-审计共享同一对象，使前实验阶段的构思更结构化、循证且可审计。

Abstract: Large language models have made research ideation increasingly accessible, yet effective idea development requires more than generating candidate directions. Researchers must ground a problem in current literature, identify meaningful bottlenecks, differentiate from existing solutions, and evaluate risks before committing to implementation. We present ResearchStudio-Idea as a reusable skill suite for this first mile of research ideation. The suite includes Paper-Search, a standalone multi-source literature search skill; Scoop-Check, a standalone prior-art collision checker for novelty claims; and IdeaSpark, the end-to-end skill that composes evidence grounding, pattern-guided generation, collision retrieval, audit, and idea-card rendering into one workflow. IdeaSpark is constructed from a corpus of 1,947 machine learning conference papers collected from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS between 2021 and 2025, including Oral papers, a separately tracked high-citation subset, and rejected submissions. Analysis of these outcomes reveals 31 recurring ideation sub-patterns, consolidated into 15 reusable ideation patterns. Each pattern is operationalized as a structured card containing research contexts, bottleneck types, differentiation strategies, supporting precedents, and common failure modes. Given a research problem and an evidence bundle, IdeaSpark evaluates evidence readiness, reconstructs the surrounding research context, identifies unresolved bottlenecks, selects relevant patterns, instantiates one candidate direction, retrieves potentially conflicting prior work, and performs outcome-informed auditing. This workflow transforms reusable ideation patterns into traceable research proposals. Blind automated-judge evaluations show that IdeaSpark consistently produces stronger research proposals than no-skill and generic-skill baselines while maintaining competitive novelty.

</details>


### [626] [Why Pure Reasoning is Not Enough: Nature as the Source of Mathematical Innovation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04505)
*Charanjit S. Jutla,Vimal Sharma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个核心假说：由于形式系统面临不可判定性和计算难处理性的根本障碍，人类数学推理本质上依赖于来自纯演绎外部领域（尤其是自然界）的模式匹配。作者以傅里叶变换的历史发展为案例，论证每一个关键数学创新都由物理问题驱动而非纯逻辑演绎,并据此为当代大型语言模型的巨大规模提供了理论上的合理性辩护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯演绎推理系统面临两大根本性限制：哥德尔不完备性定理所揭示的不可判定性,以及即使是"可判定"的逻辑片段也具有令人望而却步的计算复杂性(如命题逻辑的NP完全性、QBF的PSPACE完全性、LTL/CTL的PSPACE/EXPTIME完全性,以及S1S/S2S的非初等决策过程)。鉴于这些障碍,纯逻辑"暴力搜索"无法作为发现新数学的现实可行策略。为理解人类数学创造力如何绕过这些障碍,作者从认知和历史的双重视角考察了数学创新的真实来源。
