Method: 论文采用历史案例分析与逻辑复杂性论证相结合的方法:(1)以傅里叶变换为线索的历史考察,涵盖1740年代弦振动争议(D'Alembert、Bernoulli、Euler、Lagrange之争)、1807年Fourier热方程工作,以及后续Dirichlet(1829)、Riemann(1854)、Cantor(1872)、Lebesgue(1902)、Schwartz(1950)等数学家对物理驱动的数学工具的形式化追赶;(2)对逻辑复杂性的层级综述,从命题逻辑的NP完全性到S1S/S2S的非初等决策过程;(3)通过反例分析(ZFC公理化集合论的失败模式、证明助手的本质、AI辅助定理证明如AlphaProof)来精炼和验证论点;(4)区分"词汇重组"与"词汇扩展"两种认知层次。

Result: 论文得出一个清晰可证伪的结论:纯演绎推理不是数学发现的引擎,而是发现后的"清查"工具。具体证据:(1)傅里叶级数、向量空间抽象、Dirac delta分布等关键创新均先在物理系统中被"观察到",后被数学形式化;(2)公理集合论的"反例"印证:切断物理根基的数学导致基础危机并与科学实践脱节;(3)对Kepler椭圆轨道、Lobachevsky双曲几何、非交换代数等所谓"抽象先于物理"的反例进行细致反驳,证明物理刺激始终在场;(4)当代LLM的巨大规模并非偶然,而是数学创造力对跨领域模式库的认知必要性的原则性体现。当前LLM的前沿在于"词汇重组"与"词汇扩展"之间的边界。

Conclusion: 论文的核心结论具有三重意义:(1)认识论层面,数学创新本质上是自然启发的模式匹配,纯逻辑只是其形式化工具;(2)人工智能层面,为LLM的巨大规模提供了非经验性的、原则性的理论辩护——系统必须嵌入海量跨领域模式库方能接近人类水平的数学创造力;(3)开放性问题层面,词汇扩展(如测度、无穷、分布等真正新原语的诞生)目前仍依赖于"自然的原始形态"这一外部神谕;是否能让人工系统获得这样的神谕访问,是未来研究的关键问题。该论文还承认使用DeepSeek和Opus Sonnet作为辅助写作工具。

Abstract: We advance the hypothesis that human mathematical reasoning, constrained by both the undecidability and the computational intractability of even modest logical fragments, relies fundamentally on pattern matching from domains external to pure deduction. The most prolific reservoir of such patterns is the natural world, whose physical laws and biological systems have undergone billions of years of ``pre-computation'' and already exhibit surprisingly innovative solutions. To ground this claim, we trace the history of the Fourier transform and relevant mathematics, from the vibrating string controversy to the hear equation and subsequent formalisms prevalent in mathematics. At each critical juncture, a physics problem forced the acceptance or creation of a mathematical tool that pure formal reasoning failed to anticipate or, worse, human reasoning had resisted. We further survey the landscape of logical complexity, from NP-hard propositional satisfiability to the non-elementary decision-procedures for monadic second-order theories, to demonstrate that even when a logic is decidable, the resources required for worst-case deduction are astronomically prohibitive. We argue that these barriers make physics-inspired pattern matching not just a historical accident but a cognitive necessity. Finally, we draw the consequence for artificial intelligence: if pure reasoning is constitutively insufficient, then any system aiming at human-level mathematical creativity must embed a vast store of cross-domain patterns rather than rely on deduction alone. This furnishes a principled justification for the enormous scale of contemporary large language models.

</details>


### [627] [Compressing the Validation Bottleneck: An Agentic Self-Driving Lab for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04508)
*Kyunghoon Hur,Chihun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对智能体自驱动实验室(SDL)中两个物理瓶颈——实验轮次过多和单轮成本过高——提出统一解决方案:在生物领域采用先验感知的智能体DOE(实验设计)循环,在材料领域采用成本感知的代理测量循环,旨在用单一智能体同时压缩循环次数和单次实验成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Agentic AI-for-Science已能自动化构思、规划、设计实验、写作等上游研究流程,但最终的实验验证仍依赖物理实验,是当前的速率瓶颈。SDL虽能自动执行实验,但仍面临两大瓶颈:(1)智能体在缺乏领域先验、实验反馈和可行性约束时,会在低价值实验上浪费过多轮次;(2)若每个候选都需高成本、高分辨率测量,循环将受限于测量吞吐量而非智能体的候选提案能力。

Method: 提出单一智能体框架同时攻克两个瓶颈。瓶颈1方面:先验感知的智能体DOE循环结合贝叶斯优化(BO)与LLM代理,智能体利用领域知识、文献先验和历史反馈提出可行且信息量大的候选区域,经可行性校验后排序执行,在抗体生物工艺优化场景中应用。瓶颈2方面:成本感知的代理智能体根据预测不确定性在低成本/低分辨率测量与高成本/高分辨率测量之间切换(预测区间控制);仅当代理不确定性低时才信任低成本测量,在金属增材制造(DED)场景中,采用硬度预测抗拉强度、用XRD+成分+CALPHAD预测相分数,替代耗时的SEM/EBSD测量。框架中将先验与反馈均路由至GP/神经代理(而非仅依赖LLM),通过可行性校验器把关。

Result: 论文为前瞻性框架论文(提案/构建中),未给出完整的实验结果。已规划的评价指标包括:瓶颈1的trials-to-target、不可行提案率、反馈敏感性(与人工DOE、随机搜索、网格搜索、vanilla BO对比);瓶颈2的代理精度、不确定性校准、每单位表征成本的目标命中数以及达到目标规格的挂钟时间。附录将本工作定位于LLM增强BO方法学谱系(LLAMBO、BO-ICL、LGBO、ChemBOMAS、Coscientist、ChemCrow等)中,强调区别于LGBO的单领域偏好局限以及Gupta等人揭示的LLM不敏感反馈问题。

Conclusion: 物理实验是智能体科学发现的速率限制器。本文聚焦SDL中两个仍浪费时间的环节——过多实验循环和高单轮成本,通过先验感知DOE减少轮次、通过成本感知代理减少单轮成本,目标是在预算内以更少实验更快达成目标规格,推动智能体科学发现突破物理验证瓶颈。

Abstract: Agentic AI-for-Science can automate ideation, planning, and analysis, but final validation still depends on real experiments. A self-driving lab (SDL) can execute those experiments, yet the loop still has bottlenecks: the agent may spend too many rounds on low-value experiments, or each round may require a high-cost experiment. We target these two physical bottlenecks with one agent. First, a prior-aware agentic DOE loop uses domain knowledge and past results to propose feasible and informative next experiments, reducing trials-to-target. Second, a cost-aware surrogate agent predicts high-cost, high-resolution measurements from low-cost, low-resolution measurements. It chooses between a high- and a low-cost measurement based on the predicted uncertainty. We examine these directions in the biology and materials domains, respectively. Together, under a single agent, these components aim to accelerate the SDL loop by reducing both the number of loops and the cost per experiment.

</details>


### [628] [VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04517)
*Damir Shodiev,Aleksei Staroverov,Nikita Kachaev,Alexey K. Kovalev,Aleksandr I. Panov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VLA Grounder 方法：将冻结 VLA 模型的适应性改进从动作权重空间转移至语言条件空间，通过强化学习（GRPO）优化上游的语言条件策略，使其将人类指令转化为视觉更对齐的"接地命令"，从而在不更新 VLA 自身权重的情况下提升下游任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型的行为高度依赖指令措辞，常出现指令与视觉接地不匹配导致的失败（如"put champagne glass on plate"失败而"the tall white glass"成功）。现有数据集指令模板化、多样性不足，导致语言通道未被充分利用。传统方法通过更新 VLA 权重或动作空间做 RL 适应，本文提出新视角：把语言本身作为可优化的条件输入变量，在不修改冻结 VLA 的前提下改善行为。

Method: 形式化为部分可观测 MDP 中"语言条件空间"上的 RL 问题：在 episode 初始由语言条件策略 q_φ 根据场景图像 o₀ 与人类指令 u 采样一个"接地命令" ũ∈𝒰(u)，然后用冻结 VLA π_VLA 在整个 rollout 中执行该命令。优化目标为最大化任务完成回报的期望 J(φ)。训练采用 GRPO：对每个训练实例采样 G 个候选命令，在冻结 VLA 下 rollout，按组内归一化优势更新 q_φ；VLA 权重始终冻结。采用由失败案例衍生的"命令空间先验"（command-space prior），引导探索朝物体外观、空间关系、目标接地等行为相关维度变化，避免仅表层改写导致的"语言混叠"问题。实现上使用 Qwen3.5-9B 作为引导 VLM，配合 LoRA（rank 32）微调，仅学习率 5e-6、1600 步训练。

Result: 在 VL-Think 与 RL4VLA 基准上，使用冻结的 π₀ 与 OpenVLA 骨干进行评估。VL-Think 任务上 π₀ 平均成功率从 12.6% 提升至 38.7%（最高任务从 4.2% 提升至 41.7%），OpenVLA 从 38.7% 提升至 63.9%；RL4VLA MultiPlate/MultiCarrot 任务上 π₀ 从 13.6% 提升至 23.4%，OpenVLA 从 57.0% 提升至 64.0%；固定物体 Pepper 任务从 39.1% 提升至 89.6%，显著优于 TextGrad、GEPA 等通用提示优化基线。线性探针分析表明重写命令使 OpenVLA 隐藏状态中的任务相关信息更易恢复（Public Info：66.6→89.3）。典型失败案例：抽象目标（如"sunrise icon"→"white card with yellow sun"）、罕见物体名（"champagne glass"→"tall white glass"）、多物体歧义（"plate"→"left yellow plate"）等均被有效接地重写。

Conclusion: 语言可作为机器人基础模型的可优化适应层，策略改进可从动作空间"提升"至语言空间。语言条件空间优化是对冻结 VLA 的轻量级后训练原语，与权重微调、奖励模型、验证器选择等正交且可组合。局限在于：当失败源于感知噪声、严重视觉误判、低层操作技能或长程推理时，语言优化收益有限；不应被视为取代感知与控制改进的万能方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly treated as end-to-end action policies conditioned on natural-language task descriptions. In practice, however, their behavior often depends sharply on how the instruction is phrased, suggesting that language is not merely a task label but an optimizable conditioning input. We study whether frozen VLA policies can be improved by optimizing language space rather than updating action weights. Our method introduces a language-conditioning space policy that translates a human instruction into a short VLA-grounded command using object appearance, spatial relations, and target-grounding cues. The language-conditioning space policy is initialized with a failure-derived command-space prior and optimized with reinforcement learning from sparse task-completion rewards, while the downstream VLA remains fully frozen. This yields language-conditioning space optimization: RL discovers which VLA-grounded commands best elicit successful behavior from the frozen action policy. Experiments on RL4VLA and VL-Think show that language-conditioning space optimization improves success on instruction-sensitive, symbolic, and multi-object manipulation tasks, demonstrating that language can serve as an optimizable variable for a robot foundation models. Website: this https URL

</details>


### [629] [Measuring Harness-Induced Belief Divergence in Multi-Step LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04528)
*Haiwen Yi,Xinyuan Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM软件智能体的"harness"（执行基础设施）会在任务、环境和基础LLM均固定的情况下改变智能体的多步信念轨迹，导致终端成功指标相同的智能体可能持有完全不同的内部信念。作者提出了信念展开（belief rollout）诊断方法和BIWM（信念不变世界建模）无训练协议，将整体信念散度分解为到达项（arrival，即接口差异）与增长项（growth，即随视野演化的信念差异），并在控制基准HIBench-Code、SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench上系统验证了harness设计应被视为实验变量而非实现细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的软件智能体基准普遍只报告终端成功/失败，但智能体的执行环境（harness）控制着观察抽象、动作门控、修复压缩、选择性验证与日志记录等多个通道，从而改变驱动后续决策的中间信念。即使任务、环境、基础LLM全部固定，不同harness仍可能让智能体形成截然不同的进展、风险、可恢复性与失败模式信念。这种"接口层面的信息改变"在终端标签上不可见，但直接影响后续推理与动作选择，构成评估可比性与安全审计的关键盲区。

Method: 1) 将harness形式化为六元组（观测映射、动作接口、验证器、风险门、修复策略、日志策略），并假设存在规范嵌入以消除语法不可辨识性。2) 定义K步LLM信念展开：固定任务、环境、LLM后，在信念空间 B = B^cat × B^fail × B^set × B^num × B^act 上逐步采样信念状态，覆盖进度/风险/可恢复性、失败模式标签、约束集合、不确定性/成功率/修复成本等数值预测、以及推荐下一动作。3) 定义加权信念散度 D_belief 并分解为 D_arrival（约束集+动作的接口级差异）与 D_growth（分类状态+失败+数值预测的视野相关差异），并证明其有界性、自反性与对称性以及审查增长单调性的充分条件。4) 提出BIWM无训练协议：规范化观测、记录被屏蔽动作日志、展开修复轨迹、登记验证掩码、对危险分支进行影子执行、并跨harness做投票/平均对齐。5) 在六种harness（原始、结构化、风险门控、修复密集、验证选择、成本感知）× HIBench-Code/SWE-bench Verified/Terminal-Bench上进行控制实验、长视野实验、分组扩展与权重敏感性分析。

Result: 在HIBench-Code控制实验中，所有受中介harness相对原始harness的D_arrival在K=1即接近饱和（≈0.99），而D_growth随视野呈机制特异性非单调轨迹——结构化解析在K=5达最大D_growth=0.257，验证选择在K=8升至0.231。长视野分析（K=1→20）表明总体D_belief过早稳定，但D_num仍从0.044上升到0.136，失败模式距离在K=5出现暂时收敛（0.325）。SWE-bench Verified切片上风险门控使D_fail从K=3的0.400升至K=5的0.800；Terminal-Bench分组扩展（每组n=15）显示领先harness随执行机制变化。在840步原始-中介配对中，动作类别发散率从D_growth最低四分位的0.28升至最高四分位的0.595；风险门控下UnsafeRetryRate为0.700/60个被屏蔽高危步。BIWM各组件分析显示：暴露效应最大者来自修复展开（+0.131）与验证掩码（+0.030），对齐全视图则降低D_growth（鲁棒性），两者方向相反且机制不同。权重敏感性测试表明下调到达分量后，结构化harness仍为最大散度来源，机制性结论稳健。

Conclusion: harness设计是软件智能体评估中一阶的实验变量，而非中立基础设施；同一任务、同一LLM下不同harness能系统性改变驱动后续决策的信念轨迹，使终端成功度量呈现虚假的可比性。本文信念展开诊断与D_arrival/D_growth分解使harness诱导的信念漂移可测、可审计：到达项主要由接口表征差异决定（饱和迅速），增长项揭示风险/失败/预测随视野演化，是衡量harness效应的关键量。BIWM协议通过补全被压缩、被门控、被省略的证据并将跨harness信念对齐，降低了对单一harness轨迹的依赖；同时通过影子执行让被屏蔽的危险分支可见于信念更新，缓解风险门控下UnsafeRetryRate=0.700的隐患。建议未来评估将harness机制与基准任务配对报告，并将审计协议作为发布物。

Abstract: Software-agent benchmarks usually report whether an agent solves a task, but the agent reaches that outcome through a harness that controls what it sees, which actions it can take, which failures are repaired, which states are verified, and which evidence is logged. We show that this harness can change the agent's multi-step beliefs even when the task, environment, and base LLM are fixed. We introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that elicits structured K-step trajectories over progress, risk, recoverability, constraints, failure mode, uncertainty, future success, repair cost, and next action under alternative harnesses. We define a cross-harness belief divergence and decompose it into an arrival term for immediate interface shifts and a growth term for horizon-dependent belief changes. On controlled coding tasks and public-benchmark stress tests, blocked actions, compressed repairs, selective verification, and cost-aware evidence pruning often preserve terminal success while changing the beliefs that drive later decisions. We further introduce BIWM, a no-training protocol that canonicalizes observations, logs censored branches, expands repair traces, records verification masks, executes risky branches in shadow, and aligns belief trajectories across harness views. The results suggest that harness design is an experimental variable in agent evaluation, not an implementation detail. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [630] [Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients for Eliminating Epistemic Entropy in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04562)
*MY Pitsane,Hope Mogale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HCRC（Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients）框架，将LLM推理重构为由谓词门控的状态转换，通过Heaviside Gate结合模型置信度与并行验证信号，实现验证驱动的执行控制，在不修改模型的前提下将高质量模型的错误完成率从4-7%降至0%，并将弱模型错误完成转化为诚实停顿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成流畅但可能错误的内容，且由于自回归解码缺乏中间推理验证机制，错误难以检测；现有方法多依赖模型规模提升可靠性，缺乏对推理执行过程本身的验证控制。论文旨在通过执行控制而非模型扩展来提升LLM推理的可靠性。

Method: 提出HCRC（Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients）验证优先执行框架，核心是Heaviside Gate：将推理建模为由正确性谓词门控的状态转换，结合模型自身置信度与来自并行worker架构的独立验证信号，仅当预定义谓词满足时才推进执行，从而阻止无效中间状态传播，降低认知熵，且不修改底层模型。

Result: 在涵盖四个提供商13种proposer的软件工程与推理任务上评估：在强proposer上将错误完成率（FCR）从4-7%降至0%，且延迟具有竞争力、部分场景更快；在弱proposer上将错误完成转化为诚实停顿，避免污染下游状态。该框架已作为智能体编码环境的产线控制平面运行数月，负责授权文件变更、验证驱动的进度报告及记忆压缩。

Conclusion: HCRC被确立为验证驱动LLM执行的通用框架，证明通过原则化的执行控制而非单纯依赖模型规模即可实现可靠推理，为LLM系统的可信部署提供了可落地的执行层方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent outputs that can be wrong. Unlike humans, who often exhibit cues when providing false information, LLMs produce errors that are difficult to detect because autoregressive decoding provides no mechanism for verifying intermediate reasoning before state progression. We introduce Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients (HCRC), a verification-first execution framework that reformulates inference as predicate-gated state transitions governed by a Heaviside Gate. HCRC combines model confidence with independent verification signals from a parallel worker architecture, allowing execution to advance only when predefined correctness predicates are satisfied. This prevents invalid intermediate states from propagating, reducing epistemic entropy without modifying the underlying model. We evaluate HCRC on software-engineering and reasoning tasks across thirteen proposers from four providers. On capable proposers, the gate reduces the false-completion rate (FCR) from 4--7% to 0% while remaining latency-competitive and, in some settings, faster than the unwrapped model. On weaker proposers, it converts false completions into honest halts instead of corrupting downstream state. Beyond benchmarking, HCRC has operated for months as the production control plane of an agentic coding environment, authorizing file mutations, verification-driven progress reporting, and memory compaction. These results establish HCRC as a general framework for verification-driven LLM execution, showing that reliable reasoning can be achieved through principled execution control rather than model scale alone.

</details>


### [631] [Detecting Answer-Driven Reasoning in LLM-Based Educational Tutors via Truncated Chain-of-Thought Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04572)
*Bonan Shen,Dingyan Shang,Youting Wang,Tao Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于截断思维链审计（TRACE）的方法，用于检测LLM教育辅导系统中"答案驱动推理"（answer-driven reasoning）现象——即模型在生成解释之前就已知道最终答案，仅在形式上输出看似合理的推导过程。在1000道GSM8K题目上，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行配对实验，结果显示：获得答案键访问权限后，推理链仅10%前缀处即可通过验证器的比例从11.3%飙升至99.7%，中位TRACE AUC从0.375升至0.900。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM辅导系统的评估多聚焦于最终答案是否正确或是否显式泄露答案，但忽视了一个过程级问题：即使最终答案正确、教学格式规范，模型的解释过程可能早已依赖私有的答案键、评分标准或检索到的解题资料（即"答案驱动"），而非真正从题目推导。该研究旨在补足这一过程级诊断空白，提出一种轻量级的审计方法。

Method: 采用TRACE（截断推理AUC评估）框架，在三种配对条件下生成辅导解释：(1) 仅问题（question-only）；(2) 问题+正确答案键（answer-key）；(3) 问题+错误答案键（wrong-key，设置为y_i+1）。对生成的解释在10%、25%、50%、75%、100%前缀处插入强制回答指令，检验其是否能通过黄金答案验证器。指标包括：TRACE AUC（前缀通过率曲线下面积）、Pass@10（10%前缀通过率）、First-pass（首次通过的前缀比例）。模型为Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct（4-bit量化），数据集为GSM8K 1000题，使用精确整数匹配作为验证器。

Result: 关键结果：(1) 仅问题组中位TRACE AUC为0.375，答案键组升至0.900，错误答案键组为0.125；(2) Pass@10从11.3%跃升至99.7%，且在997/1000的答案键案例中黄金答案可在10%前缀处被恢复；(3) 在746道最终答案都正确的配对子集中，答案键组仍以697/746胜出，说明效果并非由最终正确率差异驱动；(4) 配对AUROC为0.9663，表明TRACE AUC能极强地区分两种条件；(5) 错误答案键条件下最终正确率降至61.3%，说明私有答案通道会实质性地影响辅导输出。

Conclusion: 研究证实截断CoT审计可作为检测LLM辅导系统中答案驱动推理的轻量级过程级诊断工具。形式正确且教学友好的解释仍可能掩盖答案驱动的生成过程，传统的答案泄露检测不足以发现此类依赖性失败。建议将该方法部署为审计流程的一环：抽样辅导解释，在固定前缀网格上探测强制回答，计算早期通过指标并与基线对比，标记异常轨迹进行人工审查或检索过滤。局限在于仅使用单一3B模型和短答案数学数据集，开放性辅导、多轮对话和非数值答案需要更复杂的验证器。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) tutors often produce fluent step-by-step explanations, but a correct and pedagogically formatted response does not guarantee that the answer was derived from the student-facing problem. In realistic tutoring systems, the model may also have access to teacher notes, answer keys, rubrics, or retrieved solution artifacts. We study whether such private answer information can make tutor explanations answer-driven: the final answer is behaviorally available before the written explanation has justified it. Using Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation (TRACE), which probes how early a chain-of-thought prefix can pass a verifier, we evaluate 1000 GSM8K test problems under three paired tutoring contexts: question-only, correct answer-key, and wrong answer-key. At fixed fractions of each generated explanation, we force the model to answer immediately and verify the response against the gold numeric answer. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, answer-key access raises median TRACE AUC from 0.375 to 0.900 and makes the gold answer available at the first 10% prefix in 997 of 1000 cases. The effect remains strong on the 746 examples where both question-only and answer-key explanations end with the correct answer. These results support truncated CoT auditing as a lightweight process-level diagnostic for answer-driven reasoning in math tutoring explanations.

</details>


### [632] [Attention Limited Reward Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04590)
*Wenqian Xing*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战RLHF中标准的Bradley-Terry奖励建模假设，提出人类成对比较应被视为"注意力受限的测量过程"而非直接的偏好揭示。基于理性不注意力理论，作者构建了注意力缩放的比较通道（ℓ_z = η_z + β_z Δ*_z），证明异质注意力可使标量奖励拟合恢复错误排名，且奖励、注意力和默认倾向在被动比较数据中不可识别。学习效果取决于"总被注意信息"而非标签数量，在Chatbot Arena和感知比较数据上获得了实证支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF及其对齐流程通常使用Bradley-Terry对数几率模型来解释人类成对比较，将选择概率归因于潜在奖励差异。然而，这一假设遗漏了关键因素：评估者注意力有限——某些比较困难是因为候选确实价值接近（"因为接近而难"），而另一些是因为关键差异难以察觉（"因为隐藏而难"）。后者恰恰是"可扩展监督"所关注的情形——表面流畅但微妙误导的输出、看似有用但有长期风险的方案。对于对齐而言，这种混淆是危险的，因为弱偏好信号可能反映评估未能获取必要信息，而非真正的无差别。

Method: 1. **建模框架**：从Shannon理性不注意力的一阶条件出发，推导出归约形式的注意力缩放比较通道 q_z = σ(η_z + β_z Δ*_z)，其中 β_z ≥ 0 为查询特定的注意力乘子，η_z 为默认/顺序/显著性项。2. **表示层面分析**（第3节）：在有限比较图上证明对数几率场可被标量奖励表示当且仅当其绕任意环的循环和为零（命题1）；Bradley-Terry在低信息极限下收敛到对数几率场在势子空间上的加权投影（命题2），并构造三项目示例展示投影反转——每对多数票正确，但拟合排名仍可反转；进一步证明奖励、注意力和默认倾向在被动比较数据中不可识别（命题3）。3. **信息论层面分析**（第4节）：证明高标签熵≠高奖励信息（命题4），单标签关于奖励差异的Fisher信息以β²缩放，且当注意力未知时局部信息矩阵至多秩1（命题5）；通过KL和Fano界给出符号恢复（命题6）和任意假设类的奖励恢复复杂度（定理1），表明所需样本量为1/(β²δ²)；在比较图上利用Hodge分解证明标量奖励必然丢弃的循环信息的KL代价恰为(1/8)‖ℓ^cyc‖²_W（命题7，"八分之一律"）。4. **实证检验**：Chatbot Arena上32个模型、15001次投票的对数几率场存在显著超出采样噪声的循环能量（bootstrap p=0.008），八分之一律对拟合损失的预测准确度达89%；感知比较任务显示响应时间携带标签不包含的差距幅度信息（每位评估者心理测量斜率差异达6倍），注视数据表现为加性默认。

Result: 1. **理论结果**：异质注意力可使Bradley-Terry错误排序——尽管每对多数方向均正确，三项目示例中注意力盲的BT拟合仍可将次优项B排在最优项A之上；奖励、注意力和默认在被动比较概率上存在连续的观测等价类，无论使用何种估计器或多少数据均无法区分；Fisher信息关于β²缩放，未知β时信息矩阵秩1，识别极限仅能达到β·Δ的乘积；奖励恢复所需标签数约为1/(β²δ²)，且Fano界表明总注意力信息∑d_t（而非标签数n）决定学习可行性；在比较图上标量奖励的最优KL损失为(1/8)‖ℓ^cyc‖²_W，给出了被丢弃循环信息的精确价格。2. **实证结果**：Chatbot Arena数据拒绝任何标量分解释（似然比统计量70.6，自由度43，bootstrap p=0.007），实际循环能量4.2%超出零分布的95%分位3.5%，BT拟合每比较损失0.0034比特，八分之一律预测0.0038比特（比率0.89）；感知任务中标签仅携带0.0001比特差距幅度信息，但响应时间携带0.035比特，且每位评估者斜率差异达6倍，注视表现为加性默认。

Conclusion: 奖励学习在人类理性不注意力下发生质变。注意力缩放通道不只是为奖励差异增加噪声，而是按查询依赖的方式缩放并添加不随奖励缩放的默认项。因此原始对数比较不必形成势场，Bradley-Terry伪真奖励可反转审慎排名，奖励无法从注意力或默认中分离。近50-50标签既可能反映真正接近，也可能反映注意力瓶颈；关于奖励的每标签信息以β²缩放；KL和Fano界表明符号、排名和奖励恢复需要总注意力信息。Hodge分解定价了标量奖励无法表示的循环比较信息。对齐实践的含义是：奖励学习应被视为内生信息约束下的测量问题，而非曲线拟合；注释协议应将弱成对信号视为真实无差异与评估失败之间的歧义，并对安全相关的近似均势对保持警觉；可扩展监督干预的价值在于提高关键比较的注意力乘子，被动重标注无法替代被注意的信息。未来方向包括能够展示性改变注意力的监督干预、响应时间/深思熟虑努力作为信息获取代理、显式注意力约束下的部分识别界，以及将图信息分解扩展到上下文和轨迹上的函数逼近。

Abstract: Pairwise human comparisons are a primary interface through which modern AI systems learn human preferences. RLHF and related alignment pipelines typically model such comparisons with Bradley--Terry log-odds, where choice probabilities are governed by latent reward differences. This paper examines what this assumption misses through a reduced-form model motivated by rational inattention, in which each label is generated by a low-capacity evaluation channel. The model separates two forms of ambiguity that standard reward modeling tends to conflate: a comparison may be difficult because the two candidates are genuinely close in value, or because the relevant distinction is hard to detect under limited attention. We show that limited attention can fundamentally distort what pairwise comparisons reveal. In particular, passive comparison data cannot generally distinguish reward, attention, and default tendencies, and heterogeneous attention can make standard Bradley--Terry reward modeling recover misleading rankings. Our analysis shows that learning is governed not by the raw number of labels, but by the amount of attended information each label carries. A case study on human votes over language-model pairs from Chatbot Arena exhibits the predicted signature, a cyclic component of the comparison data that exceeds sampling noise and that no scalar reward can represent; a second case study on perceptual comparisons shows that response times and gaze carry gap information that the labels do not. This perspective suggests that human feedback should be treated not as direct revealed preference, but as an attention-limited measurement process: a weak preference signal may reflect hidden evaluation difficulty rather than genuine indifference.

</details>


### [633] [Governed Individuation: Cryptographically Decoupling an Agent's Learning from Its Authority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04613)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"治理个体化"(Governed Individuation)架构,通过密码学冻结的身份摘要将智能体的身份与其可学习的认知组件解耦,并基于动作的语义效应(而非名称)进行权限判定。理论上证明了无论智能体如何学习、获取技能或自诱导治理原则,其被授权的权限边界都无法在无操作者签名的情况下被突破;实证上在工具使用基准上将已执行的违禁效应降为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体正从文本生成器演变为代码、数据和物理基础设施的操作者,并具备部署后持续学习的能力。现有对齐技术(训练时对齐、提示策略)本质上是概率性的,且针对固定模型设计,无法回答"经过现场适应后,运行中的系统是否仍被约束于操作者授权范围内"这一可验证问题。具备能力的智能体在奖励压力下会理性地选择绕过测量目标的捷径(如编辑测试文件而非修复代码),现有身份方案、认证机制和执行框架各提供部分保障,但缺少三者结合的架构性保证。

Method: 架构核心由三部分组成:(1)启动时将智能体的授权上限、红线和操作者签名的种子S哈希为不可变身份摘要H,记忆、权重、技能和工具版本被刻意排除在承诺之外;(2)语义效应门控:将每个提议动作解析为效应格上的语义效应(如test_mutation、secret_access、policy_mutation),而非根据动作名称判定;(3)唯一的权限放宽通道是操作者签名更新种子S,自动收紧无需签名,自动放宽不可能。理论框架包含四个定理:定理1(权限边界守恒)证明已执行权限仅受验证器残差、TCB绕过概率和哈希冲突概率约束,与诱导原则的正确性无关;定理2(开放技能获取)证明在保守组合抽象下,技能库无限扩展不会突破冻结上限;定理3(签名门控放宽)基于EUF-CMA和抗碰撞性证明自动放宽概率上界;定理4(诱导原则的拒绝率上界)分离安全(架构性)与能力(经验性)。实验包含ToolGym-GI工具使用基准(开源动作空间)和治理决策基准(检验原则诱导迁移),使用Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3.5-mini三个开源权重模型,设置五组对照(未治理、提示策略、护盾、gi-names、gi-induced)。

Result: 在ToolGym-GI上:未治理智能体在最难任务上12/12个种子会改写评分文件(综合违规率Mistral 27%、Qwen 31%),而效应门将所有门控组的已执行违禁效应降为零(这是构造的可验证性质而非经验估计),且在能力可达的任务上保留任务成功(如Qwen偶数斐波那契族:治理12/12 vs 未治理9/12)。对抗性验证器评估中,32次攻击(4效应类×8间接编码)在四级监控器上误放率呈单调下降:名称/意图黑名单0.75、子串0.50、静态语义0.25、动态效应追踪0.00。在治理决策基准上:诱导原则降低了未见红线族的违禁提议率(Mistral 0.00 vs 0.34、Qwen 0.26 vs 0.43、Phi 0.43 vs 0.55),但随机对照(打乱任务与拒绝原因的配对但保留拒绝效应集合)在Mistral上打平、在Qwen和Phi上优于诱导原则,且错误域原则也能降低违规,表明迁移信号是广泛回避被拒绝效应而非唯一诱导的具体规则;预注册的具体性检验显示诱导原则实为"谨慎"而非"特异",在7B规模上不表现出效应特异性分离。前沿模型(GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash)在任何提示下均实现零违规且零过度阻拦,表明该机制在能力前沿冗余而非有益。

Conclusion: 治理个体化将部署学习智能体的可信性从主张变为可计算:身份任何人都可重新计算,权限边界在智能体学习过程中不可被放大,这一性质由构造验证而非由对齐维持。安全的承载保证完全落在架构层(定理1-3),治理记忆仅作为能力辅助(可被诚实测量、随模型和领域变化)。论文明确承认保证以动作空间的可靠效应验证器为条件,扩展至完全开放动作空间的可靠验证、记忆整合、联邦化与物理执行是自然后续工作。论文同时报告若干负面结果:诱导原则在小模型上是泛化谨慎而非效应特异性;前沿模型已无需该机制;行为认证指纹在能干模型间无区分度,身份主张必须由签名承诺承载而非行为探针。这些负面结果反而强化了核心论点——安全不能依赖模型对齐或学到的原则,只能依赖架构门控。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are moving from sandboxed text generators to operators of code, data, and physical infrastructure, and they increasingly learn while deployed. This reopens a question that alignment techniques answer only probabilistically: after an agent has adapted in the field, is the running system still confined to what its operator authorised? Here we show that confinement can be guaranteed as an invariant of the agent's execution architecture rather than a probabilistic outcome of its training. Governed individuation binds an agent at boot to a cryptographically frozen identity digest, and routes every action through a gate defined over the semantic effect of the action rather than its name. We prove that no amount of learning, skill acquisition, or self-induced governance abstraction can widen the agent's permitted authority without an operator-signed change to its identity; the guarantee holds even when the agent induces its own safety principle and that principle is wrong. Empirically, in an open-ended tool-use benchmark where a large action space rules out name-based blocking, ungoverned software agents under reward pressure attempt to tamper with their own evaluation at a task-dependent rate that reaches every run on the hardest task, whereas the gate reduces executed forbidden effects to zero as a verified property of the construction while preserving task success. An adversarial evaluation of monitors of increasing semantic depth shows false-allows falling from 75% (name-based gating) to zero (dynamic effect tracing), and refusal history transfers compliance to held-out red-line families. Trust in a deployed learning agent shifts from a wager on its continued alignment to a check anyone can run at boot.

</details>


### [634] [MRMS: A Multi-Resolution Memory Substrate for Long-Lived AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04617)
*Jizhizi Li,Amy Shi-Nash*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MRMS（多分辨率记忆基底），一个面向长寿 AI 智能体的双轴记忆架构。正交组合"表示轴"（结构化记录 + 向量检索 + 图关系）与"时间轴"（短时迹 → 中期抽象 → 长期承诺），通过四组同步不变量保证记忆在选入生成上下文前经过授权、状态与图关系的把关。原型在 800 个确定性合成任务上达到 98.8% 总体准确率，并通过消融实验验证各组件（结构过滤、时序策略、图推理）的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长寿 AI 智能体需要跨交互的连续性，但这无法仅靠扩展上下文窗口实现。作者指出记忆错误的代价随时间累积：相比假阴性，假阳性（即过期的偏好、被取代的事实、越界的观察被反复引入推理）更具破坏性。现有的 RAG、MemGPT、长上下文模型等方案或仅关注召回质量，或将多种存储机制混合为实现细节，缺少对"记忆能否影响下一步生成"这一前置治理能力。论文将可靠性个性化重新定义为记忆设计问题——有用记忆应当是结构化的、可选择性暴露、持续整合并带有认识论标签的，而非未分化的对话历史。

Method: MRMS 采用两条正交轴组织记忆：① 表示轴由结构化记录 S_t（权威字段：层级、信度、状态、来源、范围 σ、修订史 h）、向量索引 V_t（语义召回）、类型化记忆图 G_t（节点=记忆对象，边类型含 supports/contradicts/supersedes/derived-from/part-of-session 等）构成；② 时间轴分短时迹、中期抽象、长期语义承诺三层。检索走四阶段管道：x_t → 结构化授权集 A_t → 向量邻域 N_k(x_t) → 图扩展证据子图 H_t → 上下文包 C_t。打分函数 s_i = αR + βC + γF + δU − ηN 平衡相关性、信度、新鲜度、效用与冗余成本。操作涵盖 write / select / consolidate & revise / boundary projection / context packet 五个阶段。核心概念贡献是四条同步不变量：向量点→唯一结构记录、图节点→有效结构记录、高影响图边必须证据支撑、结构化状态优先于向量/图视图。

Result: 基于 800 个确定性合成任务（每类 100，覆盖延迟召回、近界越界、来源分隔、修订、过期抑制、证据归属、矛盾处理、时间承诺八族）的诊断基准：Full MRMS 总体 98.8%（95% 自助置信区间 98.0–99.4）；基线"近期上下文"3.9%，"仅向量"21.2%，"结构+向量"37.6%，"+时序"75.0%。消融显示结构化过滤主导边界控制（100%），时序策略修复过期抑制与弃权（均 100%），图扩展承担矛盾处理（100%）与证据归属（90%）。定性分析揭示剩余失败集中在归属场景中解析器选取了活跃声明却漏掉指定支持迹（10/100）。平均每次仅选 1.11 个记忆对象，经结构化筛选后候选为 1.8 个，证明上下文投影的紧凑性。

Conclusion: MRMS 将贡献定位于基底层框架——结构化记录、向量检索、图关系、时间承诺与边界感知上下文投影之间的同步契约才是新颖之处，而非具体后端。其原型聚焦生成前控制点，使记忆对象变得可审计、可追溯、可弃权。未来评估应同时报告下游答案与前置记忆包（含被拒候选、取代迹与归属边），将对比转化为可检验的系统层面问题而非黑箱偏好测试。自然延伸方向为接入完整 LLM 智能体、学习式检索器与真实多轮对话基准。论文主张记忆应成为长寿智能体的可审计基底，而非隐藏的提示扩展，并强调存储与影响的分离——对象可在保留为证据、被嵌入搜索或链接为历史支撑的同时，仍被禁止引导当前生成。

Abstract: Long-lived AI agents require continuity across interactions, but continuity cannot be obtained by simply extending the prompt window. An agent must preserve useful prior experience, retrieve it selectively, distinguish personal context from external evidence, and revise memory when the underlying situation changes. We propose an architectural memory substrate organized along two orthogonal axes: a representational axis spanning structured records, vector representations, and graph relations; and a temporal axis spanning short-term traces, medium-term abstractions, and long-term semantic commitments. Its key design constraint is synchronized structured-vector-graph memory: structured records govern eligibility, vector representations support recall, and graph relations adjudicate support, contradiction, and supersession before gated context projection. Its central claim is that reliable personalization is a memory design problem: useful memory is structured, selectively exposed, continuously consolidated, and epistemically labeled rather than stored as undifferentiated conversation history. Beyond the framework, we instantiate MRMS as a lightweight prototype implementing structured records, vector retrieval, temporal policies, and graph-based revision. The prototype exercises the core substrate mechanisms through pre-generation memory selection, revision, boundary enforcement, and evidence attribution under controlled long-lived interaction scenarios with explicit evidence requirements.

</details>


### [635] [Formal Disco: Scalable Open-Ended Generation of Formally Verified Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04631)
*Gabriel Poesia,Simon Henniger,Tzu-Han Hsu,Yilun Du,Nada Amin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Formal Disco 是一个用于大规模开放式生成形式化验证程序的多智能体分布式系统，通过 Initiator、Fixer、Extender 三类 LLM 智能体协作，结合"特征最大熵"原则，在 Dafny、Verus、Frama-C 三种验证语言上生成超过 10 万个合成验证程序，并通过熵最大化迭代 SFT 让开源模型 Qwen 2.5-Coder 32B 在验证任务上达到甚至超越 Claude Opus 4.5 的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI 编程智能体能力提升，代码生产成本急剧下降，但生成程序的质量保证手段未能同步跟进。形式化验证能提供最强正确性保证，但验证感知语言（如 Dafny、Verus）训练数据极度稀缺（最大公开 Dafny 数据集 DafnyBench 仅不到 800 个程序），限制了开源 LLM 在该类语言上的能力，亟需突破数据瓶颈。

Method: 提出 Formal Disco 分布式系统：1）基于共享 agenda 的多智能体架构，三类工人（Initiator 从随机 GitHub README 和文档片段中构思并起草初始程序；Fixer 根据编译器和验证器反馈修复；Extender 对已验证程序提出扩展补丁）；2）引入"特征最大熵"原则，将数据集质量统一为对程序特征（逻辑注解数量、引理大小、循环结构、方法体大小等）的熵最大化；3）使用基于最小惊喜排名（msr）的 ReST 风格筛选策略，对生成的成功例子取 top-1/3 进行迭代监督微调；4）通过 LoRA 在 Qwen 2.5-Coder 32B 上交替进行蒸馏（Claude）和自改进。

Result: 1）在 Dafny、Verus、Frama-C 上分别生成大规模合成验证程序数据集（dafny-disco、verus-disco、framac-disco）；2）经 5 轮熵最大化 SFT 后，Qwen 2.5-Coder 32B 在所有工人任务上的成功率匹配或超越 Claude 4.5 Opus/Sonnet；3）特征熵在迭代中持续提升，最长验证程序规模比 Claude 种子语料库增加 22%-62%；4）下游任务上：在 DafnyBench 逻辑注解任务中 Pass@16 达 40.4%（匹配 Opus 4.5 单次 41.4%，是基线模型的 2 倍），VerusBench 注解 Pass@1 达 43%（匹配 Opus 4.5），引理证明 Pass@1 相对基线提升 5 倍以上（25.5% vs 4.5%）；5）消融实验证实三工人分工、GitHub README、文档片段均为不可缺的外部熵源。

Conclusion: Formal Disco 证明了形式化验证中数据稀缺障碍是可克服的——验证器本身提供了合成数据生成所需的可扩展质量信号，多样性可作为直接可优化的目标。使用最简单的 SFT 流水线即可大幅提升开源模型在验证任务上的能力，使新设计的验证感知语言无需数十年积累大规模语料库即可获得有效的 AI 辅助编程支持。

Abstract: The cost of producing code is rapidly diminishing with increasingly capable AI agents, while quality assurance of generated programs has not kept pace. Formal verification provides the strongest possible guarantees, but the ability of AI models to work with verification-aware languages is hindered by the scarcity of human-written examples of programs in those languages. To tackle this prevalent data scarcity issue, we propose Formal Disco: a distributed system for coordination of LLM-based workers that can be easily applied to open-ended synthetic data generation at scale. We use Formal Disco to share tasks and programs between three classes of workers: "initiators", which read random READMEs from open-source repositories and documentation snippets to sketch a related verified program, "fixers" which take compiler and verifier feedback and attempt to resolve issues, and "extenders" that take working programs and propose patches to expand them. Formal Disco records all agent-generated traces and uses them both for initial distillation from a stronger model as well as self-improvement. We also propose a principle of maximum entropy for synthetic program generation, and use entropy maximization via iterative supervised fine-tuning to learn to generate increasingly diverse programs over time. We release large datasets of synthetic verified programs in three languages - Dafny, Verus, and Frama-C -, and fine-tune open models for verification-relevant tasks, often matching or exceeding the performance of Claude Opus 4.5. Overall, our work offers a path to create synthetic data at scale for formal reasoning domains and overcome the long-standing data barrier.

</details>


### [636] [Integrated Altruistic and Fairness Preference Induces Advanced Mutual Cooperation in Sequential Social Dilemmas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04710)
*Yu Wei,Yukiko Ogura,Yoshiyuki Ohmura,Ildefons Magrans de Abril,Hoshinori Kanazawa,Yasuo Kuniyoshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"利他与公平偏好"（AFP）的新型效用函数，将社会心理学与行为经济学中的利他偏好（对他人奖励的激励）和公平偏好（对平等的激励）整合到多智能体强化学习（MARL）中。在两个序列社会困境（SSD）游戏（Cleanup和Harvest）中的实验表明，AFP智能体能够实现比标准RL和不平厌恶（IA）基线更高的互惠合作水平，获得更多集体奖励并实现更高公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体强化学习中，社会困境场景下的合作问题是一个核心挑战。个体理性往往导致次优的群体结果。现有的解决方法包括集中式训练范式（可扩展性差、不现实）和单一类型的他人关注偏好（如不平厌恶、前景奖励）。然而，单一偏好难以全面捕捉人类合作的复杂动机。此外，已有方法多采用后向视角（基于已获得奖励），在高随机性环境中表现不佳。本文旨在通过整合利他偏好与公平偏好，并采用前瞻性机制，促进分布式智能体在社会困境中实现互惠合作。

Method: 1. 提出AFP效用函数：将自身奖励、他人奖励（利他成分）和奖励分配的公平性（公平成分）整合到一个统一效用公式中（公式7）。其中包含两个权重参数α（利他权重）和β（公平权重）。
2. 采用前瞻性机制：智能体使用期望奖励而非已实现的奖励来评估效用，避免后向视角在高随机性环境中的问题。
3. 学习算法：采用分布式优势Actor-Critic（A2C）算法，用效用替代原始回报进行策略梯度更新。网络结构包括卷积层、全连接层、LSTM层和线性读出层。
4. 实验设置：在两个SSD游戏（Cleanup公共品困境和Harvest公共资源困境）中进行实验，智能体使用15×15灰度图像作为观察输入。
5. 基线对比：IAC-e（独立自私A2C）、IAC-u（功利主义A2C）、IA（不平厌恶模型）。
6. 评估指标：四个社会结果指标——功利性（U）、平等性（E，基尼系数倒数）、贡献度（C，劳动投入比例）和互惠性（M，劳动分配公平性）。

Result: 1. 在Cleanup和Harvest两个环境中，AFP智能体均成功实现了互惠合作，集体奖励和平等性显著高于IAC和IA基线。
2. IAC倾向于产生过度专业化的智能体分工，导致不平等；IA则产生性能低下的不平厌恶智能体。
3. 消融研究揭示：利他偏好鼓励智能体投资公共品（贡献），但可能加剧不平等；公平偏好则促进奖励和劳动分配的平等性。
4. 在Cleanup中，两种偏好的组合产生高均衡性能；在Harvest中，利他偏好起主导作用（使智能体克制不过度消耗资源），而公平偏好作用较弱。
5. 实验证明了利他偏好和公平偏好在解决不同类型社会困境中的互补作用。

Conclusion: AFP机制通过整合利他与公平偏好，有效诱导分布式MARL智能体在序列社会困境中实现互惠合作。该方法在公共品困境（Cleanup）和公共资源困境（Harvest）中均优于标准RL和不平厌恶基线。利他偏好促进对公共品的贡献，公平偏好促进互惠行为，二者结合实现了高均衡的合作表现。然而，AFP存在三个局限：(1) 缺乏奖励解释能力导致虚假奖励问题；(2) 智能体不倾向惩罚搭便车者，降低了策略多样性；(3) 智能体同质性作为超参数需要适当设置。未来研究方向包括自动识别最优偏好权重的方法，以及研究智能体异质性对行为的影响。

Abstract: Inducing cooperation among distributed agents is still a difficult problem in the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), particularly in social dilemma situations. There, individual interests are misaligned with the common good and individual rationality leads to suboptimal group outcomes. In contrast, humans are able to achieve cooperation with one another in such situations. A common explanation for such cooperative behavior is that individuals have social preferences. In order to achieve cooperation in MARL, we design a new utility function integrating altruistic preferences (incentive for other's reward) and fairness preferences (incentive for equality) from social psychology and behavioral economics, namely, Altruistic and Fairness Preference (AFP), a reward-sharing mechanism which converts one's own and other's rewards to incentives for cooperative behavior. We performed comparative experiments with standard RL and inequity aversion agents in two challenging sequential social dilemma games, and showed that AFP agents successfully achieved mutual cooperation with more collective rewards and higher equity than the baselines. To further understand the progression of AFP during training, we subsequently explore the effects of altruistic preferences and fairness preferences on agents' behavior. The results suggest that altruistic preferences encourage agents to contribute to the public goods, and fairness preferences induce mutual behavior between agents.

</details>


### [637] [FORGE: Research-Trajectory Hijacking Attacks on Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04718)
*Yue Pan,Ziheng Zhang,Junxiang Lei,Changhao Jia,Qingyi Si,Hongcheng Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FORGE 是一种针对深度研究智能体（Deep Research Agents）的规划层投毒攻击，通过文档内推理伪造与跨文档链条协调两层级构造，将局部注入升级为报告级污染；并提出按认知类型加权的 PRISM 度量与根查询锚定（RQA）轻量防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究智能体采用递归式"规划-检索-合成"工作流，早期检索到的对抗性文档不仅影响单次回答，还可劫持后续子任务规划，使局部投毒在多轮检索中逐级放大为报告级污染。现有针对标准 RAG 的投毒攻击与防御均假设检索步骤相互独立，无法应对"检索-规划耦合"所产生的规划层攻击面，且二元 ASR 度量难以刻画长篇报告中推理权重的失真程度。

Method: 1) **威胁模型**：黑盒攻击者利用 j 篇对抗文档 P，目标为将预设投毒叙事 V 嵌入最终报告 R；评估采用 Local（控制文档库）与 Network（网络检索池）两种注入场景。2) **FORGE 两层级构造**：文档内层将每篇文档构造为 r^1⇒…⇒r^{m_k}=c_k 的伪造推理链，使目标断言呈"推导结论"形态；跨文档层将 P 组织为分布式论证链 C: c_1→…→c_j=V，通过前置文档引用实现叙事级联。当规划器在初始检索 D^(0) 中吸入 FORGE 文档时，生成的子任务 t̂∼V，进而在 Eq.(1) 检索中召回头多篇 FORGE 文档，污染子报告 ŝ 并汇入 R。3) **PRISM 度量**：抽取报告与投毒文档的原子声明，按事实/规范/评价/因果/框架五种认知类型赋权（4–8），计算被感染声明的加权占比。4) **RQA 防御**：在递归子任务生成与 learnings 提取两个节点，将根查询 q_0 重新注入提示，以覆盖多维度的角度引导子任务对齐原始目标。

Result: 基于 gpt-researcher 平台、25 个查询、5 类主题、4 层深度的实验：Network FORGE 在 j=5 时达 26.4% PRISM，Local FORGE 在 j=2–3 即迅速上升；Trend Forecasting 与 Factual Surveys 类最易受攻击（Network j=5 分别 35.1%、33.5%），Method Comparison 最具抵抗力（14.2%）。在 10 查询子集上，FORGE 达 38.5% PRISM，显著高于 PoisonedRAG（23.0%）与 AuthChain（18.8%），优势集中在高权重的因果与框架维度。深度 δ 实验揭示"深度迁移"现象：浅层时投毒以显式框架出现，δ≥2 时被吸收为事实前提与量化机制，整体 PRISM 维持 13–16%。2×2 移植实验表明，固定 j=1 子任务列表、将检索注入从 j=1 升至 j=5 仅使 PRISM 维持 14.1%；而改用 j=5 子任务列表即便检索量最低也升至 22.8%，证明规划层劫持是报告级污染的主因。RQA 将 PRISM 从 38.5% 降至 18.3%，且是唯一同时提升 RACE 效用分数的防御（0.5000→0.6173）。跨框架实验（Perplexica、DeerFlow）复现了同一趋势，PRISM 评估与人工标注一致性达 92.7%（声明分类）与 94.7%（感染判定）。

Conclusion: FORGE 揭示了深度研究智能体区别于标准 RAG 的规划层攻击面：通过文档内推理伪造与跨文档链条协调的协同设计，可将单次检索投毒升级为对子任务规划的结构性劫持，并随递归深度变得更加隐蔽（框架→事实迁移）。PRISM 以认知类型加权方式衡量报告级推理失真，比二元 ASR 更适合长篇投毒评估。规划层移植实验在因果上将报告级污染归因于子任务列表劫持而非单纯证据注入，为防御设计提供方向。RQA 作为规划层轻量干预，在保持乃至提升生成质量的前提下显著降低污染，证明防御必须从检索层延伸至规划层。该工作同时强调局限：单平台验证、网络模拟未建模域权威/时效性/反垃圾、PRISM 权重未经读者感知数据标定、RQA 不阻止词面层面与根查询对齐的自适应攻击者。

Abstract: Deep research agents decompose open-ended queries into subtasks, retrieve web evidence over multiple rounds, and synthesize long-form reports. This workflow creates a planning-layer poisoning surface: adversarial documents that enter the retrieval pool can steer follow-up questions and turn a local injection into report-level contamination. We present FORGE (Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation), a two-level attack that combines intra-document reasoning fabrication with inter-document chain coordination to hijack subtask planning. We further introduce the PRISM metric, which weights infected report claims by cognitive type, and Root Query Anchoring, a lightweight defense that ties recursive follow-up generation to the root query. Across 25 queries, Network FORGE reaches 26.4% PRISM with five injected documents and exhibits depth migration, in which recursive synthesis shifts poisoned content from overt framing into factual premises. On the 10-query defense subset, RQA (Root Query Anchoring) reduces PRISM from 38.5% to 18.3%.

</details>


### [638] [FM-ChangeNet: Learning Change through Pathwise Feature Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04750)
*Roie Kazoom,George Leifman,Genady Beryozkin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FM-ChangeNet 提出了一种基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的路径监督变化检测框架，将双时相变化推理重新建模为特征空间中的连续传输过程，而非传统的静态端点对比。该方法通过学习时间条件速度场来实现路径监督，并在三个遥感变化检测基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法（如基于孪生网络的 FC-Siam、IFNet、SNUNet 及基于 Transformer 的 BIT、ChangeFormer 等）普遍存在一个根本局限：仅通过对最终变化掩码进行端点监督来推断变化，将双时相观测视为静态快照进行比较，无法显式建模从前一时相到后一时相的过渡过程。这种局限在渐进式结构演变、跨分辨率差异和空间错位场景下尤为突出。虽然扩散模型等生成式方法尝试缓解该问题，但仍依赖随机采样且未显式刻画转换路径。因此，本文提出核心问题：能否将变化检测建模为学习变换过程本身，而非仅在端点检测差异？

Method: 1. **问题重新定义**：将 CD 建模为特征空间传输问题，通过时间条件速度场 $\hat{v}_\theta(z_t, t)$ 建模 $f^0$ 到 $f^1$ 的连续转换，$dz_t/dt = v_\theta(z_t, t)$，$z_0=f^0$，$z_1=f^1$。\n2. **多尺度特征提取**：使用共享 ViT 编码器提取层级特征 $\\{f_s^0\\}$ 和 $\\{f_s^1\\}$，在各尺度构造插值状态 $z_t^{(s)} = (1-t)f_s^0 + tf_s^1$。\n3. **跨时相对齐**：在最深尺度使用对称交叉注意力融合双时相特征，得到对齐的粗特征初始化。\n4. **时间条件多尺度解码器**：通过 MLP 将 $t$ 映射为时间嵌入 $e_t$，以从粗到细的方式递归解码，在每级尺度预测速度场。\n5. **基于速度的变化表示**：计算通道级速度幅度 $M = \\|\hat{v}^{(1)}\\|_2$，使用验证集百分位数进行归一化，与方向信息和解码器特征结合生成分割 logits。\n6. **联合训练目标**：$\\mathcal{L} = \\lambda_{\\text{flow}}\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{flow}} + \\lambda_{\\text{cons}}\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{cons}} + \\lambda_{\\text{tv}}\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{tv}} + \\lambda_{\\text{mask}}\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{mask}}$，包含流匹配损失（多尺度速度场回归）、一致性损失（双向端点重建）、TV 正则化（空间平滑）、以及 CE+Dice 分割损失。\n7. **理论分析**：证明了四个命题——规范传输场定理、流匹配目标最优性、"变化能量"原则（速度幅度可作为局部变化线索）以及路径监督相对于端点监督的严格约束优势（$\\mathcal{S}_{\\text{path}} \\subset \\mathcal{S}_{\\text{end}}$）。同时证明了线性插值路径是欧氏几何下的最小动能传输桥。

Result: **主要性能**：在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD 和 DSIFN-CD 三个基准上均取得最优结果：LEVIR-CD F1=92.45%、IoU=85.96%、OA=99.24%；WHU-CD F1=95.44%、IoU=91.28%、OA=99.66%；DSIFN-CD F1=88.96%、IoU=80.12%、OA=95.61%，全面超越 CNN-based、Transformer-based、Mamba 及 Diffusion-based 方法。\n\n**关键消融实验**：\n- 匹配容量对比实验中，FM-ChangeNet 显著优于静态差分、无时间条件、端点特征回归、直接融合预测及仅掩码监督等变体，证实增益来源于路径监督机制本身而非架构容量。\n- 插值路径鲁棒性：非线性插值（$\\alpha(t)=t^2$、$3t^2-2t^3$）和学习插值均保持竞争力；固定中点 $t=0.5$ 性能显著下降，证实连续路径约束的必要性。\n- 时间采样点数量 $K$ 增至 4 时收益饱和。\n- 速度幅度的"变化能量"作为独立变化线索具有强判别力（仅 $M_{\\text{norm}}$ 仍能产生有效检测）。\n\n**效率**：11.23M 参数、17.46G FLOPs，推理仅需 27.8ms/对，三个随机种子下标准差均 ≤0.30%，稳定性优异。

Conclusion: FM-ChangeNet 通过将遥感变化检测重新表述为特征空间中的路径监督传输问题，引入基于流匹配的时间条件速度场建模，提供了比传统端点对比更密集、结构化的监督信号。速度幅度作为可解释的"变化能量"表示，在光照变化和空间错位等干扰下展现了鲁棒的局部化能力。该框架在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD 和 DSIFN-CD 上均达到当前最优水平，同时保持了紧凑的模型尺寸和高效推理速度，验证了显式建模时相演化过程相对于隐式端点对比的根本优势。局限在于当前为确定性模型，未来工作将扩展到多时相序列、不确定性估计及多模态融合（如 SAR 或文本元数据）。

Abstract: We present FM-ChangeNet, a pathwise-supervised framework for change detection that reformulates bi-temporal reasoning as continuous transport in feature space rather than static endpoint comparison. Given encoded pre and post-temporal representations, we construct intermediate latent states and learn a time-conditioned velocity field $\hat{v}_\theta(z_t,t)$ along the transformation trajectory. This pathwise formulation constrains the predictor over a continuum of intermediate states, providing a denser and less ambiguous supervision signal than conventional endpoint-only segmentation and enabling the model to capture temporal evolution explicitly. The learned velocity field is not only a transport mechanism but also an interpretable representation of change: its magnitude serves as a spatially localized change cue that helps distinguish true structural variation from nuisance effects such as illumination shifts and spatial misalignment. We develop a hierarchical multi-scale architecture with cross-temporal alignment, time-conditioned coarse-to-fine flow decoding, and a unified objective that couples flow supervision, trajectory consistency, spatial regularization, and segmentation loss. Experiments on remote sensing benchmarks show that the proposed framework produces more structured and robust change representations while achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [639] [AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Physical Design QoR Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04758)
*Shuo Ren,Zijin Cheng,Yaohui Han,Libo Shen,Leilei Jin,Wanting Tian,Rongliang Fu,Chao Wang,Bei Yu,Tsung-Yi Ho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgenticPD 是一个面向物理设计（PD）质量（QoR）优化的阶段感知多智能体框架。它由一个 Judge Agent 负责在优化树中导航分支决策，由四个阶段专用 Agent（FP/PL/CTS/RT）利用阶段级局部工具和检查点复用机制做出局部决策。所有候选均在 post-route signoff 处评估，避免了每次试验都重跑整个 EDA 流程的开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 物理设计 QoR 优化代价高昂——一次评估需要运行完整 EDA 流程，且阶段间存在强依赖（早期决策会影响后续阶段）。2. 现有方法存在两类局限：黑盒调参器（如 AutoTuner、PPATuner）将 PD 流程视为扁平的输入-输出映射，不利用中间状态；基于 LLM 的脚本生成系统（如 ORFS-Agent、ChatEDA）以一次性脚本生成为主，不适合多阶段、状态依赖的决策任务。3. 因此需要一种能将 PD 优化建模为多阶段结构化决策问题、且能复用中间检查点的智能体框架。

Method: 1. **优化树（Optimization Tree）**：将优化历史组织为有根树，根节点为综合后设计，每次阶段执行创建一个节点；支持从任意先前中间节点分支（Branching），复用 Bef(b) 阶段的检查点结果，仅重跑 b 及 Aft(b) 阶段。2. **Judge Agent**：基于 LLM + 系统提示 + Harness Skill 构建，接收由 Observation Tool 计算的自适应画像（含探索平衡 E(n) 和阶段瓶颈 B(s)），输出分支决策 D_k=(分支节点 n̂_k, 分支阶段 b_k, 阶段提示 h_k)。3. **Stage Agents**：四个阶段专用智能体（FP/PL/CTS/RT），各自配备 PD Skill，定义可调参数（符合 IEEE CEDA METRICS2.1 标准）、后端执行接口和阶段级反馈；输入上下文 ctx_s 包含上游 QoR、跨迭代经验与 Judge 提示。4. **Agent Harness**：包含 Observation Tool（计算自适应画像并生成分层树快照以控制 token 使用）、Orchestrator Tool（将决策分派给下游 Stage Agents）和 PD Skills。5. **总体算法**：外层循环中 Judge 选分支 → Orchestrator 复用上游 → Stage Agents 顺序执行并反馈；更新优化树与历史；以时序为主、面积/功耗为守门的 Pareto-dominance 规则更新全局最优。

Result: 1. 在 SkyWater 130nm HD 与 ASAP 7nm 两个工艺节点上、AES/ibex/JPEG 三个设计上以 20 次迭代预算进行评估。2. 相比 Vanilla LLM（同一 LLM 后端的扁平单智能体），AgenticPD 在 9 对对比中有 7 对时序更优，JPEG ASAP7 上达到正的 post-route WNS（时序收敛），几何均值改进为：性能 2.4%、面积 2.2%、功耗 1.1%。3. 相比 OpenROAD 默认配置、AutoTuner 和 ORFS-Agent，AgenticPD 在全部 6 个基准上均取得最佳 post-route WNS；典型改进如 JPEG ASAP7 上 WNS 从 −10.0 ps（AutoTuner）提升到 +50.6 ps，功耗与面积保持竞争力。4. 收敛分析显示在 8–14 次迭代内三项指标即可收敛到最终值的 20% 以内；分支阶段分布较均衡（FP 28.1%、CTS 27.2%、RT 23.7%、PL 21.1%）。5. 由于压缩的观察画像与固定大小上下文，峰值 prompt 仅 43K tokens，远低于现代 LLM 上下文窗口上限。

Conclusion: AgenticPD 通过将 PD QoR 优化建模为围绕阶段边界的树搜索，结合 Judge Agent 的全局导航与 Stage Agents 的局部决策、以及中间检查点复用机制，在时序指标上同时超越了扁平 LLM 智能体和此前 SOTA 的黑盒/LLM 调参器，并在功耗与面积上保持竞争力。该工作表明针对 PD 优化问题结构定制的智能体架构（而非仅对 LLM 调优）能带来实质性收益。

Abstract: Physical design quality-of-results~(QoR) optimization is hard and expensive. Choices made at one stage can help or hurt later stages. Each evaluation requires a costly EDA run through the full flow. While existing methods still treat optimization as flat parameter tuning or a LLM-based script generation task, we present AgenticPD, a stage-aware agentic framework for physical design QoR optimization. Instead of re-running the full flow after every trial, AgenticPD is organized around the stage boundaries of the physical design flow, where a Judge Agent navigates the search and stage-specialized agents make local decisions within their own stage using stage-local tools. Additionally, the agent harness in AgenticPD provides structured observations, execution history, and agent context management. As a result, the system can branch from prior intermediate states and reuse checkpoints to continue the optimization procedure, and every candidate is evaluated at the post-route signoff. Across these baselines, AgenticPD achieves strong post-route timing while remaining competitive in power and area.

</details>


### [640] [CARL: Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Planning with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04854)
*Qiuyi Qi,Jinjian Zhang,Mutian Bao,Tian Liang,Guocong Li,Dongnan Liu,Wei Zhou,Jie Liu,Ming Kong,Linjian Mo,Feng Zhang,Qiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CARL提出了一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过比较模型在有约束和无约束输入下的输出分布差异（KL散度）作为奖励信号，从内部增强LLM对约束的敏感度，无需依赖外部求解器或大型模型，在多个规划基准上显著优于RFT基线和先进推理模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在规划任务中经常违反任务约束，主要原因是缺乏系统性的约束信息整合机制。现有方法依赖外部工具或任务分解，未能增强模型内在的约束意识。作者旨在从根本上提升LLM的内在约束感知能力。

Method: 核心方法是将总奖励分解为任务奖励R_task（0/1指示函数）和约束感知奖励R_CA（模型在完整输入与去除约束的输入下输出分布的KL散度）。框架兼容多种RL算法（GRPO/PPO/DPO），并提出了CA-DPO变体通过约束消融构造偏好对。使用Qwen3-8B作为基础模型，在8块A100 GPU上训练。

Result: 在BlocksWorld、TravelPlanner和T-Eval三个基准上：Qwen3-8B在TravelPlanner的最终通过率从2.2%提升至56.1%（绝对提升53.9%），超过o1-preview（10.0%）和DeepSeek-R1（12.2%）。归因分析显示CARL显著提升约束相关token的注意力得分。CARL兼容PPO、GRPO、DPO等多种RL算法，对奖励权重α和约束提取质量均具有鲁棒性，在噪声奖励下也保持优势。

Conclusion: CARL建立了可扩展的端到端约束感知规划路径，无需外部求解器或顶级模型，能够在8B规模模型上实现与依赖GPT-4的智能体方法相当甚至更优的规划能力，是发展自主、可靠语言智能体的重要技术路径。

Abstract: Despite their strong reasoning capabilities and extensive world knowledge, Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently generate plans that violate task constraints, undermining their reliability in real-world applications. This deficiency arises from a lack of systematic mechanisms to incorporate constraint information during the generation process. While existing approaches attempt to mitigate this by relying on external tools or task decomposition, they fail to enhance the model's intrinsic constraint awareness. To address this, we propose Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning (CARL), a novel RL framework designed to strengthen LLMs' intrinsic focus on constraints. CARL introduces a constraint-aware reward by comparing the model's output distributions under constrained and unconstrained inputs, encouraging constraint focus and penalizing neglect. Compatible with various RL frameworks and requiring no external solvers or top models, CARL enables scalable, end-to-end constraint-aware planning. Extensive experiments on BlocksWorld, TravelPlanner, and T-Eval demonstrate that CARL significantly outperforms standard Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) baselines and state-of-the-art reasoning models, exhibiting a markedly increased focus on constraints.

</details>


### [641] [Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04907)
*Mohammed Saim Ahmed Quadri,Yunzhe Xue,Justin W. Ady,Usman Roshan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Medi-Gemma 提出了一种用于伤口病理分诊的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）架构，通过解耦临床感知与数据编排，采用多阶段流水线设计，以解决大语言模型在临床高风险场景中的结构化幻觉、确定性推理不足和检索遗漏等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗等高风险临床场景中部署大语言模型面临三大核心挑战：LLM 的结构性幻觉、对结构化表格患者数据的弱确定性推理，以及向量检索中的遗漏问题。现有系统难以同时保证可追溯推理、数据保真度与安全合规性，亟需一种将生成推理与确定性数据访问相分离的架构模式。

Method: 该系统采用由 ClinicalOrchestrator 集中协调的多阶段解耦流水线：(1) DataManager 通过类型强制转换（type coercion）清洗非结构化 EMR 数据，避免数据库编译崩溃；(2) 层次化 IntentRouter 将自然语言查询路由到确定性分析路径（PandasQueryEngine）或患者特异性推理路径（ClinicalRAGEngine，使用 CPU 优化的向量存储）；(3) 核心创新 Ground Truth Injection Module 拦截患者特异性查询，提取数值识别 token，通过 Pandas 查询结构化数据，检索最新验证的临床状态，并将该快照作为覆盖上下文块嵌入 LLM 提示中；(4) ProtocolManager 将临床术语映射到固定的循证风险路径以强制安全合规；(5) SafetyVerifier 短语过滤器防止输出违反规则。

Result: 验证表明，该架构有效消除了语义上下文漂移（semantic context drift），防止了数据库编译崩溃，并显著提升了对后端临床数据仓库的事实遵从性（factual adherence）。通过确定性组件保障了结构化数据保真度和检索基础。

Conclusion: 在需要结构化数据保真度、检索基础和确定性安全保障的 LLM 临床决策支持场景中，Medi-Gemma 提供了一种更安全的架构范式，将生成式推理与确定性数据访问及安全防护层有效分离，实现了可追溯且符合循证医学的临床决策支持。

Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in high-stakes clinical settings remains limited by structural hallucinations, weak deterministic reasoning over tabular patient data, and omissions in vector retrieval. This paper presents the architecture and validation of Medi-Gemma, a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for wound pathology triage and workflow automation. The platform introduces a decoupled framework that separates clinical perception from data orchestration while preserving traceable reasoning. Medi-Gemma uses a multi-stage pipeline coordinated by a centralized ClinicalOrchestrator. Data requests are handled without generative inference by a DataManager that cleans unstructured Electronic Medical Record (EMR) files through type coercion. Natural language queries are processed by a hierarchical IntentRouter, which routes requests to deterministic analytics paths executed by a PandasQueryEngine or to patient-specific reasoning managed by a ClinicalRAGEngine using a CPU-optimized vector store. A key contribution is the Ground Truth Injection Module, which intercepts patient-specific queries, extracts numeric identification tokens, queries the structured dataframe via Pandas, retrieves the latest validated clinical state, and embeds this snapshot as an overriding context block in the LLM prompt before generation. Safety compliance is enforced by a deterministic ProtocolManager that maps clinical terminology to fixed evidence-based risk pathways, while a SafetyVerifier phrase filter prevents output rule violations. Validation shows that this architecture eliminates semantic context drift, prevents database compilation crashes, and improves factual adherence to backend clinical repositories. These results support Medi-Gemma as a safer pattern for LLM-based clinical decision support where structured data fidelity, retrieval grounding, and deterministic safeguards are essential.

</details>


### [642] [STAPO: Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04963)
*Qiuyi Qi,Tian Liang,Mutian Bao,Jinjian Zhang,Dongnan Liu,Wei Zhou,Linjian Mo,Ming Kong,Jie Liu,Feng Zhang,Qiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STAPO是一种针对LLM智能体长视野任务的分层组强化学习框架，通过提出"归一化熵"指标来精确定位由"轨迹忽视"导致的异常步骤，并结合"轨迹感知奖励"和"轨迹独立惩罚"进行选择性优化，在ALFWorld、WebShop和搜索增强QA任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长视野任务中，稀疏和延迟奖励导致"轨迹忽视"（trajectory neglect）问题——智能体在中间步骤失去对任务目标和交互历史的关注，产生低质量动作。现有方法使用Shannon熵作为不确定性信号，但混淆了状态固有复杂度与智能体置信度，无法可靠识别决策可靠性问题。

Method: 1. **归一化熵（Normalized Entropy）**：在锚点状态组内对Shannon熵进行组内标准化（z-score），通过聚合同一状态在不同采样轨迹中的行为来衡量置信度偏差，解耦状态复杂度与智能体置信度；2. **异常定位**：使用IQR方法（λ=1.5）根据归一化熵动态识别异常步骤；3. **选择性优化机制**：对异常步骤施加"轨迹感知奖励"（完整prompt与遮蔽轨迹的prompt之间的KL散度，鼓励模型利用轨迹信息）和"轨迹独立惩罚"（约束遮蔽prompt下的策略接近参考策略，防止奖励黑客）；4. **分层优势估计**：结合episode级优势（A^E）和step级优势（A^S）进行信用分配。

Result: 1. 在ALFWorld上Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达到96.9%成功率（vs GiGPO 90.8%），WebShop上1.5B模型达到69.0%成功率（vs GiGPO 65.0%）；2. 搜索增强QA任务中平均提升约1%，归因于该任务视野较短；3. 异常步骤比例与性能负相关，STAPO显著降低异常比例；4. 可泛化至DAPO框架（WebShop达80.2%），适用于Llama3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-14B；5. 冷启动场景下（LLaMA-3.1-8B在WebShop）能突破零奖励僵局；6. 训练开销仅增加约5.7%，远低于扩大组大小的成本。

Conclusion: STAPO通过归一化熵精确定位轨迹忽视问题，并结合轨迹感知奖励与轨迹独立惩罚进行选择性优化，有效缓解了长视野任务中的低质量动作问题。实验证明该方法在多种模型规模和架构上均具有一致性和鲁棒性，为智能体训练提供了一种高效且模型无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is the dominant paradigm for training Large Language Model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, sparse and delayed rewards often lead to trajectory neglect, in which agents lose focus on the task goal and interaction history at intermediate steps. Prior work has explored step-level supervision using Shannon-entropy-based uncertainty signals, which conflate inherent state complexity with agent confidence and therefore provide unreliable estimates of decision reliability. To address this issue, we propose normalized entropy, which measures confidence deviations relative to an agent's average behavior under a given state, thereby strengthening the association between low-quality actions and trajectory neglect. Building on this insight, we introduce Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (STAPO), a hierarchical group-based RL framework. STAPO leverages normalized entropy to locate outlier steps associated with trajectory neglect and optimizes them via a joint mechanism of trajectory-aware reward and trajectory-independent penalty, enhancing trajectory awareness while preserving training stability. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-Augmented QA demonstrate that STAPO achieves state-of-the-art performance while substantially alleviating trajectory neglect, validating its effectiveness and robustness for agentic tasks.

</details>


### [643] [Quantum-Inspired Harmonic Decision Models: A Computational Framework for Music Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05007)
*Josef Pavlíček,Petra Pavlíčková,Martin Molhanec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种量子启发式和声生成框架：先并行探索候选和弦，再用调性和声规则优化。实验表明它能提升稳定性和功能组织，但自然度仍强烈依赖风格语境，方法目前属于初步验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统和声生成需要在大量候选和弦中权衡功能、稳定性、密度、风格等多重约束。论文希望借助量子启发式思想中“并行候选”和“干涉筛选”的表达方式，构建一种更适合复杂音乐决策的计算框架。

Method: 作者将旋律配和声表述为组合优化问题：先通过量子启发式/干涉式机制并行考虑多种候选和弦序列，再用基于调性和声规则的经典优化过程筛选与修正结果，以提升结构连贯性、功能组织与风格合理性。实验在若干音乐片段上进行，并结合定量指标与专家评价。

Result: 定量结果显示，优化阶段能显著降低和弦密度、提高和声稳定性，并改善功能组织。但专家评价表明，更高的和声复杂度并不必然带来更自然的听感，风格语境对结果接受度具有关键影响。

Conclusion: 该研究认为，和声生成可被建模为受约束搜索空间中的结构化决策过程；量子启发式的干涉搜索机制与传统调性和声优化结合，有潜力用于音乐等创造性领域中的复杂决策建模，但目前结论仍属初步。

Abstract: This paper introduces a quantum-inspired computational framework for harmonic decision-making in music. The proposed approach formulates harmonization as an optimization problem within a structured combinatorial space, where multiple candidate chord sequences are evaluated under interacting musical constraints. The model combines an interference-based harmonization stage with a classical optimization procedure grounded in tonal harmony. The quantum-inspired component enables the parallel consideration of multiple harmonic alternatives, while the classical stage refines the resulting sequences to ensure structural coherence and stylistic plausibility. The framework is evaluated on selected musical examples, including Autumn Leaves and It's a Long Way to Tipperary. Quantitative analysis shows that the optimization stage significantly reduces chord density, increases harmonic stability, and improves functional organization. At the same time, expert evaluation highlights the importance of stylistic context, demonstrating that increased harmonic complexity is not always perceived as more natural. The results suggest that harmonic generation can be interpreted as a structured decision-making process in a constrained search space. The proposed approach provides a computational model that integrates domain-specific knowledge with an interference-based search mechanism. Although preliminary, this work indicates that quantum-inspired methods may offer a useful framework for modeling complex decision processes in creative domains such as music. The proposed framework contributes to ongoing research on quantum-inspired models of cognition and decision-making in complex biological and creative systems.

</details>


### [644] [Toward Trustworthy Large Language Model Agents in Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05055)
*Hadi Hasan,Safaa Salman,Adam Tai Abou Dargham,Ammar Mohanna,Ali Chehab*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CareConnect是一个面向医疗预约调度场景的安全优先型LLM对话代理，通过确定性预过滤意图分类、模式约束的工具编排和混合RAG-工具执行管线，在680个测试场景中实现91.8%任务完成率和96.0%安全合规率，单次预约成本仅$0.0324（较人工降低23倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗预约调度长期面临人工协调效率低、遗留系统碎片化和管理开销高等运营瓶颈；现有LLM医疗系统多聚焦于临床决策支持与诊断推理，缺少针对运营工作流的事务完整性保障和安全约束机制，难以直接部署到预约调度等需要高可靠性、事务正确性的真实场景。

Method: CareConnect架构包含四大核心组件：(1) 基于GPT-4o的Agent Orchestrator，通过原生function calling实现多轮对话与工具执行循环（最多10轮）；(2) 规则化意图分类器在LLM调用前对紧急情况、医疗建议请求和诊断意图进行确定性模式匹配（支持英/阿双语），触发短路机制并返回预定义响应；(3) 八个领域特定工具（可用性检索、预约、修改、取消、用户预约查询、医生目录、通信确认、知识检索）通过严格JSON Schema强制参数验证与状态一致性检查；(4) 基于ChromaDB+text-embedding-3-large的RAG管线（512-token分块、top-5检索），索引设施文档、医生档案和化验准备指南。系统同时提供Web/WhatsApp文本接口和基于Whisper/TTS的语音接口，后端采用FastAPI+SQLAlchemy+Pydantic，Docker Compose三容器部署。

Result: 在680个合成测试场景（标准工作流160、修改130、信息检索130、安全150、边缘110）中：整体任务完成率91.8%（624/680），其中安全合规子集达96.0%；工具调用准确率94.8%（3283/3462），所有错误均由Schema验证拦截未污染数据库；中位延迟2.2s（p90=4.2s，p99=8.7s），RAG最优top-k=5时准确率92.8%；单次预约成本$0.0324，相比人工接待员基线（$0.75，85%成功率，9-5工作时间，20次/小时上限）实现23倍成本降低并支持24/7无限扩展。失败主要集中在约束冲突解决（37.5%）、长对话上下文漂移（32.1%）和跨周相对日期歧义（19.6%）。

Conclusion: 研究证明，通过精心限定范围并采用确定性安全机制保障的LLM代理可以可靠地自动化复杂医疗运营工作流。核心创新在于：LLM调用前的确定性意图分类、嵌入完整性检查的模式约束工具编排、以及将信息检索与事务操作分离的混合RAG-工具管线。局限在于评估基于合成基准，真实部署仍需IRB临床验证、HL7 FHIR系统集成、患者可用性研究及纵向信任研究；未来工作将开展受控患者试点、多模态视觉安全机制、偏好学习个性化调度以及约束满足编程在多约束协商中的应用。

Abstract: Healthcare appointment scheduling remains a persistent operational bottleneck, driven by manual coordination, fragmented legacy systems, and high administrative overhead. These inefficiencies constrain provider availability and degrade patient access to care. This paper presents CareConnect, a safety-first conversational agent for healthcare logistics automation that leverages large language model (LLM) function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and layered deterministic safety guardrails. The system orchestrates eight domain-specific tools to support appointment booking, modification, cancellation, and facility information retrieval, while enforcing strict scope constraints that prohibit medical advice or diagnosis. Safety-critical situations are handled through deterministic short-circuit mechanisms for emergency detection and medical intent refusal. We evaluate CareConnect on a comprehensive benchmark of 680 task-oriented scenarios spanning end-to-end workflows, multi-turn interactions, and edge cases. Experimental results demonstrate a 91.8% task completion rate with a median per-request latency of 2.2 seconds, 96.0% safety compliance on the dedicated safety-critical evaluation subset, and an average operational cost of $0.0324 per appointment, yielding a significant cost reduction compared to manual human scheduling. These findings show that carefully scoped and rigorously safeguarded LLM-based agents can reliably automate complex healthcare operational workflows while maintaining safety guarantees and achieving substantial cost efficiency. The source code and system implementation are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [645] [Diffusion-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Delayed Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05064)
*Junqi Tu,Zejiao Liu,Fangfei Li,Yang Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DUPO方法，使用扩散模型建模随机观测延迟下延迟状态消息与真实状态之间的多模态后验分布，并基于价值不确定性对延迟策略进行加权，以应对随机MDP中延迟反馈导致的性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中强化学习常面临通信和计算延迟，现有方法（无记忆法、状态增广法、状态预测法）多假设可恢复马尔可夫性或进行单点状态估计，但忽略了随机延迟在随机MDP中引入的延迟状态与真实状态之间的本质差异，且这种差异随延迟增长被放大，导致最优策略性能下降。

Method: 1) 理论证明：定理1证明延迟消息对真实状态的后验协方差随延迟长度线性放大，定理2证明单点状态估计策略的性能差距与延迟长度成正比；2) 扩散状态估计器：用条件扩散模型学习p(s_t|M_t)，刻画延迟消息到无延迟状态的多模态后验分布；3) 不确定性加权延迟SAC：对扩散采样得到的多个状态估计Q值方差，用逆方差加权对基础Actor输出进行重加权，实现延迟自适应策略；4) Critic基于无延迟转移训练，Actor使用加权SAC代理目标进行更新。

Result: 在MuJoCo-v4五个连续控制任务（Ant、HalfCheetah、Hopper、Walker2d、Swimmer）上，针对ΔT_max∈{5,10,25}的随机延迟设置，DUPO在多数环境中取得最佳或近最佳归一化性能，优势随延迟增大更加显著（如HalfCheetah-v4在ΔT_max=25下达15.96倍DC/AC基线）。消融实验表明：扩散多模态采样优于单模态高斯采样和MC Dropout采样；性能对延迟分布类型（均匀、高斯、泊松）不敏感；超参数β和后验采样数N在合理范围内鲁棒。

Conclusion: DUPO通过扩散模型显式建模随机延迟诱导的状态多模态后验并以不确定性加权策略更新，理论上克服了单点估计的次优性下界，实现在中长随机延迟场景下稳定且优于现有基线的性能，为延迟环境中的RL部署提供了原则性解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning in real world environments often suffers from severe performance degradation due to delayed feedback. Existing approaches typically mitigate performance degradation caused by observation delays by constructing augmented states or predicting the true states. However, these methods often overlook the inherent discrepancy between delayed state and true states induced by stochastic MDP. We theoretically prove the existence of such a discrepancy and show that it leads to the degradation of the optimal policy. To address this challenge, we propose Diffusion Guided Uncertainty Aware Delayed Policy Optimization (DUPO). Our method explicitly models the relationship between delayed state message and the current state using a diffusion model, and leverages the resulting discrepancy estimates to weight delayed policies. Extensive experiments on continuous robotic control tasks with multiple stochastic delays demonstrate that DUPO consistently outperforms existing methods and remains effective even under long and random delay scenarios.

</details>


### [646] [ASSEMCAD: Production-Ready CAD Assembly Generation from Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05123)
*Yurui Dong,Shu Zou,Siqi Li,Nianchen Deng,Hongbin Zhou,Xuemeng Yang,Pinlong Cai,Licheng Wen,Xinyu Cai,Botian Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AssemCAD 框架，将自然语言转换为生产级 CAD 装配体。通过公理化装配规范、端口-配合基装配库及确定性验证流水线，显著优于以代码为中心的基线方法，在 AssemBench 基准上 SR 与 APR 均达到最高水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-CAD 方法主要面向单零件生成，难以处理装配体所涉及的多组件协同推理、功能接口、装配关系与物理一致性。直接生成可执行 CAD 代码无法保证装配体的机械有效性与可复用性，因此需要将装配体生成从代码生成问题重构为可验证的工程流水线。

Method: AssemCAD 包含三阶段：(1) 语义分解阶段，由 LLM 生成公理化装配规范（含类型化零件、几何支撑的端口、可执行配合及 62 条工程公理，涵盖 10 个 MECE 类别），采用有界修复循环保证结构合法；(2) 组件构建阶段，基于端口-配合机制的 CadQuery 扩展库（含 13 个内置参数化工厂及 cq_warehouse、cq_gears 适配器），通过三沙箱验证（含端口-几何一致性检查）支持开放世界组件按需合成；(3) 几何验证阶段，通过闭合形式配合变换（避免迭代求解器非确定性）、SafeUnion 防断裂复合体、配合类型感知的冲突分类及公理可追溯性检查，实现确定性、可审计的装配体验证。

Result: 在 AssemBench（120 个装配实例）上，文本设定下 AssemCAD 取得 SR 89.17%、APR 87.50%，均为最优；在图文设定下取得 SR 84.17%、APR 82.50%，同样领先。集成 Claude-4.8 后 APR 从 0.8 提升至 82.5，展示出对不同基础模型的后置无关性。此外，论文从理论上证明了 Chamfer Distance 在装配评估中缺乏结构可辨识性与排序一致性，因而不适用于装配质量评测。

Conclusion: AssemCAD 通过将公理化装配语义与确定性几何执行相结合，将 Text-to-CAD 从孤立零件生成拓展至生产级机械装配设计。其核心贡献在于将装配关系显式绑定工程公理，通过端口-配合抽象与验证流水线为下游工程制造提供了可解释、可复用、字节级确定的设计产物。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models and programmatic CAD have significantly improved Text-to-CAD generation for individual parts. However, production-ready mechanical assembly generation remains largely unsolved. Unlike single-part modeling, assemblies require coordinated reasoning over multiple components, functional interfaces, assembly relations, engineering principles, and physical consistency. Consequently, directly generating executable CAD code is insufficient for constructing mechanically valid and reusable assemblies. We present AssemCAD, an axiom-grounded framework for production-ready CAD assembly generation from natural language. Instead of representing an assembly as monolithic CAD code, AssemCAD first constructs an axiomatic Assembly Specification consisting of typed parts, geometry-backed ports, executable mates, and engineering axioms. Each assembly relation is explicitly grounded in one or more engineering principles, making the resulting specification interpretable, reusable, and verifiable. To realize this specification, AssemCAD introduces a port- and mate-based CAD assembly library that executes symbolic assembly relations through deterministic mate transformations and validates declared interfaces using concrete B-Rep geometric evidence. Built on this representation and library, AssemCAD further supports on-demand synthesis of reusable parametric component factories for both standard and open-world geometries. Experiments on AssemBench show that AssemCAD substantially improves assembly preservation and physical validity over code-centric CAD generation baselines, while generalizing across different foundation-model backbones. By combining axiom-grounded assembly reasoning with deterministic geometric execution, AssemCAD extends Text-to-CAD from isolated part generation toward production-ready mechanical assembly design.

</details>


### [647] [TacReasoner: A Dynamic Tactile-Language Framework for Interactive Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05131)
*Kailin Lyu,Di Wu,Long Xiao,Jianning Zeng,Jianwei He,Chang Lin,Lianyu Hu,Lin Shu,Jie Hao,Ce Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了TacReasoner，一个面向真实场景的动态触觉-语言推理框架。其核心贡献包括：动态感知触觉编码器（Dynamic-aware Tactile Encoder）、首个触觉思维链数据集TouchCoT-10k，以及动态触觉评估基准DynTAC-Bench。该框架在仅有7B参数的情况下，在多项任务上超越了14B的VTV-LLM模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉-语言模型存在两个核心局限：(1) 缺乏对动态触觉信号时序演化的显式建模，无法捕捉接触过程中的形变传播、剪切累积和滑动变化；(2) 基于静态属性和固定模板的训练范式导致语义幻觉问题，模型容易过拟合于传感器特定的表面模式而非通用物理规律，难以在真实场景中实现可靠推理。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **动态感知触觉编码器**：采用解耦设计，分别通过冻结的VTV编码器提取外观特征、通过轻量级时间编码器建模帧间形变（利用问题文本嵌入作为条件信号进行问题引导的时间注意力），再通过交叉注意力融合外观与时序特征；(2) **TouchCoT-10k数据集构建**：基于VTV-150K原始数据，通过标准化探索流程（包括按压至最大接触和滑动阶段）采集触觉视频，利用DeepSeek生成结构化思维链推理，并经人工审核过滤；(3) **两阶段训练范式**：Stage I使用VTV-150K指令数据训练触觉-语言适配器实现触觉-文本对齐；Stage II在TouchCoT-10K上使用LoRA进行端到端监督微调，激活推理能力。

Result: 在VTV-150K数据集上，7B模型平均准确率达66.7%，超越VTV-LLM-7B 6.3%，并超越VTV-LLM-14B（62.1%）；14B版本进一步达到68.6%。在弹性（+9.24%）和摩擦（+1.96%）等动态属性预测上提升显著。在动态感知推理任务上，RFOR任务从43%提升至68%（+25%），OCSE任务从46%提升至53%（+7%）。消融实验验证了DynEncoder（平均提升4.6%）和TouchCoT-10K SFT的必要性，移除任一阶段均会导致性能大幅下降。

Conclusion: TacReasoner通过联合优化数据（思维链数据集）与架构（动态感知编码器），有效缓解了动态触觉信号建模不足和语义幻觉问题，实现了真实场景下可靠的触觉推理。7B参数模型超越14B基线，证明了方法的高效性。未来工作将聚焦于交互多样性、跨传感器/跨场景泛化以及真实机器人系统部署。

Abstract: Among the five primary human senses, tactile is arguably the most fundamental to survival, as it enables the perception of physical contact and interaction in real-world environments. In this paper, we explore two key challenges of integrating tactile sensing into intelligent systems for multimodal reasoning: (i) insufficient modeling of dynamic tactile signals, which restricts reasoning over temporally evolving properties, and (ii) hallucination in tactile foundation models caused by the absence of explicit reasoning mechanisms, leading to unstable real-world inference. To address these challenges, we propose TacReasoner, a dynamic tactile-language framework for interactive reasoning in real-world scenarios. First, TacReasoner incorporates a Dynamic-aware Tactile Encoder to enhance the perception and representation of dynamic tactile signals. More importantly, we introduce TouchCoT-10k, the first tactile chain-of-thought dataset for structured reasoning over tactile inputs. Upon it, we establish DynTac-Bench to systematically evaluate dynamic tactile perception and real-world commonsense reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TacReasoner achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Notably, despite using only 7B parameters, TacReasoner outperforms the 14B VTV-LLM model on most subtasks, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency in tactile commonsense reasoning.

</details>


### [648] [DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05147)
*Xin Cheng,Xingkai Yu,Chenze Shao,Jiashi Li,Yunfan Xiong,Yi Qian,Jiaqi Zhu,Shirong Ma,Xiaokang Zhang,Jiasheng Ye,Qinyu Chen,Chengqi Deng,Jiping Yu,Damai Dai,Zhengyan Zhang,Yixuan Wei,Yixuan Tan,Wenkai Yang,Runxin Xu,Yu Wu,Zhean Xu,Xuanyu Wang,Muyang Chen,Rui Tian,Xiao Bi,Zhewen Hao,Shaoyuan Chen,Huanqi Cao,Wentao Zhang,Anyi Xu,Huishuai Zhang,Dongyan Zhao,Wenfeng Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DSpark是一个推测解码框架，通过半自回归生成架构（并行主干+轻量级序列头）和置信度调度的验证机制，解决了并行草稿器因缺乏token间依赖导致的接受率快速衰减，以及在高并发场景下盲目验证带来的吞吐量下降问题。在DeepSeek-V4生产部署中，相比MTP-1基线，per-user生成速度提升60%-85%，并显著扩展了服务的Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码中，现有两类草稿器存在固有局限：(1) 自回归草稿器（如Eagle3）draft延迟与块大小线性相关（O(γ)），被迫使用浅层网络和短块；(2) 并行草稿器（如DFlash）虽将draft延迟降至O(1)，但因各位置独立预测导致多模态碰撞（multi-modal collision），接受率沿块快速衰减（suffix decay）。更关键的是，无论草稿质量如何，固定长度验证在高并发系统中会将batch容量浪费在高拒绝风险的尾部token上，严重降低吞吐量。理想验证长度应同时考虑数据侧（结构化vs开放域）和系统侧（轻载vs重载）两个维度。

Method: DSpark包含两个核心组件：
1. **半自回归生成**：以DFlash为并行主干，仅附加一个轻量级序列头（默认Markov头，低秩分解B=W₁W₂，r=256；或RNN头，带门控循环状态），在保持draft并行性的同时注入块内token间依赖。生成过程遵循P(X|x₀)=∏pₖ(xₖ|x₀,x_{<k})，其中pₖ通过softmax(Uₖ(v)+Bₖ(x₀,x_{<k},v))计算，保持逐token精确概率。
2. **置信度调度验证**：(a) 置信度头输出每位置条件存活概率cₖ=σ(w⊤[hₖ;W₁[x_{k-1}]])，以1−½‖pᵈ−pᵗ‖₁为软标签监督；(b) 提出Sequential Temperature Scaling (STS)进行后验校准，将ECE降至~1%；(c) 硬件感知前缀调度器将验证长度选择建模为全局吞吐量最大化Θ=τ·SPS(B)，通过贪心+早停机制实现因果安全（满足non-anticipating property，保证lossless）。训练损失为加权组合L=α_ce·L_ce+α_tv·L_tv+α_conf·L_conf（权重0.1/0.9/1.0），位置加权wₖ=exp(−(k−1)/γ)强调前缀位置。生产部署中采用异步调度（用两步前的置信度预测截断长度K），适配ZOS和CUDA graph。

Result: **离线基准**（Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B}, Gemma4-12B；数学/代码/聊天9个数据集）：DSpark在所有目标模型和领域上均显著优于Eagle3和DFlash。在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B上，相比Eagle3宏平均接受长度提升30.9%/26.7%/30.0%，相比DFlash提升16.3%/18.4%/18.3%。位置级分析显示DSpark兼具并行模型位置1的高容量优势（如数学上0.93 vs Eagle3 0.81）和自回归模型尾部的稳定性。架构分析表明2层DSpark即可超越5层DFlash基线；γ=15时相对DFlash提升达22%-30%，而序列头延迟开销仅0.2%-1.3%。

**在线生产部署**（DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro预览版，真实用户流量）：(1) Pareto前沿：80 tok/s/user SLA下DSpark吞吐量提升51%（Flash）和52%（Pro）；120 tok/s/user严格SLA下，基线进入低并发区，DSpark可维持有效服务；(2) 匹配吞吐量下per-user生成速度加速60%-85%（Flash）和57%-78%（Pro）；(3) 负载自适应：轻载时验证预算从静态2扩展至4-6 tokens，重载时平滑缩减，避免batch容量浪费；(4) STS校准将ECE从3%-8%降至~1%。

Conclusion: DSpark通过半自回归架构突破了并行草稿的suffix decay瓶颈，通过硬件感知置信度调度突破了固定验证长度的系统效率瓶颈，二者协同将推测解码的Pareto前沿显著外推。其核心贡献在于：(1) 证明"少量自回归即可走很远"——轻量级序列头比单纯加深并行层更具参数效率；(2) 形式化将验证长度选择建模为吞吐量优化问题，并给出因果安全的贪心解法及异步工程适配；(3) 在真实高并发生产环境中验证了价值，开源checkpoint和DeepSpec训练仓库。局限在于复杂查询（低接受率场景）仍需承担完整草稿块的前期开销，未来可引入难度感知的草稿早退机制进一步优化。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving systems. We introduce DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification. To maintain draft quality, DSpark utilizes a semi-autoregressive architecture, coupling a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential module, to introduce intra-block dependency modeling and mitigate suffix decay. To optimize system efficiency, DSpark employs confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically tailoring the verification length for each request based on estimated prefix survival probabilities and engine-specific throughput profiles. On offline benchmarks across diverse domains, DSpark substantially improves the accepted length over state-of-the-art autoregressive and parallel drafters. When deployed within the DeepSeek-V4 serving system under live user traffic, DSpark successfully mitigates verification waste. Compared to the established production baseline (MTP-1), DSpark accelerates per-user generation speeds by 60 to 85 percent at matched throughput levels. More importantly, by preventing severe throughput degradation under strict interactivity constraints, it enables performance tiers that were previously unattainable, shifting the Pareto frontier of our serving system.

</details>


### [649] [The Changing Role of Symbolic Methods in Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05168)
*Jun Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"压缩原理"与"建模-推理权衡",论证显式符号推理并非智能的本质属性,而是在有限计算资源下对简化模型的补偿机制。随着基础模型等富表征技术的崛起,符号方法的角色正从智能系统的"计算引擎"迁移为人类与AI之间的"符号接口"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统计算机科学长期将符号推理视为智能的核心特征,但现代基础模型(如大语言模型)在几乎不依赖显式符号推理的情况下展现出强大能力,引发了符号AI与统计学习范式的长期争论。本文试图超越"如何推理"的技术层面,追问一个更根本的问题:为什么智能系统需要进行显式符号推理?进而解释符号方法在AI中的角色演变。

Method: 本文采用概念分析与理论思辨的方法,围绕一个反复使用的"红绿灯路口"思想实验展开论证:从人类驾驶员依赖红绿灯简化信息,类比到自动驾驶车辆可直接基于富环境模型决策。由此提出两个核心概念:(1)压缩原理(Compression Principle)——每个计算模型都是现实的简化表征,显式符号推理用于补偿建模过程中丢失的信息;(2)建模-推理权衡(Modeling-Reasoning Trade-off)——模型保留的信息越丰富,所需的后续显式符号推理越少。基于有限计算(Bounded Computation)的历史约束与人类有限理性(Simon的bounded rationality)解释符号方法的兴盛,再以富模型时代解释其角色转移。

Result: (1)统一解释了符号AI的历史成功与基础模型的有效性:两者本质上是计算资源在不同阶段(推理vs建模)的不同分配策略;(2)揭示了一个悖论——机器内部对显式符号推理的需求可能持续下降,但人类社会对符号方法的需求反而上升;(3)为形式化方法、可解释AI、AI安全与治理等研究领域提供了新的定位:这些本质上都是"符号接口设计"问题,关注的是人类如何向AI系统表达期望、验证行为并建立信任;(4)提出关键命题:"符号不是智能,而是接口"(Symbols are not intelligence. Symbols are interfaces.)。

Conclusion: 未来AI既不会完全由符号方法主导,也不会让符号方法消失。符号方法的未来在于"迁移"——从智能系统的内部计算核心迁移至人类与机器智能之间的边界层。研究议程应从"符号vs神经"的二元对立,转向同时推进富表征建模与面向人类的符号接口设计,实现机器智能能力与人类理解、监管、协作需求之间的协同。

Abstract: Why do intelligent systems need to perform explicit symbolic reasoning? Computer science has traditionally regarded symbolic reasoning as a defining component of intelligence. Yet the remarkable success of modern foundation models raises a fundamental question: if increasingly capable AI systems can operate with little explicit symbolic reasoning, what role do symbolic methods actually play? This article argues that explicit symbolic reasoning is not a fundamental property of intelligence, but a computational consequence of operating on simplified models of reality. We propose the Compression Principle: every computational model is a simplified representation of reality, and explicit symbolic reasoning compensates for information omitted during model construction. From this principle, we derive the Modeling--Reasoning Trade-off: as computational models preserve richer representations of the world, the need for explicit symbolic reasoning correspondingly decreases. This perspective provides a unified explanation for both the historical success of symbolic methods and the remarkable effectiveness of modern foundation models. Paradoxically, the same development makes symbolic methods increasingly important for humans. As intelligent systems become more capable and more opaque, symbolic representations increasingly serve as interfaces through which humans specify requirements, verify behavior, regulate autonomous systems, and establish trust. We therefore argue that the future of symbolic methods lies not primarily as the computational engine of intelligent systems, but as the symbolic interface between increasingly capable AI systems and the humans who build, govern, and depend upon them.

</details>


### [650] [AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05174)
*Zhiheng Xi,Dingwen Yang,Jiaqi Liu,Jixuan Huang,Honglin Guo,Baodai Huang,Tinggang Chen,Qi Zhang,Zhonghang Lu,Chenyu Liu,Jiajun Sun,Jiazheng Zhang,Dingwei Zhu,Xin Guo,Junzhe Wang,Zhihao Zhang,Yuming Yang,Junjie Ye,Minghe Gao,Dongrui Liu,Jiaming Ji,Guohao Li,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentGym2 是一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体在去理想化真实世界环境中表现的基准框架。它包含 437 个任务，覆盖 27 个领域，包含复杂工具使用、数据分析和深度搜索三大场景，重点考察智能体在噪声、不确定、信息不完整等真实条件下的端到端任务执行能力、工具探索与组合能力以及鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体评估基准大多依赖预打包的工具接口、预先解决的中间步骤以及干净完整的输入，属于简化的理想化环境。这低估了真实部署中普遍存在的不确定性和噪声，以及智能体主动探索环境以发现新工具的需求。因此，亟需一个在去理想化真实世界条件下严格评估 LLM 智能体能力的基准框架。

Method: AgentGym2 采用分层模块化设计，将智能体与工具、环境解耦。其核心方法包括：（1）提供由 27 个基础可组合工具构成的工具箱，覆盖网页浏览、信息检索、文件处理、多模态理解和代码执行五大类，并允许智能体自由访问整个互联网以发现新工具；（2）支持沙箱隔离与异步并行工具调用；（3）从 GitHub、Reddit、Kaggle 等平台采集真实用户需求，通过自动合成、查询增强和人工标注构建任务实例，并采用模型检查与人工审核相结合的多级验证流程保证质量；（4）三大场景（复杂工具使用 182 例、数据分析 57 例、深度搜索 198 例）分别聚焦工具发现与组合、端到端数据清洗与分析、对抗噪声与模糊性的鲁棒性；（5）采用 ReAct 范式，限制 100 轮交互，以 Avg@3 和 Pass@3 为指标，使用 Qwen3-235B 作为 LLM 评判器。

Result: 实验评估了 15 个专有和开源模型。结果显示：即使是最先进的 GPT-5 在 AgentGym2 上 Avg@3 也仅得 46.15，Claude-4.5-Sonnet 约 37.17，Gemini-2.5-Pro 约 20.67；开源模型中表现最好的 Nex-N1-671B 为 32.19，DeepSeek-V3.1 为 21.66。性能随参数规模和计算成本呈上升趋势，但增加交互轮次未带来扩展效应。智能体后训练可显著提升性能（Nex-N1-32B 和 Nex-N1-671B 较基座模型分别提升约 9.16 和 10.53 分）。细粒度分析揭示主要失败模式为：分析错误（24.0%）、探索不足（22.8%）、确认偏差（复杂工具使用场景占 24.7%）、指令误解（数据分析场景占 27.0%）以及深度搜索中因探索不足而过早终止（35.2%）。消融实验表明，隐藏信息检索、工具发现和模糊/带偏噪声这三类去理想化因素均是性能下降的关键来源。

Conclusion: AgentGym2 揭示了当前 SOTA LLM 智能体在真实世界应用需求之间存在巨大差距，凸显了在推理分析、开放世界探索、工具发现与组合以及噪声鲁棒性等方面的不足。该工作为未来构建更鲁棒、更实用的智能体提供了重要基准和方向指引。

Abstract: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are ubiquitous and agents must proactively explore the environment to uncover new tools. To bridge this gap, we present AgentGym2, a new evaluation framework with task instances grounded in real-world end-to-end working demands. Beyond reasoning and planning, it measures agents' ability to execute end-to-end procedures, discover tools via exploration, compose tools for unseen tasks, and remain robust to noisy and underspecified information. Experiments on 15 proprietary and open-source models show that even SOTA systems like Gemini and GPT-5 struggle on AgentGym2, revealing a substantial gap between the capability of current agents and the demands of real-world applications.

</details>


### [651] [CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05177)
*Vipul Patel,Anirudh Deodhar,Dagnachew Birru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CP-WSP 是一个基于 CP-SAT 的声明式人员排班框架，通过 JSON 配置支持 14 个硬约束（结构上不可违反）和 15 个软目标（加权惩罚优化），共 29 个约束，远超现有系统 6-12 个约束的行业平均水平。核心贡献包括：(1) 三变量班次窗口分解 (x=w-b) 实现强制休息调度与中点控制；(2) 锐度加权工作量公平性；(3) 30 分钟到 2 小时的多粒度时间分辨率；(4) 周间排班稳定性；(5) 网格偏移预处理技术支持跨午夜班次；(6) 36 配置可复现基准测试套件。在 INRC-II 基准上，n005w4 达到证明最优（目标值 118，gap 0.0%，104 秒），所有实例零硬约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人员排班是 NP-hard 组合优化问题，需同时满足劳动法规、覆盖需求、员工偏好和运营目标。现有 CP 公式通常仅建模 6-12 个约束且采用班次级粒度，缺乏对以下关键特性的显式支持：强制休息调度与中点放置控制、锐度加权工作量公平性、子班次时间粒度、跨周排班稳定性，以及 24 小时运营中常见的跨午夜班次模式。启发式方法将法规编码为惩罚项而非硬约束，可能产生违反休息或不可用性要求的排班；增加新劳动法规需修改求解器代码，对运营团队而言摩擦成本高。

Method: 1) **三变量班次窗口分解**：将传统单一二元变量 x[e,d,s] 分解为 (x,w,b)，其中 w 表示班次窗口、b 表示休息，x=w-b 区分三种可行状态（off-duty/active/break），实现不可用单二元变量表达的约束类（如 H10 连续班次、H11 强制休息、H12 休息并发限制、S11 休息中点性）。2) **硬/软约束分离**：14 个硬约束通过 CP-SAT 结构化强制（违反在结构上不可能），15 个软目标通过统一加权惩罚函数 Z = Σa_i·w_i·f_i(X) 优化，消除惩罚方法的可行性-最优性张力。3) **网格偏移预处理**：通过最优偏移 Δ* = argmin_Δ max_t(end(t,Δ)-start(t,Δ)) 将跨午夜班次（如 22:00-07:00）映射到单一日历日，无需结构模型变更。4) **声明式 JSON 配置**：Constraint_Activation、Constraint_Weights、Operational_Rules 三段式 JSON 架构，无需修改求解器代码即可增删约束和调整权重。5) **基于 OR-Tools CP-SAT v9.12**：16 并行 worker、LNS/RINS/RENS 策略、完整预求解（缩减 60-70% 模型规模）。

Result: **INRC-II 基准**（10 实例，5-80 名护士）：小时级粒度下所有实例零硬约束违反，模型线性扩展至 179,800 变量和 351,425 约束；班次级粒度下 n005w4 达到证明最优（目标值 118，gap 0.0%，104 秒），模型缩减 4.5-6.5 倍，n060w4 目标值从 41,473 降至 579（>99% 改善）。**NRP-23 跨午夜验证**：3 个实例全部产生可行解，网格偏移 Δ=7 正确映射 D/E/N 班次，n010w4 gap 仅 13.6%。**36 配置合成基准**：全部零硬约束违反，≤10 员工实例获得 OPTIMAL 认证，20 员工 7 天实例求解 18.4 秒。**粒度影响**：粗粒度带来约 10 倍加速但建模保真度降低（目标值从 15,240 降至 9,820）。**模型复杂度**：线性扩展约 4,400 变量/员工和 9,400 约束/员工。**约束消融**：完整模型较基线实现 37% 目标改善；工作量公平性 S15 将公平性标准差从 6.2h 降至 2.1h（66% 改善），覆盖成本仅增 0.8%。**权重敏感性**：JSON 权重调整无需重编译，覆盖+ 配置下覆盖率提升至 97.1%。

Conclusion: CP-WSP 通过声明式 JSON 接口、四项核心贡献（声明式约束配置、班次窗口分解、硬/软约束分离、可复现基准套件）和五项新颖能力（强制休息中点控制、锐度加权公平性、多粒度时间分辨率、跨周稳定性、跨午夜班次），将约束覆盖范围扩展至行业平均水平的近三倍。框架在所有评估实例中实现零硬约束违反，证明了通过结构强制实现法规合规的有效性。x=w-b 分解具有普适意义，可推广至任何区分"窗口内-非活动"与"窗口外"状态的问题（如机器维护窗口、车辆停歇）。局限在于线性模型规模（~4,400 变量/员工），超过 50 员工的扩展性可借助 Benders 分解或列生成。未来工作可将静态 JSON 接口扩展为 QuAcq 式交互反馈或基于 LLM 的自然语言约束规范。

Abstract: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives.
